jobs.title: AEM Developer

jobs.title: Applied Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ SPREEAI builds AI virtual try\-on that fashion brands embed in their sites and apps. Every try\-on starts with the same question: did we read the person and the garment correctly? This role owns the computer vision pipelines that answer it, from preprocessing through evaluation, and keeps them reliable in production. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and maintain preprocessing pipelines for try\-on: segmentation, pose estimation, human parsing, and body mapping * Validate and standardize inputs so downstream models get clean, consistent data * Benchmark and integrate new vision models, and measure how they perform on our own evaluation datasets * Run dataset quality checks and fix the failures they surface * Work with ML scientists to move research into pipelines that run every day **Qualifications** ------------------ * Hands\-on production experience in applied computer vision with Python and PyTorch * Experience with segmentation or pose estimation and a record of shipping pipelines, not only research * Comfort owning data quality and evaluation, not just model training * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup, in San Francisco (hybrid) **Why Join SPREEAI?** --------------------- * Real ownership: a small team where the pipelines you build run in production for brand partners * Hard, visible problems: accurate try\-on across a wide range of people and garments SPREEAI is a fast\-growing, innovative AI company at the forefront of fashion and e\-commerce, revolutionizing how consumers engage with fashion through lifelike photorealistic try\-on technology and hyper\-personalized shopping experiences. Our mission is to redefine the retail landscape with cutting\-edge AI solutions that blend high fashion and technology. We thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment where creativity meets technology to drive real impact. If you are passionate about innovation and shaping the future of fashion, SPREEAI offers a platform to make your mark. The pay range for this role is: 145,000 \- 180,000 USD per year (San Francisco, CA)

The company surpassed 100 years in business—a century shaped by an unwavering commitment to its core values of people, ethics, respect, commitment, and excellence. Since its founding in 1925, Higley Construction has partnered with clients to bring their goals and visions to life, consistently guided by honesty, integrity, and mutual respect. At Higley Construction, we build more than buildings — we build trust, relationships, and communities. From the offices where you work, to the schools where you learn, and the hospitals where you heal, we create environments where people can live, work, and thrive. With every project, we go beyond bricks and mortar to connect people and place, delivering spaces that stand the test of time. As a 100% Employee\-Owned Company, we foster a culture of shared success, job stability, and long\-term financial growth for all employees. Within the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), you're building more than a career — you're building ownership. **Position Overview:** The Project Engineer (PE) is an entry\-level position that provides exposure to a wide range of functions within the construction industry and the firm. Through hands\-on involvement in project operations, safety, project controls, estimating, business development, and other aspects of the business, the PE develops a strong understanding of company processes, procedures, and systems while exploring areas that align with their skills and career interests. The PE collaborates with project teams, department leaders, and field personnel, gaining experience in both office and field environments. This role plays a key part in supporting successful project delivery and providing exceptional service to colleagues, owners, owner representatives, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders. It is unlikely that any one individual will possess all of the qualifications and skills outlined below; rather, these represent the company's vision for success in this role. **Responsibilities:** * Demonstrates an understanding of the values and ethics that differentiate Higley Construction in the competitive marketplace. * Understands how to read construction drawings and documents and understand general industry terminology. * Demonstrates a commitment to problem solving, process improvement, and a willingness to contribute to initiatives that may go beyond the scope of his or her position. * Possesses an appreciation of the value of building a professional network of industry and community relationships. * Manages all project engineering duties including managing RFI’s, Submittals, drawing coordination, writing meeting min. and project correspondence. * Plays an active role in maintaining a safe and secure job site. * Assists the PM with change management. * Assists the superintendent with field coordination and subcontractor management. * Performs other related duties as assigned. **Skills and Abilities:** * Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with project teams, clients, subcontractors, and other stakeholders. * Exhibits strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and professional work habits. * Demonstrates a commitment to learning and growth while developing the skills necessary to become a successful project leader. * Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and willing to learn and utilize a variety of construction management software and technology platforms. * Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify issues and develop practical solutions. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. * Demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and a willingness to take on new challenges and responsibilities. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. * Builds and maintains positive working relationships through professionalism, integrity, and a customer\-service mindset. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management or construction\-related degree, or relevant experience. * Although no previous experience is required for this role, 1\-2 years in engineering, construction management, or a related field is a benefit. * A positive if the candidate holds engineering certifications, such as an EIT. * Has completed co\-op work rotations or similar experience. Why Higley Construction? * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – 100% Employee\-Owned * 25 days of Paid Time Off * 9 Paid Holidays​ * Health, Dental, \& Vision Insurance​ * Pet Insurance * Health/Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts​ * 401k Contributions/Match​ * Life Insurance/AD\&D​ * Employee Assi from being under the influence of substances such as drugs or alcohol during work hours. Responsibilities include climbing ladders, working on scaffolding, driving motor vehicles, and walking on roofs or other surfaces commonly found in a construction site environment. **Physical Activities:** This role requires driving to and from office, jobsites, meetings, client locations, events, and other work\-related locations as necessary. It involves remaining in a stationary position—standing or sitting—for extended periods, as well as frequent movement between tasks or worksites, including walking on snow\-covered or icy surfaces. The position requires lifting or adjusting objects, including weights ranging from 30 to 50 pounds without difficulty, as well as performing repetitive motions involving the hands, wrists, or fingers. Use of hands and arms to handle tools, equipment, and materials is frequent, and tasks may involve operating spray test equipment, construction site tools, power tools, machinery, and heavy equipment. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Mission \+ People \+ Culture**: With a corporate **Mission** to *stop disease through technology,* InductiveHealth is the market leader in software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) solutions to public health agencies. Our **People** come from all backgrounds and walks of life ranging from world class experts in epidemiology, informatics, and disease surveillance to engineers and product teams building high performance, modern solutions. Mission \+ People are unified around a virtual first **Culture** centered around teamwork, relentless focus on client outcomes, and individual accountability. **Why work at InductiveHealth?** 1\. **Motivation**: We value initiative\-takers and self\-starters who want to contribute to the success of our Team and client outcomes. 2\. **Curiosity**: Seeking to understand and comprehend is critical \- we expect and encourage questions to master job duties and grow professionally. 3\. **Organization**: We are a Team. This means we hold each other accountable and have high expectations for performance and outcomes. 4\. **Feedback**: "Open and honest" is part of our corporate values that builds a culture of professional growth to support client success. 5\. **Impact**: Your individual contributions will stop the spread of disease and improve individual, community, and population health outcomes. As part of a collaborative, agile team, you'll work closely with data architects, integration engineers, data scientists, and product stakeholders to deliver solutions that directly impact public health outcomes. data systems. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating data pipelines in Azure or AWS, including secure handling of sensitive data (IAM/RBAC, encryption, secrets management). * Experience implementing CI/CD best practices for data pipelines with GitHub and GitHub Actions, including NiFi flow versioning and promotion (NiFi Registry), automated testing, and peer\-reviewed releases. * Able to partner with DevOps/SRE to integrate pipelines into existing tooling (not responsible for overall platform design). * Experience using  ms in production environments. * Familiarity with Master Patient Index (MPI) solutions or data deduplication frameworks. * Bring a proactive mindset: anticipating challenges, designing with scalability and security in mind, and delivering solutions that accelerate time to product. jobs.title: Database Support Engineer (US West)
jobs.description: **About PhoenixAI** PhoenixAI is the Agentic AI Database, purpose\-built to give autonomous AI agents sub\-second access to live enterprise data at massive scale. The platform unifies real\-time and at\-rest data in a single AI\-native engine, combining the speed and concurrency that agentic workloads demand with the governance and deployment flexibility enterprises require to put AI into production. Formerly known as CelerData, PhoenixAI is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Learn more at phoenixdata.ai **Job Overview** ================ We are seeking a talented Database Support Engineer to join our team and play a pivotal role in the sales cycle for our Agentic Database. You will be working on the post\-sales side — driving onboarding, deployment, adoption, and long\-term customer success. This customer\-facing role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a passion for solving complex data challenges throughout the customer journey. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== As a Database Support Engineer, you'll be the ongoing technical point of contact for customers, ensuring they realize sustained value from PhoenixAI's Agentic Database, while flexibly supporting the sales team as presales needs arise. Your responsibilities include: * **Onboarding \& Deployment:** Guide new customers through implementation and deployment, ensuring solutions architectured during the sales cycle are realized in production. * **Adoption \& Expansion:** Serve as the ongoing technical point of contact post\-sale, driving product adoption, resolving technical issues, and identifying opportunities for expansion. * **Customer Advocacy:** Build trusted, long\-term relationships with customer technical stakeholders, **understanding their business problems and technical constraints deeply enough to represent their interests internally.** * **Technical Health \& Optimization**: Proactively monitor account technical health, troubleshoot production issues, and recommend architecture or configuration improvements as customer needs evolve. * **Feedback loop to product/engineering:** Relay patterns and pain points seen across customers back to the core engineering/product team * **PoC Support to Presales:** Assist with the design or execution of Proof of Concepts for prospects when presales bandwidth requires it. * **Documentation:** Keep detailed records of evaluations—covering use cases, challenges, PoC plans, and outcomes—to refine our process and inform product enhancements to PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with sales to align technical discussions with business goals, address objections, and close deals, while gathering customer insights to shape PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database roadmap with product and engineering teams. * **Marketing Support \& Thought Leadership:** Boost PhoenixAI’s presence by delivering webinars, staffing conference booths, speaking at user groups, and writing blogs on Agentic AI use cases and best practices. **Qualifications** ================== * **Experience:** 3\+ years in a pre\-sales and/or post\-sales role such as solutions engineering, technical consulting or customer success engineering, ideally within the data analytics, database, or cloud infrastructure space. **We are flexible on experience requirements and welcome outstanding Computer Science graduates from strong universities.** * **Technical Expertise:** + Hands\-on experience of OLAP workloads, query optimization, and data modeling (e.g., star schema, snowflake schema) + Proficiency in SQL. + Deep understanding of distributed data processing system theory. + Familiar with at least one of the public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) * **Ambition \& Curiosity:** A driven, inquisitive mindset—eager to learn PhoenixAI Agentic Database product’s intricacies, tackle tough challenges, and grow into the role, even if starting with less experience or specific skills. * **Communication Skills:** Proven ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders, from engineers to C\-level executives. * **Problem\-Solving:** Adept at troubleshooting technical challenges during PoCs and adapting solutions to meet unique customer needs. * **Sales \& Customer Success Mindset:** Experience supporting sales and post\-sales teams in technical evaluations, with a track record of securing technical wins and driving revenue growth. * **Bonus Points:** + Knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) + Experience with streaming processing systems (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.) Every PhoenixAI hire is held to the same operating bar: own the outcome, seek truth and build trust, move fast with judgment, work AI\-first, and raise the bar without ego. The base salary range for this role in the San Francisco Bay Area is **$80,000 to $200,000**. The offer also includes bonus, equity and PhoenixAI's full benefits package. Where you land in the range depends on your experience, scope, and interview results. *PhoenixAI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Director of Engineering and Product Developme
jobs.description: Director of Engineering \& Product Development — INOX Solar Americas About INOX Solar Americas INOX Solar Americas is a U.S. manufacturer of solar PV cells and modules, building a fully domestic supply chain for utility\-scale, commercial, community and residential solar. The company is part of the renewable energy platform of Inox Clean Energy and the India\-based INOXGFL Group. In April 2026 the company completed its roughly $750 million acquisition of Boviet Solar's U.S. operations, including a 3 GW module plant in Greenville, North Carolina. A further 3 GW of cell manufacturing capacity at the site is planned for 2027\. Customer demand is moving fast. In September 2026 the company announced two utility\-scale supply agreements totaling about 1\.57 GW (767 MW and 800 MW) for projects in North Carolina, Texas, Colorado and Georgia, using its Vega Series bifacial modules built on Galaxion N\-type cells, with deliveries starting in 2027\. Position Summary The Director of Engineering \& Product Development owns the technical roadmap for INOX Solar Americas' cell and module products, from new product design through certification, factory industrialization and field performance. This leader builds and runs the engineering organization that will take the Greenville site from module assembly to an integrated cell\-and\-module operation, while keeping every product bankable, certifiable and compliant with U.S. domestic\-content and supply\-chain rules. Product strategy and roadmap * Own the multi\-year product roadmap for the Vega Series modules and Galaxion N\-type cells, aligned with utility\-scale, C\&I, community and residential customer needs. * Translate market, customer and policy inputs (domestic content, FEOC/PFE rules, tariffs) into product requirements, bill\-of\-materials choices and launch plans. * Benchmark competing technologies (TOPCon, HJT, back\-contact, glass\-glass formats) and recommend where INOX should invest. New product development and introduction * Lead new module designs from concept through prototype, qualification and mass\-production release, using a stage\-gate process with clear cost, efficiency and reliability targets. * Drive design\-for\-manufacturing and cost\-down programs across cells, glass, frames, encapsulants, backsheets and junction boxes. * Qualify alternate and domestic suppliers for critical materials to strengthen domestic\-content value and supply resilience. Technical Documentation Development * Develop PV module and cell datasheets, PAN files, BOM, GA drawings etc * Conduct third party lab verification of PAN files and relevant technical documents * Benchmark products against competition and industry standard to keep the documents up to date Domestic Cell Integration * Work with the cell manufacturing team to develop technical specifications, testing plan and commercialization of the cells from the company’s US cell plant * Integrate cell and module engineering so cell bins, power classes and module designs are optimized together. Certification, reliability and quality * Own product certification to UL 61730, IEC 61215/61730 and related standards, and manage relationships with test labs and independent engineers. * Own and lead bankability audits, accelerated\-stress and extended reliability testing (e.g., PVEL/RETC\-style programs) to support bankability and warranty terms. * Lead root\-cause analysis and corrective action for production defects and field returns. jobs.title: ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **About Coinflow** Coinflow is the next\-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI\-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud \& chargeback indemnity, global pay\-ins, multi\-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide. Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi\-billion\-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest\-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments. Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring an MLOps Engineer to own the platform that takes our fraud, risk, and payments models from notebook to production. You'll build the pipelines, serving infrastructure, and monitoring that let us score every transaction in real time, retrain safely. Our models sit in the authorization path of real money, so latency, reliability, and explainability matter as much as accuracy. You'll be hands\-on with AI\-native tooling: we use AI as a force multiplier for building pipelines, writing evals, and automating the boring parts of model operations. If you want to be one of the first ML infrastructure engineers building this way at a fast\-growing PSP, you'll fit in well here. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Real\-Time Model Serving:** Build and operate the inference layer that scores transactions in the authorization path. Hit tight latency budgets, design safe fallbacks when a model or feature is unavailable, and make sure a model outage never becomes a payments outage. **ML Pipelines \& Feature Store:** Own training, validation, and deployment pipelines end to end. Build reproducible feature pipelines from our transaction, device, and chargeback data, with point\-in\-time correctness so offline training matches online scoring. **Model Deployment \& Rollout:** Make shipping a model boring. Versioning, registries, shadow mode, champion/challenger, canary rollouts, and one\-click rollback. Every change is gated by evals, not vibes. **Monitoring \& Drift Detection:** Instrument models the way we instrument services. Track latency, score distributions, feature drift, approval rates, and fraud and chargeback outcomes, wired into our observability stack with alerts that fire on real problems. **Third\-Party Model Integration:** Integrate and evaluate external fraud and risk vendors alongside our own models. Run parallel and shadow testing, compare performance on our data, and give the team a clear answer on what to trust. **Merchant\-Facing Risk Tooling:** Power the data and scoring behind our merchant\-facing risk products, so merchants can see risky customers and set their own blocking rules on top of our signals. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years in MLOps, ML infrastructure, or ML platform engineering, ideally at a fintech, payments company, or other regulated environment * You've run models in production with real latency and uptime requirements, not just trained them. Experience with real\-time inference in a transaction or decisioning path is a big plus * Strong Python and solid production engineering habits. Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript/Node, since that's where most of our services live * Hands\-on experience with ML pipeline and serving tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex, BentoML, Feast, or similar) and the judgment to know when not to use them * Solid infrastructure skills: containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud provider * Data engineering chops: you can build reliable feature pipelines over operational, warehouse, and streaming data, and you understand training/serving skew * Experience monitoring models in production: drift, calibration, and tying model metrics back to business outcomes like fraud loss and approval rates * Familiarity with fraud, risk, or credit modeling, and with explaining model behavior to non\-ML stakeholders like banks and auditors * Comfort working with AI\-native tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start * A bias toward shipping. We'd rather have a working v1 of a model pipeline today than a perfect platform next quarter The base salary range for this role is $120,000 \- $180,000 USD \+ equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs. Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross\-border payments market. Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Reliability Lab Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Reliability Lab Engineer plans, executes, documents, and improves product and process reliability evaluations for SMT assemblies, repaired PCBAs, and assembled server systems. The role validates product robustness, investigates failure mechanisms, supports new product introduction (NPI) and engineering changes, and converts laboratory findings into corrective and preventive actions. Testing includes electrical, environmental, thermal, mechanical, and operational stress evaluations appropriate to product and customer requirements, with particular attention to high\-density GPU/server platforms, power delivery, connectors, and liquid\-cooling interfaces where applicable. **LEVEL I – Reliability Lab Engineer I** **Key Responsibilities** * Execute approved reliability test plans for SMT components, PCBAs, repaired boards, and server assemblies under engineering supervision. * Prepare samples, fixtures, test setups, labeling, and traceability records; verify test conditions and acceptance criteria before starting. * Operate environmental chambers, thermal cycling equipment, temperature/humidity loggers, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs, oscilloscopes, and data acquisition tools as qualified. * Perform functional checks before, during, and after stress testing; capture failure symptoms, photographs, measurements, and test logs. * Support thermal profiling, burn\-in, power cycling, vibration/shock, and humidity exposure tests when specified by approved methods. * Follow ESD controls, equipment safety requirements, calibration status checks, and laboratory work instructions. * Enter test results and deviations in approved laboratory reports and MES/QMS systems; segregate failed samples for analysis. * Assist with initial failure isolation and collaborate with SMT, Repair, Manufacturing, and Quality teams. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Materials, Reliability Engineering, or related discipline. * 1–3 years of experience in electronics testing, manufacturing, PCBA repair, or laboratory operations. * Basic understanding of SMT solder joints, BGA/QFN components, PCBAs, server hardware, ESD protection, and test documentation. * Ability to interpret drawings, schematics, test procedures, and equipment measurement data. **LEVEL II – Reliability Lab Engineer II** **Additional Responsibilities** * Develop and validate reliability test plans, sample sizes, test conditions, and pass/fail criteria with Design, Manufacturing, and Customer Quality teams. * Lead environmental and operational evaluations such as temperature cycling, thermal shock, damp heat, burn\-in, power cycling, and vibration/shock as applicable. * Analyze SMT/PCBA failure mechanisms including solder fatigue, cracked joints, head\-in\-pillow, component damage, intermittent connections, and repair\-induced defects. * Investigate server\-level failures involving power distribution, thermal management, fans, interconnects, GPU boards, and liquid\-cooling leakage or interface integrity when applicable. * Perform failure analysis using electrical troubleshooting, microscopy, X\-ray, cross\-sectioning, or external analytical laboratories as appropriate. * Apply statistical methods, Weibull/life\-data analysis where justified, trend charts, and design\-of\-experiments principles to interpret reliability results. * Lead structured root cause analysis (5 Why, fishbone, 8D) and verify corrective\-action effectiveness following repeat failures or RMA trends. * Coordinate laboratory equipment calibration, preventive maintenance, method validation, and controlled records for audit readiness. * Support NPI qualification, process changes, repair\-process validation, and customer reliability reporting. **Qualifications** * 3–6 years in electronics reliability, SMT/PCBA manufacturing, server assembly, or repair engineering. * Hands\-on experience with environmental chambers, electrical instrumentation, and structured failure analysis. * Working knowledge of IPC workmanship and repair standards, ESD controls, and risk\-based qualification methods. * Proficiency in technical reporting, statistical analysis, and cross\-functional problem solving. **LEVEL III – Senior Reliability Lab Engineer III** **Additional Responsibilities** * Own the reliability laboratory roadmap, qualification strategy, test capability, capacity planning, and technical standards for SMT, PCBA repair, and server platforms. * Define risk\-based reliability qualification matrices for high\-density GPU boards, high\-power systems, BGA assemblies, connectors, and liquid\-cooled server configurations. * Lead accelerated stress and life testing strategies, reliability modeling, and failure\-mechanism\-driven test selection; document assumptions and limitations. * Approve test methods, engineering protocols, acceptance criteria, and technical reports in alignment with customer and product requirements. * Direct complex multi\-disciplinary investigations of field returns, recurring RMA issues, and latent failures; integrate findings into design and process improvements. * Partner with R\&D, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and Repair to establish reliability design rules, screening strategies, and corrective actions. * Develop laboratory investment plans for chambers, thermal measurement, power cycling, vibration, inspection, and data systems; qualify external labs as needed. * Lead customer technical reviews and audits; maintain traceability, data integrity, and compliance with applicable QMS and ESD requirements. * Mentor junior engineers and technicians, establish technical training, and drive reliability KPIs such as test completion, failure recurrence, and closure effectiveness. **Qualifications** * 6–10\+ years of high\-reliability electronics engineering, including significant hands\-on laboratory and failure analysis experience. * Demonstrated leadership in server, GPU, SMT/PCBA, or repair reliability qualification programs. * Advanced understanding of thermal, electrical, mechanical, material, and solder\-interconnect failure mechanisms. * Experience with reliability statistics, accelerated testing, customer qualification, and technical team development. **COMMON PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS** * Safe, repeatable testing with complete sample traceability and calibrated equipment. * On\-time, technically sound reports with clear conclusions, risks, and recommended actions. * Timely escalation of critical failures and documented closure of corrective actions. * Continuous improvement of laboratory methods, coverage, and cross\-functional learning.

He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI\-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.* **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Applied AI Engineer** to lead the technical design and delivery of high\-impact AI initiatives across our products. ----------------------- * Agentic AI systems that autonomously execute complex, multi\-step business workflows. * AI\-powered product experiences combining LLMs, retrieval, backend services, and human oversight. * Retrieval and knowledge systems that connect AI agents to organization\-specific information. * Backend services, APIs, and tool integrations enabling AI systems to safely interact with production applications. * Evaluation, observability, and testing frameworks that improve the quality, consistency, and reliability of AI behavior. * Orchestration systems and infrastructure supporting scalable, production\-grade AI applications. * Engineering tooling and practices that improve development velocity, software quality, and operational reliability. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Technical Leadership \& Delivery** * Lead small teams of engineers in the design, development, and delivery of complex, high\-impact AI initiatives. * Own the technical execution of projects from initial design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. * Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear technical approaches, actionable engineering tasks, and achievable delivery milestones. * Drive architectural discussions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and establish sound implementation strategies. * Coordinate engineering efforts, observability, latency, and cost management. * Demonstrated commitment to software engineering best practices, including automated testing, code review, CI/CD, system design, and maintainability. * judgment, debugging skills, and the ability to navigate complex systems and ambiguous requirements. * Ability to balance hands\-on engineering contributions with technical leadership responsibilities. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across engineering, product, and business teams. * Experience operating in fast\-moving environments where ownership, adaptability, and execution are essential. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, or jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer — AI-Native Data Platform
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Aarden is a land intelligence platform that helps landowners, investors, and developers figure out what a piece of land can actually be used for, and how to market it. We turn messy parcel, infrastructure, market, community, and ecological data into clear, bankable answers for land\-dependent assets. Our goal is to become the default decision layer for land: helping physical projects start in places where they can be built and supported for decades. We’ve built out a suite of data products to support that goal — pipelines, databases, and AI/ML models that power our maps and AI agents. We have strong product\-market fit, and we're now focused on hardening and scaling our data systems. That’s where you come in. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a high\-autonomy senior data engineer to own and evolve two types of assets central to Aarden’s future: our core datasets and the pipeline that keeps them current. The datasets bring together property data, geospatial data, and AI\-derived intelligence to power our insights and products. The pipeline makes it efficient and reliable to refresh, expand, and improve those datasets as our business grows. You’ll be responsible for the quality of the data and the systems behind it, with opportunities to contribute directly to our user\-facing product. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Own and operate the data platform** * Own the day\-to\-day reliability and operation of our data infrastructure, including S3, Iceberg, Postgres, Lambda, PMTiles, and raster datasets. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve pipeline performance, observability, and data quality. * Extend existing pipelines to support new data sources and transformations. * Use automation and AI\-assisted workflows where they make operations more reliable or efficient. **Partner across the team** * Work with product to build datasets that support new features. * Co\-develop intelligence products with the analytics team. * Keep pipeline and dataset documentation useful and current. **Evolve the platform thoughtfully** * Stay current on data and geospatial technologies relevant to our stack. Identify opportunities to improve it, run focused experiments, and recommend changes when the benefits justify the tradeoffs. **You might be a good fit if you have…** ---------------------------------------- **Must\-have** * Owned the operation of one or more production data pipelines for a continuous period of at least 12 months * Experience with relational databases and lakehouse architectures * Strong Python skills; Experience with workflow orchestration (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, or similar) * Curiosity and excitement about AI and the impact it can have on our ways of working as developers * Comfort working in a git\-based, CI\-friendly workflow * Minimum of 5 years of professional experience **Strongly preferred** * Experience with geospatial data and associated tooling (GDAL, GeoParquet, PostGIS, Apache Sedona, or similar) * Experience working in full\-stack environments, where your work can directly impact the application layer * Comfortable with PySpark or similar distributed data processing * Experience with Apache Sedona or other cloud spatial\-compute platforms * Experience building observability/logging layers for data pipelines (not just app services) * Experience with socioeconomic, property, parcel, real estate, or land data **Nice To have** * Experience using AI agents to improve data architecture in a real production codebase * Experience in real estate/land, energy, forestry, or agriculture tech * Experience in data scraping; ideally via agents. **Our Stack** ------------- **Languages:** Python and SQL. TypeScript/Node is a plus for our Application layer and AWS ingest paths. **Orchestration \& compute** * **Prefect 3** for pipeline orchestration (YAML/config\-driven flows, retries, logging) * **Coiled** for elastic EC2 workers on GDAL\-heavy and batch Python jobs * **Wherobots** (managed Apache Sedona / PySpark) for large\-scale spatial joins, parcel ingest, and lakehouse work **Data lake \& formats:** Apache Iceberg, Cloud\-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), and PMTiles. Queried with PySpark and DuckDB. **Geospatial:** GDAL, rasterio, GeoPandas, and tippecanoe. Large\-scale spatial work runs on Sedona/Spark via Wherobots. **Databases \& serving:** PostgreSQL \+ PostGIS (and pgvector on the app side) as the production store. **Working at Aarden** --------------------- Aarden is a high\-trust, high\-output team. We’re striving to be intentional about our team growth. This allows us to test the outer boundaries of our individual capabilities, while also going deeper on developer tooling and support. You’ll work hard here, and we’ve got your back. Practically, this means you’ll be asked to take on large projects, have a high bar of expectations to meet, and have a strong support system to help you meet that high bar. That support system includes: * **At least 2 in\-person days per week at our office in Capitol Hill \|** We’ve found that while heads\-down time at home is fantastic for task\-related productivity, in\-person time is magic for longer\-form productivity. Our in\-person days are used to plan, troubleshoot, and check\-in with each other on progress and questions. Expect team lunches and whiteboarding. * **Focused ownership in your role \|** The rest of the team is here to help you and cares about the evolution of our data products. With that said, we’ll be looking to you to own your lane, go deep, and own the development of these products. * **Dedicated monthly AI tooling budget \|** We’re in a golden era of AI\-powered developer tooling. We strongly encourage augmenting your output with AI tools, and have a dedicated \& flexible budget for every team member to support that setup. We care about *what* you ship, not *how*. **Details** ----------- * **Reports to:** CTO * **Compensation:** $150,000 \- $180,000 based on skills and experience * **Location / remote policy:** Seattle\-based, able to commute to our office in Capitol Hill Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- Everyone knows the feeling of opening something unexpected and loving it. IcyBox turns that feeling into a business. We move fast, sweat the details, and are still writing our playbook. **Our Values** -------------- * **Move Fast, Build Right:** Ship today, fix tomorrow. * **Own the Gap:** If nobody owns it, we step in. * **Clarity Is a Gift:** Turn noise into decisions and action. * **Trust Over Title:** Follow\-through beats position. * **Say the Real Thing:** Hard conversations happen early. * **Do the Unglamorous Work:** No task is beneath us. **About the Role** You’ll own our internal operations platform. It’s the system every team uses to run the business: merchandising builds and prices boxes in it, operations ships items and manages stock, finance reconciles payments and payouts, growth runs promotions, affiliates and experiments, and support helps users. This is a full\-stack product role. You’ll talk to internal users, decide what to build, and ship it end to end, usually within days. This role is in person at our New York City office, five days a week. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build features across a Rust backend and a React frontend, from database schema to UI. * Build tools for operational workflows such as catalog and inventory management, pricing, order fulfilment and customer support. * Turn data into decisions with dashboards, reporting and analytics built on our data warehouse. * Integrate the platform with external services and keep those integrations reliable as they scale. * Make the system safe to operate: role\-based access, audit trails, safe migrations and performance under real production load. * Work closely with the teams who use what you build, learn how they actually work, and replace manual processes and spreadsheets with fast, simple tools. **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with real experience on both backend and frontend. * Strong backend skills in Rust, or in another typed language (Go, Kotlin, TypeScript, etc.) plus a clear interest in moving to Rust. * Solid React \+ TypeScript skills, including data fetching and state management (e.g. TanStack Query) and building data\-dense UIs: tables, filters, forms, charts. * Strong PostgreSQL / SQL: schema design, migrations, query performance. * Product sense. You ask why an operator needs something before building it, and you care that internal tools are fast and pleasant to use. * Comfort owning features end to end in a small team with high velocity. **Nice to Have** * Experience with internal tools, admin platforms or ERP\-like systems at an e\-commerce, marketplace or fintech company * Data warehouse experience (Snowflake, dbt) or building analytics and experimentation tooling * Experience working on the AWS platform * Experience using AI coding tools effectively in your daily workflow. * Startup or high\-growth company experience Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Backend Software Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: **Senior/Staff Backend Software Engineer – Data Platform** ========================================================== **About Us** ------------ GridCARE is the pioneer of **Power Acceleration** — a new category solving the most critical constraint in AI's growth trajectory: **immediate access to power**. As demand for computing skyrockets, access to energy has become the defining bottleneck in the AI infrastructure race. While leading tech companies invest billions in speculative, long\-term solutions that may take decades to arrive, GridCARE's **Energize platform** uses physics\-based AI to identify and activate gigawatts of hidden capacity in today's electric grid — enabling hyperscalers, data center developers, and utilities to power AI infrastructure years sooner than conventional approaches and without costly upgrades. Founded at Stanford's Doerr School of Sustainability, GridCARE has assembled a world\-class team spanning power systems, AI, and infrastructure, and is backed by leading climate\-tech and deep\-tech investors. **At GridCARE, you will:** * Work at the intersection of AI, energy, and infrastructure — the foundation of the next industrial revolution. * Partner with hyperscalers, developers, and utilities on high\-impact, real\-world deployments. * Help shape a more abundant, efficient, and resilient energy future for the digital era. * Join a company defining a new category — Power Acceleration for AI. * Receive competitive compensation, equity, and benefits in a fast\-growth, mission\-driven environment. *Learn more about GridCARE:* * TechCrunch: GridCARE thinks more than 100 GW of data\-center capacity is hiding in the grid * Utility Dive: Portland General Electric invests in AI\-powered flexibility to speed data\-center connection * GridCARE Raises $64 Million Series A to Create a New Category: Power Acceleration * GridCARE Named a World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer for AI Power Innovation **The Role** ------------ We're hiring a Senior/Staff Backend Software Engineer who has **built and run a data platform before** — and wants to do it again for a problem that matters. You'll be a foundational owner of the platform behind Energize: the shared ingestion, storage, compute, and serving layers that our modeling, product, and customer\-facing teams all build on. This isn't a role for someone who has only consumed a platform. We're looking for an engineer who has designed one: someone who has decided how data enters a system, defined the abstractions other engineers rely on, made the platform reliable enough that teams stop thinking about it, and lived with the consequences of those decisions in production. You'll bring that pattern recognition to GridCARE and set the technical direction for our platform on AWS. You'll also build, monitor, and maintain teams of AI coding agents that accelerate how we develop and deliver software. Orchestration, observability, and scalability are central to the role. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Owning the architecture and roadmap of GridCARE's data platform, treating it as an internal product with clear users, interfaces, and service levels. * Designing how data enters the platform: ingestion architecture for heterogeneous energy and grid sources, the canonical data model, and the contracts that let sources change without breaking downstream consumers. * Building the shared foundations other teams build on — orchestration, storage layers, compute frameworks, and reusable patterns — so modeling and product engineers can ship without reinventing infrastructure. * Developing fast, reliable APIs and distributed processing services that connect energy data, analytical models, and customer workflows. * Establishing platform standards for data quality, lineage, observability, access control, and cost management. * Owning delivery from initial design through deployment and production operation, including on\-call readiness and incident learning. * Building and operating AI coding agent teams, including coordination and evaluation. * Shaping technical decisions, mentoring engineers, and partnering with product and domain experts to understand what the platform needs to support next. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * **Prior data platform experience:** you've been a core builder or technical owner of a data platform used by multiple teams or products — not just pipelines for a single use case. Please be ready to walk us through a platform you built: what you designed, what you'd change, and how it evolved. * Experience making foundational platform decisions — ingestion patterns, data modeling, schema evolution and data contracts, storage and compute layout — and carrying them through growth in data volume, sources, and users. * Experience architecting and operating production backend systems, with clear judgment on design tradeoffs. * Experience with distributed systems, concurrency, failure recovery, and safe migrations. * Hands\-on AWS experience, including deployment automation, monitoring, and secure access management. * Strong Python, SQL, API design, and database modeling skills. * Hands\-on experience with modern backend and data infrastructure, such as Kubernetes, Docker, workflow orchestrators (Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster), dbt, PostgreSQL, cloud warehouses or lakehouses (Redshift, Athena, Snowflake, or Iceberg/Delta), and/or streaming or queuing systems (Kafka, Kinesis, or SQS). * Experience developing ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines into data marts and serving layers. * Experience building and maintaining AI coding agent teams, including task delegation, context management, and evaluation. * Strong testing, debugging, and technical communication skills. ### **Preferred** * **Early\-stage startup experience with a demonstrable deliverable:** you've worked at an early\-stage startup (roughly seed through Series B) and can point to something concrete you shipped there — a platform, product, or system that reached production and that customers or internal teams relied on. Tell us what you built, what it enabled, and how you measured its impact. * Experience taking a data platform from early stage (0 1\) to scale, or re\-architecting an existing platform while keeping it running. * Experience designing self\-serve platform capabilities: templates, SDKs, internal tooling, or developer\-experience improvements that reduced the load on the platform team. * Experience with data governance at the platform level: catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and fine\-grained access control. * Full\-stack development experience, including delivering features across backend services and frontend applications. * Geospatial systems, spatial databases, or location\-based applications. * Experience building agentic AI assistants in production: setup and tool design, guardrails, natural\-language querying and response quality, evaluation, and integration with security and access\-control tooling. * Production data science workflows or infrastructure as code. * Experience in energy, climate tech, or other infrastructure domains. **Your Approach** ----------------- * Think in platforms: you build things once so others don't have to build them many times. * Bring a startup builder's bias for shipping: you scope tightly, deliver something real, and iterate. * Take initiative and turn open\-ended problems into working software. * Balance ambitious ideas with practical engineering judgment. * Learn from domain experts and help others succeed. * Explore new ways to build with AI while taking responsibility for results. **Location** ------------ * Redwood City, CA **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. * Hybrid schedule: 3 days in office for collaboration, 2 days remote for focused work. * Access to leading academic, industry, and government partners in the AI\-energy ecosystem. **Salary Range** ---------------- $184,000 – $284,000 Total (Base \& bonus) This range covers Senior and Staff levels; final level, scope, and compensation will be calibrated to your experience and demonstrated impact. **Join us in tackling one of the most important infrastructure challenges of our time — enabling the energy foundation for the age of AI.**

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Sr. Software Engineer, Agents **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Head of Engineering ### **About Plug** Plug is the marketplace for used electric vehicles. Consumers get an instant cash offer backed by battery\-health data, and dealers across the US bid in real time on that inventory. Former Tesla executives founded Plug in 2023\. We’ve raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. ### **Why Plug** * You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You’ll be part of an AI\-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes. ### **The Opportunity** Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. What we need now is someone who can turn a stream of real operational problems into agents that work reliably, one after another. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build and ship agents and multi\-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling. * Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them. * Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible. * Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them. * Monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human\-review rates. Fix what breaks and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time. * Ship full\-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them. * Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Machine Learning Research
jobs.description: A\-Alpha Bio is an early\-stage, rapidly growing biotechnology platform company headquartered in Seattle, WA. We are focused on building the foundational data layer for AI\-driven protein engineering. We provide biopharma companies and model builders with access to ground truth experimental datasets, including affinity and structure, for training, benchmarking and validating AI protein models. In parallel, we apply our data and models directly with select partners to engineer next\-generation dual\-specific and molecular glue therapeutics, and to discover and optimize differentiated biologics. ***A\-Alpha Bio is headquartered in Seattle, WA, but remote applicants are welcome to apply. Candidates must reside in the United States.*** **Starting Salary Range:** $164,000 \- $206,000 annually **Exemption Status:** Exempt **Location Expectations**: Remote\-Eligible (expected travel to Seattle HQ once per quarter) **Reporting To**: Director, Machine Learning Research **Role Description** A\-Alpha Bio is seeking a Senior Scientist, Machine Learning Research to turn large\-scale protein interaction data into insights and models that advance antibody and protein engineering. The role focuses on developing innovative AI/ML methods that learn from millions of protein\-protein interaction data points to predict and engineer protein binding. The Senior Scientist will take a technical lead on challenging AI/ML projects within the ML Research team, including *de novo* design of antibodies or minibinders as well as models for affinity prediction and developability optimization. The Senior Scientist will work together with other ML Scientists to design and execute experiments (both *in silico* and *in vitro* with the help of wet\-lab colleagues), support long\-term AI/ML research initiatives, and communicate scientific results to the ML Research team and broader company, as well as to external collaborators and partners. **Key Responsibilities** * **Develop AI/ML methods.** Design and implement novel AI/ML approaches for the prediction and engineering of protein\-protein interactions, drawing on experimental measurements, protein sequences, and structural information, and use these approaches to solve challenges in drug discovery and optimization. * **Evaluate rigorously.** Design benchmarks and evaluations that assess model performance, uncertainty, and generalization, using appropriate baselines and guarding against data leakage so that conclusions are scientifically defensible and reproducible. * **Deliver results.** Generate deliverables (such as data packages, model executables, and technical reports) to a level of quality suitable for use within the company and by external collaborators, in accordance with assigned timelines. * **Contribute code and data.** Expertly contribute to the shared company codebase and database, helping teammates understand judgements and decisions, authoring and reviewing merge requests, documenting methods, organizing data, and ensuring that new capabilities and data are effectively rolled out to the rest of the team. * **Advance our scientific capabilities.** Apply scientific discipline and critical thinking to propose and analyze experiments, stay current with emerging technologies and trends, and identify and develop innovative computational approaches that increase the value of AlphaSeq data for protein engineering. * **Lead, collaborate, and communicate.** Take a technical leadership role on assigned projects interfacing across departments, provide mentorship to colleagues, help write and publish technical blog articles or scientific papers, and represent A\-Alpha Bio publicly at conferences and/or in scientific discussions with key collaborators. **Qualifications \& Experience** Required * PhD in a quantitative or life sciences field (biology, chemistry, physics, computer science, etc.) with 4\+ years of professional experience in software development and AI/ML, including 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with AI/ML using biological sequence and/or structure data; or Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or life sciences field with 12\+ years of relevant experience, including 6\+ years of professional experience in software development and AI/ML; or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong experience with deep learning, spanning modern software frameworks (PyTorch, JAX), model architectures and approaches (variational autoencoders \[VAEs], transformers, graph neural networks \[GNNs], diffusion, and flow matching), and common protein engineering tasks (protein language models, inverse folding, and protein structure prediction) * Strong proficiency with data science best practices, including wrangling and transforming data, model training, model selection, cross\-validation, and deployment at scale * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain methods, findings, and limitations to computational and experimental audiences, as well as to external collaborators and partners Preferred * Expertise with cloud computing, particularly Amazon Web Services (AWS) * Proficiency with best practices using large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI tools to assist in code generation and modeling * Experience analyzing large experimental datasets and making scientifically defensible decisions about data quality, statistical methods, and interpretation * Thorough understanding of concepts from biology, chemistry, and physics that govern molecular properties and interactions * Familiarity with the state of the art in antibody engineering, protein engineering, synthetic biology, or other high\-throughput biology environments with particular emphasis on the relationship between sequence, structure, and function In 2018, A\-Alpha Bio spun out of the University of Washington's Institute for Protein Design and Center for Synthetic Biology – both communities filled with brilliant and highly entrepreneurial scientists. Since the company's inception, we have built and scaled AlphaSeq, our high\-throughput platform for quantitatively measuring protein\-protein interactions at unprecedented scale. What began as a technology for generating large, standardized affinity datasets has grown into a broader data engine for AI\-driven protein engineering. New members of the team should expect a fast\-paced, highly dynamic, and interdisciplinary work environment. We are building a diverse, meritocratic, and supportive team that shares our values of speaking the truth, shooting for the moon, taking the reins, playing for the team, and improving the world. A\-Alpha Bio is headquartered in a custom designed lab and office space in downtown Seattle's Belltown neighborhood. We are fortunate to be situated in a region that is renowned for its premier outdoor activities, including hiking, biking, climbing, skiing, kayaking, sailing, and more. At A\-Alpha, you'll find many who love the outdoors, but also gamers, amateur chefs, explorers, sports fans, bakers, crafters, photographers, brewers, jetsetters, animal lovers, and artists. Whatever your passions, you belong at A\-Alpha Bio!

This role serves in a leadership position that will continuously modernize ADP’s Internet policies, identifying weak control/policies and engineering relevant mitigating controls, that drive towards reducing operational risks associated with data in motion and at rest. Like what you see?**Apply now!** **Learn more about ADP at tech.adp.com/careers** **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** **Key Responsibilities:** * Assess Secure Web Gateway (SWG), next\-generation firewall, URL filtering, SaaS inline, and related SSE controls against ADP policies and standards; identify configuration, coverage, and enforcement gaps. Govern access exceptions, allow/block lists, inspection exclusions, and rule lifecycle reviews, confirming business justification, least privilege, accountable ownership, expiration, and evidence of approval. jobs.description: Agfa HealthCare, is a division of the Agfa\-Gevaert Group which is headquartered in Mortsel, Belgium and traded on Euronext Brussels (AGFB). jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY DESCRIPTION** At AirLife, we are dedicated to improving the quality of every breath. *Excellence with Every Breath* is not just a tag line, but the way we work and take care of our customers. With a mindset to evolve, innovate, and grow, we are a premier manufacturer of the highest\-quality and market\-leading breathing consumables. This growth philosophy has positioned us to increase our global footprint and business reach, impacting even more people around the world. Our expanding family of the most trusted brands offers a product portfolio that spans the continuum of care from first responder to home care, with safety, patient comfort, and clinical performance in mind. Collective expertise allows us to provide quality products and experiences to our patients, customers, and our people. Our values of Customer first, Differentiate with our People, Bias for Action, Continuous Improvement and Accountability define who we are and how we work. Join us! **POSITION SUMMARY** The Data Engineer is the hands\-on builder and operator of AirLife’s Databricks Lakehouse, reporting to the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager. This role builds, operates, and improves the pipelines that bring data from SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Salesforce, and other operational systems into the Lakehouse, and applies the governance, architecture, and cost standards the Manager defines. As AirLife’s analytics and AI platform matures, this role is the execution layer that keeps pipelines reliable, documented, and ready for business and AI consumption. **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:** * Hands\-on, production experience building on Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows / Lakeflow Jobs, and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines. * Strong Python and PySpark for data engineering; advanced SQL. * Experience ingesting ERP and CRM data into a lakehouse; SAP ECC required or strongly preferred, Microsoft Dynamics GP and Salesforce a plus. * Working knowledge of Azure data services: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Azure Key Vault. * Software engineering practices applied to data: Git, pull requests and code review, CI/CD (Databricks Asset Bundles, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions), and automated data quality tests. * Practical understanding of Unity Catalog access controls, row\- and column\-level security, and data classification. * Experience implementing medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and dimensional modeling for analytics consumption. * Working knowledge of data cataloging, lineage, and metadata management practices. * Awareness of data privacy and classification expectations in an FDA\-regulated / ISO 13485 manufacturing environment. * Ability to read someone else's pipeline, figure out what it does and why, and take ownership of it. **Preferred:** * Building data products for AI consumption: Databricks Genie / AI/BI, Databricks Apps, vector search, or serving curated data to LLM\-based tools. * Experience with cost\-aware engineering on Databricks — cluster and job right\-sizing, serverless trade\-offs, and reading system tables for usage. * Experience taking over work from consultants or offshore partners, running it in\-house, and mentoring less\-experienced engineers through the transition. * Exposure to Power BI as a downstream consumer of lakehouse data. * Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) for Databricks/Azure resources. * dbt (data build tool) or equivalent transformation framework experience. **Level of Experience:** * 2\+ years of hands\-on Databricks pipeline development in an enterprise environment. Manufacturing, healthcare, or life sciences data experience preferred. **Level of Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional preferred. **Travel:** * Up to 10% as required by the business. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build, test, and deploy data pipelines — including medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layers — that ingest data from SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Salesforce, and other operational systems into the Databricks Lakehouse, using batch and incremental patterns and the architecture standards set by the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager. * Take ownership of pipelines, notebooks, and data models built by external implementation partners: lead the technical side of knowledge transfer, document what exists, close gaps, and run it in production. * Operate what you build: monitor job health and data freshness, triage failures, fix root causes, and keep downstream teams informed when data is late or wrong. * Write data quality checks into pipelines (expectations, reconciliations to source, row\-count and null\-rate monitors) and act on what they find. * Apply Unity Catalog governance standards in daily work — naming, tagging, ownership, lineage documentation, metadata management, and access grants — as defined by the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager. * Implement data security and access controls on the data you manage, consistent with AirLife's data classification standards and FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / ISO 13485 data\-integrity expectations. * Participate in integration design reviews and new data source onboarding evaluations led by the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager, and partner with Commercial Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, Master Data, and the AI Lead to translate their requirements into pipeline and data model changes that support self\-service BI and AI use cases. * Support integrations that write data back to operational systems; keep code in source control, work through pull requests, and deploy through CI/CD. * Write and maintain runbooks and technical documentation, including data lineage and pipeline architecture documentation. * Watch compute cost and performance on the jobs you own — right\-size clusters and schedules, tune queries and pipelines (partitioning, caching), flag risks early, and provide usage data from Databricks system tables to support the Manager's cost governance. * Bring forward improvements to standards, patterns, and tooling. * Support the onboarding and technical mentoring of junior data engineers or offshore/outsourced engineering resources as the team grows. **OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES** * Uphold and embody AirLife’s values in all aspects of work. * Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness in daily work; look for ways to improve and promote quality \& safety. * Inspire the trust of others; treat people with respect and dignity and embrace the value of diversity. * Use time efficiently; perform job accurately, thoroughly, and conserve Company resources to improve profits. * Contribute to building and maintaining a positive team environment. * Assure all policies and guidelines are implemented and followed. **QUALITY POLICY** At AirLife, Quality is our promise. It is our commitment to customer satisfaction and our dedication to product excellence in an evolving global healthcare market. This promise is kept through a continuously improving and effective Quality Management System and compliance to Regulatory Requirements. **DEIA STATEMENT** At AirLife, we are committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities and customers we serve. We believe our philosophy on Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Advancement (DEIA) encourages excellence and equips us to serve an evolving global marketplace. **BENEFITS** AirLife offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays, bereavement leave, Employee Assistance Program resources, and medical leave benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Certain positions may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation. **Please note:** The responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive and may evolve over time. The role holder may be required to undertake additional duties as reasonably expected to meet the needs of the company.

jobs.description: Manufacturing Project Engineer **Position Overview** The Manufacturing Project Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing manufacturing processes and equipment to support operational excellence. This position focuses on improving production efficiency, maintaining product quality, enhancing workplace safety, and reducing manufacturing costs through engineering solutions, project management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities * Evaluate existing manufacturing processes and equipment to identify opportunities for improved productivity, quality, safety, and cost efficiency. * Develop, implement, and maintain manufacturing procedures, engineering standards, technical documentation, and equipment specifications. * Ensure manufacturing processes and equipment comply with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies. * Collaborate with production, maintenance, quality, and engineering teams to resolve manufacturing challenges and improve operational performance. * Lead and support engineering projects involving process improvements, equipment upgrades, and manufacturing technology. * Coordinate the introduction of new products, equipment, and manufacturing processes into production. * Participate in Lean Manufacturing initiatives, including waste reduction, workflow optimization, and continuous improvement projects. * Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including technical drawings, process specifications, and equipment records. * Assist in establishing long\-term manufacturing technology plans and identifying opportunities for modernization and automation. * Provide technical guidance and engineering support to manufacturing personnel and cross\-functional project teams. * Monitor project progress, coordinate resources, and ensure engineering initiatives are completed within established timelines and budgets. * Analyze manufacturing data and performance metrics to identify inefficiencies and recommend corrective actions. * Work closely with internal engineering teams and other departments to ensure successful execution of new product development and capital improvement projects.
