jobs.title: Senior Data Center Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. **About the Role** Armada is hiring a Senior Data Center Commissioning Engineer to support the Galleon, Leviathan, and Orion product lines, a brand\-new capability for the company. As we scale Modular Data Center (MDC) deployments for AI workloads across a growing number of sites, we need someone who can own the commissioning thread that runs from factory acceptance testing through site start\-up, functional testing, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and handover to operations, and make sure every system performs as designed before a customer takes over. You will build Armada's commissioning program from the ground up: the commissioning plan, test scripts, and turnover standards for Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning across MV/LV electrical distribution, UPS and battery energy storage (BESS), liquid and air cooling, BMS/EPMS controls, and fire and life safety systems. Because our products are factory\-built, you'll push as much testing as possible into the factory, so units arrive on site pre\-tested and site commissioning focuses on integration and verification. This is a hands\-on senior IC role. You'll write the procedures, lead the tests, and be the commissioning point of contact for customers, third\-party commissioning agents, contractors, and OEM vendors, while feeding what you learn back into product engineering. **Location.** Remote, USA (approximately 40–50% travel to domestic and international project sites, factory/integrator facilities, and vendor locations) **What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)** * **Commissioning program and standards:** Build and own Armada's commissioning program to industry standard (the ASHRAE Guideline 0 and Standard 202 commissioning process and the industry\-standard Level 1 through Level 5 testing framework), including the commissioning plan, OPR/BOD alignment, pre\-functional checklists, functional performance test scripts, IST procedures, and turnover requirements, so every Galleon/Leviathan/Orion deployment commissions against one repeatable playbook instead of a one\-off plan per site. * **Factory acceptance testing:** Define and lead factory acceptance testing (FAT and integrated FAT of complete modules) at integrator and vendor facilities for modules, e\-houses, skids, and major equipment (switchgear, UPS, BESS, CDUs, chillers, controls), shifting testing into the factory so units arrive on site pre\-tested and ready to integrate. * **Site commissioning through IST:** Lead receipt inspection, pre\-functional checks, start\-up, functional performance testing, and Integrated Systems Testing on active sites, including load bank testing, failure\-mode and transfer scenarios, liquid\-cooling flushing and fluid quality verification, and GPU load step and ramp\-rate behavior, owning the issues log through closure. * **Hands\-on testing and troubleshooting:** Personally write test procedures, witness and run tests, analyze trend and power quality data, and troubleshoot failures across electrical, mechanical, and controls systems, particularly on first\-of\-a\-kind products and sites where no precedent exists yet. * **Customer, CxA, and vendor coordination:** Act as the commissioning point of contact for customers, third\-party commissioning agents, general contractors, and OEM vendors; coordinate witness schedules and readiness reviews, direct vendor start\-up activities, and align commissioning scope with the Armada/customer responsibility matrix. * **Turnover, operational readiness, and product feedback:** Own turnover packages (test records, as\-builts, O\&M manuals, warranties, training) and the final commissioning sign\-off for operational handoff, and feed failures, lessons learned, and test data back into product engineering so each product generation commissions faster than the last. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or relat ications** * Commissioning certification such as CxA (ACG), BCxP (ASHRAE), CCP (BCA), or CBCP (AEE); a Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus. * Prior commissioning experience with modular, prefabricated, or containerized data centers, including factory acceptance testing at integrator facilities. * Experience commissioning high\-density, liquid\-cooled AI/GPU deployments (direct\-to\-chip, CDUs, technology cooling systems), including flushing, filtration, and fluid quality programs. * Experience with battery energy storage (BESS), GPU power stabilization, load step and ramp\-rate testing, and utility interconnection requirements (e.g., ERCOT). * Experience on the hyperscale owner, colocation, or commissioning agent side, leading IST on large\-scale (10 MW\+) facilities. * Experience with commissioning management platforms (CxAlloy, CxPlanner, Facility Grid, or equivalent), Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud, and test equipment (load banks, power quality analyzers, thermal imaging). * Experience standing up commissioning standards, templates, or governance processes for a growing team or product portfolio, rather than only executing against existing ones. * NFPA 70E qualified person training and OSHA 30\. **Compensation \& Benefits** For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the *starting* base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits *(details available upon request)*. We use a geographic pay structure based on cost\-of\-labor markets. * **Tier 1 (e.g., SF Bay Area, NYC, Seattle):** $157,596 \- $196,995 * **Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas):** $137,040 \- $171,300 * **Tier 3 (other cities):** $130,188 \- $162,735 Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range. **Benefits** * Competitive base salary and equity * Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost) * Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA) * Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k) * Unlimited paid time off (PTO) * 14 paid company holidays per year \#LI\-SM2 \#LI\-Remote **You're a Great Fit if You're** * A go\-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge * A detail\-oriented problem\-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get\-it\-done" attitude * Thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company * A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda * Highly organized and results\-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you **Equal Opportunity Statement** At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time. **Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates** Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

jobs.title: AI and Image Processing Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ASP Health is an early\-stage commercial company working to develop and bring to market novel medical devices. Our first device is used in the operating room to take a biopsy sample, deposit it on a microscope slide, and then dry, fix, and stain the slide for immediate evaluation of the sample adequacy. Our second device is a digital microscope designed to specialize in specific workflows and applications. The device is combined with AI and image processing capabilities to aid in the assessment of the microscope slides. workflows. * Develop and maintain production software that integrates AI models into the company's imaging platform, connecting image acquisition, inference pipelines, prediction metadata, image visualization, and clinician\-facing user interfaces. * Build, optimize, and troubleshoot GPU\-accelerated training and inference workflows, including multi\-GPU training, checkpoint/restart functionality, memory optimization, and performance benchmarking. * Design, develop, and maintain production Python applications, including backend services, APIs, and multiprocessing workflows. * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows\-based software applications, including desktop user interfaces, software packaging, installation, and release management. * Implement software engineering best practices, including automated testing, logging, error handling, debugging, version control, and reproducible software builds to ensure reliability and maintainability. * Independently own software solutions across the full application stack, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure system performance, reliability, and scalability. **Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 3\+ years of experience in a related position. * Strong programming skills in Python and C\+\+. * Experience with medical image processing, specifically microscopy and cytology/pathology (e.g., whole\-slide imaging or digital pathology systems). * Hands\-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for segmentation, detection, or classification using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including with limited labeled data. * Understanding of computer vision techniques. * Experience developing and operating machine learning workflows on cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud storage, GPU compute, Python\-based training pipelines, and resource monitoring (e.g., Prometheus). AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. * Experience with software development lifecycle and methodologies. * Experience with version control for code, data, and models (e.g., Git, DVC, MLflow). * Knowledge of signal processing and mathematical modeling. * Experience with GPU programming and optimization. * Experience working in healthcare, medical devices, or biotech. * Knowledge of image preprocessing, compression, and enhancement techniques. * Experience deploying models on edge or embedded hardware (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson). * Eagerness to learn, grow, and take on many challenges and opportunities across the company. jobs.description: Role : Build and Release EngineerLocation : Remote Required Skills : • Strong hands\-on experience with Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, and Azure Artifacts, and working knowledge of Azure Boards. • Demonstrated ability to create and troubleshoot multi\-stage YAML pipelines from scratch. • Strong experience administering Azure Repos permissions, branch policies, pull request rules, and merge strategies. • Hands\-on experience designing and consuming reusable YAML templates across multiple repositories. • Experience configuring and maintaining self\-hosted build agents on Windows and Linux, including agent pools, toolchains, permissions, and troubleshooting. • Strong Git knowledge, including branching, merging, rebasing, cherry\-picking, tagging, conflict resolution, and history recovery. • Proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash for build and deployment automation. • Practical experience with at least one major build ecosystem: .NET/MSBuild, npm/Node.js, Maven/Gradle, or Python packaging. • Clear understanding of the end\-to\-end software build and release lifecycle, artifact versioning, environment promotion, deployment validation, and rollback. • Proven ability to diagnose failures across application code, pipeline configuration, dependencies, operating systems, and infrastructure. Required Qualifications — Certification • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert certification is required, including successful completion of AZ\-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions and the applicable prerequisite certification. Azure Pipelines and Reusable Templates • Design and create YAML\-based CI/CD pipelines from scratch and maintain existing pipelines. • Implement multi\-stage pipelines covering build, test, package, publish, and deployment activities. • Design and maintain reusable stage, job, and step templates to standardize pipelines across repositories. • Use template parameters, variables, variable groups, conditions, dependencies, and output variables appropriately. • Manage shared template repositories, template versioning, and controlled rollout of template changes. • Configure CI triggers, branch and path filters, scheduled runs, pipeline\-resource triggers, and Azure Repos PR build validation policies. solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a similar role that requires working with varied stakeholders. * You can engage credibly with CTOs and senior business leaders, ask established security and governance teams. * You bring substantial relevant experience; senior engineering depth and stakeholder maturity matter more than a specific title, tenure, employer, or framework. **Base Salary Range** ===================== The target salary range for this position is ($200,000\-$225,000\), and is part of a competitive total rewards package including an annual bonus, employer\-paid benefits, L\&D stipend and incentive pay for eligible roles. ASG will never ask you for sensitive personal information during the hiring process such as social security numbers, banking information or other personal details.

jobs.description: Location: Houston, TX, United States Date Posted: Oct 30, 2026 **About Alvarez \& Marsal** Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action\- and results\-oriented professionals. GAIKO brings together the firm's AI and Knowledge Management capabilities to put trusted, governed AI into everyday consulting work. As the pod's go\-to technical expert for skills and agents, you'll report to the AI Skills Pod lead with technical direction from the Intelligence Layer tech lead. Your work will directly shape how thousands of A\&M colleagues use AI in their work with clients. The team is growing, the work is technically demanding, and priorities will move quickly, so this role requires sound judgment, adaptability, and a willingness to contribute wherever the build needs support. We're looking for a fast builder who can take an idea from prototype to working capability quickly, learn from feedback and keep momentum without sacrificing quality. Just as important, you make the people around you better. You teach, share knowledge openly, step in across workstreams when needed, and adjust quickly when priorities shift. **How You Will Contribute** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of applied AI solutions, needs into skills and agents, and agree clear success metrics. * Work with the Knowledge Management and Data team leads to gather and clarify requirements, and translate them into skill and agent scaffolding, testing and evaluation harnesses, packaging and deployment) so new skills can be created and released quickly and consistently. * Build integrations with large language model platforms and use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to make skills available to approved AI tools and the Intelligence Layer. * Integrate structured and unstructured content from enterprise systems while preserving source permissions, metadata and governance requirements. * Guide the team in assessing current Power Platform and wider Microsoft stack processes, reimagining them as AI\-first workflows rather than one\-to\-one rebuilds, and converting them into, or connecting them to, skills and agents. * Train the wider team on how to build skills, through workshops, playbooks, templates, worked examples and office hours. * Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews and hands\-on coaching, raising the quality bar for skills and agents across the pod. * Apply and help shape engineering standards for skills and agents, working with the Intelligence Layer tech lead, including evaluation, CI/CD, versioning, reproducibility and performance monitoring. * Bring forward recommendations on tools, frameworks and design patterns. Technical decisions are made by the Intelligence Layer tech lead together with the Intelligence Layer lead. * Support respon requirement: confirm 5\+ years (including 2\+ on LLM or agent systems) is right for the Manager level. * Work arrangement: confirm remote, hybrid, or office\-based expectations. **Your journey at A\&M** At A\&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands\-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real\-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high\-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one. Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez \& Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD\&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy\-two (72\) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A\&M’s benefits programs. The salary range is $140,000 \- $160,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A\&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details. **Culture \& Values** --------------------- At Alvarez \& Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, GDCO Central Intelligence and Analytics Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We're looking for a Senior Technical Product/Program Manager to own a portfolio of these business\-facing products and programs end to end: shaping what each one should do and for whom, driving its design and delivery with engineering, science and data technicians, and proving it changes business outcomes. This role is oriented toward business problems and the products/programs that solve them, not toward running shared platform infrastructure. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a system architecture or challenging a recommendations quality as presenting a roadmap to senior executives like VPs. \#\# The portfolio you'll own * \*\*Self\-service analytics, to production.\*\* Take our natural\-language and SQL analytics product over the governed data lake from team tool to a production service leaders rely on: accuracy on governed metrics, onboarding new domains, reliability, access controls, and adoption. * \*\*Recommendation engine delivery and quality.\*\* Deliver the AI\-assisted recommendation engine from pilot to broad use, own its quality bar: what it recommends, with what confidence, when it should stay silent, and how we know it worked. * \*\*Business domain decision products.\*\* Our operation runs on a few core business domains, each with its own leaders, metrics, data sources, and decisions. For each one, you'll own the product that moves a leader from "what's happening" to "what should I do about it": define the decisions it supports, the metrics and data it needs, and how we measure whether it improved the domain's outcome. Today that means: data products that cover repair backlog and aging, repair throughput and turnaround time, parts availability and other blockers, and repeat failures. The core decision is where to focus the effort so it returns the most capacity to customers fastest. Data products track deliveries from plan through install and hand\-off, show what's on track, what's at risk, and why (parts, labor, facilities, network readiness), and route each blocker to the owner who can clear it. The core decision is which at\-risk deliveries need intervention now. Success is more capacity delivered on its committed date. Key job responsibilities * \*\*Own program strategy and roadmap\*\* for each product/program in the portfolio, tied to a business outcome (repair turnaround, labor productivity, capacity on time), and phase scope deliberately from pilot to GA. * \*\*Define and enforce quality.\*\* Set the bar for each products/programs, such as answer accuracy for self\-service analytics or recommendation precision, confidence, and abstain behavior for the recommendation engine. Partner with engineering and science so no product presents correlation as causation or claims more confidence than it has earned. * \*\*Prove business impact.\*\* Define how actions are captured, how impact is measured against matched baselines, and how outcomes feed back into the product. Success is not "recommendations accepted" or "queries run"; it's decisions that changed outcomes. * \*\*Run technical delivery with the engineering team.\*\* Own the delivery cadence, sprint planning, and release management for your products/programs. Review design docs, understand the architecture well enough to weigh tradeoffs (build vs. reuse, latency vs. cost, coupling between services), and keep scope, sequencing, and dependencies honest. * \*\*Drive launch readiness\*\* across security review, penetration testing, operational readiness (ORR), and privacy reviews for each product moving to production. * \*\*Lead cross\-org dependencies\*\* with Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Facilities, workforce planning, and peer data teams: write the asks, negotiate data contracts, and escalate when a partner dependency blocks the roadmap. * \*\*Write the narratives\*\* (PR/FAQs, 6\-pagers, pilot readouts) for Director and VP audiences, with honest accounting of what is proven vs. pending. About the team Our team is focused on building and delivering data solutions that drive meaningful outcomes for AWS and our customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers work closely with engineers, scientists, and business leaders to tackle challenging problems at scale. jobs.title: Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering that physical infrastructure — partnering with build partners, equipment manufacturers, and utilities to stand up facilities that can reliably power some of the largest accelerator clusters in the industry. As a Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design, you'll own the electrical architecture of our facilities from the utility service entrance through to the rack — substation interface, medium\- and high\-voltage distribution, on\-site generation and storage integration, UPS, switchgear, busway, and rack power. You'll develop and maintain the basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications that our build partners and A/E firms design against, and you'll be the point of technical authority when their drawings and calculations come back for review. You'll run the engineering studies — short\-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality — and you'll keep the architecture ahead of rapidly increasing rack densities and the unique load characteristics of large\-scale ML training. A central part of this role is speed\-to\-capacity through prefabrication: you'll shape Anthropic's offsite\-manufactured electrical strategy — modular skids, e\-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies — and drive its standardization across sites. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, with our hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator requirements into electrical design criteria, and with supply chain to qualify and diversify regional equipment vendors. Expect roughly 10–25% travel for design reviews, partner and vendor meetings, factory witness testing, and site visits to support commissioning and startup. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Electrical design \& engineering** * Lead the electrical design of critical data center infrastructure across the US portfolio, including the utility interface and substation, site medium\- and high\-voltage distribution, generators, UPS, switchgear, transformers, busway, and grounding * Develop and maintain Anthropic's electrical basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications for critical power distribution — covering switchgear, UPS systems, PDUs, busway, and rack power delivery — producing designs that meet our reliability and maintainability requirements while staying within budgetary targets * Perform and validate engineering studies — including short\-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality analysis — and use the findings to steer topology, redundancy, equipment\-selection, and protection\-setting decisions * Design and plan data center hall power distribution layouts for newly allocated spaces in coordination with the telecom, mechanical and cooling design ### **Prefabrication \& modular delivery** * Drive Anthropic's prefabricated and modular electrical strategy — developing modular skids, e\-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies, and partnering with external engineering and manufacturing teams on a productization roadmap that accelerates deployment and reduces onsite labor * Design for offsite manufacture and onsite assembly: define the interfaces between prefabricated components and site\-built work, and the electrical interfaces and switchover points for temporary\-to\-permanent power sequencing * Drive standardization of modular electrical designs across sites to compress deployment timelines while preserving flexibility for site\-specific constraints and evolving hardware generations ### **Partner, vendor \& utility coordination** * Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify and qualify major electrical equipment, and partner with supply chain to build a diversified vendor base that mitigates lead\-time and single\-source risk * Work with utilities and interconnection/transmission operators (e.g., ISOs/RTOs) to define site utility service and interconnection requirements, and with local authorities having jurisdiction to ensure designs comply with the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70/NEC), NFPA, IEEE, UL/ANSI, and local requirements * Work with Anthropic's hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator power, density, and power\-quality requirements into electrical design criteria, and keep the reference architecture aligned with upcoming hardware generations * Present oject experience delivering data centers in multiple US markets (e.g., Virginia, Texas, Arizona, Ohio, Oregon) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. jobs.title: Principal Engineer & Technical Lead — Azure / Containers
jobs.description: **About Aperia Solutions** Aperia Solutions is a leading payments SaaS company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. We build risk management, residuals accounting, compliance, and analytics platforms used by merchant banks, ISOs, payment processors, and other participants in the credit card payments ecosystem. Operating under PCI DSS 4\.0 compliance across dual on\-premises datacenters (Allen, TX and Chicago, IL) plus Azure cloud, we process high\-volume payment data for some of the industry's largest players. We're in the middle of a significant platform modernization program: a next\-generation risk analysis and scoring platform on Microsoft Fabric, an AI\-powered ingestion platform, new AI\-native applications, and ongoing evolution of the products our clients rely on every day. The teams executing this work are deliberately small and senior, with executive\-level support and minimal bureaucracy. Every senior hire is a founding contributor to the architecture and the code. **Role summary** We are hiring a Principal Engineer and Technical Lead: a builder first, with deep architecture and enterprise design pattern experience behind every line of code. This person is the SVP of Technology's chief lieutenant on technical execution. You will take on the heaviest technical lifting, prove risky ideas with working prototypes, turn approved architecture into production systems, and hold distributed engineering teams to a high technical bar. This is a hands\-on role, not an architecture\-only or slideware role. Target architecture is set with technology leadership; you own making it real, from implementation design, code and IaC through the hard production problems, and you push back with evidence when a design won't hold up in implementation. The platform is a regulated, multi\-tenant payments SaaS built on Azure, Microsoft Fabric, AKS, C\#/.NET and Python. You will report directly to the SVP of Technology and act as the senior hands\-on technical authority across platform, data and AI initiatives. **Title options:** Principal Engineer, Lead Software Engineer / Technical Lead – Cloud Platforms, or Staff Engineer – Azure. **What** **you'll** **do** **Hands\-on engineering, POCs and heavy lifting (****50%)** * Build working prototypes and POCs for advanced concepts (LLM/RAG services, event\-driven pipelines, multi\-tenant patterns, new Azure services) to retire technical risk before teams commit. * Own the hardest technical slices end to end: write and ship production\-quality C\#/.NET and Python, debug production issues, and unblock teams by doing the work rather than delegating it. * Implement enterprise design patterns in real code: event\-driven and messaging (outbox, saga, idempotent consumers, retries and dead\-lettering), CQRS, resilience (circuit breaker, bulkhead, backpressure), caching and multi\-tenant isolation. * Author and review IaC (Terraform/Bicep), Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines; build the golden\-path templates teams adopt. * Benchmark and load test candidate designs; bring numbers, not opinions, to technical decisions. * Take on heavy\-lift tasks directly from the SVP: technical spikes, hands\-on vendor evaluations, migration tooling, and performance and cost investigations. **Design and implementation patterns (****25%)** * Turn target\-state architectures into implementation designs: service boundaries, contracts, data models and deployment topology across AKS, Container Apps, Functions, APIM, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Cosmos DB and Azure SQL. * Build and harden integration paths into Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, mirroring, Real\-Time Intelligence), knowing where the sharp edges are from having hit them. * Write ADRs and design docs for the decisions made during implementation, and contribute to architecture reviews and threat models with implementation\-level detail. * Implement regulated\-workload controls in code and IaC: network isolation, private endpoints, identity (Entra ID, managed identity, workload identity), secrets, encryption and audit. * Bring run\-cost to every build: estimate before, measure after, and flag designs that won't scale economically. **Technical leadership with delivery teams (****25%)** * Act as the SVP's chief lieutenant on technical execution: carry decisions into teams, keep builds aligned with approved designs, and stand in on technical matters when the SVP is unavailable. * Run design reviews, code reviews and technical checkpoints with onshore and offshore teams across multiple time zones. * Track technical status and surface risk early: integration gaps, drift from approved designs, quality and security debt. * Mentor senior engineers and tech leads; raise the bar on implementation quality, testing and observability. * Translate implementation status and risk into concise options for technology leadership, and work directly with security, product and vendors. **Technical stack** Candidates should be expert in the core column and fluent in most of the adjacent column. Area Core (expert) Adjacent (fluent) Cloud Azure: AKS, Container Apps, APIM, Functions, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Front Door Azure Policy, Landing Zones, AWS/EKS equivalents Data Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Databricks, Synapse, ClickHouse, Kafka Languages C\# / .NET 8\+, Python TypeScript, SQL/KQL, Go Design patterns Event\-driven/messaging (outbox, saga, idempotency), CQRS, resilience patterns, multi\-tenant isolation DDD, hexagonal/clean architecture, API versioning, enterprise integration patterns Containers Docker, Kubernetes, Helm Dapr, KEDA, service mesh, GitOps (Flux/Argo) IaC and delivery Terraform, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions Bicep, policy\-as\-code, container image signing/scanning AI Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, RAG patterns Semantic Kernel, LangChain, vector search, evaluation tooling Observability Azure Monitor, App Insights, OpenTelemetry Prometheus, Grafana Security Entra ID, managed/workload identity, private networking Defender for Cloud, PCI DSS controls **Required qualifications** * 12\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years as a lead or principal engineer shipping production cloud systems. * 4\+ years building and operating containerized workloads on Kubernetes in production, preferably AKS. * Deep, current hands\-on Azure experience: you have personally built, deployed and debugged the services you work with. * Code you can show: substantial, active C\#/.NET and Python work in the last 12 months, not just reviews. You are still one of the strongest individual contributors on any team you join. * Deep, applied command of enterprise design patterns (messaging, resilience, integration, multi\-tenancy); you can explain their failure modes because you have hit them in production. * Track record of taking a novel concept from whiteboard to working POC in weeks, then building or leading the first production slice. * Working architecture depth across operational and analytical data stores, including event\-driven and streaming implementations. * Fluency with IaC and CI/CD; you write the Terraform and the pipeline, not just the diagram. * Security\-first implementation in a regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or financial services equivalent). * Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams through design and code reviews without direct authority. * Clear written communication: ADRs, design docs and status summaries that stand on their own. **Preferred qualifications** * Payments, card processing, risk/fraud, or merchant services domain experience. * Production Microsoft Fabric work, including mirroring from Cosmos DB or SQL and Fabric capacity sizing. * Shipped LLM\-backed features: RAG, agent/tool patterns, content safety, evaluation and red\-teaming. * Multi\-tenant SaaS design: tenant isolation, noisy\-neighbor controls, per\-tenant cost attribution. * Azure certifications such as Azure Developer (AZ\-204\), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ\-400\), CKAD/CKA, or Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP\-600\). Nice to have, never a substitute for demonstrated work. * Open\-source contributions, technical writing or conference talks. **Eligibility Requirements** * Must be willing to submit to a background investigation and drug test as part of the selection process. **Job Type** * Full\-time **Schedule** * Hybrid: Monday to Friday **Work Location** * Dallas, TX **Benefits** * Health insurance * Health savings account * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Disability insurance * Childcare assistance * Education reimbursement * Fitness membership * Volunteer time off

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Applied Intuition Applied Intuition is a leading technology company specializing in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and software\-defined vehicle technologies. The company develops advanced software platforms, simulation tools, and operating systems that help organizations build, test, and deploy intelligent machines. Its technologies support industries including automotive, defense, commercial trucking, construction, mining, and agriculture. Applied Intuition collaborates with leading global automotive manufacturers to accelerate innovation in autonomous driving and next\-generation vehicle technologies. Its mission is to advance Physical AI by bringing intelligence, safety, and automation to machines operating in the real world. About the Role We are looking for a talented and motivated Backend Software Engineer with strong Java development experience to join our engineering team and contribute to building scalable, reliable, and high\-performance software platforms. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain backend services that support vehicle data management, telemetry processing, simulation orchestration, and intelligent software applications. You will work with modern technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Apache Kafka, SQL databases, and cloud infrastructure to build systems capable of processing large volumes of data efficiently. You will collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and cross\-functional engineering teams to develop innovative solutions that support the next generation of autonomous and software\-defined vehicles. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. * Build and enhance microservices\-based architectures to support distributed applications and enterprise platforms. * Develop RESTful APIs and backend services for vehicle data management, telemetry processing, and simulation workflows. * Implement asynchronous and event\-driven processing using Apache Kafka and related messaging technologies. * Work with relational and NoSQL databases to design efficient data models, queries, and storage solutions. * Develop reliable data processing workflows to handle large volumes of vehicle telemetry and simulation data. * Collaborate with frontend, infrastructure, and data engineering teams to integrate backend services with other platform components. * Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications in cloud environments using Docker and Kubernetes. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, debugging, and performance optimization. * Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-tested code while following software engineering best practices. * Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes to improve development efficiency and software quality. * Identify technical challenges and recommend solutions that improve application performance, scalability, and reliability. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of professional software development experience, preferably building backend applications. * Strong programming experience with Java and object\-oriented programming concepts. * Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot and developing RESTful APIs. * Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems. * Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. * Familiarity with SQL queries, database design, and data management. * Understanding of multithreading, concurrency, exception handling, and application performance optimization. * Experience with version control systems such as Git. * Familiarity with software testing, debugging, and code quality practices. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced engineering environment. U.S. Work Authorization Requirements * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. * Applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents (Green Card holders). * Applicants must be able to provide appropriate documentation verifying their employment eligibility in accordance with applicable U.S. employment laws. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Apache Kafka or other event\-streaming and messaging platforms. * Familiarity with Apache Spark or distributed data processing frameworks. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application development. * Experience with Redis, MongoDB, or other NoSQL technologies. * Understanding of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. * Exposure to high\-volume data processing, vehicle telemetry, simulation platforms, or autonomous systems. * Interest in artificial intelligence, robotics, automotive technologies, or software\-defined vehicles. Equal Employment Opportunity We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants. Employment decisions should be based on relevant qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, without discrimination on any basis protected by applicable law. **Ready to build what comes next? Apply today and become part of the team advancing the future of intelligent machines.** Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Family leave * Flextime * Paid sick time Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Controls
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** The Engineering Manager \- Controls leads a team of software engineers responsible for the real\-time control software that runs on our humanoid robots. This role is accountable for the team's people and delivery: hiring and developing engineers, driving the team's deliverables within the broader Controls roadmap, and making sure the control stack is reliable, well tested, and ready for production. This is a player\-leader role. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in robot control and real\-time software, stays close enough to the code to review designs and unblock engineers, and partners closely with the firmware, embedded software, learning, teleoperation, and test teams to bring new capabilities from simulation onto the robot fleet. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * **Real\-Time Control Software:** Oversee development of the real\-time control framework that runs on the robot, including robot drivers, state estimation, control interfaces, and the integration of learned policies and teleoperation. * **Execution \& Planning:** Plan and drive the team's deliverables in coordination with other leads within the broader Controls roadmap. Break program goals into deliverable work, track progress against milestones, and raise risks to schedule or quality early. * **Team Leadership \& Growth:** Hire, manage, and mentor a team of controls and software engineers. Set clear priorities and ownership, give regular feedback, and develop engineers and tech leads into stronger technical contributors. * **Quality \& Release:** Maintain a high bar for code quality through design reviews, code reviews, and automated testing, including simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop regression tests. Own the team's part of the software release process and the stability of what ships to the fleet. * **Iteration Speed:** Keep the control software and tooling fast to work with, so engineers can quickly try new approaches to hard robotics problems in simulation and on hardware. * **Simulation \& Hardware Validation:** Ensure the control stack behaves consistently in simulation and on hardware, and support robot bring\-up, calibration tooling, and root\-cause analysis of issues found in testing and in the field. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with the firmware, embedded software, learning, teleoperation, systems, and test teams to align on interfaces, priorities, and schedules, and represent the team in stakeholder reviews. **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** **Technical Skills (Must\-Have)** * **Controls Background:** Strong foundation in robot kinematics, dynamics, and control, with hands\-on experience in areas such as whole\-body control, manipulation, or teleoperation. * **Real\-Time Software:** Experience building or leading development of real\-time robotic software in C\+\+, including multi\-threaded execution, timing, and hardware interfaces. * **Hardware Deployment:** A track record of taking control software from simulation to physical robots and supporting it in testing and deployment. * **People Leadership:** Experience managing or leading engineers, including hiring, mentoring, performance feedback, and setting team priorities. * **Execution:** Experience planning and delivering software in a fast\-moving R\&D environment, balancing near\-term deliverables with long\-term code health. **Good to Have** * **Humanoid or Legged Robots:** Experience with humanoid, legged, or mobile manipulation platforms. * **State Estimation \& System Identification:** Experience with state estimation and system identification for robotic systems. * **Learned Policy Integration:** Experience integrating reinforcement learning or other learned policies into a real\-time control stack. * **Simulation Environments:** Experience with physics engines such as MuJoCo, IsaacSim, or Drake. * **Testing Infrastructure:** Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, continuous integration, and release processes for robotics software. * **Robotics Middleware:** Familiarity with ROS 2 or similar robotics middleware. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * MS or PhD in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 4\+ years of relevant industry experience in robot controls or robotics software (or 2\+ years with a PhD), including 1\+ year managing engineers and 2\+ years as a technical lead. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer - Electromagnetic (R&D)
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** At Apptronik, we are building the next generation of general\-purpose humanoid robots designed to change the way we live and work. To achieve unparalleled performance in our robotic platforms, we are expanding our R\&D efforts into advanced, custom motor technologies. Off\-the\-shelf frameless motors leave significant performance on the table for humanoid robots. As a electromagnetic designer for Apptronik's custom motor program, you will be the driving force behind our next generation of actuators. You will set the target metrics and design the motors to hit them, exploring cutting\-edge technologies to maximize performance while ensuring these designs remain viable for mass manufacturing. In addition to serving as the lead hands\-on EM designer, you will act as our primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) when collaborating with external partners, university collaborators, and specialized manufacturing vendors. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** **Custom Electromagnetic Design \& Simulation** * Own the electromagnetic design of custom BLDC/PMSM motors for humanoid joints from concept to built prototype. * Select and evaluate advanced topologies and approaches * Run advanced EM simulations (using Ansys Maxwell, Motor\-CAD, JMAG, or Altair Flux) to maximize performance. * Define the trade space between motor, thermal, and robot\-level requirements. **Testing, Validation \& Characterization** * Specify test requirements and oversee the methodology for characterizing internally developed motors against competing off\-the\-shelf designs. * Utilize a motor dyno to close the loop between simulation and hardware, correlating model\-to\-test data and validating EM simulations empirically. **Design for Manufacturing (DFM) \& Cross\-Functional Integration** * Bridge the gap between R\&D and production. Ensure that highly optimized, novel motor designs can scale efficiently to mass manufacturing without compromising performance. * Collaborate tightly with mechanical, thermal, electrical, and control engineers to integrate custom motors into the broader robotic joint and system architecture (accounting for drive interaction, FOC, and inverter limits). **External Partnerships** * Act as the technical lead and SME in discussions with external motor design companies, suppliers, and university collaborators. * Evaluate external proposals, drive technical requirements, ensure successful tech transfer, and audit alternative supply chains (such as US\-sourced magnet materials). **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** **Minimum Qualifications** * **Education:** MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering (electric machines), Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of industry experience designing electric machines for high\-performance applications (preferably in robotics, aerospace, or automotive/EV sectors). * **Tool Mastery:** Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with electromagnetic design and simulation software (Ansys Maxwell/Motor\-CAD, JMAG, or similar) and analytical motor modeling. * **Technical Depth:** Exceptional understanding of motor fundamentals, winding theory, magnetic materials, thermal coupling, and the trade\-offs involved in maximizing torque density. * **Manufacturing Knowledge:** Proven track record of designing motors that have successfully transitioned from the prototype phase to volume manufacturing. * **Qualities:** Deep technical credibility, a passion for mentoring others, and a true "experimentalist" mindset who thrives on building a new capability from scratch and validating models against hardware. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with specialized or novel motor topologies (e.g., axial flux, transverse flux, frameless outrunner designs). * Familiarity with the unique constraints of robotics (e.g., highly dynamic loads, tight packaging constraints, low gearing ratios, and strict thermal limits). * MATLAB/Python scripting experience for design optimization and workflow automation. * Strong vendor management experience, having successfully audited and collaborated with overseas or domestic motor manufacturers. * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. prior Tax, Assurance, or Accounting experience is not required. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, articulate design decisions, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to evolving requirements, and deliver high\-quality solutions in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to enhance engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices. * No professional certifications or licenses required. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Manufacturing Processes. Global
jobs.description: **Position Purpose** The Principal Engineer is the senior technical expert for global manufacturing\-process methods and standards. The role establishes and maintains the methodologies that govern Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA), the Global Bill of Process (GBOP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), manufacturing\-time definition, New Product Introduction (NPI) prototypes and pilots, global assembly standards, and process libraries. The Principal Engineer operates with broad objectives, initiates technical work, resolves unique and complex issues, and advises stakeholders throughout BAC. **Principal Accountabilities** **DFMA and NPI Methods** Establish technical methods that translate DFMA direction into product specifications and NPI deliverables. Define robust global methods for process definition, prototypes, pilots, validation, and readiness. **Global Process Standards** Own technical content and methodology for global process standards, GBOP, PFMEA, global assembly standards, manufacturing\-time methods, and process libraries. Establish internal standards and guide correct engineering methodologies. Develop unconventional approaches for unique process challenges. **Systems and Technology Integration** Define process requirements represented in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Manufacturing Execution System (MES), routings, work centers, and master data. Translate process requirements into equipment, automation, tooling, fixture, and specification requirements with AMT. **Technical Leadership and Coaching** Serve as company expert and advise stakeholders at all levels. Coach AMEs, regional engineers, and subject matter experts. Present complex topics to technical, non\-technical, and executive audiences. **Manufacturing Process Centers of Excellence** Lead through influence all manufacturing\-process Centers of Excellence (COEs) composed of subject matter experts in BAC core competency processes across regions and factories. Establish each COE charter, technical agenda, priorities, governance cadence, decision and escalation pathways, and expected deliverables. Use the COE network to develop, maintain, and improve manufacturing\-process standards, methods, specifications, technical guidance, and global best practices. Mobilize regional and factory subject matter experts to resolve complex process issues, compare methods, share learning, and strengthen global process capability. Develop technical depth and succession within core competency processes through peer coaching, benchmarking, and shared technical work. **Expansion Technical Content** Define process standards, design criteria, specifications, technical acceptance, and readiness evidence for the Manufacturing Processes expansion playbook. Provide technical review of layouts, process\-risk methods, and readiness packages. **Nature and Scope** The Principal Engineer is BAC senior technical expert for global manufacturing\-process methods and standards. The role works across functions, product platforms, regions, and plants, initiates technical projects within broad objectives, and advises technical and business stakeholders on complex process decisions. The role exercises matrix leadership of manufacturing\-process Centers of Excellence through influence, facilitation, technical governance, and shared accountability for enterprise deliverables. **Knowledge \& Skills** **Education \& Experience** Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree or professional designation preferred. 10\+ years in manufacturing engineering and process definition for new products. Experience in high\-variation, low\-volume manufacturing and influential technical leadership. **Technical Expertise** DFMA, industrial engineering, Lean process design, PFMEA, routings, manufacturing time, fixtures, process validation, and process governance. Ability to address unique issues using advanced and unconventional methods and establish internal technical standards. **Communication \& Leadership** Executive\-level technical communication, company\-wide influence, technical coaching, and relevant external technical engagement. **Working Conditions** Office and manufacturing environments. Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds. Domestic and international travel up to 20 percent. BAC Hiring Compensation Range $108,200 \- $185,200 BAC offers a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401k, employee stock ownership plan, and more. Strong communication, teamwork, curiosity and a willingness to help others succeed are essential. **Team Culture** ---------------- We're a new team that works closely with our partners in Product and Design to build thoughtful digital experiences. We also encourage participation in Bloomberg's broader employee communities and initiatives and value teammates who contribute beyond their immediate project work. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- You'll become a trusted engineer who can take on a complex problem and **drive it toward a successful outcome with increasing independence**. You'll deliver high\-quality software, contribute to the modernization of Bloomberg's marketing technology ecosystem and help establish engineering practices that make the entire team more effective. Over time, your impact will extend beyond your individual contributions: you'll improve the systems around you, make your teammates more effective, identify opportunities before they become explicit requirements and use modern engineering and AI tooling to continually increase the speed and quality with which the team delivers digital experiences. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, test and operate **modern web applications and digital experiences** supporting Bloomberg's marketing ecosystem. * Build and evolve our web publishing platform on **Optimizely**, helping shape content models and data structures while developing reusable components, templates, integrations, publishing capabilities and supporting services. * Build new digital experiences from the ground up, allow the team to release software confidently and frequently. * Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, code reviews and engineering standards across the team. * Experiment with and adopt **AI\-assisted development tools and workflows** to accelerate development, improve quality and increase individual and team productivity. **You'll Need to Have** ----------------------- * building websites or digital experiences for **marketing organizations, digital agencies, media companies or other organizations operating large public\-facing web ecosystems**. * Experience with CMS performance. * Experience with cloud platforms such as **Microsoft Azure**. * Experience with CDNs, caching, content delivery and performance optimization. * Familiarity with headless CMS architectures, content APIs, design systems and modern frontend frameworks. * Experience with analytics, experimentation, personalization or marketing technology platforms. jobs.title: Senior Associate Engineer, Process Quality
jobs.description: **About Blue Current** Blue Current (the "Company") is the industry leader in the development of silicon solid state batteries. Free of flammable liquid electrolytes, Blue Current's fully dry, inherently safe batteries significantly reduce risks to human and environmental health while providing a higher\-performance alternative to traditional lithium\-ion batteries. Blue Current's silicon\-based platform is highly adaptable, enabling a cost\-effective solution for both the mobility and stationary storage markets. Blue Current's team works out of its state\-of\-the\-art headquarters and pilot line facility in Hayward, California. To learn more about Blue Current, Inc., visit http://bluecurrent.com. **Position Summary** The Senior Associate Engineer, Process Quality carries out the day\-to\-day quality work that keeps Blue Current's measurements trustworthy and its processes in control. Working under the direction of senior engineers and the Process Quality manager, this role performs quality testing and inspection, keeps quality records and control charts current, and gathers the evidence that investigations depend on. It is a hands\-on role at the bench and on the manufacturing floor, learning the methods and systems that govern quality at Blue Current while taking on steadily more of their execution. Success means quality data that is complete, accurate, and available for the team to make decisions, while continuously improving the company's understanding of process and product performance. **Essential Functions \& Responsibilities** * Performs routine quality control testing and inspection on incoming materials, in\-process components, and finished cells according to established test methods and acceptance criteria * Collects, enters, and verifies quality data in established systems, checking records for completeness and flagging values that fall outside expected ranges * Maintains process control charts for assigned operations, identifies out\-of\-control signals, and escalates them to the responsible process owner and the Process Quality manager * Shares feedback between engineering and quality by observing process execution, identifying gaps between documented and actual practices, and highlighting opportunities to improve safety, reproducibility, or quality. * Executes measurement system analysis studies, including Gauge R\&R, following established protocols, and documents the results * Drafts and revises standard operating procedures (SOP) and work instructions for quality control methods under the direction of senior engineers, and routes them through document control * Conducts first\-pass investigation of nonconforming material and process deviations, documenting observations and evidence, and contributes findings to root cause analyses led by senior engineers * Performs incoming inspection on supplier materials against specification, documents non\-conformances, and tracks open supplier quality issues to closure * Compiles quality metrics and prepares recurring reports for process owners and the Process Quality team * Follows and helps improve laboratory and manufacturing safety practices, including correct use of personal protective equipment and proper handling of materials * Other duties as assigned, consistent with the scope and level of this position. **Minimum Qualifications** **Education** * BS in relevant field, or AS with 2\+ years of relevant experience, or 4\+ years of relevant experience; relevant fields include Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field, with a focus on batteries or electrochemical devices **Experience** * Hands\-on experience in a laboratory or manufacturing setting, which may include internship, co\-op, or academic research, involving measurement, testing, and documentation of results * Experience following written procedures and recording data accurately where the record matters to someone downstream **Skills \& Knowledge** * Ability to connect observations from the manufacturing floor to potential quality or process risks and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. * Working knowledge of basic statistics as applied to process data, including central tendency, variation, and control limits. * Ability to use a spreadsheet or statistical software (e.g., Excel, JMP, Minitab, or R) to summarize, chart, and interpret measurement data * Clear written communication sufficient to document observations, record results, and draft procedure text that another person can follow * Attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data integrity and record traceability * Demonstrates technical curiosity by questioning unexpected results and using observations and data to determine if further investigation is needed. * Ability to take direction, ask clarifying questions, and escalate problems rather than work around them. **Certifications / Licenses** * N/A **Preferred Qualifications** * Coursework or practical exposure to Lean S ed ability to independently prioritize, execute, and follow through on responsibilities with minimal supervision. * Proven track record of setting measurable goals, meeting deadlines, and taking initiative to resolve challenges proactively. **Technical Excellence** *Always strive for the best solution possible.* * Demonstrated commitment to quality and continuous improvement in delivering work product, solutions, and outcomes within area of expertise. * Ability to evaluate options critically and apply sound judgment to identify the most effective and scalable solution. **Learn \& Be Curious** *Think outside the box. Always learning.* * Demonstrated ability to quickly acquire new skills, tools, or domain knowledge in response to evolving business needs. * Proven track record of applying creative or unconventional thinking to solve problems. **Be Resourceful** *Be hungry, frugal, and flexible. Use what you have. Find a way.* * Demonstrated ability to deliver results in resource\-constrained environments by maximizing existing tools, processes, and partnerships. * Proven ability to adapt and find effective solutions in ambiguous or rapidly changing situations. **Delight Customers** *Build stronger relationships with internal and external customers.* * Demonstrated commitment to understanding and exceeding the needs of internal and/or external customers. * Track record of building and maintaining strong, trust\-based relationships that drive positive outcomes for all stakeholders. **Physical Requirements \& Working Conditions** * Occasional lifting and positioning of equipment and components up to approximately 30\-50 lbs (e.g., test fixtures, chamber components, cabling); installation and maintenance work may involve bending, reaching, and working around electromechanical equipment. * Work in proximity to electrical test equipment, batteries, and temperature\-control systems; adherence to all applicable electrical, battery, and laboratory safety protocols is required. * Prolonged periods of screen\-based work for test configuration, monitoring, data review, and documentation. * Regular use of personal protective equipment (PPE) including safety glasses, gloves, and lab coat; additional PPE may be required depending on materials handled * Able to pass a respirator fit test and wear a respirator periodically. * Travel is estimated at less than 10% of working time and would be primarily domestic (e.g., vendor or equipment site visits) * FAT program execution or in the event of vendor or supplier visits. * Work in gloveboxes or a dry room may be required at times, up to a full work day * Standard weekday business hours; occasional off\-hours availability may be required to support long\-running test campaigns, installations, or troubleshooting. **Equal Opportunity Employment Statement** Blue Current is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **At\-Will Employment \& Disclaimer** Employment at Blue Current is at\-will. configurations, models, datasets, embeddings, and deployment assets are developed and maintained in Government\-controlled repositories. * Serve as the technical primary point of contact for assigned Federal Agency stakeholders and provide planned/unplanned coverage for other key personnel. * Act as, or work directly with, the designated Security Lead to certify security evidence for each
