jobs.title: IT Applications Senior Developer
jobs.description: Brinks Home™ is a leader in smart home and residential security, protecting more than 1 million people across the continental United States, Canada and Puerto Rico. Our teams work together to deliver a best\-in\-class experience for our customers and one another.**Position Overview** ===================== Brinks Home is seeking an IT Application Senior Developer to help lead the design, development and support of business applications that support our customer order, installation and monitoring journey. This role provides technical and architectural leadership while building and maintaining .NET applications, APIs and integrations. AI\-assisted development is a core part of how this team works. The Senior Developer will direct AI coding agents to prepare technical plans, generate code and tests, and open pull requests. The role requires sound engineering judgment to evaluate AI\-generated work, ensure quality and security, and remain accountable for changes released to production. The successful candidate will also help establish effective practices and mentor teammates. **Key Responsibilities****:** ============================= **Application Development and Support** --------------------------------------- * Lead the application development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, code review and ongoing support. * Design, build and maintain .NET web applications, APIs and integrations in accordance with company standards and REST principles. * Develop solutions across cloud\-based and service\-oriented architectures, integrating core business systems such as CRM, ERP, inventory and monitoring platforms. * Investigate and resolve production issues using application logs, telemetry, databases and AI\-assisted analysis; document fixes and maintain runbooks. * Maintain coding standards, improve application performance, address technical debt and support continuous integration. **AI\-Assisted Engineering** ---------------------------- * Translate Jira stories into clear, testable acceptance criteria, including edge cases and failure scenarios. * Direct AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, to develop file\-level technical plans and implement code, tests and pull requests. * Critically review AI\-generated plans, code and tests for accuracy, security, scope, quality and potential regressions. * Maintain traceability from requirements and technical plans through testing and deployment, including documentation for change approval requests. * Evaluate test results in system integration and staging environments and determine when changes are ready for production. * Improve shared agent prompts, skills and rules, and coach developers on effective AI use and appropriate human review. **Technical Leadership and Collaboration** ------------------------------------------ * Help establish technical and architectural direction for applications and systems. * Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to explore solutions and deliver business value. * Lead peer reviews and quality assurance activities, participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and recommend process improvements. * Mentor developers and share technical knowledge with engineering, support and cross\-functional teams. * Research new tools and frameworks and assess their impact on business processes, application health and performance. **Required Qualifications****:** ================================ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 8 years of experience designing, building and maintaining production web or business applications, including 3 or more years with C\#/.NET. * At least 8 years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Daily, hands\-on experience using AI coding agents or assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor on real development work. * Strong expertise in C\#, .NET Core/ASP.NET MVC and Entity Framework, with solid SQL Server skills, including query analysis and working with large production tables. * Experience designing, maintaining and consuming REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL and third\-party or legacy integrations is beneficial. * Full\-stack development experience with Angular, React, Vue or a similar framework, as well as HTML5, CSS3 and JSON. * Experience with Azure, cloud application architecture, service\-oriented systems, Git\-based CI/CD and DevOps practices. * Ability to plan, implement, test and troubleshoot complex software and system solutions, and to identify security or quality issues in AI\-generated code. * Experience with Jira, Confluence, technical documentation, code reviews and established quality assurance practices. * Strong communication, problem\-solving and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with product owners, stakeholders and cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications****:** =========================== AI\-agent skills, MCP servers, custom tool integrations or AI\-assisted software development workflows. * Knowledge of AI\-related risks, including prompt injection, secret handling, data protection and licensing of generated code. * Familiarity with Azure App Services, Key Vault, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Entra ID, Sentry or ConfigCat. * Experience with API management tools such as Sentinet and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI or Octopus Deploy. * Python experience and knowledge of Linux; familiarity with Ruby, Nuxt.js, Heroku or Selenium. * Experience with ERP/CRM platforms such as Business Central or SalesLogix, home security systems or alarm\-monitoring workflows. * Experience mentoring developers through changes in tools, technology or development processes. **Technology Environment****:** =============================== The team works with C\#/.NET, Python, REST APIs and modern web frameworks; SQL Server and business application databases; Azure services including Key Vault, Application Insights and Log Analytics; Entra ID and ConfigCat; service\-oriented integrations and Sentinet API management; and GitHub, Jira and Confluence. AI tooling includes Claude Code and Cowork, shared agent skills, and MCP connections to systems such as logs, SQL and Jira. **AI\-Assisted Development Expectations****:** ============================================== AI use is a core expectation of this position. Each change request must include an AI\-written technical plan, and AI agents are expected to open pull requests for human review. Acceptance criteria define expected behavior and guide test creation. Human reviewers remain accountable for technical plans, code, tests and production promotion while automated verification is evaluated and improved. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Within the first 30 days, the Senior Developer is expected to deliver a change through the full AI\-assisted workflow. Within 60 days, the developer should own a feature area with plans and pull requests requiring minimal rework. Within 90 days, the developer should contribute a shared agent skill or rules improvement. Ongoing success includes improved delivery throughput, fewer escaped defects, evidence\-based quality controls and active mentoring of junior developers. **Location and Travel** ======================= This is a remote position open to candidates located in the continental United States. Candidates in the Dallas–Fort Worth area are preferred. Travel is expected to be approximately twice per year to our Farmer’s Branch, TX Headquarters. **Benefits:** * Brinks Home recognizes the value of benefits for you and your family, so we offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits program: * + Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with Employer Match, Paid Time Off \& Paid Holidays, HSA/FSA, Life \& AD\&D Insurance, Disability Coverage, Maternity/Parental Leave, Mental \& Physical Health Benefits, Employee Resource Groups, Volunteer Hours, Discounted Equipment \& Monitoring, Employee Referral Program. * To learn more about our company culture and career opportunities, please visit our **LinkedIn** and **Career Page**. *Brinks Home provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* \#equalopportunityemployer \#veteranfriendly We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Fire Protection Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Senior Fire Protection Engineer position is responsible for the preparation of detailed Building Code and Life Safety Code analyses and analysis of fire detection, mass notification and suppression systems. Bristol Alliance of Companies (Bristol) is committed to building lasting relationships that reflect our hard work, ingenuity, and dedication to safety. Every employee has an impact on our success, which benefits the Native Culture, land, and people of the Bristol Bay region. Our values: People, Communities, Reputation, Teamwork, Trust, and Truth. **Essential Functions** * Responsible for the preparation of detailed Building Code and Life Safety Code analysis and analysis of fire detection, mass notification and suppression systems. Prepare designs and plans using AutoCAD, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), specifications, and cost estimates, in support of in\-house and Architect/Engineer (A\&E) design bid\-build and design\-build projects, for a wide range of new or rehabilitated DoW facilities and infrastructure projects. Analyze existing buildings and building egress systems to determine adequacy of egress and construction type for existing conditions and proposed changes to buildings and building occupancies. Investigate and recommend corrective measures for deficiencies in existing facilities. Typical design projects include Naval Shore Facilities, including multi\-story offices and quarters, hangars, hospitals, towers, aircraft overhaul facilities, piers, training facilities and a very wide diversity of other new and existing structures and facilities. * Analyze the applicability of fire protection innovative processes, systems, equipment, or techniques and implement such on projects and specifications. Demonstrate knowledge of the latest fire protection systems and methods of construction. Prepare correspondence, engineering studies, and technical reports regarding fire protection and Life Safety related topics. jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer, AI Support Systems
jobs.description: **About Broccoli** ------------------ At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world. We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep America running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done. Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences. Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built. Today: * Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day. * We've grown to **$25M\+ ARR in 2\.5 years.** * We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry. * We're backed by **Khosla Ventures** and **Y Combinator**. We're still just getting started. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for an AI\-first builder to transform how we deliver customer support at Broccoli AI. You'll own customer support experience and build the AI workflows, systems, and documentation that help us resolve customer issues faster and more effectively. You'll work closely with our Technical Support team, Customer Success and Product Engineering, to build tools and automate workflow, improve how our AI troubleshoots customer issues, and build a knowledge base that delivers accurate, helpful answers. This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to use technical skills to impact directly how a world class technical support team works. You'll identify recurring customer issues, build and improve AI\-powered solutions, and use support data to identify opportunities to improve the customer experience. You'll report to our Head of Customer Success and partner closely with teams across the company. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and improve AI workflows that help resolve common customer questions and Tier 1 support issues. * Own our support knowledge base, ensuring documentation is accurate, easy to navigate, and useful for both customers and AI. * Build out the customer facing support platform (example). * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks and build the tools, integrations, and workflows to make them happen. * Investigate recurring customer issues and AI failures to understand root causes and develop lasting solutions. * Partner with Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Engineering to improve the customer experience and address underlying product issues. * Build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into ticket trends, resolution rates, and support performance. * Help ensure enterprise customers and complex issues receive the attention they need while making routine support more scalable. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering or closely related technical experience, with a track record of building and shipping software. * A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. * Strong coding skills and experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software. * Experience building integrations, working with APIs and databases, and connecting systems. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-powered applications, LLMs, AI agents, or workflow automation. * A product\-minded approach to engineering. You enjoy understanding customer problems and building solutions that address them. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to take projects from initial idea through implementation and iteration. * Experience working with customer support teams or building customer\-facing tools is a plus.

jobs.title: Innovation Software Engineer 1 New
jobs.description: **Built's Mission:** Connect and simplify doing business in real estate. Built is the AI\-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose\-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at **getbuilt.com**. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Innovation Software Engineer I, Marketplace** =============================================== Built Technologies is the AI\-first platform for construction and real estate finance, managing over $300 billion in annual capital for more than 340 lenders, including 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks. Our technology helps financial institutions and construction companies manage the movement of capital throughout construction projects, from loan draws and inspections to payments, compliance, and portfolio risk. We're bringing modern software and AI into an industry where many critical workflows still depend on spreadsheets, emails, and manual processes. **This role sits on Marketplace**, a business unit focused on expanding Built beyond its core software into the services surrounding construction projects, including inspections, appraisals, insurance, and materials sourcing. The team operates a little differently from a traditional engineering team. We're building the foundational technology that powers Marketplace while also experimenting with new products, getting early versions into customers' hands, and improving them based on real feedback. As an **Innovation Software Engineer**, you'll be part of that work from the beginning. You'll write code, build prototypes, experiment with AI\-powered workflows, and learn how to turn customer problems into working software. You'll work closely with experienced engineers who will help you develop your technical skills, make sound engineering decisions, and gradually take on more ownership. This is an opportunity for an early\-career engineer who loves building things, learns quickly, and wants to understand not just how software works, but why it matters to the people using it. **The Team** ------------ Marketplace is a small, experienced engineering team that recently became its own business unit at Built. It's a collaborative group with a strong culture of mentorship, code review, and hands\-on problem solving. You'll work alongside Senior and Staff engineers, Product, Design, and business leaders, learning how new products go from an initial idea to something customers actually use. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build real software:** Develop features, APIs, internal tools, and reusable components that support Marketplace products, working alongside experienced engineers on design, implementation, testing, and code review. * **Prototype new ideas:** Help turn early product concepts into working prototypes and MVPs. Build quickly, learn from feedback, and improve what you've shipped. * **Build with AI:** Use AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and help build AI\-powered features, including document extraction, data validation, agent\-driven workflows, and automation. * **Learn production engineering:** Develop your understanding of backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, data models, testing, and the practices that make software reliable and maintainable. * **Get closer to customers:** Participate in customer discovery conversations, observe how people use the products, and help translate what you learn into improvements. * **Improve existing products:** Identify friction in workflows, fix bugs, improve usability, and help make products more reliable and valuable for customers. * **Automate manual work:** Learn how a workflow operates before automating it, then build tools and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve efficiency. * **Grow your technical ownership:** Participate in code reviews, ask questions, learn from feedback, and gradually take responsibility for larger pieces of engineering work. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, product engineering, or a related technical role. Recent graduates and career changers with strong hands\-on projects are encouraged to apply. * Experience writing code in **TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python**, whether through professional work, internships, coursework, or personal projects. * Familiarity with APIs, databases, and fundamental software engineering concepts. * Experience using AI coding tools or experimenting with LLMs to build something, along with curiosity about how AI can be incorporated into real products. * At least one project you've built that you can product insights. * Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team. *Built’s salary range for this position is $80,000\-$110,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market\-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.* **\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_** **Travel Requirement:** Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs. **Perks:** * The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1\.5T industry * Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation \[US ONLY], medical, dental \& vision insurance * Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options * Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development * 401k with match and expedited vesting \[US ONLY] Built brings together passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines, each bringing their unique perspective to everything they do. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly \- without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Built is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please share with your Talent Partner or email careers@getbuilt.com. ***Greenhouse Data Disclosure:*** *When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Built. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Built’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, communicating with you regarding your application (including via text message),and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Built’s behalf. Your personal data will also be shared with Grayscale Labs, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built Technologies to facilitate candidate communications, including text messaging.Your personal data will be retained by Built as long as Built determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for current or future employment. You have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability.* *Built Privacy Policy* *By providing your phone number, you consent to receive text messages from Built related to your application. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP.* *If you would like to contact Built to ask questions surrounding processing of your personal data or to make a request, you can send an email to* *privacy@getbuilt.com**.* *California residents: Please note that Built does not sell your personal data. For details on how your data is shared with our service providers, please see our* *Privacy Policy**.*

on\-call rotation for the services you build. **Requirements:** ================= * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM\-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. * Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. * Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. * Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding\-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. * Services built on message\- or event\-driven architectures, including long\-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event\-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy\-in from a team before buildi  code review you can give as well as take. **Even Better if You Have:** * React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full\-stack feature end to end. jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Core Backend team in our Cloud Customer Experience (CCX) organization. Core Backend builds the shared services that every Crusoe Cloud product depends on: quota management, customer notifications, organization onboarding and KYC, and the API framework that sits in front of our backend services. Customers rely on these systems to sign up, get access to the capacity they are entitled to, and hear from us when something changes on their account. Product teams rely on them so they can launch on Crusoe Cloud without building their own quota, notification or onboarding systems. You will lead a team of backend engineers, partner with the team's product manager, and set technical direction for services that sit on the path of every customer request. This is a full\-time, hands\-on management role for someone who has led backend or platform teams, can go deep on distributed systems design, and can weigh requests from many internal teams against one roadmap. **What You'll Be Working On:** * Shared services for product teams: Own the services other Crusoe Cloud teams build on, including quota management, the notification service and the API framework, so a new product can launch without building its own versions of them. * Quota management: Run the system of record for what each organization and project can consume across GPU, compute, storage and networking, along with the request and approval workflows that change those limits. * Customer onboarding: Lead self\-serve onboarding, organization state management and automated KYC, and work with risk and security partners on fraud prevention for self\-serve customers. * Customer notifications: Own the service that sends email, in\-console, webhook and Slack notifications to Crusoe Cloud customers. * Reliability and operations: Set and meet SLOs for the team's services, run on\-call and incident reviews, and move long\-running operations onto durable workflows. * Technical direction: Guide architecture decisions with the team, including API standardization across services and breaking apart monolithic services, and make the tradeoffs between new features and platform work. * Cross\-functional partnership: Work with Product, Customer Success, Security and the other CCX teams (Billing, Identity and Access Management, Client Interfaces and Admin Tooling) to set one roadmap from many requests. * Team building: Hire, mentor and grow engineers, including filling open roles on the team. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * People leadership: 2\+ years managing software engineering teams, including hiring, performance management and career development for engineers at different levels. * Backend engineering: 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services in Go or another compiled language (Rust, Java or C\+\+). Our services are primarily written in Go. * Distributed systems: Experience designing and running distributed systems or cloud platform services, including versioned APIs (gRPC or REST), relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and message queues such as Kafka, NATS or Pub/Sub. * Operations: Experience owning customer\-facing production systems, including SLOs, monitoring and alerting, on\-call and incident response. * Platform mindset: A track record of leading a team that serves other engineering teams, and of setting priorities when several teams need something at once. * Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs to engineers, product managers and non\-technical partners. * Education: Bachelor's degree minimum. **Bonus Points** * Quota and entitlement systems: Experience building quota, rate limiting or entitlement systems for a cloud provider or multi\-tenant platform. * Onboarding and risk: Experience with customer onboarding, KYC or fraud prevention systems. * Workflow engines: Experience with Temporal or similar workflow engines, or with state machines and reconciliation loops for long\-running operations. * API platforms: Experience building API gateways or API frameworks used by many engineering teams. * AI infrastructure: Familiarity with GPU cloud platforms or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 \-$260,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** We are looking for a Staff Engineer to be the technical lead and systems architect for Crusoe's Managed Data Transfer (MDT) service, the person who owns how its parts fit together and how MDT fits into Crusoe Cloud. MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data between hyperscaler storage and Crusoe storage as a managed service, so AI labs and Physical AI companies can train on Crusoe GPUs without building their own transfer pipelines. You will design the control plane, the transfer worker fleet and the integration with Crusoe's storage and network, and set the path for adding other clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers. This is an engineering leadership role on a new team. Managed Data Transfer starts from a working prototype that already serves customers in production, so your first decisions are about what to keep, harden or replace, and how to sequence that work without disrupting the customers who depend on it. You will lead the design through Crusoe's architecture review, mentor the engineers who build it, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer within Managed platform services. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end design of MDT: the job API and scheduler, the transfer workers on Kubernetes, storage integration and network paths. You decide what the system looks like and explain why. * **Prototype Assessment and Migration:** Evaluate the production prototype, decide what gets refactored, extended or replaced, and move its current users onto the managed service without interruption. * **Throughput and Correctness:** Set the data\-plane strategy (sharding, concurrency, straggler handling, checksum verification) and the benchmarks that prove it, aiming for line\-rate transfers over dedicated interconnects. * **Cross\-Team Contracts:** Own the interfaces between MDT and Storage, Network, Kubernetes, IAM, Console, Billing and Monitoring. You define what partner teams build to and hold the line on it. * **Extensibility and Build\-versus\-Buy:** Design for new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers with a pluggable transfer engine and regional worker pools, and evaluate open\-source and vendor options before the team builds. * **Operational Excellence:** Set the bar for reliability, observability and on\-call for every system the team ships. * **Product Partnership:** Work with Product on scope, pricing trade\-offs and milestones, and surface edge cases early enough to change the plan. * **Technical Mentorship:** Raise the team's level through design reviews, RFC feedback and direct coaching, so the team runs well without depending on you. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Distributed Systems Depth:** Hands\-on and the judgment to steer AI toward high\-quality code you fully understand and can stand behind * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate well with both technical and non\-technical teammates * A passion for building scalable solutions that have real customer impact **Bonus Points If You Have** * Proficiency with microservices architecture or micro\-frontend infrastructure * Experience with observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing) * Hands\-on experience building features that integrate LLMs or AI capabilities into a product *We know many women do not apply for a job if they don't perfectly fit the description. jobs.title: Data Engineer 5
jobs.description: Data Engineer 5 Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking **a Data Engineer 5** who is passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One. Enterprise Data Tech (EDT) is responsible for managing data technology, platforms, and experiences across Capital One. Our core mission is to make data easy to find, use, understand, govern, and protect throughout the complex end to end data lifecycle. This foundation is built on key platforms that manage Capital One’s Data Pipeline, including data storage, and access. Looking ahead, our imperatives are centered on evolving our capabilities for the AI world and strategically expanding Capital One’s data platforms. **What You’ll Do:** * Collaborate with and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions in full\-stack development tools and technologies * Influence a team of developers, data analysts and data scientists with deep experience in machine learning, distributed microservices, lakehouse architecture, and full\-stack systems * Utilize programming languages such as Python and Spark, along with open\-source relational and NoSQL databases, and cloud\-based data warehousing platforms including Databricks and Snowflake * Share your passion for staying on top of trends in data, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal and external technology communities, and mentoring other members of the data community * Collaborate with product managers and software engineers to deliver robust cloud\-first data solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment * Independently design, build and deliver world\-class cloud data solutions and applications with little or no support from supervisors or managers * Architect and enforce common data engineering design patterns to ensure code quality, maintainability, and reusability across data platforms and pipelines * Serve as an ambassador for the data engineering team, communicating technical concepts and data outcomes clearly to both internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and shared understanding * Design and build data pipelines and platforms with a focus on scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency, ensuring robust performance under increasing data volume and business demands * Serve as a force\-multiplier for the team, balancing deep, hands\-on technical contribution and innovation with mentoring and elevating the skills of peers and junior engineers * Lead and execute large\-scale, transformative data initiatives from end to end, independently driving critical architectural decisions and evaluating platform choices, such as Snowflake versus Databricks, based on technical and business requirements **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 6 years of experience in application development (Internship experience does not apply) * At least 4 years of experience in distributed data * At least 4 years of experience with SQL * At least 4 years of experience programming with at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, or Scala * At least 4 years of experience designing and developing data pipelines * At least 2 years of experience in data modeling and designing end\-to\-end data solutions using both relational and non\-relational database systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, deploying and operating data workloads in AWS * 5\+ years of experience building or supporting distributed data or compute workloads using tools such as EMR, Spark, Glue, or Databricks * 5\+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating real\-time or streaming data pipelines * 5\+ years of experience working with unstructured or semistructured data using NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) * 5\+ years of experience designing and supporting data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift) * 4\+ years of data modeling experience * 3\+ years of experience working in an Agile development environment * 3\+ years of experience developing user\-centric reusable data products * 3\+ years of experience working on data observability (e.g., Monte Carlo, Splunk) or data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. Cambridge, MA: $229,900 \- $262,400 for Data Engineer 5 McLean, VA: $229,900 \- $262,400 for Data Engineer 5 New York, NY: $250,800 \- $286,200 for Data Engineer 5 Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part\-time status, exempt or non\-exempt status, and management level. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries. If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1\-800\-304\-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third\-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site. Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

jobs.title: Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network
jobs.description: Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network Capital One has grown from a promising credit card startup into a Fortune 100 company. Our businesses span Card, Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, and Financial Services, backed by an Enterprise Services group that is Capital One's digital and technology backbone. Within that enterprise, the **Global Payment Network (GPN)** is one of the company's most ambitious builds: the unification of three legacy networks — Discover Network, PULSE, and Diners Club International — into a single, modern payment network. Rather than three separate acceptance footprints, three separate data models, and three separate operating teams, GPN is being rebuilt from a clean sheet so that a card issued anywhere on the network works everywhere on the network. This is the kind of ground\-up platform build most engineers only read about — a chance to define how data moves through one of the largest payment networks in the world, not maintain what's already there. **What You'll Do:** The **Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer (IC)** for GPN will be responsible for architecting and delivering the real\-time and batch data infrastructure that every other team on the network builds on — ingestion, streaming, the canonical data model, and the catalog and metadata layer that gives the network a single source of truth. This role sits at the cross\-section of Core Network, Fraud/AML, Analytics, and the Modeling teams building on top of this data, and offers the rare opportunity to define how a payment network's data platform gets built from the ground up rather than inheriting one. A deep understanding of distributed systems, real\-time streaming architecture, data modeling at scale, and cloud infrastructure is required. This is a highly visible and influential individual\-contributor role, with no direct reports, that requires a combination of deep technical skill, setting vision and architecture, and effective partnership across engineering, data science, product, and risk. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect the real\-time, event\-driven data pipelines that move authorization, transaction, settlement, and fraud\-relevant events across the network with the latency and exactly\-once delivery guarantees a payment network requires — this is not a dashboard\-refresh pipeline, it is infrastructure fraud and risk decisioning will run on. * Define the canonical data model that reconciles three legacy schemes — each with its own merchant hierarchies, participant identities, and transaction semantics — into one shared model, with legacy formats translated at the network's edge only, never propagated inward. * Design and build the catalog and metadata layer (schema registry, lineage, data contracts, access policy) that gives every downstream team — fraud models, analytics, canonical modeling — one trustworthy source of truth instead of each team reverse\-engineering its own. * Set the technical architecture and standards for streaming, storage, and low\-latency serving at network scale, and serve as an evangelist for data standardization both internally and with the partner teams building on this platform. * Operate as the deep technical authority and trusted advisor across the data engineering function, reimagining what a modern, portable data platform should look like — favoring open, well\-understood components over one\-off tooling, so the platform is something new engineers can reason about on day one. * Partner directly with Fraud/AML, Analytics, and Canonical Modeling leadership so your architecture directly unblocks their roadmaps rather than trailing behind them. * Mentor and raise the technical bar for engineers across the organization, acting as a force multiplier on a brand\-new network build without owning a reporting chain of your own. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field Enterprise architecture and design patterns + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering * 12\+ years of experience in all of the following: + Software engineering and solution architecture + Enterprise architecture and design patterns + Web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript and SPA frameworks) + Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * Deep experience designing event\-driven, real\-time streaming architectures at scale (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or equivalent) * Experience with distributed storage, catalog, and metadata/lineage systems (e.g. Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures) * Experience designing canonical or shared data models that unify disparate or legacy systems * Experience architecting high\-availability, low\-latency distributed systems in a jobs.title: Senior R&D Test engineer
jobs.description: At Capstan Medical, we’re driven by an unwavering commitment to transforming the treatment of heart valve disease. By merging surgical robotics with catheter\-based technology and next generation implants, we’ve pioneered a patient\-optimized approach to repair and replace heart valves. Our innovative technology offers a significantly less invasive alternative to traditional open\-heart surgery while ensuring precise and reliable placement of the heart valve implant. With these advancements, we may be able to provide patients with a solution to their heart valve disease while significantly reducing recovery time and minimizing the risk of complications. With a dedicated team of heart valve device experts and robotics engineers, we are fully committed to developing a comprehensive and transformative solution that will positively impact the lives of individuals affected by this condition. Capstan Medical is uniquely positioned in Santa Cruz. This gives us access to the amazing technical talent of the Bay Area, but in an environment that we feel is conducive to doing our best creative work. Our office is adjacent to large tracts of open space with bicycle trails straight from the office doors offering access to the hills and beaches of Wilder Ranch State Park for road/mountain bicycle riding, hiking, and surfing. Come join us and become part of a team revolutionizing heart valve treatment! ### **Responsibilities** The Senior R\&D Test Engineer will own testing for the hardware of a novel robotic platform and required to Come bring your experience to accelerate and strengthen our hardware testing strategy and be part of a successful initial product release. This is a hybrid position requiring 4 days per week on average at our Santa Cruz, CA location. **What you’ll do:** * Develop high level verification and validation test plans for the robot hardware systems. * Translate robot hardware requirements into test methods, test cases, and acceptance criteria. * Own and lead execution of test protocols for design verification testing including system reliability testing and mechanical testing against IEC 60601\-1\. Coordinate with external test houses for executing IEC 60601\-1 related mechanical testing as appropriate. * Write test protocols and test reports to support regulatory in accurately and clearly representing our test results in FDA submissions. * Design test fixtures needed to perform verification testing and identify pre\-existing fixtures and test methods that could be improved. * Collaborate with manufacturing to design test fixtures to qualify robot hardware in manufacturing. * Identify and communicate any issues or observations to the broader team. Collaborate with the team on root cause analysis or failure investigations. * Document and communicate your work through design reviews and as appropriate released documents as part of the product development process. * Align individual work to best support company goals, identifying high risk items and being part of developing solutions. ### **Requirements** **What you’ll need:** * BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline, or equivalent work experience. * 5\-8 years of relevant experience working in a regulated environment with formal verification testing, medical device experience strongly preferred. * Proficiency in CAD (SolidWorks preferred) for creating detailed parts, assemblies, and drawings for test fixtures, using GD\&T as appropriate. * Hands on prototyping capabilities and familiarity with sensing equipment (e.g. Chatillon, Instron) * Strong written communication skills, in particular writing technical content for a reviewer audience like the FDA. * Comfortable working with high levels of ambiguity and an ability to convert that into tangible outcomes. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience with various manufacturing methods and hands on prototyping, including manual machining, 3D printing, etc. * Experience with medical robotics, in particular testing hardware to IEC 60601\-1\. **Why join us:** * We offer a fun, hands\-on, fast\-paced, collaborative environment where you will be working on transformational technologies in the cardiac healthcare space. * We offer outstanding benefits with medical, dental, and vision covered at 100% for you and your family, as well as flex time off. * We thrive in our work\-hard, play\-hard environment. Bring your bike or running shoes if you’d like or just be ready to enjoy a fun office outing. We enjoy time inside the office and out! **We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment** **without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status.** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Care Access** Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.** With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all. To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com. ### **How This Role Makes a Difference** The **Senior Data Engineer** is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and enterprise data solutions that support the organization's operational, analytical, and reporting needs. This position oversees the ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery of complex data from multiple sources to ensure the availability, reliability, and integrity of enterprise data assets. The Senior Data Engineer collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to develop modern data architectures, optimize data processing workflows, and enhance platform performance using industry best practices and cloud\-based technologies. This role provides technical leadership in advancing the organization's data infrastructure, supporting data governance initiatives, and delivering high\-quality data solutions that enable informed business decision\-making. ### **How You'll Make An Impact** * **Data Engineering Strategy and Architecture:** + Design and implement scalable, reliable, and efficient data pipelines to support clinical, operational, and business needs. + Develop and maintain architecture standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across data engineering workflows. + Build automated systems for data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration leveraging cloud\-native and open\-source tools. * **Data Infrastructure and Performance Optimization:** + Optimize data storage and processing in data lakes and cloud data warehouses (Azure, Databricks). + Develop and monitor batch and streaming data processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. + Maintain documentation and lineage tracking across datasets and pipelines to support transparency and governance. * **Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement:** + Work cross\-functionally with analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver fit\-for\-purpose data solutions. + Review and refine work completed by other team members, ensuring quality and performance standards are met. + Provide technical mentorship to junior team members and collaborate with contractors and third\-party vendors to extend engineering capacity. * **Technology and Tools:** + Use Databricks, DBT, Azure Data Factory, and SQL to architect and deploy robust data engineering solutions. + Integrate APIs, structured/unstructured data sources, and third\-party systems into centralized data platforms. + Evaluate and implement new technologies to enhance the scalability, observability, and automation of data operations. * **Continuous Improvement:** + Proactively This role embeds security into the AI development lifecycle, establishes governance frameworks aligned with NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001, and leads threat modeling, red\-team testing, and incident response for AI\-related risks. The position collaborates cross\-functionally with IT, data, legal, and program teams to ensure responsible, secure AI adoption in support of CARE's humanitarian mission. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** *AI System Security \& Threat Assessment* * Assess and harden AI/ML models, APIs, and inference endpoints against adversarial attacks including prompt injection, model inversion, and data poisoning. Perform threat modeling for generative AI and agentic AI deployments. Conduct red\-team exercises against LLMs and AI\-powered applications, including jailbreak testing and adversarial prompt analysis. Monitor AI workloads for anomalous behavior, model drift, and signs of compromise. This responsibility directly protects CARE's operational data and the integrity of AI\-assisted program delivery. *Security Architecture \& Enterprise AI Integration* * Partner with engineering and IT teams to integrate security controls into the AI/ML development lifecycle. Establish secure data handling practices for training data and model artifacts. *AI Governance \& Compliance* * Develop and maintain AI security policies, standards, and risk frameworks aligned with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP LLM Top 10, and MITRE ATLAS. Maintain an inventory of AI systems and assess risk posture, access scope, and data exposure. Support audits and compliance reviews related to AI use. Advise senior leadership (CISO, COO, General Counsel) on evolving AI security risks, threat intelligence, and remediation priorities. Ensure AI adoption remains compliant with applicable data privacy laws and organizational policy. *Incident Response \& Security Awareness* * Lead or support incident response for AI\-related security events including prompt injection attacks, model abuse, and data exfiltration through AI interfaces. Develop playbooks and runbooks specific to AI security incidents. Deliver security awareness training on AI\-generated threats such as deepfakes, AI\-assisted phishing, and social engineering. Stay current on AI security research, threat actor tactics, and responsible disclosure in the AI security community. ### **Required Qualifications:** * **Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent combination of education and work experience.** * **3\+ years in cybersecurity engineering or application security.** * **Demonstrated knowledge of AI/ML concepts and common frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).** * **Hands\-on LLM security experience: prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial input testing.** * **Experience securing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Anthropic Claude enterprise deployments. Proficiency in Python for security tooling. Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for AI/ML workloads.** * **Knowledge of NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, or ISO/IEC 42001\.** ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Experience with agentic AI systems, multi\-agent orchestration, and AI workflow automation.** * **Familiarity with Copilot Studio, Graph\-grounded agents, and MCP connector security. The role translates business and user needs into scalable technical solutions; integrates applications with enterprise data products and platforms; and helps ensure that CareQuest applications and services are reliable, well documented, and sustainable. Emerging capabilities may be incorporated when they provide clear user or organizational value, while the position remains focused on sound application architecture, usability, performance, observability, and operational reliability. **PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, build, test, and maintain full\-stack web applications, including backend services, REST APIs, background tasks, and integrations with internal and external systems. * Develop responsive, accessible, testable, and user\-centered frontend experiences using React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript practices. * Build and maintain backend services using Python and FastAPI or comparable technologies, with attention to code organization, authentication, authorization, asynchronous processing, and performance. * jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer

(Bronze, Silver, Gold layers). * Develop transformation processes to standardize, cleanse, and prepare enterprise datasets for reporting, analytics, and downstream application consumption. * Collaborate with analytics and reporting to deliver curated datasets supporting dashboards, AI, and machine learning models. * Design scalable frameworks for both inbound and outbound data integrations to support new client onboarding and enterprise data exchange requirements. * Monitor and tune data pipeline performance to ensure efficient data movement, minimal latency, and reliable execution. * Implement data governance, metadata management, and data lineage practices to improve transparency and trust in enterprise data assets. * Participate in architectural discussions and or related roles. * Strong experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or similar integration platforms. * Experience with Python for data processing, automation, or pipeline orchestration. * Strong experience working with SQL Server and relational databases. * Experience designing scalable data ingestion and transformation processes for large datasets. * Experience building or supporting cloud\-based data platforms within Microsoft Azure. **Preferred** * Experience designing and implementing data lake architectures. * Experience with medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold). * Experience supporting analytics platforms such as Power BI or similar BI tools. * Experience with distributed data processing or big data technologies. * Experience supporting AI/ML data pipelines and analytics workloads. * Experience with healthcare, insurance, or large\-scale transactional data environments. ##### **SKILLS** * Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking abilities. * Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and reusable data integration frameworks. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including data analysts, data scientists, application developers, and infrastructure engineers. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and operational reliability. * Ability to mentor and provide technical leadership within a data engineering team. jobs.title: Research Scientist - College of Engineering - Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: Carnegie Mellon University is a private, global research university that stands among the world’s most renowned education institutions. With ground\-breaking brain science, path\-breaking performances, creative start\-ups, big data, big ambitions, hands\-on learning, and a whole lot of robots, CMU doesn’t imagine the future, we invent it. If you’re passionate about joining a community that challenges the curious to deliver work that matters, your journey starts here! Innovation. Interdisciplinary collaboration. Complex problem solving. In Carnegie Mellon University’s Department of Mechanical Engineering, faculty members, researchers, and students are revolutionizing focus areas in advanced manufacturing, bioengineering, computational engineering, energy and the environment, product design, and robotics. In addition, they are using their expertise in interdisciplinary research centers across the university. Carnegie Mellon University’s department of Mechanical Engineering is searching for a Research Scientist to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in an interesting and challenging work environment. You will contribute to the department by leading the Safe AI Lab's research program on scenario generation, simulation, and digital twins for embodied AI. The role builds digital twins of industrial work cells and assembly processes, generates safety\-critical and long\-tail scenarios from incident data, standards, and procedural variation, and runs simulation\-based evaluation of robot policies in physics simulators (NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) to produce quantitative safety evidence and sim\-to\-real validation.
