jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.description: **About Carolina Foods** Carolina Foods LLC produces high\-quality Duchess branded and private\-label bakery goods for retail customers nationwide. Based in Pineville in the Charlotte, North Carolina area, our single\-site bakery brings product development and manufacturing together, giving team members a direct connection to the products, people, and decisions that drive our business. Our people are central to our success. We value team members who take pride in their work, share ideas, and build strong partnerships. Our commitment to safety, food safety and quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement guides how we work and grow. **Your Role as a Continuous Improvement Engineer** The Continuous Improvement (CI) Engineer leads hands\-on improvements on the plant floor to reduce losses, improve production performance, and build reliable processes. This role focuses on the performance and quality components of overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), ingredient and packaging waste, labor utilization, and changeover efficiency. Working with Production, Maintenance, Reliability, Sanitation, and Quality, the CI Engineer identifies the largest losses, leads root cause analysis, and implements improvements that hold over time. The role also serves as the plant's technical liaison for automated baking line startup and commissioning, translating improvements into standard work, training, and daily operating routines. **Key Responsibilities:** **Loss Elimination and Performance Improvement** * Analyze OEE, downtime, scrap, and production data by line and shift to identify, prioritize, and address the largest performance losses. * Lead projects that reduce ingredient, material, and packaging waste; improve labor utilization; and increase throughput and available capacity. * Troubleshoot manufacturing issues, lead root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Verify sustained results and reduce recurring equipment\-related losses. * Facilitate rapid changeover events using Single\-Minute Exchange of Die (SMED) methods, with clear baselines, improvement targets, action plans, and follow\-up. **Equipment, Automation, and Reliability** * Lead startup and commissioning activities for highly automated baking lines as the plant's technical liaison with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), controls integrators, and Maintenance. * Participate in factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), equipment debugging, punch\-list closure, and ramp\-up to rated speed and required product quality. * Lead Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) activities for new and existing equipment with Maintenance and Reliability; establish routines that improve equipment care and reduce repeat breakdowns. * Diagnose mechanical and automation issues using programmable logic controller (PLC) and human\-machine interface (HMI) alarms, input/output and sensor status, and machine sequences; partner with Maintenance and controls specialists on repairs and countermeasures. * Support material\-handling flow design for new or expanded lines, from raw materials and packaging delivery through finished goods transfer to shipping. **Standard Work, Training, and Operating Discipline** * Develop, maintain, and audit standard operating procedures (SOPs) for new automated equipment and improved processes; confirm procedures are practical for the teams using them. * Lead SOP training for Production, Sanitation, and Maintenance employees, verify understanding, and coach teams to identify and solve problems. * Support the site's Management Operating Structure (MOS), including daily and weekly performance reviews, department metrics, action tracking, and timely follow\-through. **Additional Responsibilities:** * Model safety, food safety, product quality, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), and housekeeping expectations. Follow equipment safeguards and applicable safe\-work procedures during troubleshooting and startup. * Promptly report hazards and food safety or quality concerns, support audits, and close assigned corrective actions on time. Never compromise employee safety, food safety, or quality to improve speed or cost. * Partner respectfully across departments and shifts, encourage employee improvement ideas, and provide hands\-on support during startups and other critical operating periods. * Perform other related duties as assigned to support continuous improvement and business needs. **What Matters Most** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, food science, operations management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Three to five years of hands\-on manufacturing experience applying continuous improvement or Lean methods, with demonstrated, measurable results. * Hands\-on experience starting up and commissioning automated production equipment, including FAT/SAT, debugging, and ramp\-up to rated performance. * Demonstrated root cause analysis and problem\-solving skills, with working knowledge of GMPs and food safety requirements. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including facilitating meetings and training employees; proficiency with Microsoft Office and production data analysis. * Sound independent judgment, strong organization, and the ability to manage several projects and competing priorities in a results\-driven environment. * Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts, weekends, and holidays, particularly during equipment startups and critical project milestones. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in food, baking, or other process manufacturing. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher, and hands\-on experience with TPM, SMED, and OEE improvement. * Strong mechanical aptitude and working knowledge of PLC/HMI systems sufficient to diagnose faults; PLC programming is not required. * Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), OEE platforms such as Redzone, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) data. * OSHA 30\-hour or comparable safety training. **Skills for Success:** * Hands\-on ownership: Works at the line with employees and follows through. * Analytical judgment: Uses reliable data to identify losses, prioritize work, and verify that completed projects deliver measurable improvement. * Problem\-solving discipline: Resolves root causes and verifies lasting results. * Collaboration and influence: Builds trust across functions and shifts and leads improvement without direct supervisory authority. * Coaching and standardization: Explains technical concepts clearly and turns successful changes into repeatable, trained, and audited practices. **Measures of Success:** * First\-year goals will use agreed baselines and track the following outcomes: * Measurable OEE improvement and reduced ingredient, packaging, and labor losses on assigned lines. * Shorter changeovers against targets established for each SMED effort. * Documented SOPs and completed training for new automated equipment before handoff to Production. * Established TPM routines and fewer recurring equipment breakdowns. * Timely closure of root cause analyses and corrective actions, with verified, sustained results. **Work Environment and Physical Demands** * This onsite, plant\-floor\-based role works in a high\-volume industrial bakery and at a computer for analysis, documentation, and project coordination. * Work involves standing and walking through production areas, observing equipment and processes, and accessing equipment areas for troubleshooting and startup support. * Conditions may include heat, noise, moving equipment, and material\-handling traffic. Required personal protective equipment and food safety and hygiene practices must be followed. * Work may include nonstandard shifts, weekends, and holidays, especially during startups. Travel is expected to be minimal. Essential functions may be performed with reasonable accommodation. **Come Join Us!** Help turn plant\-floor challenges into lasting improvements. At Carolina Foods, your technical skills, curiosity, and teamwork can strengthen bakery performance and help our teams succeed. If you enjoy solving problems, launching automated equipment, and making improvements last, we invite you to apply and grow with us.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About Carolina Foods:** Carolina Foods LLC produces high\-quality Duchess branded and private\-label bakery goods for retail customers nationwide. Based in Pineville in the Charlotte, North Carolina area, our bakery brings product development and manufacturing together, giving leaders a direct connection to the products, people, and decisions that drive our business. Our people are central to our success. We value leaders who take pride in their work, share ideas, and build strong partnerships. Our commitment to safety, food safety and quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement guides how we work and grow. **Your Role as Head of Engineering:** A hands\-on engineering doer, not a program administrator. This role owns the plant's forward\-looking improvement agenda, making existing lines better and building the capital pipeline that makes the plant fundamentally more capable and personally does the engineering work behind it: specs, FMEAs, business cases, and startup. It does not run day\-to\-day reactive maintenance or the plant's full legacy PM program. What it does own outright is the technical integrity of everything it touches: every project this person leads is engineered and commissioned to a real standard, not just installed and walked away from. Success looks like a live pipeline of improvement and capital projects, each with a credible business case, delivered on time and on budget, engineered to hold up, and with realized results tracked against what was promised. **What this Role Is Not:** Not a day\-to\-day reactive maintenance role, floor\-level PM execution and shift standards stay with the Maintenance Lead. Not, on its own, a rebuild of the plant's entire legacy PM program across every existing asset, that comprehensive lift is a future Engineering Lead's mandate once the plant adds that seat. This role's reliability and FMEA discipline applies fully and personally to everything it touches, its own projects and the assets it's asked to dig into, not to the full inherited asset base on day one. **Key Responsibilities:** **Continuous Improvement Pipeline (Existing Lines)** * Own the loss/opportunity Pareto for existing lines \- OEE, yield, changeover time, rate, and labor productivity \- and convert it into a prioritized improvement pipeline. * Apply flow/constraint analysis (Theory of Constraints) to find the plant's true system constraint before proposing a fix, rather than optimizing a line in isolation. * Lead structured improvement events (Kaizen/DMAIC) with cross\-functional teams and put a control plan behind every completed improvement so gains are sustained and visible in the data months later. **Capital Project Development, DesignJustification** * Own capital project scoping, specification, and the business case \- ROI/payback, cross\-functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Quality, and the formal approval (AFE) package. * Build and prioritize the capital project pipeline against the plant's strategic priorities, in partnership with the COO and plant leadership. * Lead vendor/OEM selection, design review, and installation oversight personally \- this role is the plant's technical authority on its own projects, not a project manager coordinating someone else's engineering. **Commissioning, ReliabilityStartup (Hands\-On)** * Personally treat every project as complete only once a real commissioning package is delivered: performance validated against design intent, a failure mode and criticality analysis (FMEA) completed, PM procedures and frequencies derived from that FMEA, spare parts strategy defined, and operating parameters (rate limits, setpoints) validated against real flow data \- never assumed from a single output point. * Lead or directly support root cause analysis on failures tied to this role's own projects or the plant's highest\-impact assets, in partnership with the Maintenance Lead; reject "replaced the part" as a root cause. * Own the formal handoff of new or modified equipment to the Maintenance Lead, including training, documentation, and a defined transition point before moving to the next project. * Track realized results against the original business case for at least two full quarters post\-startup and report the gap openly. **What Matters Most** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Process, or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a highly automated manufacturing environment. * Track record personally leading capital projects from spec through startup \- not just coordinating others' engineering \- ideally in food or CPG manufacturing. * Demonstrated continuous improvement leadership (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent) with results tied to OEE, yield, or throughput gains. * Working knowledge of FMEA, RCA methodology, and PM strategy development as engineering disciplines applied hands\-on, not administered. * Strong financial acumen \- comfortable building and defending an ROI/payback case to Finance and executive leadership. **Preferred:** * Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. * Experience with automated packaging/wrapping equipment and high\-speed bakery or food production lines. * Familiarity with capital appropriation (AFE) processes in a PE\-backed or multi\-site manufacturing environment. * Familiarity with CMMS/EAM platforms (e.g., RedZone). **Leadership Standards:** * Does the engineering personally \- specs, FMEAs, and validated parameters \- rather than delegating the technical substance and managing only the schedule. * Builds the business case on real data and conservative assumptions \- never sells a project on a number that won't hold up under scrutiny. * Protects the pipeline from becoming a firefighting queue; escalates instead of quietly absorbing reactive work that belongs elsewhere. * Reports realized projectresults and technical limitations honestly, including projects that fell short. **Skills for Success:** * **Hands\-on engineering:** Personally, develop specifications, technical analyses, FMEAs, and validated operating parameters and maintains ownership of the technical substance. * **Project and budget management:** Integrates scope, schedule, resources, cost forecasts, vendor commitments, and risk controls to deliver approved projects. * **Financial and analytical judgment:** Challenges assumptions, uses reliable operating data, and distinguishes projected benefits from verified results. * **Systems thinking and problem solving:** Uses flow analysis, constraint analysis, and structured RCA to address causes and improve plant\-wide performance. * **Influence and communication:** Leads across functions without direct supervisory authority, explains technical tradeoffs clearly, and reports setbacks honestly. * **Execution and sustainability:** Protects agreed priorities, documents decisions, trains operating owners, and follows results through commissioning, handoff, and sustained operation. **Work Environment and Physical Demands:** * Onsite role in a high\-volume industrial bakery, combining plant\-floor leadership with office work for planning, analysis, and project coordination. * Requires walking and standing in production areas and accessing equipment areas for inspection and startup support. Conditions may include heat, noise, moving equipment, and material\-handling traffic. * Required personal protective equipment, hygiene practices, and safe\-work procedures must be followed. Flexibility is needed for off\-shift work, weekends, shutdowns, emergencies, and project\-related travel * Essential functions may be performed with reasonable accommodation. **Come Join Us!** Bring your engineering expertise, leadership, and passion for solving problems to Carolina Foods. Help build reliable bakery operations, develop strong technical teams, and turn investments into lasting results. If you enjoy hands\-on leadership and working with senior leaders to improve performance, we invite you to apply or contact our Human Resources team.

As a hands\-on technical leader, you will provide architectural governance, mentor engineering teams, and guide execution across a scaled Agile environment—enabling frequent, predictable, and high\-quality releases while strengthening Caterpillar’s capabilities in automation, autonomy, cybersecurity, and digital innovation. **Additional Information:** * **Location:** Irving, TX (United States) * **Required Travel:** Up to 10% (International) * **Relocation Assistance Offered:** None. * **US Work Authorization Sponsorship Offered:** None. * This position requires the selected individual to work onsite at the Irving, TX office. **What You Will Do:** * **Drive DevOps Architecture Strategy**: Lead the definition and evolution of scalable DevOps architecture, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment provisioning, observability, security integration, and performance optimization strategies for embedded and distributed systems. * **Translate Business and Operational Needs into Solutions**: Partner with customers, Product Owners, and System Architects to analyze delivery workflows, define requirements, and design end\-to\-end DevOps solutions that tooling, ensuring high\-quality, secure, and performant delivery of embedded and connected applications. * **Champion Quality and Best Practices**: Define and promote automated testing strategies (unit, integration, system, and release validation), security, monitoring, and reliability practices (SRE) to ensure robust and resilient software delivery. * **Provide Technical Leadership and maturity. * **Own Architecture Artifacts and Governance**: Develop and maintain DevOps architecture documentation, standards, metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR), estimates, and validation artifacts to support alignment, scalability, compliance, and long\-term sustainability. * **Dependency Management:** Define and   strategy, configuration management, and release/versioning practices. + Experience deploying and managing applications across cloud, edge, and on\-premise platforms using containerization and orchestration technologies. + Ability to optimize pipeline performance, build efficiency, deployment speed, and system reliability in embedded or distributed environments. * **Strategic Thinking:** Knowledge of the importance of "big picture" thinking and effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to use these to deepen own expertise and impact or challenge decisions within and outside own organization. * **Software Product Design/Architecture:** Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into software product design. + Demonstrated extensive professional experience as a web application developer and/or UI Architect (or equivalent) delivering production software. + Demonstrated experience developing embedded web applications using HTML5 and Angular. **What Will Set You Apart (Preferred Qualifications):** * Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python, C\+\+) for automation, tooling, and system integration. * Strong experience in the C\+\+ ecosystem including toolchains, cross\-compilation, CMake\-based builds, and dependency management using Conan. * Experience with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash) for pipeline and workflow automation. * Knowledge of networking protocols and security (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, SSL/TLS). * Experience with Linux\-based or real\-time operating systems in embedded or distributed environments. * Familiarity with jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Agentic Automation
jobs.description: **About Cerby** At **Cerby**, security is everyone's business. Cerby extends your security perimeter to include your disconnected applications, providing identity automation and eliminating manual processes. It's one of the biggest blind spots in enterprise security, and we're the team closing it. If you want to work alongside the team solving one of the hardest, most overlooked problems in security, you're in the right place. Founded in 2020, Cerby is backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises across the globe. **OVERVIEW \& IMPACT** Every application Cerby protects needs Cerby to know how it works — its API, or the clicks behind its login, password rotation, MFA setup, or access change — and that knowledge breaks whenever a vendor redesigns its site or changes its API. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to own the AI agents that onboard new applications and repair automations when they drift. You will start with two agent systems we have already built and benchmarked: **API catalog generation:** reads a vendor’s public API docs in a headless browser and produces a validated OpenAPI spec, with per\-job cost ceilings and an accuracy benchmark. **Browser workflow generation:** performs a task in a SaaS app’s web UI and writes a replayable automation workflow, handling MFA, one\-time codes, and CAPTCHAs along the way. Your job is to take them to production, make them self\-healing, and set the direction for agentic automation at Cerby. These agents handle real customer credentials and browse untrusted sites, so security is part of the job, not an afterthought. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ### **Ownership and Production** * Own agentic onboarding and self\-healing end to end: architecture, roadmap, and on\-call once live. * Take the existing systems to production on durable workflows (Temporal), with the observability to run them. ### **Self\-Healing Automation** * Detect drift — a changed login page, a moved button, a renamed API field — from failed runs, before customers notice. * Build agents that diagnose the break, repair the workflow or spec, and re\-validate the fix against real runs before it goes back into service. * Decide what heals automatically and what needs human review. ### **Evaluation and Cost** * Own the benchmarks for generated specs, workflows, and repairs, and make “good enough to ship” a measured threshold. * Own cost and latency per output, choosing between frontier and open\-weight models on measured accuracy versus cost. ### **Security** * Own the threat model: prompt injection from page content, credential isolation, token handling, sandboxed browsing, and egress. * Keep credentials out of prompts, logs, queues, and stored run state. ### **Collaboration** * Partner with the integrations, automation\-runtime, and platform teams; write the design docs they build on, and mentor contributors. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIRED SKILLS** ===================================== ### **Experience** * You have shipped an LLM agent with tool use that ran unattended for real users, and owned a backend system in production. ### **Technical Skills** * Strong in **Python or TypeScript**, and productive in both. * **LLM agents and tool use**: agent loops, structured outputs, retries, and the failure modes they create. * **Eval discipline**: you have built benchmarks or eval harnesses and used them to make decisions. * Depth in **browser automation** (Playwright or similar) **or** **backend and API\-integration systems**, and comfort in the other. * **Distributed systems**: queues, idempotency, and durable workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar). * **Security judgment** for systems that handle secrets, including agent\-specific threats such as prompt injection. ### **Desirable** * Temporal in production; Pydantic AI or a comparable agent framework. * Open\-weight model serving (Fireworks, Together, Bedrock) and LLM cost modeling. * Computer\-use agents or browser extensions (Chrome MV3\); OpenAPI tooling. * Identity, IAM, or credential\-management experience; AWS and Terraform. ### **Soft Skills** * Clear technical writing and trade\-offs other teams can depend on. * You take an early system to production without waiting to be told how, and care that it keeps working after launch. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** =========================== * **6 months:** both systems run in production for real workloads, with improving error rates and cost per output, and drift is detected automatically. * **12 months:** onboarding a new application is predominantly automated, and most drift\-driven breakages heal without a human.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Pyrolysis
jobs.description: About Charm Our mission is to return the atmosphere to 280 ppm CO₂. We convert excess inedible biomass into carbon\-rich bio\-oil and inject it into underground storage for permanent carbon removal. At scale, we can use bio\-oil to make fossil\-free iron. Our carbon removal efforts began in 2020 with initial purchases from customers like Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft. Since then, we’ve scaled to **thousands of tons of carbon removal**, grown to over a hundred employees, and established three locations in San Francisco, Colorado, and Louisiana. We're expanding our team of ambitious, creative, and hands\-on problem solvers. We value psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous learning. We take calculated risks and treat mistakes as opportunities to improve. If you're excited about tackling big challenges, we encourage you to explore **our company values**. Come help us reverse climate change. Gigatons or bust! ### **About the Role** As a Senior Mechanical Engineer based out of our Fort Lupton facility, you’ll be responsible for designing the next generation of pyrolysis technology, implementing and troubleshooting mechanical systems in production, and collaborating with the broader engineering team, including electrical, automation, and manufacturing engineers, as well as fabricators, technicians, and operators. This group collaborates to overcome design/build/test challenges and successfully execute commissioning and production handover campaigns. This role involves designing new mechanical systems, selecting electromechanical actuators, sensors, pumps, etc. and continually improving on our pyrolysis and biomass processing equipment. You’ll turn wrenches to help bring your designs to life and work with our testing team to ensure your systems meet overall design intent. Often, you will be tasked with updating the configuration of legacy systems in order to validate novel design pathways or new subsystems, informing the architecture of our next generation of pyrolysis equipment. In order to meet Charm’s overall production and throughput goals, the role will leverage mechanical and system expertise to provide troubleshooting support for production machines based on issues observed by our Operations partners. This role will report to the Lead Pyrolysis Engineer based out of Fort Lupton, Colorado. Someone successful in this role will enjoy bringing new designs to life and helping to test and commission their new equipment. This person takes pride in delivering robust mechanical solutions that work in the real world, and loves stepping through the root cause analysis process when systems are not performing as intended. This person also takes an analytical approach to problem solving and is not afraid to step out of their comfort zone when tackling new problems. A great attitude in the face of difficult and fast\-paced environments is a must! We have ambitious goals, help us make them possible! ### **Your Responsibilities** * Design unique solutions for our next generation operations pyrolyzer: Develop mechanical and electromechanical systems for production use while considering interfacing systems, operating requirements, operator burden, and regular service and maintenance. Consider what technology needs thorough R\&D to simplify and redefine our machine architecture. Learn from previous successes and failures to develop and integrate novel vessels and process steps that tie back to real business needs. Work with our testing team to validate performance before operations integration. * Conduct thorough engineering analysis: Work with process engineers to develop thermal and flow models to inform system design. Process piping and vessels are important components in our greater pyrolysis system, refine their mechanisms to deliver an industrial solution. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues: Identify and troubleshoot mechanical system malfunctions and performance gaps. Determine why a failure mode is observed and implement a corrective action to return the system to optimal performance. * Develop and execute test plans and commissioning campaigns for production hardware: Take direct ownership of your designs beyond pressing print on your drawings. Validate performance before and after machine installation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams: Work closely with electrical engineers, software developers, and other mechanical engineers to implement mechanical systems into the larger pyrolysis package * Support on\-call production support as needed, if our frontline Engineering Technician group needs help solving critical Operations problems ### **You Bring** * *Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field* * Seasoned mechanical design experience (5\-8 years) * CAD knowledge is a must, we use OnShape * Experience reviewing and releasing detailed fabrication and assembly drawings with a high attention to detail and strong configuration control practices * Skilled in modes of heat transfer, sensor and actuator selection for robust operations, and building project requirements from ambiguity * Skilled with basic fabrication techniques and the design principles around them * Familiarity with piping standards, flange interfaces, gasket selection, and mechanical integration of process systems. * Hands\-on mechanical troubleshooting and assembly experience * A strong willingness to get your hands dirty and intimately interact with all pyrolysis system components * Documentation skills that demonstrate your thought process and design process when making improvements * Skilled with electromechanical systems and design for material handling, think conveyors, pumps, and blowers * Experience designing mechanical weldment under load and process pressure * A desire to work alongside Electrical \& Controls Engineers and fabricators to turn solutions into physical, installed hardware as quickly as possible. Use quick implementation skills to make quick and long\-term fixes to the pyrolysis system in service of system improvement. * Ability to communicate priorities, system progress, and work cross functionally * Hands\-on mechanical troubleshooting and assembly experience * An excitement for scaling up hardware that has the potential to positively impact climate change! ### **Bonus, if You Bring** * A Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field * Onshape modeling experience * Experience with process piping and vessel design in high\-temperature or industrial environments * Design of operations facing industrial equipment * Experience with 24/7 operations **What We Offer** * Equity ownership through stock options * 100% employee healthcare premiums covered * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options * Employer\-funded HSA contributions for eligible HDHP plans * Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 50% match on contributions up to 6% * Paid leave, including parental and medical leave * PPE and workwear allowances * Annual professional development stipend * Employee recognition programs that celebrate impactful work and team contributions * Opportunities for internal growth, career development, and transition into climate from a range of industries and backgrounds **Visa Sponsorship Policy** Since we are a small startup, certain accommodations for visa sponsorship may not be within our capability. At this time, Charm Industrial is only sponsoring E3 and TN visas. **Our Commitment** Charm Industrial is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and passion for our mission. Climate challenges require a wide range of perspectives and expertise, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We’re excited to grow our team with people who bring unique strengths and help us improve as a company. At Charm, we may use AI\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the hiring process, including organizing candidate information and highlighting experience that may be relevant to a particular role. In a world where AI\-assisted resumes, synthetic content, and deepfakes are increasingly common, these tools help our team navigate the process thoughtfully and efficiently. Every application and resume is reviewed by a member of our hiring team, and hiring decisions are made by people, not algorithms. Our recruiting process is designed to ensure candidates are evaluated fairly, consistently, and in alignment with our equal employment opportunity commitments. AI tools support our team's work, but they do not replace human judgment or determine hiring outcomes.

Through our premier brands, we lead the industry in providing groundbreaking high\-performance closure solutions for both the places people call home and the spaces where the world does business. By joining our team, you become part of a legacy that blends the residential elegance of Clopay, known as "America’s Favorite Garage Doors," with the industrial strength and 180\-year heritage of our rolling brands, Cornell and Cookson. Together, we secure everything from family garages to the world's most iconic stadiums and skyscrapers. You will take early ideas and turn them into working circuits, assemblies, and demonstrators that show what is possible — then help refine the most promising concepts into future products across the Clopay and CornellCookson product lines. If you have a bench full of dev boards, a well\-used oscilloscope, and a habit of prototyping your way to answers, we want to talk to you. **Responsibilities include:** * Design, build, and debug proof\-of\-concept circuits, assemblies, and working demonstrators in the lab that turn new ideas into something people can see, touch, and evaluate — quickly. * Rapidly prototype using Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, STM32 Nucleo, and similar development platforms, along with breadboards, perfboard, off\-the\-shelf modules, and quick\-turn PCBs. * Capture schematics and lay out simple to moderately complex printed circuit boards (e.g., KiCad, Altium, or similar) and coordinate quick\-turn fabrication and assembly. * Hand\-build and rework assemblies, including through\-hole and surface\-mount soldering, wire harnesses, connectors, and enclosures; partner with mechanical engineers on 3D\-printed and machined fixtures and housings. * Write embedded and scripting code (C/C\+\+, MicroPython/Python) to bring prototypes to life — reading sensors, driving motors and actuators, and communicating over wired and wireless interfaces. * Explore and demonstrate concepts relevant to Clopay and CornellCookson residential and commercial door systems, such as motor control, sensing and safety detection, power electronics, wireless connectivity, and smart\-home / IoT integration. * Characterize circuits and systems using lab instrumentation — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, programmable power supplies, electronic loads, function generators, and spectrum analyzers. * Perform signal analysis on prototype and production hardware, including noise, timing, power quality, RF/wireless performance, and data acquisition, and summarize findings clearly. * Build test fixtures, automated test rigs, and data\-logging setups to evaluate concepts and existing products under realistic operating and environmental conditions. * Document prototypes and results — schematics, bills of material, code, test data, and lessons learned — so promising concepts can be handed off and refined into production designs. * Present demonstrations and recommendations to Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and leadership, and help evaluate feasibility, cost, and risk for moving concepts toward product. * Support product engineering teams in transitioning proven concepts into the product development process, including design reviews and early compliance considerations (UL, FCC, and related standards). * Evaluate new components, sensors, modules, and emerging technologies and keep the lab current with tools and techniques that speed up learning. * Help maintain and organize the electronics lab, including equipment, components inventory, and safe work practices. * Completes other engineering projects as assigned. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering Technology. * Minimum 3 years of hands\-on electrical engineering experience in product development, prototyping, R\&D, or a test/lab environment. * Demonstrated ability to design and build working circuits from concept through functional prototype — analog, digital, and mixed\-signal. * Practical experience with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar rapid development platforms, and with embedded programming in C/C\+\+ and/or Python. * Proficiency with standard lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, DMM, power supplies, function generator) and sound measurement and signal analysis techniques. * Working knowledge of common interfaces and protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485, CAN, and PWM. * Strong soldering, rework, and hands\-on assembly skills. * Schematic capture and basic PCB layout experience. * Self\-directed, curious, and comfortable working with ambiguity — able to take a loosely defined idea and turn it into a working demonstration. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications:** * A portfolio of personal, academic, or professional builds (photos, repositories, videos, or write\-ups) that shows a maker mindset. * Experience with motor control (DC, BLDC, AC induction), motor drivers, and power electronics. * Experience with wireless technologies such as Bluetooth Low Energy, Wi\-Fi, Zigbee/Thread/Matter, or sub\-GHz RF. * Experience with sensors and safety\-related detection (photoelectric, IR, current sensing, edge sensors, encoders). * Familiarity with Linux on single\-board computers, Git, and scripting for test automation and data analysis (Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar). * Experience with spectrum analysis, EMC pre\-compliance testing, or familiarity with UL 325, UL 991, and FCC Part 15 requirements. * Basic CAD and 3D\-printing experience for enclosures and fixtures. * Experience in the building products, access control, or garage door / door operator industry a plus. **Why Choose a Career with Us?** We don't just manufacture doors; we engineer the "front door" of the American dream and the security of global commerce. At Clopay, we believe our strength lies in our people. From our design engineers to our manufacturing associates and delivery drivers, every member of the team plays a vital role in our success. **Our team members thrive because we prioritize:** * **Unrivaled Scale:** Work for a market leader with a massive manufacturing footprint and a reputation for excellence that spans nearly two centuries. * **A Culture of "What’s Next":** We invest heavily in automation, sustainable materials, and smart\-home integration to stay ahead of the curve. * **Commitment to People:**As a Griffon Corporation company, we provide the stability of a large organization with the tight\-knit, collaborative feel of a specialized craft team. * **A Legacy of Expertise:** Join our "Pioneer Club"—a group of over 440 employees who have been with us for 20 years or more. We offer the stability of a market leader and a place where you can truly grow a lifelong career. * **Commitment to Innovation:** We aren’t just keeping up with industry trends; we’re setting them. Whether it’s our exclusive WINDCODE® technology or our award\-winning designs, we provide the tools for you to do your best work. * **Community Focused:**Our success is linked to the well\-being of our neighbors and communities. Through our partnership with Habitat for Humanity, Clopay employees help provide homes and security to families in the communities where we live and work. **Equal Opportunity Employer** **Disclaimer:** *"This posting does not constitute a contract or guarantee of employment or compensation. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, CBCI
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, CBCI **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** CloudBees CI helps enterprises build and deliver software with confidence. Built on Jenkins, with a core written in Java and deployments running on Kubernetes, it brings together the challenges of distributed systems, an extensible plugin ecosystem, and the reliability customers expect from critical delivery infrastructure. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction for the CloudBees CI product area and turn that direction into working software. You will lead architecture and execution across teams while staying close to the code: solving the hardest engineering problems, improving an established codebase, and helping other engineers do their best work. You bring deep expertise in Java, Kubernetes, and distributed systems, together with a product mindset. You understand that an architectural decision is only valuable if it improves the customer's experience. You know when to simplify, when to invest in a deeper change, and how to move an established product forward without compromising the workflows customers depend on. Requirements: **What You'll Do** **Shape the technical direction:** * Build a deep understanding of the existing CloudBees CI architecture, Jenkins internals, and customer workloads. Use that evidence to identify the changes that will make the greatest difference. * Define the technical roadmap with engineering and product partners, connecting architectural investments to customer needs and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Lead the design of resilient distributed systems running on Kubernetes. Make tradeoffs around scale, failure handling, compatibility, and operational complexity explicit, and document the reasoning behind key decisions. **Stay hands\-on with the hardest engineering work:** * Write production\-quality Java and own critical refactors, performance improvements, and stability fixes. Lead difficult changes from design through testing, release, and follow\-up. * Diagnose complex JVM and distributed\-system problems, including memory leaks, thread contention, classloading issues, and failures that emerge across components. * Evolve plugin\-based architectures and service boundaries while protecting compatibility and upgrade behavior. Simplify where possible and introduce new abstractions only when they solve a clear problem. **Bring the team with you:** * Earn the trust of an established engineering team. Listen first, explain your reasoning, and build alignment through technical judgment and working code. * Drive initiatives across teams by breaking ambiguous problems into achievable milestones, coordinating dependencies, anticipating risks, and unblocking delivery. * Lead rigorous design and code reviews. Mentor Staff and other senior engineers, share knowledge, and establish engineering standards that teams can apply consistently. **Make quality and customer outcomes the default:** * Strengthen secure coding, automated unit and integration testing, and release practices. Ensure changes are tested against realistic workflows, failure modes, and upgrade scenarios. * Use profiling, metrics, logs, and incident evidence to find root causes and validate improvements. Turn recurring problems into durable fixes and better engineering practices. * Partner with support, product, and engineering colleagues to resolve complex customer issues. Improve the feedback loop from code to customer, removing delivery bottlenecks while maintaining confidence in each release. **What You'll Bring** * 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership at Staff or Principal scope and a track record of delive trong point of view and update it when the data says otherwise. You argue for the best answer regardless of who's in the room, and once a decision is made, you commit to it fully. * **Hard Work** — You own the end result, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **What You'll Get** * The opportunity to shape the technical direction of CloudBees CI, with hands\-on ownership of consequential engineering work. * A global, collaborative team that takes its craft seriously, shares knowledge, and invests in each other's growth. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. Our bonus plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together. * **People who sweat the craft.** A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth. * **A global, collaborative team** that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback. **EEO Statement** CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't. * Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI\-generated results and ensure engineering rigor. * Investigating and stakeholders to solve technical problems. * Comfort working in fast\-changing, ambiguous environments. * Strong written communication and documentation skills. * Working knowledge of high\-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs. * Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts. **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation. * Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows. * Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale. **Travel Expectations** ----------------------- While this is jobs.title: Mentor, Claude Corps
jobs.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000\+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world. We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work. We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0\-to\-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it. **About the Role** **Location:** Remote, United States **Role\-Type:** Full\-Time, W2 Employee **Reports To:** AI Practice Lead, Claude Corps **Compensation:** $110,000 to $124,500 per year **Start Date:** No later than February 8th, ahead of the March 8th cohort launch Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI\-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. As a CodePath Mentor, you are the full\-time coach and guide for a portfolio of roughly ten pods: about 20 fellows across 8–12 host organizations, from pre\-Basecamp through the final day of the program. Your job is to help each fellow succeed not only in building with AI, but in navigating the organization around the work: understanding the problem, identifying the right stakeholders, communicating ideas clearly, building buy\-in, and turning an AI\-enabled solution into something people will actually use. The host organization directs the fellow's day\-to\-day work, the curriculum team owns what they learn, and your Sr. Manager of AI Practice is the manager of record who holds the performance bar. You carry the throughline across the fellow experience: you know your pods end to end, spot patterns and roadblocks early, coach fellows through ambiguity, and bring in deeper technical expertise when needed. The work combines asynchronous coaching and feedback with regular 1:1s, office hours, milestone reviews, roadmap and project feedback, and synchronous coaching when a fellow needs more than text. Fellows may be building technical integrations, designing AI\-enabled workflows, educating an organization on AI, or helping a nonprofit adopt an entirely new way of working. You do not need to be the deepest software engineer in the room. You do need enough technical fluency to understand what fellows are building, learn unfamiliar technologies quickly, and help them reason through AI\-enabled solutions. Just as importantly, you need the judgment and coaching ability to help an early\-career fellow navigate the people, communication, and organizational challenges that determine whether their work succeeds. This role is built for someone who gets energy from helping other people succeed. You may come from engineering, consulting, implementation, technical program management, AI enablement, education, or another client\-facing technical environment. What matters most is that you have personally navigated ambiguity, helped people or organizations adopt technology, and can coach fellows through doing the same. **Key Responsibilities** **Coach your pods** * Carry roughly 20 pods (up to 40 fellows across 16 to 24 host organizations) full\-time from pre\-Basecamp through final day, calibrating your time across the portfolio rather than sinking into one pod * Facilitate weekly 1:1s with all Fellows who report to you and document their progress, challenges, and successes using the tooling Claude Corps operates on * Coach fellows through ambiguous projects, helping them clarify the problem, understand organizational context, identify stakeholders, and determine the right next step * Give structured feedback on fellows' real work, including project plans, roadmap drafts, architecture proposals, presentations, technical implementations, and QBR deliverables * Help fellows strengthen the professional skills required to succeed inside their host organizations, including communication, stakeholder management, presentations, prioritization, and navigating feedback * Lead each fellow's Day 30/90/180/270 milestone review; own the fellow\-level synthesis and hand it up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the roll\-up and performance call **Deliver the curriculum in your pods** * Deliver the just\-in\-time modules the curriculum team designs; author lane\- or pod\-specific content when they commission it because you have seen the gap from closer in * Coac u consistently identify recurring technical, professional, and organizational patterns across your pods and surface them to the right program owner * Every Day 30 review is done and documented, handed up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, with a plan for any fellow whose work is at risk or ready for the next challenge **Qualifications** **Required** * 2–5 years of previous professional experience in software engineering, IT, data, technical program management, implementation, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, technical consulting, AI operations, or another technically adjacent role * Hands\-on, current experience using modern AI tools and workflows. You should be able to speak concretely about how you use tools such as Claude, AI agents, LLM\-based applications, automation, or similar technologies to solve real problems * Real coaching, mentorship, people\-development, or management experience with concrete examples of helping someone navigate a challenge and become more successful * Experience working across stakeholders to understand a problem, clarify needs, recommend or implement a solution, and help people adopt a new way of working * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions, coach someone through an important presentation, and provide thoughtful asynchronous feedback * Comfortable operating as a technical generalist: you can learn quickly, ask the right questions, understand unfamiliar systems, and bring in deeper expertise when needed * Comfortable coaching early\-career professionals through ambiguity, feedback, organizational dynamics, and the expectations of working in a professional environment * Comfortable with remote, synchronous obligations across U.S. time zones and about two evenings a month for cohort sessions and milestone reviews **Preferred** * Client\-facing consulting or implementation experience, particularly working with small businesses, nonprofits, education organizations, or teams adopting new technology * Experience helping an organization adopt AI, automation, new software, or another significant change in how work gets done * TA, bootcamp coach, fellowship mentor, instructor, manager, career coach, or other experience developing early\-career technical talent * Experience facilitating workshops, presentations, professional learning, or technical training * Experience in a small or scrappy organization where understanding the business context was as important as delivering the technical solution **Compensation** CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for an Individual Contributor level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $124,500\. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well\-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work\-life balance. * **Health \& Wellness:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer\-covered for employees and dependents), employer\-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program * **Financial Security**: 401(k), employer\-paid life \& disability insurance, and identity theft protection * **Work\-Life Balance**: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year\-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2\) * **Professional Growth**: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support * **Student Loan Forgiveness**: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt * **Additional Perks**: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings Pay range $110,000 \- $124,500 USD

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **SALARY RANGE (Grade 15\) CSA216: $89,993\.11/yr. \- $134,991\.01/yr.****(Commensurate with experience)** **GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES:** The Senior AI Engineer designs the architecture for, builds, and deploys AI\-enabled applications in OSA's Microsoft GCC environment. Working with the Innovation Assistant Director and Cloud Engineering, the role shapes OSA's AI reference architecture and turns it into production Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, agent workflows, the data pipelines that feed them, and cost\- and performance\-aware model deployments. The role builds applications on existing foundation models accessed through approved platforms such as Azure AI Foundry; it does not train or develop LLMs. The primary focus is the Audit division, delivering AI services that measurably improve audit planning, research, and analysis across OSA's statewide audit portfolio. The role also builds AI\-enabled programs for OSA's administrative and operational units, including Human Resources, Administration \& Finance (A\&F), Occupational Schools, the Division of Local Mandates (DLM), and the Bureau of Special Investigations (BSI). OSA does not expect candidates to know every tool named in this description. Solid architecture and engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience delivering LLM applications matter most. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED:** Reports to the Innovation Assistant Director and works within OSA's IT Innovation group. Collaborates closely with the Manager, System and Process Improvements, Cloud Engineering (e.g., platform security, IaC, APIM/Entra), Enterprise IT, the Data Analytics Unit, data engineering staff, contractors, and business stakeholders across Audit and OSA's operational units. The Manager, System and Process Improvements maintains the backlog of Audit process\-improvement opportunities, designs and measures pilots of AI\-assisted audit process steps and recommends adoption; Audit and agency leadership decide whether to adopt changes to audit processes. The Innovation Assistant Director runs intake for OSA's other units, sets IT Innovation work priorities in line with the IT Governance Council, manages staff and contractors, and decides technology and build\-versus\-buy choices. This role owns the technical design and engineering of the solutions and does not supervise staff. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **AI Solution Architecture** ---------------------------- * Design solution architectures for AI applications — components, integrations, data flows, security boundaries, and deployment topology — and document them in diagrams and architecture decision records. * Lead the definition and maintenance of OSA's AI reference architecture, including standard patterns for RAG, agents, API exposure, logging, and evaluation, with review and approval by the Innovation Assistant Director. * Work with Cloud Engineering to extend Azure Landing Zone patterns (CAF/WAF) for AI workloads: subscriptions, Azure Policy, VNets/NSGs, private endpoints, Key Vault, and managed identities. * Define microservice and API boundaries (REST, APIM) so AI capabilities are reused across audit and operational applications rather than rebuilt for each one. * Lead technical design reviews, and provide technical assessments of new Azure AI services, vendor tools, and build\-versus\-buy options to inform technology decisions by the Innovation Assistant Director. * Design for cost from the start: model and hosting choices, budgets, and tagging so AI consumption is visible and attributable by project. **Software Development** ------------------------ * Write, test, and maintain production Python and TypeScript/JavaScript code for AI\-enabled applications, services, and user interfaces. * Build REST APIs and backend services that connect LLMs to OSA documents, data sources, and business systems. * Write automated unit, integration, and evaluation tests; set code review and Git/GitHub branching standards for AI projects. * Build the automated tests, evaluation harnesses, and quality metrics used in OSA's software quality assurance process for AI applications (distinct from the audit Quality Assurance function), which data engineering staff and testers use to carry out testing. * Use AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot responsibly, reviewing generated code for correctness and security. * Troubleshoot and improve the AI components of applications running in production. **AI Application Engineering** ------------------------------ * Own retrieval design for RAG applications — hierarchical/semantic chunking, embedding choices, hybrid (keyword \+ vector) search, cross\-encoder reranking, and citation fidelity checks — working with data engineering staff who build ingestion, schema, and embedding pipelines. * Engineer agent and tool\-calling workflows with Microsoft Agent Framework; lead migration of existing Prompt Flow orchestration and evaluation into supported pathways. * Define and instrume sful candidate will possess and/or demonstrate:* * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building production applications that use LLMs (e.g., RAG, agents, or tool\-calling features). * Demonstrated design ownership of the architecture for at least one production system, including documentation of design decisions. * Strong Python; working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. * Hands\-on building RAG systems with hybrid search and reranking; experience with embeddings and vector stores (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate). * Experience designing and deploying applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP with a willingness to work in Azure), including identity, private networking, and secrets management. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience designing REST APIs and service boundaries, and writing automated tests. * Experience handling sensitive data (PII/PHI) under least\-privilege access and encryption controls. * Clear written communication, including architecture documentation, and the ability to explain technical trade\-offs. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Azure Government/Microsoft GCC experience, including Azure Landing Zones and Cloud Adoption Framework implementation. * Microsoft Azure certifications at the associate or expert level (e.g., AI engineering or solutions architecture). * Microsoft Agent Framework and Prompt Flow migration; LangChain/LangGraph; structured outputs and function/tool calling across providers. * Deeper Kubernetes experience on AKS: Helm charts, ingress, autoscaling, and workload identity. * Knowledge graphs, taxonomies, or ontologies (e.g., RDF, SPARQL); familiarity with Synaptica Graphite. * Data engineering with Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake) or Microsoft Fabric; data governance frameworks (e.g., DMBOK), metadata and lineage management, and MDM. * RBAC/ABAC design, Purview classification, DLP labels, Defender for Cloud, and policy\-as\-code. * Understanding of LLM serving trade\-offs: quantization (FP8/INT4\), KV\-cache strategies, MoE models and expert parallelism, and open\-weight serving stacks (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, SGLang). * Experience in government, healthcare, or financial services, including shared platform or data standards across multiple agencies or business units. * Experience integrating TeamMate\+ and external sources into AI\-driven research workflows. * Experience mentoring developers or serving as technical lead on a project. * Exposure to AWS or GCP data and AI services (e.g., Vertex AI). Salary is commensurate with experience. The Office of the State Auditor is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment actions such as recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting individuals are based upon a policy of non\-discrimination. Employment decisions and actions are made without regard to race, color, gender, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, military status, genetic information, political affiliation, or veteran’s status. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer – SLM Optimization & Inference
jobs.description: **Position Summary** **Senior AI/ML Engineer – SLM Optimization \& Inference** We are looking for a hands\-on Senior AI/ML Engineer to fine\-tune, optimize, and deploy Small Language Models, with a focus on Alibaba Qwen models and production\-ready inference performance. In this role, you will help improve model quality, latency, throughput, and GPU efficiency while contributing to real\-time audio intelligence pipelines for high\-performance, low\-latency applications. This is an opportunity for a senior\-level AI/ML engineer who enjoys working close to the model, the infrastructure, and the performance benchmarks—building scalable ML systems that are ready for production. **Responsibilities** * Fine\-tune and optimize Small Language Models, particularly Alibaba Qwen models, for domain\-specific use cases. * Improve model performance across key metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, latency, and inference throughput. * Optimize model serving using vLLM, SGLang, or similar high\-performance inference engines. * Implement advanced inference optimization techniques, including GPU memory optimization, KV\-cache management, quantization, and efficient batching. * Develop, enhance, and optimize real\-time audio intelligence pipelines for low\-latency processing. * Benchmark, profile, and tune models for production\-scale deployment. * Collaborate with engineering and data teams to evaluate model behavior, identify bottlenecks, and improve end\-to\-end ML system performance. * Build reliable, scalable ML workflows that support high\-throughput, low\-latency AI applications. * Apply senior\-level technical judgment to balance model quality, infrastructure efficiency, and production performance requirements. **Qualifications** * Strong hands\-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and LLM/SLM fine\-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT. * Practical experience using vLLM or SGLang for high\-performance model inference. * Deep understanding of GPU utilization, CUDA fundamentals, KV caching, and memory optimization. * Experience evaluating and improving model precision, recall, latency, throughput, and inference performance. * Strong Python programming and ML engineering skills. * Proven ability to benchmark, debug, and optimize models for production environments. * Experience fine\-tuning and deploying Alibaba Qwen models is preferred. * Experience with real\-time audio AI, speech recognition, ASR, or audio classification is preferred. * Experience optimizing AI models for high\-throughput, low\-latency production environments is preferred. * Ability to work hands\-on across both SLM model training/fine\-tuning and GPU inference optimization. * Strong collaboration skills with the ability to partner effectively across engineering and data teams. The base salary for this position is $ 144,964\-$ 171,321 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies.
