jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead At Lilly, we're at an inflection point where 150 years of pharmaceutical excellence meets the transformative power of artificial intelligence. Our mission to create medicines that make life better has never been more achievable than it is today. AI is fundamentally reshaping how we discover, develop, and deliver life\-saving treatments to patients around the world. Tech@Lilly is building the digital and AI foundation of a modern pharmaceutical company, one where scalable platforms, trusted data, and intelligent automation help our scientists, clinicians, and business teams move faster and make better decisions. The solutions we build directly shorten the path from scientific discovery to patient impact. If you are passionate about engineering excellence and want your work to matter to patients, we invite you to join us and help shape how medicines are made and delivered for the next 150 years. **Role Overview:** The Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead is accountable for the technical success of AI agents, systems of agents, and AI products. For this role, you will operate as a hands\-on tech lead: personally design, code, and deliver critical components (primarily in Python) while overseeing development teams through design reviews, technical guidance, and quality gates to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and delivered with a bias for action. This role provides technical leadership while driving architectural and engineering decisions, ensures high\-quality delivery, and serves as the primary technical counterpart to delivery teams and business users. The Technical Lead balances business objectives, user experience, scalability, security, and maintainability to deliver sustainable technology solutions, while enabling domain teams within Lilly's federated delivery model. Success in this role is measured by the quality and reliability of delivered solutions, the speed and predictability of technical delivery, reduction of technical debt and operational issues, adoption of engineering standards and best practices, and the technical capability and overall health of the product and team. **Primary Responsibilities:** Technical Direction \& Leadership * Own the overall technical direction, ensuring alignment with business strategy and product objectives * Translate business requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans * Lead technical design reviews and architecture discussions with engineers, architects, and security partners * Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, platforms, and development approaches * Ensure adherence to engineering standards, security requirements, and architectural principles SWE Responsibilities * Drive technical decisions and tradeoffs between speed, cost, quality, maintainability, and scalability * Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the delivery lifecycle * Review code and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices * Monitor solution quality, performance, reliability, and technical health * Establish testing strategies and oversee technical validation activities Team Leadership * Mentor developers and fosters technical growth across the team * Coordinate technical work across developers, architects, security partners, and platform teams * Assign and guide technical tasks while maintaining accountability for outcomes * Promote continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence Stakeholder Collaboration * Partner with business to create solutions with high accuracy and usage rates * Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and solution approaches to stakeholders * Act as the primary escalation point for technical issues * Align technology decisions with business strategy and product objectives **Basic Requirements:** * Bachelors in Computer Science or a related field, such as Engineering or Information Technology. * 8\+ years of software development or software engineering experience. * 3\+ years of experience leading engineering teams or large technical initiatives. * Experience using cloud platforms, software architecture, APIs, data integration, and modern development practices. * Experience influencing technical decisions across cross\-functional teams. Preferred Experience * Advanced degree such as Masters or PhD * Experience delivering technology solutions in a regulated industry such as pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with GxP and computer systems validation. * Hands\-on familiarity with AI and machine learning solutions, including LLM\-based and agentic applications and the engineering practices that support them. * Experience with DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and automated testing and deployment pipelines. * Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong mentoring and coaching skills, with a record of growing engineers into senior technical roles. * Comfort navigating ambiguity and making sound decisions with incomplete information. * Relevant certifications such as cloud architecture (AWS) Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. jobs.title: Senior AI Deployment Manager, Cyber
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **Job Summary** =============== The Senior AI Deployment Manager leads complex AI product and delivery work in Eliza's Cyber vertical. You will serve as the product counterpart to client leaders and business development, translating cybersecurity needs into feasible AI opportunities and owning delivery alignment from discovery through launch. You will work closely with forward\-deployed engineers, owning product decisions while engineering partners own implementation decisions in their lane. This is a founding role in the Cyber vertical. You will operate independently through ambiguity, set direction for client work and teammates, and stay close enough to delivery to keep commitments and outcomes credible. Engagements may include cyber\-domain discovery and, when the work calls for it, training on AI governance and Codex setup. Eliza is AI\-native and expects leaders to use AI tools in discovery, product definition, and client communication. The technology and client context evolve quickly; sound judgment means knowing where AI is useful, where it is not, and when to bring engineering or domain expertise into a decision. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. Scope cyber opportunities and prioritize use cases** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Run structured discovery with cyber stakeholders to understand workflows, risk, data readiness, and business outcomes. * Assess use\-case fit, feasibility, sequencing, and the path to production; make clear recommendations on what is ready for AI and what is not. * Build and maintain a prioritized use\-case backlog grounded in feasibility, readiness, and measurable impact. **2\. Own product definition and delivery alignment** ----------------------------------------------------- * Translate client needs into product requirements, acceptance evidence, delivery plans, and product roadmaps engineers can act on. * Partner with forward\-deployed engineers through design, evaluation, iteration, launch, and handoff; surface edge cases and risks early. * Manage the gap between prototype and production, including data quality, security, compliance, and scalability concerns. **3\. Own outcomes and stakeholder trust** ------------------------------------------ * Align client executives, subject\-matter experts, business development, and technical teams on scope, tradeoffs, timing, and measurable value. * Define success criteria with client experts for AI systems whose performance requires ongoing evaluation. * Communicate progress and risks plainly, challenge unsuitable requests constructively, and escalate decisions at the right time. **4\. Build Cyber delivery capability** --------------------------------------- * Contribute AI governance and ChatGPT and Codex setup training when required by an engagement. * Turn proven Cyber delivery methods into reusable playbooks, evaluations, and production\-readiness practices. * Coach Associates and help shape how enterprises move from AI experimentation to production in cyber contexts. * Support pre\-sales of cyber client engagements, including drafting and reviewing SOWs, work plans, and playbooks. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * Deep cybersecurity experience and sound judgment about the operating context behind client problems. * A record of independently leading complex client or product work through ambiguity and measurable outcomes. * Strong AI fluency: practical use of current AI tools and a clear understanding of where models help, fail, and require evaluation. * Product judgment that connects user needs, business impact, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and technical constraints. * Credible partnership with engineers; know which decisions belong to product and when to bring in engineering expertise. * Clear executive communication, concise written materials, and confidence facilitating difficult tradeoff conversations. * Experience setting direction for others or coaching less\-experienced delivery teammates. **Preferred** ------------- * AI governance, cyber risk, Codex setup, or responsible AI training experience. * Consulting or client\-service experience with executive stakeholders. * Experience building reusable delivery methods, evaluations, or workflow assets. **What We Offer** ================= * Competitive compensation (base salary \+ performance incentives tied to client outcomes). * Equity options in a growing AI services company. * Exposure to a wide range of industries and high\-impact AI problems. * Travel opportunities for on\-site client engagements (if desired). * Work at the intersection of enterprise AI delivery and a substantive cybersecurity domain. * Own client outcomes and work directly with senior stakeholders. * Partner closely with forward\-deployed engineers building and deploying real systems. * Help shape how Eliza's Cyber practice delivers AI work. * Compensation and benefits details will be shared during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Research Engineer – Robotics & Embodied AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers, including Andrew Dai, who was previously a leader on Gemini. Our team currently consists of 20 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised $55M in seed funding from Striker Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and NVIDIA. We are tackling some of the hardest problems in artificial intelligence, and we are growing fast. **About the Role** ------------------ As a foundation model company, Elorian aims to empower robotics developers through advanced visual reasoning, spatial understanding, and high\-quality robotics data solutions. We are looking for researchers and engineers with a background in robotics who want to apply their domain expertise to foundation\-scale AI. Instead of focusing solely on isolated robot hardware or narrow policies, you will collaborate closely with our core foundation model research team to infuse physical\-world priors into our models, address real\-world robotics challenges, and develop foundational capabilities that generalize across a broad spectrum of robotics applications. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Develop Visual \& Spatial Intelligence for Robotics:** Advance and evaluate visual reasoning, 3D spatial understanding, and physical affordance capabilities directly within our multimodal foundation models to support downstream robotic perception and control. * **Architect Robotics Data Pipelines:** Design scalable data pipelines—including data collection, teleoperation and trajectory annotation, automated quality assessment, and evaluation frameworks for multi\-modal robotic data. * **Explore Foundation\-Driven Embodied Reasoning:** Investigate and implement novel approaches to robotic task planning, hierarchical reasoning, and decision\-making powered by multimodal foundation models and Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) architectures. * **Bridge Foundation Models \& Robotics Applications:** Collaborate closely with core foundation model researchers and robotics partners to identify real\-world bottlenecks, evaluate model capabilities, and build impactful foundational AI solutions for the robotics ecosystem. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * Strong background in robotics (research or engineering), with first\-hand experience in robotic perception, planning, control, or robot learning. * Genuine excitement to transition robotics domain knowledge into large\-scale deep learning, multimodal architectures, and foundation model research. * Solid experience with machine learning and hands\-on familiarity with modern LLMs, multimodal foundation models (VLMs), or transformer architectures. * Strong research and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate open\-ended, complex technical challenges. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) for large\-scale data generation, policy evaluation, or model pre\-training. * Experience with robotics datasets, trajectory annotation, task decomposition, and benchmark evaluation for physical systems. * Experience applying, fine\-tuning, or developing LLMs, VLMs, or Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models for robotics problems. * Background working with real\-world robotic systems (manipulation, navigation, or autonomous agents) and understanding the practical limits of deploying policies to physical hardware. * Deep expertise in robotic planning, 3D spatial reasoning, affordance modeling, or embodied intelligence.

jobs.title: Senior Application Developer
jobs.description: **City** -------- Irvine**State** --------- California**Job Location** ---------------- Irvine Regional Office (Derian)**Position Type** ----------------- Regular The **Senior Application Developer** designs, builds, and supports moderate to highly complex applications on a serverless, cloud\-native architecture using an AI\-first, agentic development workflow. AI coding agents such as Claude Code write most of our code; our developers own what makes it worth shipping: the architecture, the requirements and specifications, the tests, and the code review. This role suits an experienced full\-stack engineer who wants to be at the forefront of how software is now built. The Essex Technology team is an all\-inclusive group of passionate technologists dedicated to supporting each other while supporting and driving Essex to a tech\-forward future. If you love solving problems, can appreciate well\-architected systems, and enjoy making a big impact with your contributions, then this role is for you! **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** * Design and develop web applications for internal and external customers, using agentic AI tools to plan, implement, and iterate quickly while applying sound usability concepts. * Build on our serverless architecture (e.g., AWS, Vercel) across front\-end UI, back\-end APIs, and data, using low\-code tools where they fit, to deliver scalable, secure, user\-centric solutions. * Work with business stakeholders to shape requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications and acceptance criteria that drive AI\-assisted implementation. * Define architecture, data models, and design patterns, and guide AI agents to implement within them. * Own test strategy: unit, integration, and regression suites that validate AI\-generated code. * Take a lead role in code quality, security, and performance, critically reviewing AI\-generated code. * Maintain, support, and modernize existing applications, using AI to analyze, document, and refactor legacy code. * Help lead architecture and design reviews, backlog refinement, and other scrum meetings. * Triage and resolve production issues, and deploy changes through automated CI/CD pipelines. * Contribute to technology best practices, including the secure, responsible use of AI tools. * Perform other tasks as assigned. **WHAT YOU WILL NEED:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline. * 8\+ years of hands\-on full stack web application development across the full lifecycle: requirements, design, build, test, deployment, and support. * Deep knowledge of software architecture and design patterns (e.g., separation of concerns, modular design, API design). * Strong automated testing skills (unit, integration, end\-to\-end, regression) and test\-driven development. * Proficient in capturing workable requirements from end users and business stakeholders and writing specifications clear enough for an engineer, or an AI agent, to implement without ambiguity. * Strong code\-review skills to assess AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Experience with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), or a demonstrated eagerness to adopt them. * Experience building serverless applications (e.g., AWS Lambda, Vercel) with CI/CD and DevOps practices. * Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and at least one backend language. * Preferred: .NET, C\#, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Vue.js, and building AI/LLM\-powered features. * Strong knowledge of SQL. Experience with Snowflake and PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server. * Experience implementing responsive design and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) standards. * Proficient with Git and with integrating web services and APIs (REST and SOAP). * Experience developing in web content management frameworks. * Proficient in creating clear system design, process, and user documentation, including context files for AI agents. * Experience in agile software development, with a proven track record of on\-time delivery. * Able to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical associates and mentor junior developers. **WHAT THE JOB REQUIRES:** * Work is primarily conducted in an office setting. Requires sitting at a desk or workstation for extended periods. Involves the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers. * Requires the ability to work Monday through Friday. Entails in\-person office requirements for a minimum of 4 days per week: Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Fridays located at Essex's corporate offices in Irvine or Woodland Hills. * Requires the ability to sit or stand for extended periods. Minimal physical effort in the day\-to\-day tasks. * Minimal travel may be required for occasional meetings, training, or conferences. **WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:** * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers. Ability to effectively present information. * Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret documents. Ability to solve problems involving several options in situations. Requires intermediate analytical and quantitative skills. * A collaborative attitude, actively engaging with team members to share knowledge, resolve challenges, and foster a productive and inclusive work environment. * A quality\-first, verify\-don’t\-assume mindset and the curiosity to keep learning as AI evolves. * Decisions made with thorough knowledge of procedures and company policies to achieve set results and deadlines. Responsible for setting own project deadlines. Errors in judgment may cause short\-term impact to co\-workers and supervisor. * No formal supervisory responsibilities in this position. May provide informal assistance such as technical guidance and/or training to coworkers. May coordinate work and assign tasks. All full\-time regular associates are offered competitive salaries, experience career growth, and are eligible for benefit packages that include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, 401k employer match, excellence rewards, wellness programs, and much more. With our 12 paid holidays and 15 PTO days, work/life balance is a priority! Additionally, most positions are eligible for a housing discount of 20%. Essex provides great communities in which to live, work and invest. We are a purpose\-driven company, and we pride ourselves on promoting an internal culture of growth and opportunity by engaging, enabling, and empowering our teams. Working at Essex is not a destination. It is a journey where you can confidently build your career. New hires generally start between $123,000\.00 \- $153,000\.00 per year. The final salary offer will be determined after reviewing relevant factors, including but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience; internal equity; and other business and organizational needs. This role is also eligible to participate in Essex’s discretionary Annual Bonus program that is commensurate with the level of the position.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products. In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. **Job Description** We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to support the development of Generative AI\-based digital tools and platforms in a pharmaceutical R\&D environment. The successful candidate will join the Automation and Robotics team, focusing on designing, prototyping, and implementing AI\-driven solutions for pharmaceutical applications. This role provides hands\-on experience with machine learning (ML), large language models (LLMs), automation, and data engineering, contributing to next\-generation digital tools that accelerate innovation in the pharmaceutical industry. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain knowledge graphs and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems for scientific data. * Design, prototype, and deploy AI\-driven solutions for chemical process optimization. * Implement AI/ML models for predictive analytics and decision support in chemical synthesis. * Build robotic control systems to orchestrate workflows using modular lab equipment. * Create new applications leveraging the Jupyter framework for web\-based tools. * Integrate and visualize experimental data within applications where applicable. * Develop and maintain Python\-based pipelines for data acquisition and workflow automation. * Collaborate with scientific stakeholders to refine requirements and iterate on prototypes. * Work with APIs, databases, and internal data pipelines for seamless integration. * Document code and workflows in compliance with internal best practices and quality standards. **Qualifications** * Education: BS with 5\+ years of experience OR MS in Computer Science or related field (or expected graduation before start date). * Proficiency in Python, Jupyter Notebook, Dataiku DSS, and REST APIs. * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Familiarity with RDKit for cheminformatics applications is preferred. **Additional Information** * Position is **Monday\-Friday, 8\-5\.** Overtime as needed. **On\-site role based in Groton, CT** * May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs * Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CTare encouraged to apply. * Excellent full\-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options * Life and disability insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid vacation and holidays * **\#LI\-EB1** * Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship **Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.**

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer — Layla AI
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Location** **:** Seattle preferred; other locations and employment arrangement to be confirmed **About Layla AI** Layla is an AI\-native travel\-planning and booking company within Expedia Group’s Product organization. The team is building conversational experiences that help travelers move from inspiration to a complete, bookable itinerary across flights, hotels, activities, and day\-by\-day plans. The team is small, senior, and startup\-paced. Engineers are expected to take meaningful ownership, move from ambiguous problem to production, and use data, experimentation, and AI\-assisted development practices to improve the traveler experience. **THE OPPORTUNITY** We are looking for a **Senior Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer** to help build the next generation of proactive travel\-planning experiences at Layla. You will work across agent orchestration, backend services, data and retrieval systems, and user\-facing product experiences. You will help turn emerging agentic capabilities into reliable, understandable, and useful traveler workflows — not simply prototypes or chat interfaces. This is a high\-autonomy, broad\-scope senior individual contributor role — often described as a **“** ***Super IC*** **”** profile — with the opportunity to connect product intent, agent architecture, full\-stack implementation, and production outcomes. The role has shared ownership: you will help shape direction and own meaningful work while partnering closely across Product, Design, Data, and Engineering rather than working in isolation. At Layla, engineers can influence a product used by travelers around the world. We are looking for someone energized by the opportunity to bring ideas forward, explore possibilities, and turn them into reliable experiences at global travel scale. You do not need to arrive with every answer or every technology; curiosity, sound judgment, initiative, and a willingness to learn are essential. **WHAT WE VALUE BEYOND THE CHECKLIST** The scope of this role is intentionally broad, but it is not a request for one person to be an expert in everything. We value engineers who can connect disciplines, identify where they can contribute most, collaborate generously, and bring in the right partners when deeper expertise is needed. Strong candidates may have different paths through full\-stack engineering, applied AI, product development, or startup environments; what matters is the ability to learn, make sound tradeoffs, and turn ideas into outcomes. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and operate agentic AI experiences that support travel discovery, itinerary planning, personalization, and booking\-related workflows. * Develop reliable agent orchestration patterns, including planning, tool use, routing, state management, memory, retries, guardrails, and human confirmation where appropriate. * Build and evolve backend services, APIs, data models, integrations, and event\-driven workflows that connect agent experiences to Expedia Group and Layla capabilities. * Build user\-facing experiences that make AI behavior clear, useful, and actionable across web and other relevant product surfaces. * Integrate retrieval, knowledge, and recommendation capabilities using appropriate data contracts, embeddings, search, ranking, and grounding strategies. * Establish evaluation and observability practices for agentic systems, including quality, task completion, latency, cost, safety, failure modes, and user impact. * Take shared ownership of a meaningful product surface, from framing the problem and exploring solutions through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. * Translate ambiguous product opportunities into thin, testable increments and ship quickly while preserving operational and architectural quality. * Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering to shape product direction, define success metrics, and connect technical decisions to traveler outcomes. * Apply strong software engineering practices across testing, CI/CD, observability, security, incident response, and production support. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to explore designs, accelerate implementation, improve test coverage, and investigate production behavior — whil cture, and cloud\-native systems. * Experience designing agent evaluation frameworks, offline test sets, online monitoring, quality rubrics, or experimentation programs. * Experience building systems with strong safety, privacy, security, reliability, and responsible\-AI considerations. * Experience in travel, commerce, marketplace, recommendations, search, personalization, or other high\-scale consumer products. * Experience using AI coding assistants or software\-engineering agents in day\-to\-day development, including examples of validating, correcting, and hardening generated output. Experience working in a startup, incubation, or rapidly evolving product environment where priorities and requirements change quickly. * Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness \& travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. View our full list of benefits . The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500\.00 to $258,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa;The total cash range for this position in Austin is $184,500\.00 to $258,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

Initially supporting corporate recruiting for Rooms To Go and Furniture.com, this platform will combine core applicant tracking functionality with AI\-powered search, automation, workflows, and decision support. This is a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up. use. **What Youll Do** * Own the continued development of our internal recruiting platform, evolving an existing prototype into a secure, reliable, production\-ready application. * Design and develop full\-stack functionality across the user interface, backend, databases, APIs, and integrations. * Build AI\-powered capabilities using Claude and other leading LLMs, including intelligent candidate search, matching, workflow automation, communication, and recruiter productivity tools. * Develop AI agents, prompts, structured workflows, and human\-in\-the\-loop solutions for real\-world recruiting use cases. * Partner directly with recruiters and HR leaders to translate business problems into practical technology solutions. * Rapidly prototype new ideas, gather user feedback, and iterate. * Integrate the platform with HR systems, job boards, background screening, email/calendar, and other third\-party applications. * Build with enterprise requirements in mind, including security, candidate\-data privacy, role\-based permissions, auditability, reliability, and scalability. * Help establish the technical architecture, development standards, testing, documentation, and long\-term roadmap for the platform. **What Were Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated full\-stack application development. * Experience taking applications from prototype or early\-stage development into production. * Hands\-on experience building applications using generative AI/LLMs such as **Claude/Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable platforms**. * Strong experience building and consuming APIs and integrating third\-party systems. * Experience with modern cloud\-based application architecture, databases, authentication, security, testing, and deployment. * Strong product mindsetyou think about the user and business problem, not just the code. * Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make progress when requirements are still evolving. * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non\-technical business partners. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Technical Skills \& Stack** We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than experience with one exact technology. Relevant experience may include: * **Languages \& Frameworks:** TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js or comparable modern frameworks * **AI/LLMs:** Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agentic workflows and LLM evaluation * **AI Search \& Data:** RAG, embeddings, semantic/vector search and retrieval techniques * **Databases:** PostgreSQL, SQL and/or modern NoSQL databases * **APIs \& Integrations:** REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth and third\-party system integrations * **Cloud \& DevOps:** AWS, Azure or GCP; Git/GitHub; CI/CD; containers and modern deployment practices * **Enterprise Applications:** Authentication, role\-based access controls, data security, logging, monitoring and audit trails. Experience with recruiting or HR technologyincluding ATS, CRM or HRIS platforms such as Phenom, Avature, Greenhouse, Workday or iCIMSis a plus, but not required. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** You are a **builder** who enjoys taking an idea and turning it into a working product. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- The Software Development Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing applications across all layers of the software stack, from database development through front\-end functionality. Working within an Agile development environment, this role partners with business and technical teams to gather requirements, prototype solutions, implement enhancements, and perform unit testing to support application quality, reliability, and performance. The Software Development Engineer II works across multiple projects and technical environments while collaborating with Product, UX, Engineering, and Architecture teams throughout the software development lifecycle. This position requires strong technical and problem\-solving skills, adaptability to changing business and technology needs, and the ability to develop effective solutions to business and client challenges. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: * Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications across multiple tiers of the software architecture. * Support complex and highly visible development initiatives across multiple projects and technical environments. * Gather and evaluate business and technical requirements to develop effective application solutions. * Prototype, develop, test, and implement software solutions that address business and client needs. * Design, develop, and extend back\-end web services using JSON, .NET web services, SQL, and related technologies. * Create, consume, maintain, and enhance RESTful APIs. * Develop and execute unit tests to support application quality, reliability, and performance. * Support application releases and development activities using Agile software development practices. * Apply Test Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices throughout the development lifecycle. * Collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams throughout requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation. * Work closely with architects to ensure applications and technical solutions align with Fleet Response IT's long\-term strategy and architectural standards. * Participate in solution scoping by identifying technical requirements and developing solutions to business and client challenges. * Apply knowledge across multiple technical environments and business areas when developing and supporting applications. * Troubleshoot application issues and identify appropriate technical solutions. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to development standards and best practices. * Maintain technical documentation related to applications, enhancements, and development activities. * Manage multiple development priorities while adapting to changing business requirements, technologies, and project needs. * Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned. *The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities as business needs dictate.* **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required Qualifications** * Three to five years of software development experience. * Proficiency with API and web application development technologies. * Proficiency with C\#, Angular 10\+, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, LESS, Node.js, or similar development technologies. * Experience creating and consuming RESTful APIs. * Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes. * Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, or other source control and code repository tools. * Experience working within a predominantly .NET\-based codebase. * Ability to work effectively within a predominantly Windows\-based development environment. * Experience writing T\-SQL and working with Microsoft SQL Server. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS, with Microsoft Azure preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** ---------------------------------- * Strong knowledge of full\-stack application development across database, back\-end, API, and front\-end technologies. * Strong understanding of API and web development concepts and practices. * Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies and the software development lifecycle. * Understanding of Test Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD practices. * Ability to gather and evaluate business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. * Ability to design and develop solutions across multiple technical environments. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to develop, test, implement, and support reliable software applications. * Ability to identify technical solutions to complex business and client challenges. * Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, UX, Engineering, Architecture, business partners, clients, and vendors. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a development team. * Ability to adapt to changing technologies, business priorities, and technical requirements. * Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement. **Physical Demands \& Work Environment** ---------------------------------------- * Work is performed primarily in a professional indoor office or home\-office environment. * Requires prolonged periods of sitting, typing, computer use, reading, and technical analysis. * Requires close visual attention when reviewing code, technical documentation, data, and computer screens. * Must be able to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, through video conferencing, and through electronic communication. * Regular use of wrists, hands, and fingers is required for computer and office\-related tasks. * This is primarily a sedentary position with occasional walking and standing. * Must occasionally be able to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects weighing up to 10 pounds. * Work is performed in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment requiring adaptability to changing business and technical requirements. **Work Schedule** ----------------- Flexible scheduling options and work arrangements are available based on departmental needs, business requirements, and performance expectations. jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ U.S. Remote; Austin, TX; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Security \& Corp IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $224K – $275K *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Security Team** ===================== **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door. * Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents. * The industry's playbook was written for one building at a time. Vendor\-managed appliances, manual process, and standards that assume a security team walks the floor. None of that survives contact with what we're building, so we build what should exist rather than buying what does. * Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small. **Role Scope** ============== * Build the infrastructure as code that stands up a site's entire security platform, so bringing on a campus is a pipeline run rather than a project. * Own CI/CD and the release path for the security stack, so every change reaches production tested, versioned, and reversible. * Automate the remediation the team would otherwise do by hand, and hold the line that anything done twice becomes code. * Build the package and patch pipeline that keeps a growing fleet current without a person touching a single host. * Get the automation in place ahead of the platform it serves, so on\-call stays something a small team can carry as campuses multiply. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * You've built infrastructure as code that other people deploy from, and the systems that exist because your pipeline created them outnumber the ones someone built by following a runbook. * You've automated yourself out of work you used to do by hand, and you can name what the team stopped doing as a result. * You've owned CI/CD for infrastructure rather than applications, including how a bad change gets caught and rolled back. * You've automated Windows fleets, where the tooling is thinner and the ecosystem less forgiving than it is on Linux. * You've kept an on\-call rotation survivable by removing causes rather than by writing more runbooks. * You write production code and you review other people's. * You've built tooling for people who aren't engineers, and they actually use it instead of working around it. * **Bonus:** Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell DSC). CI/CD for infrastructure (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). Windows package and patch automation (Chocolatey, WSUS, Intune). Observability and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana). Physical security or building systems platforms (Genetec Security Center, access control, IoT device fleets). We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. Applicant Privacy Notice AI Screening Notice Ashby Bias Audit *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $224K \- $275K

jobs.description: **\| About us:** Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low\-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet\-related diseases. At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. One Team \- You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food. **\| About the role:** The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for managing and automating our file transfer workflows, maintaining system security, and monitoring system alerts. You will manage and scale cloud infrastructure on AWS in a Linux\-based environment, bringing 6\+ years of expertise in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles. * You will partner with development teams, cross\-functional teams, and cross\-org stakeholders to provide day\-to\-day support on DevOps activities, including environment setup, build/deployment troubleshooting, and CI/CD pipeline optimization. * You will develop backend systems with strong proficiency in TypeScript, Java, Python, Node.js, and SQL\-based RDBMS such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, leveraging CDK (AWS Cloud Development Kit). * You will automate and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with AWS CloudFormation implemented through AWS CDK (TypeScript). * You will design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline and GitHub Actions to enable frequent and reliable software delivery. * You will implement observability and monitoring solutions such as Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent, proactively identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks and system anomalies. * You will apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to ensure high availability, scalability, performance, and incident response across production environments. * You will debug and troubleshoot issues across application layers, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure components. * You will collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and support teams—both internally and externally—demonstrating excellent communication and partnership skills. ### **You are** * Proactive: You take ownership of tasks and are quick to identify and address issues, especially in high\-pressure situations. * Collaborative: You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams and communicating clearly with both internal teams and external partners. * Security\-minded: You understand the importance of security in managing credentials, file transfers, and infrastructure, and you take steps to protect sensitive information. * Detail\-Oriented: You ensure that all file transfer accounts are well\-documented and secure, and you track system issues to avoid future disruptions. * Problem\-Solver: You are resourceful and skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to file transfer workflows and system performance. * Adaptable: You thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously. ### **You have** * 6\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role, with deep expertise in managing and scaling cloud infrastructure on AWS in a Linux\-based environment using CDK (AWS Cloud Development Kit). * 3\+ years of experience in backend development, with strong proficiency in TypeScript, Java, Python, Node.js, and SQL\-based RDBMS such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. * Proven experience in infrastructure automation and infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Cloud Formation, Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI) to support frequent, reliable software jobs.title: Senior Power Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Senior Power Plant Engineer to support the modeling and validation of our power plant controls as they relate to grid interconnection. As part of our team, you'll help verify that our power plant controller meets interconnection and compliance requirements across our DC\-coupled plant architecture, using hardware\-in\-the\-loop and simulation environments to validate system\-level behavior before it reaches the field. This is a great opportunity for an early\-career engineer with a strong power systems/controls foundation to grow into plant controls validation work on breakthrough energy storage technology. *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Support modeling and validation of our power plant controller (PPC) against grid interconnection requirements, partnering closely with senior staff on test planning and execution * Serve as a key point of contact with third\-party conversion equipment and controls suppliers, managing interface documentation, tracking open items, and professionally coordinating Form's hardware and controls requirements, interface specs, and test results across organizations * Build and run hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test cases (e.g., in Typhoon HIL) verifying that our DC/DC converters and DC bus behavior integrate cleanly with plant inverters in our DC\-coupled architecture * Develop and maintain simulation models in Simulink and PSCAD representing plant\-level electrical behavior and control interactions ahead of hardware validation * Validate grid compliance behavior (e.g., IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800\) once DC bus dynamics are factored into overall plant response * Support integration and testing of SCADA interfaces and meter data as part of plant controls validation * Document test plans, results, and findings, translating HIL/simulation outcomes into clear recommendations for senior staff and the broader controls team * Troubleshoot discrepancies between simulated and hardware\-in\-the\-loop results, escalating root causes as needed ### **What you'll bring:** * + Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related discipline, with a focus on power systems or power electronics + 3\+ years of experience in power systems, power electronics, or controls engineering — internship, co\-op, research, or equivalent strong academic project experience welcome + Foundational knowledge of power systems fundamentals (per\-unit analysis, three\-phase power, grid interconnection basics) + Exposure to power plant controls, grid compliance standards (e.g., IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800\), or inverter\-based resource behavior through coursework or projects + Familiarity with simulation/modeling tools such as Simulink, PSCAD, or HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL) + Exposure to SCADA interfaces, metering, or similar plant communication/data systems is a plus + Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, summarize observations, absorb information and requirements from other teams, and spearhead engagement with 3rd party vendors *\#LI\-Onsite* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.* *To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.* *If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* *Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.* Compensation Range: $128,662 \- $168,844

jobs.title: Software Engineer – FortiSIEM Threat Detection & Integration
jobs.description: We are seeking a software engineer to join the FortiSIEM Advanced Threat Integration engineering team. This role combines hands\-on software development with security detection engineering. The engineer will work close to the data path: ingesting and normalizing security telemetry, building parsers and integrations, modeling detections, and developing the supporting code and tooling required to deliver reliable FortiSIEM content. Responsibilities * Analyze raw security and audit logs from Fortinet and third\-party products to understand their structure and important fields. * Build and maintain FortiSIEM log parsers that extract and normalize data into standard event attributes. * Create and update FortiSIEM security rules, reports, dashboards, and related detection content. * Research vendor documentation, advisories, and sample logs to support new integrations and detections. * Develop and maintain lightweight integrations and supporting tools using Python, regex, APIs, and basic scripting. * Test and troubleshoot parsers, rules, and integrations using representative log samples and expected results. * Work in Linux environments and use Git/GitLab for source control, code review, and team development. Collaborate with developers, QA, support, and security researchers to review, validate, and release FortiSIEM content. * Required Qualifications * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of software engineering experience for candidates with a BS, or 2\+ years with an MS. * Strong Python programming skills, including data structures, file and network I/O, error handling, testing, and debugging. * Strong regular\-expression skills and the ability to reason about correctness and performance when parsing untrusted or irregular log data. * Solid understanding of core programming concepts including algorithms, data structures, complexity, object\-oriented design, and concurrent or asynchronous execution where applicable. * Good working knowledge of Linux, including processes, files, permissions, networking basics, command\-line troubleshooting, and shell scripting. * Working knowledge of Git/GitLab and collaborative code\-review workflows. * Ability to read unfamiliar logs, APIs, schemas, and vendor documentation and convert them into deterministic software and detection logic. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving ability, with attention to edge cases and reproducible testing. Ability to work effectively in a distributed engineering team and to communicate technical reasoning clearly. * Security / SIEM Knowledge * Experience with SIEM, security analytics, log management, EDR, firewall, identity, cloud, or other security telemetry is strongly preferred. * Understanding of common security event concepts such as source/destination identity, authentication events, process execution, network activity, vulnerabilities, and security\-product actions. * Familiarity with detection engineering concepts such as false positives, detection coverage, correlation, baselining, thresholds, and MITRE ATT\&CK is a plus. Prior experience developing SIEM parsers, correlation rules, Sigma\-style detections, or security\-content packages is a strong plus. * Preferred / Nice to Have * Working knowledge of C\+\+ for lower\-level or performance\-sensitive components. * Experience with REST APIs, JSON, XML, syslog, TLS, sockets, and common authentication mechanisms. * Experience with distributed or high\-throughput event\-processing systems. * Experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience building developer tooling, automated test harnesses, or CI/CD checks for data/content pipelines. * What This Role Is This is not a pure security\-analyst role and not a generic application\-development role. The engineer is expected to write production code and tooling while also understanding how security telemetry should be normalized and converted into reliable detections. The role sits at the boundary between software engineering, data parsing/integration, and detection engineering. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $123,000\-$151,000\. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors, including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion. Why Join Us: We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well\-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000\+ customers around the globe.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Globus Medical, we move with a sense of urgency to deliver innovations that improve the quality of life of patients with musculoskeletal disorders. Our team is inspired by the needs of these patients, and the surgeons and healthcare providers who treat them. We embrace a culture of exceptional response by partnering with researchers and educators to transform clinical insights into tangible solutions. Our solutions improve the techniques and outcomes of surgery so patients can resume their lives as quickly as possible. Position Summary: The Full Stack Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining both frontend and backend software for our Robotics products. This role spans modern web applications built with TypeScript and Svelte, as well as high\-performance C\+\+ backend services, rendering systems, and algorithm integration. The platform includes web\-based user interfaces, Qt\-based desktop applications, and service\-oriented components communicating through technologies such as gRPC and Protocol Buffers. This individual will serve as a technical contributor, driving architecture, design decisions, and implementation across the full technology stack. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in modern frontend development, backend systems, UI/UX design, and scalable application architecture. Experience working with 3D visualization, rendering pipelines, and regulated software environments is highly desirable The position is hands\-on and requires the ability to independently lead complex initiatives while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams including algorithm, systems, quality, and product development teams. Essential Functions: * Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack software solutions from concept through production deployment. * Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and production\-quality applications. * Lead architectural design and technical implementation across frontend and backend systems. * Build modern web applications using component\-based architectures and responsive design principles. * Develop reusable UI components and design systems that promote consistency and maintainability. * Build performant, scalable backend services and application infrastructure using modern C\+\+. * Integrate algorithms into production software in collaboration with dedicated algorithm teams. * Develop and maintain rendering and visualization capabilities, including 3D graphics subsystems where applicable. * Collaborate on API design, service contracts, and data flow between frontend and backend systems. * Contribute to existing Qt Widgets\-based applications and support migration efforts to modern web technologies. * Ensure application performance, scalability, maintainability, security, and reliability. * Demonstrate a passion for software craftsmanship, test\-driven development, and engineering best practices. * Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, and technical documentation activities. * Develop tools and utilities to support product development, manufacturing, service, and operational needs. * Support manufacturing, internal testing, and external customers by investigating product issues, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions. * Work effectively within an FDA design control environment and regulated product development lifecycle. * *Adheres to the letter and spirit of the company Code of Conduct, the AdvaMed Code, MedTech Code, and all other company policies* * *Ensures Compliance with applicable governmental laws, rules, and regulations, both in the United States and internationally, by completing introductory and annual training and maintaining knowledge of compliance as it applies to your role* * *Represents the company in a professional manner and upholds the highest standards of ethical business practices and socially responsible conduct in all interactions with other employees, customers, suppliers, and other third parties* *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.* Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including both frontend and backend technologies. * Expert proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or later). * Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\. * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as Svelte, React, Vue, or similar. * Experience developing desktop applications using Qt * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development. * Experience building service\-based systems and APIs utilizing gRPC and/or Protocol Buffers. * Experience implementing reactive programming and state management patterns. * Experience developing reusable software components, libraries, and frameworks. * Strong understanding of source control and Agile development tools including Git, Jira, and Confluence. * Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools while maintaining engineering rigor and software quality standards. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to work independently and lead technical initiatives within small, high\-performing teams. Ability to travel up to 10% of the time. * Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with rendering technologies, visualization systems, and 3D graphics pipelines. * Strong understanding of linear algebra and 3D math concepts. * Experience with algorithm development, image processing, or algorithm integration. * Experience with build systems and toolchains, including CMake. * Experience optimizing web application performance and responsiveness. * Experience scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. * Experience in robotics, medical devices, imaging systems, or other regulated software environments. * Experience leading architecture reviews, technical roadmaps, and engineering best practices. **Our Values** **:** Our Life Moves Us philosophy is built on four values: Passionate About Innovation, Customer Focused, Teamwork, and Driven. * **Passionate about Innovation** : Improving patient care by delivering advanced technology to our customers is at the core of what we do. We are passionate in our role in improving the lives of patients by continuously developing better solutions. * **Customer Focused** : We listen to our customers’ needs and respond with a sense of urgency. * **Teamwork** : Working together, anything is possible. We value every person on our team and treat each other with respect. We are accountable to one another and support each other. Together, we make each other stronger. * **Driven** : We pursue our mission with energy and passion. We are nimble, results\-oriented and decisive. We overcome obstacles that arise in our quest to deliver solutions that will improve the lives of our customers and patients. **Equal Employment Opportunity** **:** Globus Medical is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship. We are committed to a diverse workforce.
