Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description: **Cloud Architect\-Long\-Term Contract (Government) Position** **Title: Cloud Architect** **Worksite Address:** Washington, DC **Interviews: Webcam Only** **Short Description:** **Client seeks a hands\-on Azure Cloud Architect to lead its cloud build\-out (Azure primary, AWS Comm \& GovCloud). Design secure environments for client and partner agencies, delivers Terraform\-based infrastructure, leads cloud migrations, and supports AVD.** **Complete Description:** **CONTRACT JOB DESCRIPTION** **Overview:** client **is seeking a hands\-on Azure Cloud Architect to lead the continued build\-out of its multi\-cloud environment, centered on Microsoft Azure with supporting AWS workloads. This position serves as the technical lead for OCTO's cloud team and the subject matter expert for cloud architecture across DC government. The architect designs secure, well\-governed environments for OCTO and partner agencies, delivers infrastructure through code, plans and executes workload migrations, and provides architectural oversight for Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) deployments. The role works closely with agency IT leaders, OCTO security, and the on\-premises virtualization team, and provides technical direction to an Azure Cloud Engineer.** **Responsibilities:** **1\. Demonstrates expertise in conveying technical and functional concepts for cloud architecture, translating agency business requirements into clear solution designs, and presenting options, costs, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences.** **2\. Identifies improvements to project standards to achieve high quality services and products, including Infrastructure as Code practices, change management, and documentation standards for all cloud work.** **3\. Identifies best practices and standards for the use of Microsoft Azure, including the Azure Cloud Adoption Framework and Well\-Architected Framework, landing zone design, naming and tagging, Azure Policy, and role\-based access control (RBAC).** **4\. Delivers support and design for cloud technologies that require integration with on\-premises systems and networks, including hybrid connectivity to OCTO data centers, hub\-and\-spoke networking, private endpoints, firewall integration, and identity integration with Microsoft Entra ID.** **5\. Interacts with executive level business users and technical experts, including agency CIOs, OCTO leadership, OCTO security, and vendor partners, to scope requirements, communicate status, and support decision\-making.** **6\. Functions as the cloud architecture SME for OCTO, providing authoritative guidance on Azure services, security baselines, cost management, and AWS operations.** **7\. Leads large, complex cloud implementations, including assessment, design, and migration of on\-premises virtualized workloads to Azure, from discovery and dependency mapping through target design, sizing, cost modeling, and migration waves.** **8\. Designs, matures, and owns the Azure landing zone, including management groups, subscriptions, policy, RBAC, and security baselines using Microsoft Defender for Cloud.** **9\. Ensures production changes are delivered through code and pull requests rather than manual portal changes.** **10\. Provides architectural oversight of Azure Virtual Desktop environments, including the boundary between Terraform\-managed infrastructure and the Nerdio management platform.** **11\. Defines monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery standards for Azure workloads, and tracks and optimizes cloud spend to support agency chargeback reporting.** **12\. Supports existing AWS workloads at an operational level.** **13\. Provides technical direction, code review, and mentoring to the Azure Cloud Engineer, and ensures every critical system has a primary and backup owner.** **14\. Maintains current architecture diagrams, design decisions, and runbooks. Documentation is a reviewed deliverable.** **15\. Tracks work in Azure DevOps boards and incidents and changes in ServiceNow.** **Minimum Qualifications:** **1\. 8\+ years in infrastructure engineering, with at least 5 years designing and building in Microsoft Azure.** **2\. Demonstrated design and delivery of an enterprise Azure landing zone, including management groups, Azure Policy, RBAC, and hub\-and\-spoke networking.** **3\. Hands\-on Terraform experience in production, including reusable modules and remote state management.** **4\. Experience building infrastructure CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (or GitHub Actions with transferable skills).** **5\. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and identity governance.** **6\. Experience planning or leading migrations of on\-premises virtualized workloads (VMware or similar) to Azure.** **7\. Working knowledge of AWS, sufficient to operate and troubleshoot existing workloads (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3\).** **8\. Experience leading or mentoring engineers, including code review.** **9\. Strong written communication, with a track record of clear architecture documentation and runbooks.** **Preferred Qualifications:** **1\. Experience in state, local, or federal government IT environments.** **2\. Hands\-on experience with Azure Virtual Desktop and/or Nerdio Manager for Enterprise.** **3\. Experience with Azure.** **4\. Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIST 800\-53, CJIS, or FedRAMP.** **5\. Experience with Azure cost management, reservations, and chargeback models.** **6\. Familiarity with ServiceNow for incident and change management.** **Minimum Education/Certification Requirements:** **Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), or ability to obtain within 6 months of start.** **Preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or higher; HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.**

jobs.title: Data Center Plant Engineer, Controls
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Associate's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent degree program, or equivalent practical experience. * 7 years of experience in Controls/Automation in an industrial or commercial environment. * Experience with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), or Building Management Systems (BMS), including monitoring, alarming configuration, troubleshooting, and graphical user interface/Human\-Machine Interface (HMI) operation. * Experience diagnosing software/hardware errors and managing Linux operating systems within an industrial control environment. * Experience troubleshooting, programming, or designing Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) or Distributed Control System (DCS) architectures (e.g., Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider Electric). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 10 years of experience working in data centers, manufacturing, power plants, or transmission operations. * Direct experience with protective relay configuration, coordination, and testing for medium\-to\-high voltage power distribution systems including industrial network design (VLANs, routing, switching, and subnets) for automation * Experience overseeing security patching, firmware updates, access control/identity management, and vulnerability remediation for both hardware devices and host operating systems. * Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and networking Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and other industrial assets over Modbus, TCP/IP or EtherNet/IP. * Deep expertise in data center infrastructure and systems, such as facility monitoring and control systems, thermal dynamics, fluid mechanics, or electrical power distribution networks in a critical environment. * Experience collaborating with other business units to meet company goals and standards. **About the job** ----------------- As a Plant Engineer at Google specializing in Controls and Automation, you will be a key site technical leader ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of our critical data center infrastructure . You will bridge the gap between day\-to\-day operations and high\-level systems engineering, taking ownership of the site’s Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) platforms, and Building Management Systems (BMS). As a Plant engineer, you will form the technical backbone of the data center operations team, leveraging subject matter expertise to work daily with senior facility technicians and facility management in the continued operation of the site. In this role, you will apply engineering theory to optimize critical cooling and power sequences, manage operational risks, and drive key sustainability metrics like Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE). As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next\-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $122000 \- $173000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide effective leadership for successful critical system troubleshooting, unit commissioning, and repairs/replacements with minimal supervision in quality, quantity, and timeliness as assigned. * Serve as the site’s subject matter expert (SME) on controls systems, such as SCADA interfaces, control loops, automation, instrumentation, etc. * Analyze telemetry data to optimize mechanical cooling and electrical power efficiency, while collaborating with design engineers to bring a practical operational mindset to new infrastructure. * Partner with global engineering teams to resolve complex technical challenges and implement infrastructure changes, while reviewing and approving highly technical Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). * Respond to critical data center events and alarms and be responsible for being a point of escalation on operational issues. Provide critical engineering support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience maintaining and repairing semiconductor fabrication equipment. * 5 years of experience with photolithography, vacuum/plasma tools, or packaging equipment (e.g., wire bonders). * Ability to work in a cleanroom environment wearing full Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP). * Experience with Etch (ICP/RIE) and Deposition (PVD/Evaporation) systems, including high\-vacuum technology, RF power supplies, and toxic gas delivery systems. * Experience with electro\-mechanical measurements (oscilloscopes, generators, calipers, etc.) and CAD software (KiCad, Solidworks, AutoCAD). * Proficiency in troubleshooting vacuum, pneumatic, mechanical, electrical, and software systems, ideally down to the component level. * Ability to read complex schematics (electrical, pneumatic, P\&ID) and perform component\-level repairs on electronics, robotics, and vacuum sub\-systems. **About the job** ----------------- As a part of the Equipment Engineering team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation and sustainability of the manufacturing equipment utilized in the production of high\-quality quantum devices in a dependable and efficient manner. In this role, your mission involves equipment Installation and qualification, bear the responsibility for the proper installation and qualification of new equipment, ensuring it aligns with the required specifications and standards. You will execute routine maintenance procedures to forestall equipment failures and downtime, encompassing regular inspections, cleaning, and the replacement of parts as necessary. In the event of equipment issues, our engineering team intervenes to diagnose problems, execute essential repairs or cooperate with vendors, minimizing disruptions to production. You will collaborate with other teams, such as process engineers, to optimize equipment performance for the efficient and high\-quality manufacturing of quantum devices, implementing upgrades or modifications to existing equipment to augment capabilities, enhance efficiency, or meet new production requirements. You will maintain detailed records of equipment performance, maintenance activities, and any modifications crucial for compliance, analysis, and future reference. You will provide comprehensive training to our personnel on the proper usage and maintenance of equipment, ensuring safety and optimal performance, actively seek opportunities for continuous improvement in equipment reliability, efficiency, and overall manufacturing processes.The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Perform complex preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs to ensure the maximum uptime and optimal performance of critical fabrication tools. * Lead the scoping, evaluation, and procurement of new process equipment tailored for quantum manufacturing, and drive the qualification of these tools. * Manage equipment installations, retrofits, and upgrades, serving as the primary technical liaison with external vendors to ensure effective project execution. * Support operations across multiple local facilities, including shared research labs, ensuring consistent equipment standards and seamless workflow between sites. * Analyze tool reliability data to optimize maintenance schedules, enhance equipment availability, and support process engineering requirements. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **WHY HILLPOINTE?** *Hillpointe is a fully integrated real estate development and investment management firm focused on developing market\-rate workforce housing across the Sun Belt. Ranked at the top of NMHC's list of Builders and Developers, our team ensures best\-in\-class execution.* *Built on its long and proven track record of real estate development, the firm's investment approach is centered around its in\-house general contracting expertise, enabling direct control of cost and delivery timeframe. For each project, Hillpointe directly controls land acquisition, land development, construction, procurement of building materials, asset management, and capital markets. This is more than just a job \- it's a career\-defining opportunity! At Hillpointe, you'll be part of a dynamic, innovative team that has tangible impacts on day\-to\-day operations and contributes directly to overall success.* **Full Stack Developer** Hillpointe is hiring a Full Stack Developer to help build HPOS, the property management platform for our vertically integrated multifamily real estate business, from scratch. This is a greenfield engineering role. You will help establish the architecture, design the data model, ship the first services, and set the patterns the rest of the platform will inherit. Expect a zero\-to\-one cadence. Design an API contract in the morning, ship a Postgres migration before lunch, push a Bicep change to staging by end of day. We optimize for engineers who can hold the full stack in their head, make sound architectural decisions, and ship working software at pace. **The Role at a Glance:** * *Scope*: Schema to UI: Database design, API contracts, frontend components, infrastructure. No tier is off\-limits. * *Surface*: Greenfield build: Property management platform built from scratch. Multi\-tenant from day one. Operator tooling, leasing, accounting, capital markets. * *Cadence*: Zero to one: Trunk\-based development, short\-lived branches, feature flags, working software in staging on a daily rhythm. * *Impact*: Foundational: What you ship in the first year becomes how the platform works for the next ten. **Key Responsibilities:** * **React surfaces**: First\-generation operator and resident\-facing applications. React 18 with TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query v5, React Hook Form, Zod. Component composition against the PDS Foundation design system. The patterns set here will be inherited by every surface that follows. * **Service layer**: TypeScript services on Node 20 LTS with NestJS or Express. OpenAPI contracts shared with the front end through code generation. JWT and OAuth flows, RBAC enforcement, structured audit logs, request\-scoped tracing. The shared libraries that every future service will depend on. * **Postgres data model**: Multi\-tenant schema design on Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Tenant isolation strategy, normalization tradeoffs, index strategy from day one, audit trails baked into the data model. Migrations through Prisma or Knex. * **Warehouse integration**: Stand up change data capture from Postgres into the Bronze layer of Enzo, our medallion warehouse. Establish read models surfaced from Gold\-layer views back into product. Contract\-first design with the data team. * **Event\-driven backbone**: Asynchronous workflows over Azure Service Bus. Idempotent consumers, dead\-letter handling, exactly\-once where the business requires it. The async patterns the rest of the platform will adopt. * **Infrastructure and Observability**: Bicep modules for App Service, Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault, and managed identities. Multi\-stage Azure DevOps pipelines. Structured logs, OpenTelemetry, and SLO definitions in place before we ever take production traffic. * **Stack**: + *Front End*: React 18 \+ TypeScript 5 - React 18 with Suspense and concurrent features, TypeScript 5\.x strict, Vite, TanStack Query v5, React Hook Form with Zod, the PDS Foundation design system through Figma MCP. + *Back End*: Node 20 \+ NestJS - Node 20 LTS, NestJS or Express, TypeScript strict mode, Prisma against Postgres, BullMQ on Redis for background work, OpenAPI 3\.x contracts generated for both sides. + *Data*: Azure Postgres \+ Fabric - Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Azure Data Factory for orchestration, Microsoft Fabric lakehouse with Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, Power BI Premium, Python and PySpark on the data team. + *Cloud*: Microsoft Azure - App Service Premium, Function Apps, Container Apps, Service Bus with sessions, Key Vault with managed identities, Application Insights, Front Door Premium, private endpoints throughout. + *Devops*: GitHub \+ Azure DevOps - GitHub for source and PR review, Azure DevOps multi\-stage YAML pipelines for CI/CD. Trunk\-based development, required reviews, automated test gates, environment promotion via parameters. + *Infrastructure*: Bicep \+ Terraform - Bicep modules for first\-party Azure, Terraform for cross\-cloud and third\-party providers. Remote state in Azure Storage with locking, drift detection in pipelines. **Qualifications:** * **Required:** + Five\-plus years in production: building web applications. You have taken a system from greenfield to production, or rebuilt the foundations of one that needed it. + TypeScript depth: generics, conditional types, discriminated unions, branded types. You know when to reach for them and when to stop. + React expertise: hooks, render optimization, error boundaries, Suspense. You can diagnose a re\-render storm and you've written a custom hook that earned its keep. + Production Node.js: event loop awareness, streaming and backpressure, memory profiling, graceful shutdown, structured logging. + Relational data modeling: schema design, normalization tradeoffs, index strategy, partitioning, query plan analysis. You catch N\+1 in code review. + API design: REST conventions, idempotency, versioning, pagination, OpenAPI specifications, authentication patterns (OAuth 2\.0, JWT, session). + Azure or equivalent: production experience with App Service, Functions, identity, networking, observability. AWS or GCP at the same depth is fine. + CI/CD and IaC discipline: pipeline\-as\-code, environment promotion, automated test gates, infrastructure as reviewed artifacts, no clicks in the portal. * **Preferred**: + Postgres extensions in production: pg\_stat\_statements, pgvector, pgcrypto, PostGIS, logical replication. + Lakehouse and BI tooling at production scale: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium with DAX, Python and PySpark on the data plane. + Event\-sourced architectures, CQRS, sagas, or domain\-driven design applied to a real codebase. + LLM\-assisted engineering: Claude Code, Cursor, or retrieval\-augmented internal tooling shipped to other engineers. + Real estate, property management, financial services, or other regulated\-industry domain experience. + RUST development experience.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Minnesota \- ML Engineer #### **Hollstadt Overview** Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down\-to\-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations. Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran. *By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI\-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.* **Job Description** **Role**: Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineer **Location**: Remote **Duration**: 6 months to start **Rate**: $79\-$88/hour W2 **Description of work / project:** The AI CoE builds AI products and the shared platform that powers them. We're looking for a **Senior ML / AI Engineer** who is equally comfortable building models and building the platform around them: someone who can train and evaluate an ML model, ship a production LLM/GenAI application, and extend shared AI infrastructure and tooling that the wider team depends on. This is a senior builder role at the intersection of applied data science, GenAI application engineering, and AI platform engineering. Our work spans predictive modeling, LLM\-based systems, and the platform underneath them; you'll take problems from data and prototype through to governed, monitored production services, and set the technical patterns other engineers build on. Projects vary over time — we value engineers who can move across the stack rather than stay in one lane **Performance expectations:** * **Build ML models** — frame problems, engineer features, train and evaluate models (ranking, scoring, survival/time\-to\-event, classification, forecasting), and reason rigorously about metrics (AUC, C\-index, calibration), validation strategy, subgroup performance, and failure modes. * **Integrate models into decision systems** — combine model output with business/domain rules and LLM reasoning to produce explainable, trustworthy recommendations. * **Ship GenAI applications** — design and deploy LLM\-powered features: RAG pipelines, agents, structured extraction, summarization, decision\-reasoning trails, and evaluation harnesses using Claude/Bedrock and other models. * **Engineer the AI platform** — extend the shared AI gateway (unified multi\-model access, API keys, per\-team budgets, failover, observability) and reusable libraries/SDKs that other teams build on. * **Own the RAG/data layer** — embeddings, vector stores, retrieval quality, chunking, and grounding strategies; measure and improve retrieval and answer quality. * **Build evaluation \& quality tooling** — offline/online eval, LLM\-as\-judge, regression suites, statistical validation, and guardrails so model and prompt changes ship safely. * **Productionize** — wrap models and pipelines as tested, observable services (Python, containers, AWS Lambda/SageMaker/EKS), with monitoring for quality, cost, latency, and drift. * **Lead technically** — set patterns and standards, review designs and code, mentor engineers, and partner with data scientists, MLOps, clinical/domain experts, and product owners to move prototypes to production. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years building and shipping ML / AI systems in production (not just notebooks/POCs), including technical leadership of non\-trivial projects. * Strong **data science / ML fundamentals** — feature engineering, model training and evaluation, metrics (AUC, C\-index, calibration, precision/recall), gradient\-boosted trees (XGBoost), and sound experimental methodology (validation strategy, subgroup analysis). * Experience building **ranking, scoring, or survival/time\-to\-event models**, and integrating model output into a larger decision system. * Hands\-on **GenAI / LLM engineering** — RAG, prompt engineering, function/tool calling, embeddings and vector search, and LLM evaluation. * Excellent **Python** — production\-grade, tested, well\-structured code; comfortable building APIs/services and shared libraries. * **AWS** experience — Bedrock and/or SageMaker, Lambda, S3, plus containers (Docker) and Git\-based workflows. * Solid software engineering practice: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD; ability to reason about cost, latency, and reliability of AI systems in production. **Preferred Qualifications** * **AI platform engineering** — building shared gateways/proxies, model routing, multi\-tenancy, quota/budget enforcement, or internal AI SDKs. * Experience with agent frameworks, real\-time/voice AI, or streaming inference. * Vector databases (Qdrant, OpenSearch, pgvector) and retrieval\-quality tuning at scale. * IaC (Terraform), observability (OpenTelemetry/CloudWatch), and FinOps for AI workloads. * **Healthcare / clinical ML** — survival analysis, outcome prediction, or working with clinical/scientific datasets alongside domain experts. * Serving models as endpoints (SageMaker), cross\-account inference, and train/serve parity. * Experience in a regulated / PHI\-handling environment (HIPAA) — data governance, PII handling, auditability. ### **Benefits \+ Perks** Comprehensive Benefit Plan Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between! Remarketing Process Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6\-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise. Professional Development Hollstadt offers on\-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI). 401k \+ Matching One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long\-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor. Bonus Opportunities We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000! Ongoing Support \& Networking We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team \- so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Device Security
jobs.description: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially\-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 \- our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments \- and we’re growing the team to take it even further. **About the Role** ================== We’re looking for a **Software Engineer II** to join our Platform Infrastructure team in San Diego. You’ll help build the software and tools that enable our robots to run trusted software on trusted hardware, working with security, firmware, and platform engineers across the device lifecycle. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build and maintain software and tools for trusted boot and device provisioning, working with NVIDIA secure boot and UEFI. For example, you might help bring up a secure boot flow on a new device or build tooling to provision and verify device credentials. * Contribute to device trust and key protection using hardware roots of trust, including Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs), and security technologies such as ARM TrustZone. * Contribute to device key management though the use of Hardware Security Modules (HSMs). * Write, test, and debug software and scripts in Linux, and investigate issues across software and hardware. * Identify and reduce attack surfaces across device software, boot flows, and supporting tools. * Collaborate with security, firmware, cloud, manufacturing, and other engineering teams through design discussions, code reviews, and documentation; own well\-scoped projects from design through implementation and testing, with input from experienced teammates. **What You Bring** ================== You’re a curious, collaborative engineer who takes ownership, works through unfamiliar problems, and wants to deepen your skills in device security. You’ll bring: * **Software engineering experience** — Typically 1–3 years of full\-time experience building, testing, and maintaining production\-quality software, or equivalent experience. + You have a strong foundation in object\-oriented programming and software design. + You can read and reason about code, identify logic errors, and learn to contribute across C\+\+, Python, and Rust codebases + Prior experience in all three languages is not required. B.S. or M.S. in CS, CE, EE, or a related field. * **AI\-assisted development** — You’re comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools and can understand, review, and validate the code they produce. * **Security fundamentals** — Familiarity with authentication, encryption, cryptographic keys, and trust boundaries, and an interest in applying them to hardware devices. * **Linux and tooling** — Comfort working in Linux and using scripting languages such as Python or Bash to automate tasks, build tools, and investigate problems. * **Problem\-solving and collaboration** — A thoughtful approach to unfamiliar problems, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly, seek feedback, and follow work through. * Experience with **key management** and/or NVIDIA platforms, such as Jetson, is a plus * Ability to work on\-site at our San Diego office. **What We Offer** ================= * Comprehensive health coverage for US‑based employees, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, with virtual care and employee assistance resources. * Meaningful time off to rest and recharge: 23 days of PTO (accrued), separate sick leave, and paid company holidays. * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. * Equity included–we believe builders should share in what they build. * Free daily catered lunch, snacks, and drinks in‑office. * Collaboration with top‑tier engineers, researchers, and product experts in AI and robotics. * Freedom to influence the product and own key initiatives. *For this role in California, the expected base salary range is $123,000\-$154,000 USD per year; your placement in that range depends on how your experience maps to our internal leveling.*

jobs.description: **Purpose:** Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for microcontroller\-based electronic controls, primarily for HVAC/R applications. Work closely with engineering teams to develop reliable, cost\-effective products from concept through production. **Responsibilities**: * Design, develop, debug, and maintain bare\-metal embedded firmware in C for 8\-bit, 16\-bit, and 32\-bit microcontroller\-based electronic controls. * Collaborate with hardware engineers to review schematics, define interfaces, and integrate firmware with electronic hardware. * Develop control logic for sensors, switches, relays, motors, timers, and other electrical inputs and outputs. * Troubleshoot firmware and hardware interactions using problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently develop, troubleshoot, and deliver firmware while collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience development best practices.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest\-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always\-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **What's the opportunity?** --------------------------- As Fin becomes mission\-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re growing our team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work hands\-on with strategic customers, partnering closely with our R\&D and Go\-to\-Market teams to design and deliver high\-impact solutions. You’ll go beyond implementation \- helping shape product direction, influence roadmap decisions and ensure Fin delivers real, measurable business outcomes in complex, real\-world environments. If you’re excited by ownership, creativity and solving ambiguous problems, and want to work at the frontier of applied AI while collaborating with Product, Engineering and Go\-to\-Market teams, this role offers a rare opportunity to combine technical excellence with real customer impact. **What will I be doing?** ------------------------- * Drive adoption of Fin by helping customers unlock the power of our AI capabilities to automate and scale their support operations. * Embed deeply with strategic customers to understand their business challenges and technical requirements, and provide the insight needed to achieve outstanding results with Fin. * Work hands\-on with customers’ technical teams as a trusted technical expert, coding side\-by\-side to drive projects through to completion. * Collaborate closely with Sales, Success and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, successful project delivery and actionable product feedback. * Contribute to the evolution of Forward Deployed Engineering by codifying best practices and sharing insights from customer engagements to help the team scale and grow. **What skills do I need?** -------------------------- * A strong engineering background and experience building software with real\-world usage. Experience building a SaaS product is a plus, but not a requirement. * Interest in AI and machine learning, and the ability to quickly build an understanding of novel problems, capabilities and architectures \- including their trade\-offs and limitations. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate organisational boundaries and bring people together to achieve the best outcomes for our customers. * Deep knowledge of at least one high\-level programming language, such as JavaScript, Python or Ruby. It doesn’t need to be a language we use today \- great people learn quickly and can introduce us to better ways of working. * The ability to prototype and ship software quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality and a clear focus on business goals and outcomes. * Proficiency using and writing REST APIs to integrate systems effectively. * Strong communication skills. You can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non\-technical audiences, adapting the depth and detail as needed. * Willingness to travel and work on\-site with customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs. * Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the Chicago area is $160,000 \- $213,300\. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). **Unleash Your Potential** When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Policies** Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non\-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values. Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: Description: A senior Microsoft\-focused consulting role spanning discovery, architecture, engineering, governance, and client enablement. \~ Client\-Facing (Discovery/Architecture/Delivery) \~ Microsoft Cloud (Azure \& Microsoft Fabric) \~ Data Engineering (Trusted Data Foundations for Analytics \& AI) Interlink Cloud Advisors is looking for a **Senior Data \& AI Engineering Consultant** to help clients build modern, scalable data platforms on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric. In this client\-facing role, you'll lead discovery, design pragmatic architectures, and deliver end\-to\-end solutions that turn raw data into trusted, analytics\-ready datasets for BI, reporting, advanced analytics, and AI use cases. You'll work across Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse) and Azure data services to ensure solutions are secure, governed, maintainable, cost\-conscious, and operationally ready. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead client discovery to understand business goals, the data landscape, constraints, and success metrics, then translate findings into a clear delivery plan. * Design and recommend data lake, lakehouse, data warehouse, and analytical data store architectures on Azure and Microsoft Fabric aligned to client needs. * Implement, or guide implementation of, ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines using Microsoft Fabric experiences and Azure services such as Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks. * Integrate data from operational systems, APIs, and third\-party sources and transform raw data into curated datasets ready for consumption. * Build and maintain analytics\-ready data models and schemas; implement enrichment, business rules, and reusable patterns for consistency across projects. * Enable multiple compute engines \- SQL, Spark/PySpark, Spark SQL, and KQL \- against shared datasets to support diverse analytics scenarios. * Prepare governed data products and reusable datasets for BI, advanced analytics, and AI use cases, including retrieval\-ready data patterns when relevant. * Establish data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, testing, and monitoring; troubleshoot failures and continuously improve pipeline resiliency. * Optimize transformations, query performance, and pipeline execution to meet client service level and cost objectives. * Implement logging, metrics, and operational runbooks, and support deployments, cutovers, and hypercare as needed. * Design and implement security, governance, and compliance controls, including access, least privilege, data protection, and lineage across Azure and Fabric. * Facilitate workshops and communicate architecture tradeoffs, partnering with client stakeholders, architects, analysts, and BI developers to deliver trusted datasets. * Produce clear consulting deliverables, including design documents, diagrams, implementation guides, and enablement materials, to support adoption and a smooth handoff. Requirements: **Required Qualifications** * Experience designing and delivering modern analytics platforms using lakehouse and/or data warehouse patterns on Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric, including client\-facing delivery. * Strong SQL skills with experience building transformations and dimensional or analytical models. * Hands\-on experience with Spark (PySpark/Spark SQL) and/or KQL for data engineering and analytics workloads. * Experience applying software engineering practices to data solutions, including modular design, source control, automated testing, code review, and technical documentation. * Experience building reliable data pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, error handling, and automated monitoring. * Knowledge of data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, testing, incident triage, and root\-cause analysis. * Working knowledge of Power BI, including semantic modeling concepts, to support end\-to\-end analytics delivery; Power Apps experience is a plus. * Understanding of security and governance concepts for data platforms, including access controls, least privilege, compliance, and lineage. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations, align stakeholders, and manage expectations in a client environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience with Microsoft Fabric components \- OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory in Fabric, and Real\-Time Analytics/KQL databases \- including platform administration, capacity planning, and standards. * Experience with Azure services commonly used in data platforms, such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, and Key Vault. * Working knowledge of Azure architecture fundamentals across identity, networking, storage, monitoring, resiliency, and cost management. * Familiarity with AI\-enablement patterns \- such as preparing governed enterprise data for Azure AI Search or Microsoft Foundry, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agent\-based solutions—is valued. Deep agent application development experience is not required. * Experience implementing CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code, including environment strategy and release management for data solutions. * Familiarity with semantic modeling and BI enablement patterns, including Power BI datasets, self\-service analytics, and governance guardrails. * Current Microsoft certifications relevant to the role are valued, especially Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\), Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\), and, for broader architecture responsibilities, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\). Equivalent current Microsoft credentials and experience mentoring or enabling client teams are also welcome. **About Us** Interlink is a nationally recognized IT consultancy, offering the flexibility of a small company while providing stability and benefits usually found at enterprise firms. We work with a "family first" attitude, so we look to hire motivated individuals who understand that getting work done while having fun is important. As the winner of The Best Places to Work Award for five consecutive years, we know what it takes to care for our employees and clients. **Interlink Advantage** We are the premier Microsoft Cloud consulting company based in Mason, OH. We are a team of trusted experts who know how to navigate the intricacies of Microsoft's technologies, guiding and educating clients to avoid overspending on tech licenses while optimizing their tools. At Interlink, we believe working in an innovative, fun, and collaborative environment is key to success. Get to know us and our company culture more at: http://www.interlink.com/about\-us/company\-culture. *Interlink Cloud Advisors is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The Tech Lead level Software Engineer works effectively across the entire software development life cycle. This includes requirements definition, prototyping, detailed design, coding, testing, deployment, and support of the day\-to\-day operation of production systems. The Tech Lead Software Engineer is expected to collaborate with technical staff, management, and business operations staff throughout all phases of the software development life cycle to deliver working solutions to complex business problems according to agreed upon timelines and budgets to support the mission, vision, and values of Intermountain Health. The Tech Lead role is a high\-level contributor who will shape our software development processes, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and maintainability while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. Also has a good understanding of the business domain. Responsible for implementing and/or integrating new products, processes, methodologies, frameworks, and technologies. Works independently with minimal oversight and direction. Provides guidance, input, and instruction to lower\-level technical professionals. Provides mentoring and training to staff and senior level software engineers and can be their direct supervisor. **This position will be in person for the first 6 months and then hybrid after that!** **Essential Functions** * **Develop** : Develop "best\-in\-class" engineering solutions by ensuring that the components are well\-defined, modularized, secure, reliable, actively monitored and reusable. Expert proficiency in JavaScript, Python, Java or C\# with demonstrable practices in software design principles, data structures, and algorithms. Strong experience with full\-stack development, including front\-end and back\-end technologies, to develop end\-to\-end solutions. * **Security** : Follow secure coding practices, implement appropriate security measures, and stay informed about potential security vulnerabilities and threats. * **Methodology** : Work within an agile team including understanding how to participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming and sprint retrospectives. Expert knowledge of software development methodologies, such as Agile or Scrum, and experience working in an Agile environment. * **Passion for learning** : Ability to thrive in a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment, with a passion for learning and continuous improvement. Stay updated on new technologies and best practices and create opportunities for team members to better understand what you have learned. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Interra Health is a fast\-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real\-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission\-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone. Interra Health is expanding its use of artificial intelligence and machine learning across a fast\-moving, highly regulated healthcare market. As an AI Security Engineer on the Security Engineering team, reporting to the Lead Security Engineer, you will help secure the models, data pipelines, and AI solutions. This role is hands\-on and technical: you will assess AI systems for vulnerabilities, build guardrails against risks like prompt injection and data leakage, and partner with Engineering and Data \& Analytics to bake security into how AI is designed and shipped. You will independently assess and resolve AI security risks across multiple workflows, escalating complex or high\-impact issues to senior security leadership as appropriate. The right person is genuinely curious about how AI systems can fail, and wants to build the guardrails before something goes wrong, not after. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead security assessments of AI/ML models, data pipelines, and AI\-enabled applications, identifying vulnerabilities such as prompt injection, model inversion, data poisoning, and adversarial inputs * Partner with Data \& Analytics and Engineering to embed security requirements and threat modeling into the AI development lifecycle, from data collection through model deployment * Build and maintain guardrails, monitoring, and detection controls for AI systems in production, flagging anomalous model behavior and unauthorized data access * Conduct security reviews of third\-party AI tools, APIs, and vendors, such as LLM providers, before they are integrated into Interra Health * Lead incident response for AI\-related security events, including investigating suspicious model outputs or unexpected data exposure * Design and advise on standards for the secure, responsible use of AI, including data handling practices for training and inference * Test and validate access controls, encryption, and data segmentation for AI systems * Use AI tools to accelerate security testing, code review, and threat research, while modeling responsible AI use for the broader engineering organization * Stay current on the evolving AI threat landscape and translate emerging risks, such as jailbreaks and model\-supply\-chain risks, into practical mitigations * Document findings, risk assessments, and remediation plans clearly for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * Bachelor's degree and 5\+ years in security engineering or application security, including hands\-on experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM\-based applications * Deep knowledge of AI/ML security risks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, adversarial ML, and data poisoning) and proven ability to test for and mitigate them * Hands\-on experience with security tooling, including SAST/DAST and vulnerability scanning, and comfort scripting in Python or a similar language * Understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how AI/ML workloads are deployed and secured within it * Clear communicator who can translate technical risk into terms non\-security stakeholders understand * Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, post\-merger environment where systems, priorities, and structures are still evolving **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience securing systems in a regulated healthcare or life sciences environment (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) * Familiarity with LLM security frameworks and tools, such as MITRE ATLAS, Garak, or promptfoo * Security certifications such as OSCP, GCIH, or CISSP * Experience red\-teaming or penetration\-testing AI/ML systems specifically **Pre\-Employment Drug Screening:** This position is subject to a pre\-employment drug screening, where permitted by applicable law. Any required screening will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. **Benefits \& Perks:** \- **Competitive compensation** \- **Remote\-first** Work from anywhere in US. We also provide a one\-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi\-Fi reimbursement. **\- Flexible work** Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life. \- **Company\-wide offsite** We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together. \- **Time off that you’re expected to use** Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave. \- **Comprehensive health coverage** Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family. Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection). \- **Financial wellness** 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future. *Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.* Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The AI Solutions \& Transformation team builds the engineering backbone that turns Intuit's commercial strategy into production AI systems — the agentic pipelines, creative tooling, and automation that let the business move at the speed AI now demands. As Principal, you own the engineering organization behind that work: you lead the broader product development team, and you're accountable for the technical direction, delivery quality, and growth of everyone building inside this team. This is not a maintain\-the\-roadmap role. The AI landscape this team builds against changes every quarter — sometimes every month — and the job is to build a team that treats that as normal rather than disruptive: ship something real, learn fast from what the model, the tooling, or the business actually needs, pivot without drama, and build again. You'll be the person who decides what's worth doubling down on, what gets killed, and how a group of engineers and engineering leads keeps shipping enterprise\-grade AI solutions while the ground underneath them keeps moving. You'll report into GBSG Commercial organization, and you'll work in close, daily partnership with the AI Solutions product management team, who own the product bets this engineering organization builds against. That means part of the job is translating between two worlds: you need enough technical depth to set direction, make build\-vs\-pivot calls, and earn credibility with your engineers — and enough business fluency to turn product management's priorities into a technical roadmap, and explain what the team is building, and why it matters, in terms a commercial, brand\-first audience immediately understands. **Responsibilities** ### **Lead the engineering organization** * Manage and grow a team of engineering contractors and FTEs to leading the product development squads building the team's AI systems. * Set the technical direction and engineering quality bar across the full AI Solutions \& Transformation portfolio. * Own the build\-pivot\-kill calls: decide where the team doubles down, where it cuts losses, and where it re\-architects as new models, tools, and business priorities emerge. * Build the org's structure and capacity plan so it can run multiple concurrent AI initiatives without you being the bottleneck. ### **Own delivery and impact** * Be accountable for the delivery, reliability, and quality of the AI systems your organization ships into production for the commercial business. * Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: take loosely defined, fast\-changing product priorities from the AI Solutions product management team and convert them into a staffed, sequenced build plan for your team. * Establish the operating cadence — planning, prioritization, and review — that keeps a fast\-iterating AI team shipping rather than thrashing. * Serve as the escalation point for technical, delivery, or resourcing issues that need a group manager's judgment and authority to unblock. ### **Partner across the business** * Partner day\-to\-day with the AI Solutions product management team as your primary counterpart — translating product priorities into a staffed technical roadmap, and surfacing technical tradeoffs, risk, and pivots back to them in terms they can act on. * Represent engineering to brand and other cross\-functional partners on progress, risk, and the pivots the team is making and why. * Build trust with non\-technical stakeholders by communicating clearly, not just correctly. ### **Build the practice** * Establish engineering practices suited to rapid AI iteration: fast experimentation, clear criteria for scaling or killing a bet, and reusable infrastructure so each new capability ships faster than the last. * Set the hiring bar and run the interview loop for engineers and engineering leads joining the team during a period of rapid growth and change. * Coach and develop the managers and leads on your team, including Ashton and Jaga, and own their performance and career growth. **Qualifications** **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time leading engineering managers or leads (Group Manager / Senior Manager level), not just individual contributors. * Hands\-on technical depth in modern AI and agentic systems — LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration and tool use, prompt engineering * A track record of shipping production AI systems, not demos or proofs of concept, under real delivery pressure. * Demonstrated comfort with fast, repeated iteration: building something, learning it's wrong, pivoting without losing the team's momentum, and building again. * Experience managing engineering within or adjacent to a commercial, brand, or marketing organization, with the ability to translate business and brand goals into technical execution. * Strong stakeholder management and the judgment to partner with senior, non\-technical executive leadership. * Experience scaling a technical practice: hiring, leveling, interview loops, and engineering standards. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building enterprise\-grade AI solutions: RAG pipelines, multi\-agent systems, content generation, compliance/QA automation, or similar agentic tooling. * Background in fintech, SaaS, or brand/creative technology. * Experience leading a team through a significant strategic or organizational pivot. * Experience managing managers specifically, rather than only a team of individual contributors. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB220036 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function** The Staff Architect, Digital Applications is the technical and architectural leader responsible for defining and driving the long\-term technology vision for the My Intuitive ecosystem. The Principal Architect will partner closely with product, engineering, design, clinical, commercial, data, and platform leaders to transform My Intuitive from a collection of applications into a unified digital ecosystem and the digital operating system for robotic surgery. engineering organizations around a common architectural north star. **Roles \& Responsibilities** **Ecosystem Vision and Architecture Leadership** * Define and evolve the end\-state architecture for digital products and platforms. **Customer Experience Architecture** * Champion a journey\-centric architecture spanning Learn, Prepare, Perform, Review, Improve, and Mentor experiences. * Ensure experiences are designed around customer goals rather than organizational or application boundaries. * Define reusable experience patterns enabling consistent navigation, personalization, workflow orchestration, and engagement across the ecosystem. * Advocate for human\-centered design principles and frictionless customer experiences. **Platform and Systems Architecture** * Lead architecture across customer identity, entitlement, collaboration, learning, case management, insights, notifications, analytics, integration, and AI capabilities. * Drive platform\-first approaches that maximize reuse, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Guide architecture for cloud\-native platforms, APIs, event\-driven systems, data products, AI services, and interoperability. * Ensure solutions support current and future Intuitive platforms and digital services. **Applications and AI** * Establish architectural patterns enabling longitudinal customer journeys and personalized experiences. * Drive integration of AI\-enabled workflows, recommendations, insights, learning pathways, and decision support capabilities. * Partner with Data Engineering, AI/ML, Clinical, and Product teams on future\-facing digital experiences. **Cross\-Functional Influence** * Collaborate with leadership to translate long\-term business strategy into technology investments and jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: ITHAKA's mission is to expand access to knowledge and education around the world. Our services — JSTOR, Portico, and Ithaka S\+R — enable people everywhere to learn, to grow, and to overcome barriers to education. In carrying out our mission, as employees we feel a deep responsibility to members of our community and to each other, and we are committed to building and sustaining a culture where everyone can thrive. **Level** --------- Depending on experience and qualifications, ITHAKA is open to considering candidates in the following levels: **Lead Level, Lead** Software Engineer: * Expected to bring strong technical skills and adaptability, with opportunities to grow into leadership or more autonomous roles. * Focuses on hands\-on contributions and learning through collaboration on challenging projects. * 5\+ years of experience **Principal level,** Principal Software Engineer**:** * Expected to lead with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of complex initiatives and driving innovation. * Will mentor other engineers, contributing to their growth and the team's overall expertise. * Plays a key role in shaping strategic goals and optimizing workflows for scalability and impact. * 12\+ year of experience **The Role** ------------ ITHAKA is looking for a Lead / Principal Software Engineer to lead the technology vision for JSTOR's Business platform team for Books and Royalty Payments. As part of ITHAKA, JSTOR helps researchers, educators, students, and lifelong learners around the world discover and engage with trusted scholarly knowledge. In this role, you'll shape the future of the books on JSTOR. As the senior technical leader for backend engineering, you'll remain an active technical contributor while combining hands\-on engineering with long\-term architectural leadership. You'll define and evolve the backend architecture, distributed systems, search platform, APIs, data pipelines, and engineering practices that power scalable, reliable experiences across JSTOR. You'll influence technology direction across multiple engineering teams, mentor other engineers and technical leaders, and apply strong product thinking to align backend strategy with user needs, product vision, business priorities, system quality, and long\-term platform health. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Technology Strategy \& Architecture** * Define and drive the multi\-year backend technology strategy and architectural roadmap for the Books and royalty payment platforms, aligning engineering investments with user needs, product strategy, organizational priorities, and long\-term platform goals. * Lead architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams, building alignment through technical leadership and influence rather than formal authority. * Evaluate emerging backend, AI, and distributed systems technologies, translating them into pragmatic recommendations that improve products, platforms, developer productivity, scalability, and maintainability. * Apply product thinking to balance long\-term platform evolution with near\-term product delivery, making thoughtful tradeoffs across user impact, business value, engineering quality, reliability, operational complexity, developer productivity, and cost. * Drive architectural consistency across teams through shared technical direction, engineering standards, and reusable platform capabilities. ### **Backend Platform Engineering** * Lead the architecture and evolution of ITHAKA's royalty payment and fulfillment backend platforms: the distributed services, APIs, batch and scheduled processing, and data integrations behind JSTOR's books and archive licensing. * Design, build and improve highly available ordering and digital book fulfillment systems using Java, Spring Boot, Maven, MySQL (Flyway, stored procedures), and Redis, with attention to schema design, query performance, idempotency, scalability, resiliency and observability. * Drive practical use of AI in engineering and operations: AI\-assisted development and code review, anomaly detection on order and payment flows, and LLM\-assisted support and diagnostics. * Adopt organization\-wide strategies for analytics, experimentation, observability, service reliability, and platform operations that enable continuous product improvement. * Define engineering health metrics and platform success measures, such as order SLA attainment, error and recovery rates, end\-to\-end latency, and reconciliation accuracy, to guide long\-term technical investment. * Improve backend quality, developer experience, platform reliability and operational excellence. ### **Technical Leadership \& Innovation** * Lead by example through hands\-on engineering, architecture, and operational excellence on complex backend, partner, and platform challenges. * Build reusable services, frameworks, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering practices that improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery effectiveness. * Mentor e d architecture documents that led to adopted decisions. * Track record of owning the architecture of systems where correctness has direct financial consequences, such as order management, billing, payments, royalties, or revenue systems. * Deep practical experience with consistency in distributed and integrated systems: idempotent processing, deduplication, outbox and event\-driven patterns, reconciliation, and recovery from partial failure. * Experience incrementally improving a production platform while it continues to serve the business, such as moving business logic out of the database or batch jobs, or decomposing and consolidating services. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems (CRM, Finance, tax engines) and with external partners through file\-based and API\-based contracts. * Demonstrated ability to define and drive reliability programs with measurable outcomes, including SLOs, operational metrics, and incident practice. * Preferred: domain experience in publishing, digital content licensing, royalty or rights management, or revenue operations. **Work Authorization and Sponsorship** -------------------------------------- ITHAKA is not currently considering candidates who require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) to work in the United States. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- At ITHAKA we believe in openness and fair pay. Part of living those values is our commitment to clarity about salary ranges, so candidates know what to expect. The starting salary for the lead level position ranges from $129,076 to $161,345 per year and the starting salary for the Principal level position ranges from $148,437 \- $185,547 per year. Starting pay may vary with job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. At present, our total compensation package for benefits\-eligible employees includes medical, dental, and vision plans, an employer\-paid 10% retirement contribution, paid parental and caregiver leave, 22 days of paid time off, 11 paid holidays, up to 12 paid sick days, wellness benefits, and more.
