jobs.title: Head of Deployments
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** --------------- Kastle is building the AI employee for financial services. We work with some of America's largest banks, helping them scale their operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during some of the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below. We just raised a $24M Series A and are growing fast! **About the role** ------------------ Kastle is hiring its first Head of Deployments to build the team that takes our AI agents from signed contract to live production inside banks, lenders and mortgage servicers. Kastle is the AI workforce platform for financial services, starting with consumer lending. Our voice, SMS and workflow agents collect payments, answer borrower questions and qualify loan inquiries, working on top of the systems lenders already run, such as ICE MSP, rather than replacing them. We're a San Francisco team backed by Insight Partners, Y Combinator, Commerce Ventures and Fifth Wall, and we closed a $24M Series A in September 2026\. You'll report to the CEO and own every customer deployment end to end. You'll lead forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and process specialists who embed with lending operations teams, scope workflows, integrate with core systems and get agents into production safely. As we scale across banks and financial institutions globally, you'll turn bespoke rollouts into a repeatable deployment engine. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and scale the deployments org.** Hire, develop and retain forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and lending process specialists. Set the hiring bar and team structure as we grow from a handful of deployments to dozens running at once. * **Own delivery for every customer.** Be accountable for time\-to\-live, quality and adoption at each bank, credit union, lender and servicer. Run kickoffs, scoping, integration, UAT and go\-live, and step in personally on the hardest accounts. * **Make deployments repeatable.** Turn one\-off rollouts into playbooks, reusable integration patterns (servicing cores, LOS, dialers, CRMs) and tooling that cut deployment time with each customer. * **Get compliance right from day one.** Partner with customers' risk, compliance and InfoSec teams on vendor reviews, model risk management and consumer protection rules (TCPA, FDCPA/Reg F, UDAAP) so agents launch safely and audit\-ready. * **Feed the product roadmap.** Turn what you learn in the field into clear product requirements. Work closely with Engineering and Product on what becomes platform versus what stays custom. * **Partner with Sales and Customer Success.** Join late\-stage deals to scope solutions credibly, define clean handoffs from sale to deployment to ongoing success, and help expand accounts after launch. * **Bring operational rigor.** Define engagement models and deployment pricing, plan capacity for a scarce team, track deployment metrics, and report customer outcomes to leadership and in customer QBRs. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 8\+ years in technical, customer\-facing roles, with 4\+ years leading deployment, solutions engineering, professional services or implementation teams * A track record of building a team or service line from early stage and scaling it through rapid growth * Hands\-on experience deploying enterprise software into regulated environments, ideally banks, lenders, mortgage servicers or other financial institutions * Strong technical depth: APIs, system integrations, data pipelines and the SDLC, enough to unblock engineers and earn trust from customer IT teams * Working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents or conversational AI, and sound judgment on where they work in production and where they don't * Commercial instincts: you've scoped and priced services work and supported complex enterprise sales cycles * Clear communicator who can run a room with a bank COO one day and debug an integration with an engineer the next **Nice to have** * Domain knowledge of consumer lending operations: servicing, collections, loss mitigation or originations * Experience with servicing and lending systems such as ICE MSP, Black Knight, Encompass or similar cores * Background with voice or contact\-center technology * Prior early\-stage startup experience We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer - Chillers
jobs.description: Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations. Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions. Our management philosophy, "Jeong\-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer\-Value Creation' and 'People\-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone. **Chiller Application Engineer** **The Opportunity** LG Electronics is seeking a **Chiller Application Engineer** to support the selection, application, and technical sales of LG chillers and heat pumps across the U.S. market. This role serves as a technical expert for customers, consultants, representatives, and internal teams, ensuring equipment selections, system designs, and project applications align with customer requirements and LG product capabilities. Working closely with Sales, Product Management, Factory Engineering, Building Automation, and Service teams, the Chiller Application Engineer will support project execution, product line activities, technical documentation, and customer\-facing engineering support. **Why Join Our Team** Join a growing chiller business and play a key role in bringing innovative cooling and heating solutions to customers across North America. You'll work on complex HVAC projects, collaborate with global engineering teams, and help shape the future of LG's commercial chiller and heat pump offerings. **What You'll Do** * Provide application engineering support for LG chillers and heat pumps, including equipment selection, sizing, and performance analysis. * Evaluate project requirements including loads, operating conditions, flow rates, pressure drop, sound requirements, electrical characteristics, and system configurations. * Develop competitive equipment selections using approved LG software and engineering tools. * Review chilled water, condenser water, heat pump, and hydronic system designs to ensure compatibility with LG equipment requirements. * Support consulting engineers, contractors, owners, and sales teams with technical recommendations and application guidance. * Interpret plans, specifications, codes, and project requirements to prepare submittals, technical responses, compliance matrices, and equipment schedules. * Support building automation integration, including equipment controls, sequencing, BACnet/Modbus communications, and plant operation strategies. * Collaborate with factory engineering, product management, and sales teams to address project\-specific requirements and support product improvements. * Capture customer feedback and market requirements to support product development and future product enhancements. * Review and maintain technical documentation including engineering manuals, installation guides, application guides, catalogs, and product literature. * Support product line activities including new product introductions, engineering changes, feature enhancements, and product lifecycle management. * Develop and deliver technical training, presentations, webinars, and application guidance for customers, sales teams, representatives, and industry partners. * Provide technical support during project handoff, installation, commissioning, and performance investigations. * Analyze field issues and collaborate with service and factory engineering teams to identify root causes and drive resolution. * Travel as needed to support customer meetings, jobsite reviews, training, and product\-related activities. **Job Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 3\+ years of commercial HVAC experience in application engineering, consulting engineering, technical sales support, or chiller system engineering. * Knowledge of refrigeration systems, heat transfer, hydronics, pumps, controls, and variable\-speed HVAC equipment. * Ability to interpret plans, specifications, piping diagrams, sequences of operation, and applicable HVAC codes and standards. * Experience performing engineering calculations and applying technical concepts to commercial HVAC systems. * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, equipment selection software, and engineering documentation tools. * Strong technical writing, presentation, problem\-solving, and project management skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams. * Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with air\-cooled and water\-cooled chillers, air\-to\-water heat pumps, centrifugal chillers, or inverter\-driven compressor technologies. * Experience with chiller plant design, sequencing, building automation systems, energy analysis, or life\-cycle cost evaluations. * Knowledge of ASHRAE, AHRI, and commercial HVAC industry standards. * Experience supporting data centers, mission\-critical facilities, healthcare, higher education, industrial, or large commercial projects. * Experience working with manufacturer engineering teams, product development, technical training, or new product introductions. \#LI\-DB2 **Benefits Offered Full\-Time competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options. * Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of jobs.title: AVP, Full Stack Engineer – AI/GenAI.
jobs.description: ***Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion*** At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees. If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today. **Job Overview:** As an AVP, Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, cloud\-native applications, including solutions that incorporate **AI and Generative AI capabilities**. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, building modern user experiences, APIs, microservices, and AI\-enabled workflows that solve business problems. This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals along with hands\-on experience leveraging **LLMs, AI services, and agentic technologies** within enterprise applications. **Responsibilities**: * Design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications using modern front\-end frameworks such as **React or Angular** and back\-end technologies such as **C\#, Java, or Python**. * Build and integrate **AI/GenAI capabilities** into enterprise applications using LLMs, APIs, AI services, and agentic workflows. * Design and implement **RESTful APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native services**, integrating applications with AI models and enterprise data sources. * Develop solutions utilizing concepts such as **prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, tool/function calling, and AI agents**, where appropriate. * Partner with product owners, architects, business analysts, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical and **AI\-enabled solutions**. * Write clean, secure, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and engineering best practices. * Evaluate and leverage AI\-assisted development tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools** to improve development productivity and code quality. * Troubleshoot application and AI\-integrated production issues, perform root cause analysis, and improve application reliability, performance, and observability. * Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the responsible adoption of emerging AI technologies. **AI \& GenAI Engineering Expectations** * Hands\-on experience integrating **LLMs or Generative AI capabilities into applications**, rather Understanding of **prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases/search, function/tool calling, and agentic AI patterns**. * Ability to develop and integrate AI services through **APIs, SDKs, with AI\-assisted software development tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar platforms**. **What are we looking for?** ---------------------------- We’re looking for strong collaborators We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work. **Requirements:** ----------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum of 7 **years of progressive software engineering experience**, with strong hands\-on full\-stack application development experience. * Strong development experience with a modern front\-end framework such as **React or Angular** and at least one back\-end language such as **C\#, Java, or Python**. * Demonstrated experience designing and developing **APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications**, preferably within AWS. * **Hands\-on experience integrating AI/Generative AI capabilities into software applications**, including experience with LLM APIs/services and familiarity with RAG, prompt engineering, vector search/embeddings, or AI agents. **Core Competencies:** ---------------------- * Experience with **AWS**, including services supporting modern application and AI architectures such as Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, EKS, and related services. * Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases and familiarity with **vector databases or semantic/vector search**. * Experience with **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and DevOps practices**. * Understanding of enterprise AI considerations including **security, privacy, responsible AI, model evaluation, monitoring, and production reliability**. * Financial services experience is preferred. * Experience in the financial services industry is a plus. \*\* This is a **hybrid role**, requiring onsite presence at our **Charlotte/Fort Mill or NYC/Midtown** office **2–3 days per week**, as much of the team and leadership are based there. **Pay Range:** $140,500\.00 \- $234,100\.00### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI
jobs.description: LTK's mission is to empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we're looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry. We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth. **Position Title**: Principal Product Manager, AI **About the role** For more than a decade, LTK has helped shape the creator economy by connecting thousands of creators and brands with millions of consumers. Today, our platform powers more than $6 billion in annual retail sales. Behind that scale is over a decade of commerce data on how people discover products, how creators influence purchasing decisions, and how brands and consumers connect. As **Principal Product Manager, AI,** you'll use that foundation to shape the next generation of creator and agentic commerce. You'll define how AI helps brands find the right creators, turns commerce intelligence into better decisions, and enables agents to work on behalf of customers—always with their goals in mind. Your scope will span LTK's Creator Management Platform (CMP) agent harness and LLM judges, in\-house ML models, and the proprietary knowledge graph connecting our creator, brand, campaign, and marketplace intelligence. This is a deeply technical role and one of LTK's most senior individual contributor product positions, paired directly with our Machine Learning and Data Science team. You'll work together to define model capabilities, shape data and system requirements, establish rigorous evaluations, and make trade\-offs across quality, reliability, latency, and cost. With influence across product strategy, technical direction, and investment decisions, you'll turn LTK's data and relationships into products that change how creators build businesses, brands reach customers, and consumers shop. **How you will make an impact** * **Define the long\-term vision and multi\-quarter AI product strategy** for LTK's proprietary ML models, agent infrastructure, and evaluation systems, including the agent harness for our customer\-facing experiences, LLM judges, and proprietary knowledge graph. * **Work directly with Machine Learning and Data Science teams** to translate customer problems into model capabilities and experiments, and shape the data quality, coverage, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time. Partner with Engineering on model selection, retrieval, tool use, and build\-versus\-buy decisions, balancing quality, reliability, latency, and cost. * **Define how agents understand customer goals and act on their behalf**, including the tools and information they can access, when they need approval, and how customers understand, control, and override their actions. Build privacy, transparency, and appropriate human oversight into these experiences. * **Own product evaluation and launch criteria**, partnering with Machine Learning and Data Science to build representative evaluation datasets, investigate failures, and monitor quality in production across task success, reliability, latency, and cost. * **Raise the bar for AI evaluation across LTK**. Stay close to emerging research and industry guidance on evaluating non\-deterministic experiences, test new approaches, and evolve shared frameworks, tools, and quality standards. Help other PMs build effective evaluations and strengthen launch readiness and production monitoring. * **Partner closely with Product leads across LTK** to identify where AI can deliver the greatest value for creators, brands, and consumers. Translate customer needs into a focused set of opportunities for new models, agent capabilities, and shared infrastructure, then work together to validate their impact and bring them into customer\-facing products. * **Champion responsible AI development,** balancing innovation with reliability, privacy, transparency, and appropriate human oversight. * **Elevate AI\-native product thinking across teams,** influencing senior leaders and helping shape LTK's long\-term AI opportunities. **What you will bring to LTK** * 8\+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex technical products, multi\-quarter strategy, and demonstrated influence on product direction and business outcomes across teams. * Demonstrated experience shipping and improving AI/ML products in production, including LLM applications, AI agents, or model\-backed workflows, with measurable customer adoption and business impact. * Strong technical fluency and experience working directly with ML engineers and applied scientists to define model requirements, guide experiments, and translate results into product decisions. You can point to concrete contributions involving model behavior, system architecture, data quality, reliability, latency, and cost. * Deep expertise in evaluating AI\-powered products, including non\-deterministic model and agent behavior. You've built evaluation frameworks, investigated failure patterns, and helped teams adopt better evaluation practices. You actively follow advances in AI evaluation and can distinguish promising new approaches from those ready for production use. * Hands\-on experience using prototypes, evaluation tools, and data analysis to validate product ideas, diagnose AI behavior, and improve product quality. * Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify valuable AI opportunities, translate complex technical capabilities into intuitive customer experiences, and balance innovation with business priorities and technical constraints. * Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives, influencing strategic product and investment decisions, and building alignment with senior leaders without direct authority. * Understanding of responsible AI product development, including reliability, privacy, safety, transparency, and appropriate human oversight. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * A mindset focused on seizing opportunities and moving with urgency * Dedication to fierce prioritization and operational excellence * Adaptability to a dynamic, fast\-moving environment * A growth mindset and openness to feedback\#LI\-KB1 ### **What we offer for full\-time salaried employees** * The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce * A remote\-first, productivity\-first environment * Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family * 401(k) with LTK company matching * Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance * Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave * Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO * For temporary full\-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary ### **About LTK** Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose\-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full\-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world\-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160\+ countries drive more than $5 billion\+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance\-driven, cross\-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents. ### **Our mission** To empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. ### **Our values** * Here to win * Commit to the journey * Work well ### **Commitment to diversity** LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi\-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture. *For US\-Based Roles: We are not offering new sponsorships opportunities at this time for persons requiring employment visas, such as an H\-1B; authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.* *Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of LTK are considered the property of LTK and are not subject to payment of agency fees*. *LTK is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Quality Engineer 3
jobs.description: Employee Status: Full\-Time Workplace Type: Fully Remote **Who we are:** At LMCU, you'll find more than just a job \- discover a fulfilling career where your contributions truly matter. Join our talented team at Lake Michigan Credit Union and discover the difference an employer who puts people first can make in your career and life. **About this position:** This role is a senior individual contributor accountable for the quality engineering practice on one or more Agile teams. The Quality Engineer III owns the test automation architecture and framework, sets the test strategy for complex or high\-risk work, and drives quality upstream by partnering with engineers and product owners during analysis and design. This role spends a portion of its time improving how quality engineering is done across the organization, including tooling, standards, pipeline design, and the metrics used to judge delivery quality. This role mentors Quality Engineers I and II. **What you’ll do:** * Own and evolve the test automation framework and architecture. Establish patterns, shared libraries, and coding standards for test code. Review test code written by other engineers and hold the suite to a reliability standard that makes a failure meaningful. * Define the test strategy and risk model for complex, cross\-system, or high\-exposure work, including third party integrations and vendor\-delivered software. Decide what gets automated, at what layer, and what is validated another way. * Sit with the development team from analysis and design forward. Perform proactive analysis of the project or task, challenge requirements and architecture for testability and failure modes, and shape acceptance criteria before build begins. * Design and maintain the quality gates in the CI/CD pipeline. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Research Engineer, Pre-Training Data
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Research \& Engineering Overview **About Liquid AI** ------------------- Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general\-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on\-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there. **The Opportunity** ------------------- You'll join the Pre\-Training Data team, which decides what Liquid Foundation Models learn from: which data we source, filter, synthesize, and mix, and in what order. Public data sources are plateauing, so model quality increasingly depends on purpose\-built datasets and on knowing which data changes actually help. We treat data as a research problem, not an infrastructure problem. You'll work alongside our pre\-training researchers on a small team, run the experiments that settle data questions, and build the pipelines that carry the answers into training runs. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We need someone who: * **Thinks like a researcher, ships like an engineer:** You build the pipelines and you make the model\-facing calls about what goes into them. You don't hand off either half. * **Leads with a hypothesis:** Before changing a dataset, you can say what it should do to the model, what you'll measure, and what could fool you, such as contamination or a noisy benchmark. You hold views on pre\-training pitfalls, and you test them. * **Owns problems end to end:** You take ambiguous work from open question to shipped result with little direction or process, do the unglamorous parts that get it there, and don't care whose job it was. **The Work** ------------ * Source web\-scale and public datasets, and build the pipelines that filter, deduplicate, and decontaminate them * Design data mixtures and curricula for pre\-training and midtraining, and decide what goes into each run * Build synthetic data generation systems using LLMs, structured prompting, and distillation to cover what web data can't * Run proxy experiments and ablations to measure what each data change does to model quality, and decide what scales up * Build evaluation sets you can trust, and keep data lineage clear enough that any training run can be traced and reproduced **Experience \& Capabilities** ------------------------------ **What you'll need:** * Deep, hands\-on pre\-training data work you did yourself: web\-scale sourcing and curation, synthetic data generation, mixing and curriculum design, deduplication and decontamination. This is where depth matters most. * The ability to reason from a data decision to its effect on training: how data interacts with model size, architecture, and training dynamics, why more data can hurt, and which changes matter as models scale * Experiments you designed to test data changes, such as baselines, scaling ladders, small\-scale proxies, and held\-out loss, with a clear account of what a change did and why * Production data pipelines you built and owned, not only research prototypes * Solid ML fundamentals: you've trained, evaluated, and iterated on models in Python (PyTorch preferred) * 3\+ years of relevant experience with an M.S., 1\+ year with a Ph.D., or 5\+ years with a B.S. **Helpful, not required:** * Distillation, long\-context, or architecture\-specific data strategy * Designing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for pretrained models * Data work across both pre\-training and post\-training * Small, efficient models or on\-device deployment * Startup experience, or a track record of connecting model work to product needs **What Success Looks Like (Year One)** -------------------------------------- * You own a critical pre\-training data pipeline end to end * Data systems you built or improved have measurably moved model performance * You've identified and integrated at least one external dataset that moved the needle **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Upstream of every model:** Pre\-training data shapes every Liquid Foundation Model. On a small team, the mixtures, filters, and synthetic data you build go straight into the models we ship. * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location. * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company\-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location. * **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

UX designer, and two QA engineers * We work in two\-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team * We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more * Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release * We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment * We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack **In this role, you will:** * Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI * Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices * Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time\-capture partners * Help build, test, and ship our releases * Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with of experience with a typed back\-end language (for example Java, C\#, TypeScript) * Front\-end experience with modern JavaScript, a component framework such as React, and CSS styling * Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales * A habit of writing tests * Daily, hands\-on experience building software with AI coding assistants * An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones **Nice\-to\-have:** * Prior experience developing on Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL), or Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certifications * Experience at a Salesforce ISV, such as releasing managed packages and passing security review * Legal billing knowledge, such as fee arrangements, rates, write\-downs, and LEDES e\-billing * Experience with Accounting Seed or another finance or ERP product * Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries **Where you can grow:** * Learn the Salesforce platform with support from senior engineers * Use professional development funds for courses, conferences, and certifications, including Salesforce certifications * Grow into owning an area of the product, from design through release * Help shape the team's AI practices and grow into leading them * Build toward a senior role jobs.description: **Standard Job Description** ---------------------------- At Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. This is a place for engineers, scientists, and problem\-solvers who are ready to engage deeply, think critically, and build with purpose. You will not just launch a career. You will be part of something bigger. This is where the best are built. **Help ensure mission\-critical software performs when it matters most.** As a Senior Software Test Engineer supporting the Sensor Fusion team, you'll help validate the software that enables advanced aerospace systems to process, fuse, and deliver critical mission data. Your work will play a key role in ensuring high\-quality software is delivered with accuracy, reliability, and confidence. Working alongside software, systems, and integration engineers, you'll analyze requirements, develop comprehensive test strategies, execute software validation activities, and identify opportunities to improve product quality throughout the software development lifecycle. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy problem solving, collaborating across disciplines, and ensuring complex software performs as designed. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Analyze software and system requirements to develop comprehensive test strategies, test cases, and validation plans for Sensor Fusion software. * Execute software verification and validation activities to ensure mission\-critical capabilities meet quality and performance requirements. * Develop and maintain automated and manual test cases using C\+\+ while supporting continuous software integration and delivery.Collaborate with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Integration \& Test teams to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects. * Support Agile software development by participating in test planning, defect tracking, and continuous process improvement activities. * Utilize engineering tools including Linux, GitLab, Jira, and automated testing frameworks to improve software quality and testing efficiency. * Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle by ensuring robust testing, documentation, and delivery of reliable Sensor Fusion capabilities. Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering * Minimum of 2 years of testing experience * Experience coding in C\+\+ * Experience analyzing requirements **Desired Skills** ------------------ * Experience coding in C\# or Python * Experience working in Agile teams * Experience with Linux operating systems * Experience with Jira and GitLab * F\-35 Program access **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $81100\.00 \- $150500\.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well\-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. **Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10\), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability. * Annual short\-term and/or long\-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. * For (Washington state applicants only) Non\-represented full\-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6\.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Ground Software Engineer - Core
jobs.description: **Wanna join the adventure?** Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Core team within Ground Platform. The team develops the core capabilities that support Loft's ground platform, improve development workflows, and ensure platform reliability. You'll help build shared services and tools that benefit software teams across Loft. You'll work on backend services, workflow automation, AI tooling, and platform infrastructure, with a focus on observability and reliability. You'll also have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, helping investigate anomalies and supporting real\-time incident response when needed. If you're excited about improving how software is developed across Loft, contributing to key technical decisions, and building more reliable platform systems, we'd love to hear from you. ### **About this role:** * **Evaluate and implement new technologies and software patterns** that propagate to the entire Loft's software stack * **Lead the creation and evolution of Loft's AI tooling** for development, review, and spacecraft anomaly investigation * **Develop central ground platform functionalities** such as workflow automation, microservice inter\-communication, and metrics * **Take responsibility for the reliability and performance of Loft's ground platform infrastructure**, including message queues, CI/CD, and observability * **Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations** through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies and supporting real‑time incident response when needed * **Collaborate with software engineers and satellite operators from all over the company** to support and foster consistent, maintainable, and performant software solutions ### **Must Haves:** * Solid backend software development experience * Hands\-on knowledge of deployment and Infrastructure as Code * Ability to define and maintain CI/CD pipelines * Experience working with Kubernetes ### **Nice to Haves:** * Python development, particularly with Django * Knowledge of GraphQL and Graphene * Experience with message queues and streaming technologies (NATS) * Knowledge of DevOps and observability tools (Helm, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, etc) * Familiarity with AI tooling * Frontend development with Vue and Web Components ### **Some of Our Awesome Benefits:** * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents * Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA * 100% employer paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks * International exposure to our team in France * Fully paid parental leave; 14 weeks for primary caregiver and 10 weeks for secondary caregiver * Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family\-forming benefits with financial support * Off\-sites and many social events and celebrations * Relocation assistance when applicable $150,000 \- $195,000 a year State law requires us to tell you the base compensation range for this role, which is $140,000\- $190,000 per year. This is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. The salary range for this role is intentionally wide as we evaluate individuals based on their unique experience and abilities to fit our needs. Most importantly, we are excited to meet you, and see if you are a great fit for our team. What we *can’t* quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy. *\***Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.* **Who We Are** Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end\-to\-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on\-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years\-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA \| Golden, CO \| and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. *As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: OSP Construction Project Engineer

Working closely with cross\-functional teams and contractor partners, you'll help keep projects moving from field readiness through closeout while ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency every step of the way. Through T\-Fiber, our joint venture with T\-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high\-speed internet in the communities we serve. Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions\-oriented, and ready to build what's next. **What You'll Do:** * Own multiple OSP builds across the market from construction readiness through closeout. * Set clear expectations for contractors and subcontractors, holding teams accountable for safety, quality, schedule, and budget. * Track production, schedules, costs, risks, and field progress, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, timely updates. * Inspect active jobsites and ensure work meets OSHA, NESC, Lumos, and applicable construction standards. * Coordinate permitting, materials, utilities, municipalities, and other field dependencies that keep construction moving. * Resolve field roadblocks and community concerns quickly, professionally, and with sound judgment. * Partner across Engineering, Operations, Permitting, and Supply Chain to improve how Lumos plans, builds, and scales. **What You'll Bring:** * High school diploma or equivalent. * 5\+ years of experience in OSP construction, telecommunications engineering, network deployment, or related field operations. * Strong knowledge of aerial, underground, and buried fiber construction, including OSHA and NESC requirements. * Experience managing contractors and several active construction projects at the same time. * Strong project management, problem\-solving, communication, and relationship\-building skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office. * Valid, unrestricted driver's license and ability to travel throughout the market; jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Luna Innovations, we measure and manage light in optical fiber. Our Optics/Polarization product line, based in Chino, CA, specializes in industry\-leading components, modules, and test equipment for the characterization and control of optical polarization. Our instruments, ranging from dynamic optical delay/phase management and high\-speed polarization state management to full\-function polarization light analyzers, are critical for optical communications, silicon photonics testing, and fiber optic sensing. At Luna, you will work with some of the most curious, forward\-thinking engineers and scientists in the industry to shape the future of fiber optic measurement. **Role Overview** We are seeking a Software Engineer II, with flexibility to hire at the Senior level for the right candidate, to join the software development team for our photonics instrumentation. Final level and pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications. You will build the applications that control precision optical instruments, process high\-speed measurement data, and visualize complex optical behavior in real time. You will develop software for Linux and Windows platforms, including embedded Linux devices, and support the remote control interfaces customers use to integrate our instruments into their own test systems. If you are passionate about hardware\-software integration and want to build the software behind state\-of\-the\-art optical test equipment, we want you on our team. **Key Responsibilities** * **Application Development:** Design, develop, and maintain reliable C/C\+\+ and Python applications for Linux and Windows, including user\-facing applications and GUIs. * **Software Architecture:** Design maintainable, modular software components and interfaces for hardware\-integrated products; evaluate performance, reliability, and lifecycle trade\-offs. * **Embedded Linux:** Develop and integrate software on embedded and headless Linux platforms, including cross\-compilation and system integration. * **Software Infrastructure \& Lifecycle:** Improve build and release processes, automated testing, packaging, deployment, Linux updates, security patch management, and long\-term maintenance. * **Remote Control \& SDKs:** Develop and support APIs, SDKs, and remote control interfaces that enable customers to integrate our instruments into automated manufacturing and test systems. * **Software Quality \& Documentation:** Apply code review, testing, debugging, validation, versioning, and technical documentation practices throughout development and release. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with optical, electrical, firmware, and systems engineers, as well as manufacturing and support teams, to define instrument capabilities, troubleshoot prototypes, and bring new products to market. **Required Qualifications: Software Engineer II** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Python. * Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining software on Linux. * Experience with multithreading, memory management, and optimizing code for performance. * Experience with Git/GitHub workflows, version control, collaborative development, and code review. * Familiarity with software build systems, debugging tools, unit testing, and validation. * Strong analytical troubleshooting skills and ability to work across software/hardware boundaries. * Effective technical communication and documentation skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented, Agile environment. **Additional Required Qualifications: Senior Software Engineer** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Demonstrated ability to design and maintain complex C/C\+\+ software systems. * Experience designing software architecture for embedded, hardware\-integrated, or other equipment products. * Experience setting up or owning build, test, and release processes for a software product. * Strong Linux development experience, including system\-level debugging and deployment. * Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: cross\-compilation and system integration; embedded Linux platforms, BSPs, or SDKs; or Linux platform lifecyclemaintenance. * Ability to own complex technical problems, lead design decisions, and mentor engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Yocto Project, Buildroot, toolchains, root filesystem customization, or reproducible embedded Linux builds. * Experience with secure software update and deployment systems, rollback/recovery, and remote device or fleet management. * Experience with Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, or upstream patch integration. * Experience with instrument communication protocols and interfaces. * Experience developing lightweight web\-based GUIs and web server applications for embedded Linux or network\-connected devices. * Experience building GUIs for scientific or test and measurement equipment; Qt experience a plus. * Experience implementing numerical computing, signal processing, or control algorithms. * Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Luna is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Network Technician
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. **Job Overview** ---------------- The Network Technician is responsible for supporting the physical\-layer network infrastructure within hyperscale AI and accelerated computing data center environments. This role focuses on deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of structured cabling systems, fiber plant infrastructure, optics, network hardware, out\-of\-band (OOB) management networks, and console connectivity systems. The Network Technician serves as the primary onsite resource for physical network operations, ensuring the reliability and integrity of the network infrastructure supporting mission\-critical computing environments. The role works closely with customer network engineering teams, data center operations personnel, OEM partners, and deployment teams to support network expansion, break\-fix activities, and operational readiness. This position requires strong technical discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to execute customer\-directed activities within highly controlled operational environments. How You Will Make an Impact Fiber Plant Operations * Install, route, label, and maintain fiber optic infrastructure supporting production and non\-production environments. * Support MPO/MTP trunk deployments, patching, and remediation activities. * Perform fiber testing, certification, and validation using approved testing methodologies and equipment. * Troubleshoot physical\-layer connectivity issues and support fault isolation efforts. * Verify compliance with bend radius, cable routing, and fiber management standards. * Support contamination prevention programs, fiber inspection, and connector cleaning procedures. Structured Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure * Install, route, terminate, label, and document structured copper and fiber cabling systems. * Support deployment and expansion activities for new racks, pods, and network infrastructure. * Validate cabling installations against customer standards, floor plans, and port maps. * Conduct physical audits and quality inspections of deployed network infrastructure. * Maintain cable management systems and infrastructure documentation. Network Hardware Support * Install, replace, and validate network hardware components, including: * Optics and transceivers * Network switches * Console servers * OOB management devices * Patch panels and associated infrastructure * Support directed hardware replacement and maintenance activities. * Assist customer network engineers with troubleshooting and restoration efforts. * Participate in hardware acceptance testing and operational readiness activities. OOB \& Console Infrastructure * Support Out\-of\-Band (OOB) management networks and console connectivity infrastructure. * Install and maintain console cabling and access systems. * Verify console connectivity and operational readiness. * Assist with troubleshooting console access and management network issues. * Support customer\-directed changes within OOB environments. Network Deployment \& Expansion * Support deployment of network infrastructure associated with new site launches, hall expansions, and capacity growth initiatives. * Execute physical\-layer tasks associated with network turn\-up activities. * Participate in deployment readiness reviews and acceptance tes ding physical network infrastructure best practices. * Support onboarding and training activities for operational personnel. * Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on network reliability and deployment quality. * Demonstrate professionalism and customer\-focused communication skills. Minimum Qualifications * High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years of experience supporting structured cabling, network deployment, or data center infrastructure environments. * Experience installing and troubleshooting fiber optic and copper cabling systems. * Familiarity with optics, transceivers, and physical\-layer networking concepts. * Ability to read deployment documentation, rack elevations, floor plans, and network diagrams. * Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, AI, HPC, or enterprise data center environments. * Experience with MPO/MTP infrastructure, fiber certification, and network testing methodologies. * Familiarity with leaf\-spine network architectures and large\-scale data center deployments. * Experience supporting OOB management networks and console infrastructure. * Knowledge of structured cabling standards and industry best practices. * Experience working within 24x7 mission\-critical operational environments. * Vendor certifications such as BICSI, FOA, Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or equivalent are preferred. * Experience supporting commissioning, deployment, and expansion activities. Physical Requirements * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods within active data center environments. * Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Ability to work in confined spaces, overhead cable pathways, and rack environments. * Ability to distinguish cable labeling, connector types, and color\-coded infrastructure. * Ability to safely use ladders and perform elevated work activities when required. Work Environment This position operates within a mission\-critical data center environment supporting advanced AI and accelerated computing infrastructure. Work includes fiber plant operations, structured cabling deployment, optics replacement, network infrastructure support, OOB connectivity management, and deployment activities supporting highly available computing environments. The Network Technician plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and scalability of the physical network infrastructure that enables customer production operations. **Compensation** ---------------- Estimated Pay Range: 49\.43 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. **Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** -------------------------------------------- *At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.* *Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.* *We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Position:** ***DevOps Engineer*** The **DevOps Engineer**’s roles and responsibilities are multifaceted, requiring technical agility and operations mindset simultaneously. It is essential to have communication and coordination skills to successfully integrate various functions in a coordinated manner and deliver the responsibilities to the company’s needs. #### **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to deploy notebooks, jobs, and workflows to Azure Databricks. * Integrate Databricks Repos with Azure Repos (Git) for source control of PySpark/R notebooks. * Automate job runs in Databricks using Databricks CLI, REST API, or DevOps tasks. * Maintain infrastructure\-as\-code practices (e.g., using Terraform). * Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline failures, notebook issues, and deployment inconsistencies. * Collaborate with Data Engineers and Platform teams to maintain development, staging, and production environments. * Implement best practices for version control, testing, and notebook promotion in a multi\-environment setup. * Store and manage Databricks secrets, tokens, and configuration securely within Azure Key Vault and DevOps variable groups. * Understand and apply DevOps practices in a data platform context. #### **Position Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum of three (3\) years of experience in DevOps engineering or a related role, with a focus on Microsoft Azure, including other cloud\-based data integration and associated technologies. * Proficiency with data analytics and AI platforms and automating notebook execution. * Proficiency in scripting languages for automation and various programming. #### **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $138,000 to $182,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location and job\-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and internal compensation considerations. While a larger range is posted, most offers will typically fall within a narrower band based on these factors. #### **Benefits** * **Comprehensive Benefits** \- Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer\-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts * **Financial \& Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources * **Time Off \& Leave** – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave * **Wellness \& Growth** – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts #### **About Monogram Health** Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in\-home, evidence\-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present \- such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders. Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home. Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Technology Support Specialist
jobs.description: Morgan, Lewis \& Bockius LLP, one of the world’s leading global law firms with offices in strategic hubs of commerce, law, and government across North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, is seeking a Technology Support Specialist I to provide support for computer and/or audiovisual hardware of a basic to moderate nature to ensure end\-user productivity and efficiency. Reporting to our Senior IT Manager, the Technology Support Specialist will use basic troubleshooting techniques in order to provide accurate, timely and creative resolutions to hardware\-related issues and some software\-related issues. The Technology Support Specialist I serves as a liaison between hardware engineers within IT (including the Help Desk) and the end user community. This position will reside in the New York office and will work a daily schedule of 9:00 am – 5:30 pm EST. **Primary Functions and Responsibilities** **End\-user Support** **(Basic)** * Responds to end\-user hardware requests and performs restorative actions to resolve problems. * Properly logs all requests, issues and their resolutions. * Properly escalates critical issues to other local\-team members or to Firm IT for level\-3 support. * Researches and locates available tools and processes to identify and avert troublesome trends as they develop. * Responds to situations where standard procedures failed with hardware installations or upgrades. * Actively participates (with testing and documentation) in software pre\-pilots, pilots and roll\-outs. * Provides status reports to and communicates with the manager. Provides support for audiovisual and video conferencing systems and meetings. * **Administrative and Operations Responsibilities** * Unpacks, sets up, tests and installs all new equipment received by the local office. * Tracks the type of equipment, the location of equipment and to whom the equipment is allocated. * Performs all initial diagnoses of reported hardware errors to determine nature, possible cause and recommended course of action. * Where possible, performs maintenance or recovery procedures to correct reported hardware errors. * Contacts third\-party maintenance personnel, when necessary, to service diagnosed hardware errors that cannot be resolved in\-house. Performs standard preventive maintenance on specified equipment. * **Experience/Qualifications:** * Associate’s degree (A.A.) in a related field and minimum one year experience in hardware and basic software support at a professional services organization or equivalent combination of experience and education. * Strong customer service orientation, technical skills and interpersonal skills are required. Working knowledge of office productivity software, the Microsoft operating system, and/or audiovisual technologies. * Qualified candidates must apply online by visiting our website at www.morganlewis.com and selecting “Careers.” \#LI\-TS1 The base salary or hourly wage range for this position will be determined during the interview process and will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to prior experience, relevant expertise, current business needs, and market factors. The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances. Additionally, salary or hourly wages may be only part of the total compensation package. The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, the employee will be in an "at\-will position" and the firm reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, firm or individual department/team performance, and market factors. For positions in New York, New York, the salary range for this job posting is: $67,400\.00 to $107,825\.00\. Morgan, Lewis \& Bockius LLP is committed to equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. We value inclusion and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Monitoring
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Staff Software Engineer on the Equipment Monitoring team, you will build the backend systems that give fleets unmatched visibility into the location, utilization, and health of their equipment \- trailers, reefers, construction machinery, and small assets. Our data comes from IoT devices in the field: Asset Gateways, BLE environmental and door sensors, and Beacons. You will design and operate the ingestion and stream\-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink) that turn this raw sensor telemetry into accurate real\-time locations, geofence events, trips, and alerts. You will collaborate closely with our Embedded/firmware and IoT teams on device payloads and end\-to\-end data flows, making this a great role for engineers who enjoy working near the hardware while building cloud services at scale. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Develop **highly observable, reliable, and scalable** backend services that process telemetry from hundreds of thousands of IoT devices (sensors, beacons, asset gateways). * Build and operate **stream\-processing pipelines** (Kafka, Flink) powering geo\-fencing, alerting, trip construction, and asset location. * **Design, build, and maintain scalable APIs** for both internal and external applications. * **Collaborate with Embedded, IoT, and cross\-functional teams** on device data contracts and end\-to\-end feature delivery. * **Champion engineering excellence** by proactively reducing technical debt and improving code quality. * Leverage AI tools such as Cursor, CoPilot to increase productivity and code quality. * Actively work on our AWS Cloud infrastructure, and **mentor and learn** from other engineers to foster a culture of continuous growth. **What We're Looking For:** --------------------------- * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or related field * 5\+ years software development experience * Experience building distributed systems and event\-driven/stream\-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink, Kinesis or similar) * Experience in modern programming languages. Proficiency in Ruby, Golang, Kotlin/Java is a plus. * Experience with Relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, and Cassandra * Experience building for Cloud Infrastructure such as AWS, GCP, Azure or private clouds * Experience with IoT/sensor data or geospatial systems (geofencing, location) is a plus * Ownership and Problem Solving mindset * **Hybrid in the office two days a week** ***Pay Transparency*** *Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting* *Motive Perks \& Benefits**.* *The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the compensation range is:* United States $164,000 \- $200,000 USD *Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.* *Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice* *here**.* *UK Candidate Privacy Notice* *here**.* *The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations.* *It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.* *Regarding US\-based roles, depending on your role and primary work location, Motive Technologies, Inc. (“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non\-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.* *Non\-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.* *All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new\-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.*
