jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Neo.Tax helps companies automate complex tax and accounting workflows by connecting data across project management, payroll, identity, and financial systems. We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer to help prospective and existing customers understand how Neo.Tax can solve their problems and fit into their technical environments. This is a founding role—you will be the first solutions engineer ever hired at Neo.Tax! You’ll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to lead technical discovery, design credible solutions, deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept, build customer\-specific integrations, and guide technical evaluations toward successful adoption. You’ll translate customer workflows and constraints into clear solution plans, communicate trade\-offs honestly, and bring recurring needs back to the product team. This is a customer\-facing engineering role. You’re responsible for meeting customer needs, which often means building beyond demos and proofs of concept. When a customer needs something the product doesn’t support yet, you’ll build it at the integration boundary of our product (authentication, data ingestion, and connections to customer systems), and that work may ship to production. Product Engineering owns the product, including that boundary, and partners with you on reviews, handoffs, and longer\-term improvements. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers: understand their workflows, systems, goals, constraints, and evaluation criteria. * Deliver tailored product demos and technical walkthroughs that connect Neo.Tax capabilities to customer outcomes. * Design and explain solution architectures, data flows, and integration approaches across systems such as project management, code repositories, HRIS, payroll, ERP, and data warehouses. * Validate technical feasibility, data readiness, access requirements, and security or networking constraints; surface risks and dependencies early. * Build demos, prototypes, and proofs of concept to show value and de\-risk evaluations. * Build customer\-specific integrations at the edge of our product, including authentication and data ingestion. Work directly with customers to deliver solutions that meet their immediate needs and can operate reliably, then partner with Product Engineering on handoffs and longer\-term improvements. * Partner with Sales to qualify technical fit, scope proposed solutions, respond to technical questions, and set clear expectations. * Support customer technical evaluations, including architecture reviews, security and IT diligence, and implementation planning. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues with the integrations you’ve built, in partnership with Product Engineering. * Hand off to Product Engineering when customer\-specific work should become part of the core product, and partner with Customer Success to support adoption. * Share customer feedback and recurring requirements with Product and Engineering, helping distinguish one\-off requests from opportunities for reusable product capabilities. * Create and improve reusable demo assets, reference architectures, technical documentation, and playbooks. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- ### **Technical and solution\-design skills** * Experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, technical consulting, implementation, or another customer\-facing technical role. * Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to reason about APIs, integrations, data flows, and enterprise software environments. * Comfort working with data\-heavy workflows and evaluating data quality, mapping, and integration requirements; strong SQL (we use Postgres on Neon) and proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js. Experience with NestJS or React is a plus. * Ability to assess technical feasibility and explain architecture, security, and implementation trade\-offs without overpromising. * Production software engineering experience: you’ve written, shipped, and supported code that customers or other teams depend on. You can build a focused demo or proof of concept, and you can also build the version that runs in production. * Hands\-on experience building integrations with third\-party systems, including authentication (OAuth, SSO/SAML, API keys, service accounts) and large\-volume data ingestion (pagination, rate limits, incremental sync, retries, validation). ### **Customer\-facing and problem\-solving skills** * Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong discovery skills: you ask focused questions, clarify what success means, and turn ambiguous needs into a practical solution plan. * Product sense and judgment to identify when a customer request is specific to one account versus representative of a broader need. * High ownership, sound follow\-through, and comfort managing multiple evaluations and stakeholders. * Empathy fo er engagements (frequency TBD). **Compensation \& benefits** ---------------------------- * Salary range: $170,000–$190,000 * Stock Option Plan (5–10 bps of equity) * Health Care Plans (Medical, Dental, Vision, Short\-term Disability) + 90% coverage for individual \+ family * Health \& Wellness subsidy * Retirement Plan (401k) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Work From Home (100% remote team) **Additional Details** ---------------------- Still interested? Here’s more about the opportunity and how this role can make an impact. ### **Why Join Now** * **A pivotal growth stage:** Join as Neo.Tax scales its enterprise business and builds repeatable ways to support complex customer evaluations. * **Meaningful customer impact:** Help companies modernize costly, manual tax and accounting workflows with software and AI. * **Enterprise customer exposure:** Work with customers including Adobe, Block, Capital One, Mercury, Whoop, and Thomson Reuters. * **Small team, big ownership:** Shape how we qualify technical fit, demonstrate value, build the integrations that connect customers to Neo.Tax, and carry customer insight back into the product. * **Greenfield opportunity:** This is a founding role—you will be the first solutions engineer ever hired at Neo.Tax! Help develop the demos, proof points, and solution patterns. ### **Who You Are** * **Ownership\-oriented:** You keep evaluations moving, follow through on commitments, and make the next step clear. * **A proactive communicator:** You summarize what you heard, surface risks early, and ask clarifying questions instead of making assumptions. * **Customer\- and business\-aware:** You connect technical choices to customer outcomes and commercial priorities. * **Pragmatic:** You explain trade\-offs and recommend a workable path rather than defaulting to a perfect\-on\-paper solution. * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You can learn a customer’s environment quickly and make progress without a complete spec. ### **What It’s Like to Work Here** * You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, with a direct line from customer conversations to product feedback and go\-to\-market improvements. * We’re remote\-first and prefer time zones that can overlap with our San Francisco, CA headquarters. Key customer engagements may occasionally require travel. * We actively experiment with AI tools and workflows; we value using them to accelerate thoughtful work, not as a substitute for technical judgment. * A typical day may include preparing a tailored demo, leading technical discovery, building or debugging a customer integration, documenting risks and next steps, and sharing recurring customer feedback with the team. ### **What Success Looks Like in 90 Days** * You understand Neo.Tax’s product, customer workflows, and the technical patterns that commonly come up in evaluations. * You can independently lead discovery and tailored demos for common use cases, clearly explaining fit, requirements, and limitations. * You’ve built or improved reusable demo assets, proof\-of\-concept approaches, or reference materials that help customers evaluate value and feasibility. * You’ve established strong working relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering and provide clear, actionable customer feedback. * You’ve built at least one customer\-specific integration that’s running in production. ### **Who Should Not Apply** * People who want a purely internal engineering role and do not enjoy regular customer interaction. * People who need fully specified requirements before they can make progress. * People who overpromise, avoid surfacing risks, or struggle to explain technical trade\-offs clearly. * People who treat every customer request as a one\-off build instead of looking for repeatable product or solution patterns. * People who don’t want to write and support production code. Compensation Range: $170K \- $190K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Performance
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. Join us at NVIDIA and be part of a team that’s crafting the future of technology! Our dedication to innovation and excellence has made us a leader in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. As we delve into the limitless opportunities that AI brings, we are looking for passionate individuals to help us push boundaries and redefine what's possible. NVIDIA is seeking a dedicated Software Engineer, ML Performance to join our team in Santa Clara, CA. In this role, you will engage directly with the latest AI technologies and work on optimizing performance at an outstanding scale. Your expertise will ensure that our groundbreaking solutions operate flawlessly and continue to lead the industry. **What you’ll be doing:** * Analyze the performance of distributed training and inference workloads throughout the entire stack: model and framework, data loading and checkpointing, compiler and kernels, CUDA and NCCL, host and network. Identify the bottleneck, resolve it or suggest a solution, and provide the supporting evidence. * Define the performance metrics tracked across a fleet of GPUs. Break them down into factors engineers need to debug. Decide which signals the platform collects first. * Drive the analysis of regressions: segment workloads across machines, versions, and configurations to isolate the cause, and turn the method into analysis others can reuse. * Evaluate automated diagnoses: judge whether a finding is accurate, identify misleading results and missed problems, and build the labeled cases that keep the analysis honest. Work closely with build partners on their real workloads, carry findings through to improvements, and feed what the product is missing back into the roadmap. * **What we need to see:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including hands\-on optimization of GPU training or inference workloads in production. * Demonstrated performance work across more than one layer of the stack, with a clear account of the baseline, evidence, alternative explanations and validated outcome. * Experience diagnosing performance across many jobs, machines or tenants, not only tuning a single workload. * Enough familiarity with framework, runtime and compiler interfaces to say where a signal should be measured, even when someone else writes the instrumentation. * Ability to distinguish symptoms from causes, recognize noisy or incomplete measurements and the effects of the measurement itself, and know when the evidence is insufficient. * Strong programming and debugging skills, demonstrated by maintainable analysis code, tests or repeatable investigation procedures, including when using automated development tools. * Clear communication of findings, trade\-offs and remaining uncertainty to the people who own the workload. Proficiency with Python and CUDA. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Improved operation of both training and inference. * Deep knowledge of one or more of PyTorch, JAX, Megatron, NCCL, TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, SGLang or Dynamo. * Experience moving between application, system software, driver or hardware roles, and the full\-stack view that comes with it. * Statistical judgment applied to noisy, multi\-node fleet\-scale performance data. Ideally, experience with counter\-factual analysis and segmentation of workloads for diagnosing regressions. Built debugging or performance\-analysis tools used by other engineers, with evidence that they made investigations more effective. * Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. jobs.title: Full stack Developer
jobs.description: **Location: Remote \| Type: Contract** **About Newpage Solutions** Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real\-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human\-centered practices. We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives. **Your Mission** We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in. You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end\-to\-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder\-first individual\-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python. **What You’ll Do** **Problem / Opportunity Discovery** * Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable. * Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week. * Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships. * Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision. * Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques. ### **Build (fast) with AI** * When the brief is clear, head down and produce. * Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain\-driven design. * Create full stack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, Fast API, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono. * Architect and ship production\-grade agentic applications using Lang Graph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer. * Integrate frontier and self\-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open\-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors. * Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with Elasticsearch or Solr, and BM25 \+ similarity search. * Work across relational, document, key\-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event\-driven patterns where they fit, not by default. * Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub\-agents—with discipline and review. * Fine\-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it. ### **Test, Deploy, Productionize** * Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users. * Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless—chosen for fit, not preference. * Treat evals as a first\-class discipline: hands\-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear\-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short. * Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). * Own what you build end\-to\-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running. * Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices. **What You Bring** * 3\+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches—full stack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more. * Hands\-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi\-step using Lang Graph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration. * Active, structured use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub\-agents, skills, and innovative approaches. * Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12\-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, Fast API services, and similar. * End\-to\-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses. * Cloud\-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel—with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. * A no\-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost. * A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave—and where they break—and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost. * Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them. * A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions. * A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high\-impact technical challenges. * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. **Bonus Skills / Experience** ----------------------------- * Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI. * MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker). * Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue). * Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure. * AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications. **What We Offer** At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer: * A people\-first culture \- Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging * Smart, purposeful collaboration \- Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges * Balance that lasts \- We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life * Room to grow \- Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you * Meaningful rewards \- Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential **Ready to Apply?** Let’s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to: *shilpa.shetty@newpage.io* #### **More about Newpage** Newpage is a digital health solutions company. We devote ourselves to advancing the quality of life by enhancing health and optimizing the longevity of people. We do this by, passionately building futuristic technologies for global organizations across the healthcare ecosystem. We partake at every stage from problem definition, strategy \& service design, user research, UX design, and agile software development – utilizing lean practices to deliver and validate highly innovative digital health solutions that drive user value and business transformation. Newpage is recognized by ‘CIO’s Review’ as “Top 50 Promising Healthcare Solution Providers” and Great Place to Work Certified (GPTW) 2023 \& 2024\.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99\.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI\-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. **About the Role** You’ll join a small infrastructure team with broad, shared ownership — the engineers who keep Niantic Spatial running. The team covers the cloud platform, the developer tooling every engineer depends on, and the edge services our customers’ requests pass through. You’ll work across SRE, infrastructure, and developer platform alongside teammates who know the stack well, and you’ll grow into owning parts of it yourself. Because every engineer here builds on what this team provides, your work will also shape how the whole engineering org builds, ships, and operates. **What You'll Do** * **Cloud and SRE:** Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code, and help improve reliability through monitoring, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * **Developer Platform:** Help run our source control, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure so engineers can ship quickly and safely. * **Production Operations:** Share on\-call, take part in incident response and follow\-up, and automate away repetitive operational work. * **Edge and Delivery:** Help run the edge API gateway, CDN, and authentication and authorization systems with the rest of the team. * **Compute and GPU Management:** Help provision and monitor compute and GPU capacity across teams. * **AI\-Assisted Operations:** Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. **What You'll Bring** * **Years of Experience:** 3\+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. * **Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with GCP, AWS, or another major cloud provider in production. * **CI/CD:** Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar. * **Containers:** Production experience with containers and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes. * **Core Technical Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C\+\+, plus shell scripting and Linux systems. * **AI in Your Workflow:** Comfort using AI\-assisted tools in your engineering work, or a strong interest in building that habit. We’ll help you ramp up on how we use AI here. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with API gateways, load balancers, or CDNs. * Familiarity with modern authentication and authorization, such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, or cloud IAM. * Experience with GPU workloads or ML infrastructure. * Experience with message queuing systems. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco or Sunnyvale, CA office, or in Bellevue, WA. We work in a high\-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on\-site a minimum of 3 days per week. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $230,000 for Bay Area candidates and $162,500 \- $218,500 for Seattle/Bellevue candidates. Actual salary is based on assessed skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity, bonus, and benefits. Your recruiter can answer questions about total compensation during the hiring process. **Inclusive Application** We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. **Equal Opportunity** Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process. **Candidate Privacy** I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice. reliability and scalability through robust testing, observability, incident response, and performance tuning. * Drive software engineering best practices across the team by producing high\-quality, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 1\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong self learning and improvement mindset. * Strong proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Rust, Python, C\+\+. * Strong fundamentals in backend services, distributed systems, data modeling, and API design. * Demonstrated experience designing scalable systems and leading complex technical projects. * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams. **Nice to have** * Experience observability stack like OpenTelemetry. * Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and production. * Experience building internal developer platforms, tooling, or workflow systems. * Exposure to automation environments such as warehousing, manufacturing, or logistics. **Compensation** The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $150,000 \- process efficiency, and quality\-system usability. ***This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in our office in Oakmont, PA, with a minimum of three days onsite per week, or more depending on business needs.*** ### **Responsibilities** * Own and continuously improve Product Lifecycle Management and Product document\-control processes, including workflows, templates, approval structures, configuration management, and change control * Serve as the Product team's PLM/eQMS subject\-matter expert, supporting system administration, workflow configuration, troubleshooting, user adoption, and continuous improvement * Develop, maintain, and improve QMS documentation supporting Product activities, including Design History Files (DHF), Bills of Materials (BOMs), SOPs, forms, templates, and related product records * Ensure product records are accurate, complete, appropriately controlled, and maintained in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulatory requirements * Manage document version control, review, approval, release, implementation, and archival activities * Administer Document Change Order (DCO) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes, ensuring jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** **About the Khoury College of Computer Sciences** Khoury College is committed to building a community of belonging among students, faculty and staff. We strongly encourage applicants from individuals with disabilities, veterans, and those with varied experiences and backgrounds. We invite you to join a fast\-moving, ambitious college with an underlying mission that is driven by our motto of “CS for Everyone.” **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- The Security and Privacy Heterogeneous Environment for Reproducible Experimentation (SPHERE) is a newly funded National Science Foundation (NSF) mid\-scale research infrastructure being built by the University of Southern California Information Sciences Institute and Northeastern University’s Khoury College of Computer Sciences. This research infrastructure will offer access to an unprecedented variety of hardware, software, and other resources relevant to cybersecurity and privacy research. These resources will be connected by a user\-configurable network substrate and protected by security policies uniquely aligned with cybersecurity and privacy research needs. The Research Engineer will help build this innovative cyberinfrastructure. The portion of SPHERE being developed at Northeastern University will focus on Internet of Things (IoT) device experimentation. The primary goal is to create the world’s largest remotely accessible IoT testbed, composed of dozens of samples of IoT devices across several categories and manufacturers, including smart speakers, smart televisions, and smart cameras. In addition to hosting IoT devices, the SPHERE IoT testbed will provide programming interfaces for interacting with devices through all available modalities, including physical access, companion application access, and voice access. These interfaces will be remotely accessible, allowing users worldwide to interact with devices and conduct experiments without purchasing devices or building their own infrastructure. The IoT testbed will be complemented by tools for capturing network traffic produced by the devices, securely storing data, integrating with the broader SPHERE research infrastructure, and streamlining automated and repeatable experiments at scale. This is a unique opportunity to join a vibrant team and conduct groundbreaking research supporting scalable, large\-scale virtual access to diverse IoT hardware. This is a research position and is on\-site at the Boston campus. Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education, and skills when extending an offer. Northeastern University provides a comprehensive benefits package for benefits\-eligible employees, including medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness and life benefits, retirement benefits, and commuting and transportation benefits. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Design
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations. Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI\-assisted solutions and 30\+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other. The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it. This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- **NuBrain** — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30\+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful. **New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale**. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally. **Canonicalizing what already exists.** Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds. **Deciding the shape of the answer.** Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones. * Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable. * Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function. * Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow\-up. * Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you. * Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade\-offs legible to people who don't read code. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer.** This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges. **A track record architecting UX systems.** Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front\-end infrastructure used by many teams. **A love for design that shows up in your work.** Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them. **Agentic systems that help design scale.** Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role. **A protagonist.** You'll serve a 260\-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project. **Evidence you've shipped.** Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio. ### **Backgrounds that tend to fit** * Design systems and UI platform engineers at design\-led product companies. * Engineers at design tooling companies. * Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public. * Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design\-led product. ### **What this role is not** * Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar. * Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core. * Not customer\-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function. * Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.) Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. We’re hiring a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead high\-impact, cross\-functional programs that directly support company OKRs and strategic priorities. This is a principal\-level individual contributor role and one of the most senior TPM positions at OpenLoop. You will help set direction for how OpenLoop plans, prioritizes, and delivers its most complex, multi\-team programs, translating business vision into structured, executable technical programs. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders, run Agile delivery across engineering teams, and make sure every initiative is tied to measurable outcomes. You will help lead the build\-out of the TPM function at OpenLoop in standardizing Agile and practices, defining reporting cadences, and providing delivery metrics that improve how teams plan and ship. You will act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, presenting in stakeholder and leadership meetings with C\-level visibility and meaningful ownership. You will connect engineering and product with the rest of the business so that priorities move forward predictably. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own and drive execution of complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives tied directly to company OKRs. * Ensure every request from business stakeholders aligns with company objectives and measurable outcomes. * Make prioritization and tradeoff decisions in partnership with Engineering and business leaders, negotiating across scope, timelines, and impact. * Produce status reports and updates tailored to the audience: executive summaries for leadership, detailed delivery views for engineering, and updates for business partners. * Own cross\-team planning, dependency management, and delivery cadence across multiple engineering teams. * Use metrics and retrospective findings to find bottlenecks and improve team efficiency, predictability, cycle time, and delivery health, and communication. * Set program strategy, consistent operating model cadence engineering and product, including quarterly planning, program reviews, and multi\-quarter roadmaps across portfolios of related initiatives, aligned to company OKRs. * Define the TPM operating model at OpenLoop, including standards for intake, planning, prioritization, reporting, and delivery health. * Lead organizational change, such as new delivery practices, tooling, or team structures, and bring stakeholders along. * Lead delivery during high\-stakes moments, such as critical launches, client escalations, or incidents, keeping teams focused and stakeholders informed. * Run a consistent operating cadence across engineering and product, including quarterly planning, program reviews, and launch readiness checks. * Provide program data on capacity and resourcing to inform headcount planning, architecture reviews, and portfolio discussions. * Keep TPM documentation and onboarding materials current so the practice runs as a repeatable discipline, not on any one person's knowledge. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or an equivalent strategic technical role, including 3\+ years leading programs that span multiple teams or business units. * Deep working knowledge of Agile software development, such as Scrum and the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). * Strong technical fluency (not required to be an engineer) with the ability to understand systems architecture, APIs, integrations, and technical dependencies. * Demonstrated experience translating complex systems into business\-friendly language. * Proven experience driving programs tied to OKRs and measurable business outcomes. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting to senior stakeholders and executives. * Experience writing status reports and program updates tailored to different audiences, from executives to engineering teams. * Experience defining and using delivery metrics (velocity, predictability, cycle time, health indicators) to improve team performance. * Strong prioritization and decision\-making skills with the ability to operate autonomously. * Experience aligning and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders. * Hands\-on experience using **Jira** and other project management tools to manage cross\-functional delivery at scale. * Experience structuring backlogs, defining epics and milestones, and creating executive\-ready reporting dashboards. * Track record of building or scaling a program management function, including defining processes, tooling, and reporting standards that other teams adopt. * Experience mentoring and developing program managers, and raising the capability of a team. * Executive presence, with experience advising C\-level leaders and influencing decisions without direct authority. * Experience leading organizational change and driving adoption of new delivery practices across engineering and business teams. * Ability to connect technical roadmaps to business strategy, budget, and resourcing decisions. * Experience leading through influence across senior leaders and peers, including resolving conflict and aligning teams with competing priorities. * Track record of coaching others into stronger program leaders, with examples of people you have helped grow or promote. * Sound judgment under ambiguity, with a history of making high\-stakes decisions and owning the outcomes. * Experience shaping team structure, hiring, or leveling for a program or project management team. * Track record of finding and resolving delivery risk before it becomes a customer or launch issue. * Experience building capacity and resource plans, and using data such as velocity and burndown to forecast delivery. * Calm under pressure, bringing structure and clarity to programs that are off track or ambiguous. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Release Train Engineer, SAFe Agilist). * Experience in healthcare, health tech, virtual care, care delivery platforms, or healthcare operations. * Experience with clinical, pharmacy, or technical integrations. * Experience working in fast\-growing or globally distributed teams. * Experience jobs.title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer - Exadata Database
jobs.description: Exadata is Oracle's flagship engineered system and the foundation of the world's most advanced database platform. jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Principal Software Engineer to build a new Data Processing Unit (DPU) platform spanning networking and storage. You will address system\-level questions such as host\-versus\-DPU responsibilities, predictable tail latency under mixed workloads, and correct behavior across offload transitions, failures, and upgrades. You will own a major subsystem spanning components and teams. Depending on the assignment, that could include a storage I/O pipeline, packet processing pipeline, host\-to\-DPU data path, or infrastructure acceleration subsystem. You will define architectural boundaries, align component owners, and remain accountable for integration and subsystem outcomes. We welcome engineers with deep storage data path expertise and working familiarity with networking, or deep networking data path expertise and working familiarity with storage. Your primary ownership will draw on your strengths while requiring collaboration across both domains. **What you will do** Own subsystem architecture and outcomes. Turn ambiguous system requirements into an architecture, component contracts, and a phased delivery plan. Establish decision authority and resolve tradeoffs that individual component owners cannot settle independently. Shape foundational data path decisions. Evaluate partitioning across host, DPU software, firmware, and hardware. Validate choices about queueing, memory ownership, acceleration, and recovery through prototypes and representative workloads. Lead delivery across component owners. Decompose subsystem work, align technical dependencies, and resolve integration risks across teams. Guide implementation through other engineers while personally implementing or debugging critical paths. Set end\-to\-end performance expectations. Establish subsystem budgets and targets for throughput, tail latency, resource efficiency, and relevant storage I/O or packet processing metrics. Resolve bottlenecks that span component boundaries. Connect storage and networking architecture. Work with engineers in both domains to evaluate I/O processing, transport, ordering, buffering, backpressure, and recovery tradeoffs. Ensure local optimizations preserve end\-to\-end performance, availability, and data integrity. Own integration and production readiness. Lead subsystem qualification and technical readiness reviews. Establish compatible interfaces, observability, fault isolation, and safe upgrade behavior; resolve systemic risks during rollout and operation. Develop component owners. Mentor engineers in architectural judgment and systems debugging. Establish shared engineering practices and help component leaders make sound decisions independently. Establish reusable AI practices. Guide effective AI use across subsystem engineering work, with validation and clear accountability. Share approaches that improve quality and productivity, reduce repetitive debugging and documentation, and support employee well\-being. **Required qualifications** 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience in systems or infrastructure software, including substantial hands\-on experience building high\-performance storage data paths or networking data paths. Demonstrated technical ownership of a major subsystem spanning multiple components and engineering teams, from ambiguous requirements through production integration. Deep expertise in either storage data path architecture, implementation, and optimization, or networking data path architecture, implementation, and optimization. Relevant experience may include storage I/O pipelines, block storage or storage transport, or high\-performance packet processing and network virtualization. Strong hands\-on C or C\+\+ expertise and deep knowledge of Linux, synchronization, memory management, multicore architectures, and performance analysis. Working familiarity with the complementary domain: networking fundamentals and transport behavior for storage specialists, or storage I/O architecture and behavior for networking specialists. Ability to evaluate cross\-domain performance and failure interactions with partner engineers. Experience defining component boundaries and contracts, establishing performance budgets, and resolving cross\-component correctness and reliability issues. A record of driving technical alignment and delivery across teams while remaining actively involved in implementation and difficult debugging. Ability to explain complex architectural decisions and develop other engineers into effective component owners. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications** Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable. Experience with every listed technology is not required. DPU architecture \- DPUs, SmartNICs, AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, P4, or comparable technologies; software, firmware, and hardware interface design. Packet processing \- Architecture or substantial extension of DPDK\-based systems or comparable user\-space packet processing frameworks. Storage data paths \- Storage I/O pipeline design or optimization, block storage, NVMe, NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, or storage virtualization. Hardware and production \- Hardware co\-design, PCIe, DMA, SR\-IOV, IOMMU, zero\-copy techniques, fleet qualification, failure recovery, or upgrade compatibility. What success looks like You will establish a coherent subsystem architecture, align component owners, and deliver successful integration with measured end\-to\-end results. You will resolve systemic risks early, lead consequential cross\-team decisions, and strengthen the technical judgment of the engineers around you. Why join us Influence foundational architecture while remaining deeply involved in engineering. You will have ownership of how a substantial part of the platform fits together, performs, and reaches production, working with experienced networking, storage, and hardware partners.

jobs.title: Software Developer

You will take technical problems from the IT department and our business analysts and turn them into working solutions — automation scripts, internal web applications, ERP integrations, and Power Automate and AI\-assisted workflows that remove manual effort from the business. system\-to\-system handoffs. * Apply AI and large language model (LLM) capabilities where they add practical value — for example, using AI APIs and Microsoft Copilot services in Python\-based scripts Build and maintain internal websites, dashboards, and tools used by staff across the company. * Deploy and maintain those applications on internal web servers (IIS) and in Azure. * Apply secure development practices — authentication, authorization, input validation, and least\-privilege access. **ERP \& Business Systems Integration:** * Integrate custom solutions with our ERP platform, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and with our MES and other line\-of\-business systems. * Build and consume REST APIs to move data reliably between systems. * Develop, test, and deploy Business Central extensions as needed, and validate existing customizations against Business Central release waves and updates. * Support our data analyst with data ingestion, pipelines, and transformation work in Microsoft Fabric, and help troubleshoot data quality and pipeline reliability issues. **General IT Support \& Practices:** * Learn our ERP and MES platforms and become a trusted technical resource for both. * Assist the IT team with general support tasks as needed, such as endpoint issues, Microsoft 365 administration, and user support during busy periods or coverage gaps. * Follow change management and version control practices and keep technical documentation current. **Requirements:** * Associate or bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, MIS, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience. * 2–3 years of professional software development experience. * Strong, demonstrable proficiency in Python and PowerShell — these are the two You should be comfortable writing, debugging, and maintaining production\-quality scripts in both for automation, integration, and data work, not just adapting existing examples. * Working knowledge of Windows Server — roles and features, services and scheduled tasks, file systems and permissions, and basic troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure services relevant to application hosting, identity, storage, and integration (for example App Service, Entra ID, SQL, Storage, DevOps). * Working understanding of computer networking fundamentals — DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, firewall rules, certificates, and how they affect the applications and integrations you build. * Experience consuming and building REST APIs, including authentication, JSON handling, and error handling. * Familiarity with source control (Git) and disciplined development practices. * Strong written and verbal communication skills — you will be explaining technical work to non\-technical people frequently. * Demonstrated willingness to learn business systems and the operational processes behind them. Genuine curiosity about how the business works is a requirement. * Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and know when to escalate. * Proactive — anticipates opportunities and issues, presents solutions, and leads execution. * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. Lifelong learner and forward thinking. **Preferred Skills and Abilities** * HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — enough to build and maintain functional internal web applications. * Internet Information Services (IIS) — site and application pool configuration, bindings, and certificates. * Microsoft Power Automate — building and supporting flows in a business environment. * Working understanding of AI and large language models (LLMs) — prompt design, calling AI APIs from code, and a practical sense of where these tools are appropriate, where they are not, and the data\-privacy and security considerations involved. * Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central development using AL and Visual Studio Code. * Microsoft Fabric or Power BI experience with data pipelines and reporting. * Cybersecurity fundamentals and secure coding practices. * Experience in a manufacturing or food production environment.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic builder who treats data pipelines as production software. They write clean, testable SQL and PySpark, care about data quality and lineage as much as throughput, and can explain tradeoffs among cost, latency, data freshness, and complexity to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. **Position Responsibilities*** Own data engineering work from source\-system discovery and requirements through design, build, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support * Partner with analysts, BI developers, AI engineers, architects, security, and business stakeholders to define data requirements, freshness targets, and acceptance criteria * Build reusable ingestion patterns, transformation frameworks, and data contracts so that pipelines, definitions, and lineage are consistent and maintainable across teams * Evaluate Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and complementary tools against requirements for scale, performance, security, and total cost of ownership, and track platform changes and new features * Document designs, data flows, and operating procedures clearly, review peers’ work, and contribute to a culture of engineering discipline * Design and implement medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architectures in Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse on OneLake using Delta Lake tables, OneLake shortcuts, and appropriate partitioning and table optimization strategies * Build batch and incremental ingestion with Fabric Data Factory pipelines, Copy job, Dataflow Gen2, and Azure Data Factory, and replicate operational databases into OneLake using mirroring and change data capture (CDC) * Develop transformation logic in Spark notebooks (PySpark and Spark SQL), T\-SQL, and KQL; handle duplicate, missing, and late\-arriving data; and implement slowly changing dimensions and incremental merge patterns * Build and maintain pipelines in Azure Databricks using Lakeflow Jobs, Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines, Auto Loader, and Unity Catalog, and integrate them with OneLake and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 * Ingest and process streaming data with Fabric Real\-Time Intelligence (Eventstreams, Eventhouse, and Activator), Azure Event Hubs, and Spark Structured Streaming * Design star\-schema fact and dimension models and collaborate with BI developers on Power BI semantic models, including Direct Lake, to deliver performant and consistent reporting * Implement validation rules, schema enforcement, reconciliations, and automated data quality tests; monitor pipelines with the Fabric Monitoring hub, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics; and resolve failures through root\-cause analysis * Apply OneLake security, row\- jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Data Collection Hardware
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Mechanical Engineer, Data Collection Hardware **Department:** Software Engineering **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Location:** Pensacola, FL **Travel:** 10% **Who We Are** Persona is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material\-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff. We are backed by leading strategic and financial investors and engaged with global industrial leaders across Korea, Japan, the United States, and Singapore. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale. **Why Join Persona?** * We offer competitive compensation, a performance\-based bonus, 100% employer covered medical benefits for most healthcare plans, early\-stage equity, competitive PTO, and company\-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd. * You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction. * Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning. **About the Role** As a Mechanical Engineer focused on Data Collection Hardware, you will bridge the gap between human operators and humanoid kinematics. Your time will be spent in fast\-paced rapid development of handheld UMI data\-collection tools capable of capturing delicate contact dynamics. Later, there will be the opportunity for rigorous, precision engineering as you architect and build a hand and human exoskeletons. To train robot foundation models at Persona, we will be relying on massive amounts of high\-quality, human\-demonstrated data, including rich force and tactile feedback. We are looking for a highly capable Mechanical Engineer to own the physical hardware our operators use to collect data. You will initially be responsible for rapidly iterating on agile, handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices. **What You Will Be Doing** * **Force\-Aware UMI Hardware Design:** Design, rapid prototype, and assemble handheld UMI frames, grippers, and mounting rigs that accurately mimic our humanoid’s hand mechanics while integrating load cells and force\-torque sensors to capture contact forces. * **Sensor \& Actuator Integration:** Design precise, vibration\-resistant mounts for spatial tracking sensors, GoPros, embedded electronics, and force sensors in the UMI. Seamlessly integrate high\-resolution encoders and haptic\-feedback motors in the console to enable robust, force\-aware data collection corresponding with the robot’s senses. * **Rapid Prototyping \& Manufacturing:** Seamlessly shift between rapid in\-house 3D printing for UMI iterations and sourcing machined metal components (CNC, sheet metal) for the console structure. * **Design for Assembly and Design for Manufacturing:** Should be proficient in DFM, DFA, and GD\&T concepts. + Defining PCBA outlines when working with EE (mounting points, outline). + Choosing appropriate materials for housing. + Shock\-vibe considerations. + Experience with industrial design and the human experience. * **Workstation Ergonomics (Human Factors):** Apply human\-factors engineering to design seating and viewing angles that accommodate the 5th to 95th percentile of human operators during extended, fatigue\-free data collection sessions. * IP rating considerations for equipment used outdoors (water resistance). * Human ergonomics when designing for use with human hands. * Basic thermal analysis for components mounted with hardware. **What We Are Looking For:** * **Education:** B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related field. * **CAD Proficiency:** 4\+ years of advanced experience with 3D CAD modeling software (OnShape, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Siemens NX), managing both small parts and large, complex workstation assemblies. * **Precision Mechanism Design:** Proven experience designing multi\-axis kinematic systems, selecting bearings, and managing cable\-drive or low\-friction transmission systems. * **Force \& Tactile Sensing Integration:** Demonstrated experience integrating load cells, 6\-axis force\-torque (F/T) sensors, or tactile arrays into mechanical assemblies to capture physical interactions. * **Human\-Factors Experience:** Demonstrated understanding of ergonomic principles and designing hardware that physically interfaces with human users for long durations. * **Prototyping Expertise:** Deep hands\-on experience with both rapid prototyping (advanced 3D printing) and traditional manufacturing processes (machining, turning). * **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop:** Experience designing enclosures and structural routing for delicate sensors, heavy optics/monitors, and cable management. **Bonus Skills:** * Previous experience in teleop and data collection devices, such as surgical robotics (e.g., designing consoles or master controllers for systems like Da Vinci, Monarch, or Ottava). * Experienced with implementing optics/cameras, such as: + Accommodating FOV estimates. + Choosing appropriate window materials. * Background in mechanical haptics, force\-feedback systems, and admittance/impedance control hardware. * Experience designing flight simulators, driving rigs, or high\-end VR hardware. * Familiarity with mechatronics and integrating smart servos into mechanical assemblies. * Experience with designing human wearables (watch/pedometer/glasses). ***Persona is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** ***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.***

jobs.title: FDE AI/ Solutions Architect (AI, Python/Data)
jobs.description: Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services \& Insurance** and **Healthcare \& Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre\-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. Our team holds 100\+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co\-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements. **Where this role sits** ------------------------ You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDX; our delivery arc is Sprint Enable Realize: * Forward Deployed Executive (FDX) owns the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C\-suite level to move the client's KPIs — revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction. * Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds with a client to change how that client operates. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. You map the client workflow as it actually happens, identify the business problem underneath it, build a working AI solution, present to the client in the language of outcomes, and transfer it. Provectus maintains industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a client in the same industry — so you begin from running code and tuning it to this client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. You will be measured on whether the Business Unit's number moved, not on hours or scope delivered. ### **What You’ll Do:** **Take the seat** * Sit with the client and the Forward Deployed Executive at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc, and redesign the function from first principles. * Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow. **Build** * Design and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud\-native data, LLM\-based, and agentic AI solutions). Implement and optimize RAG systems for production use cases * Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design. * Write production code across the stack — AI, backend services, data pipelines. We choose tools to fit the customer. * Take systems to production on AWS (GCP or Azure where the customer requires it): containerised, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and maintainable after we leave. Hand the system over to the client. * Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from. * Lead architecture reviews, produce technical design documents, and contribute to standards. Mentor engineers and share knowledge across the team. **Own the outcome.** * Work in a pair with a FDX who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number. * Own the technical direction of technical proposals and scoping. Drive adoption. Change management is part of the engineering job here. * Be credible with the customer’s engineers and their executives. * Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. ### **What You’ll Bring:** **Mindset** * Proactive and self\-directed; identify problems before they're handed to you * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job * B2\+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams **Client Engagement** * You are willing to spend time understanding and doing someone else’s job on the client's side before you write a line of code * Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO, presenting outcomes to them * You can produce a scoped, phased delivery plan with clear deliverables, dependencies, and risks — and estimate what it will cost to build and to run **Technical depth** * 7\+ years building and running production systems. * Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes * Designed and shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks * Agentic orchestration: multi\-step workflows, graph\-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure * Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks. * Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Experience in making and defending architectural trade\-off decisions * Hands\-on AWS production depth: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus * Cloud\-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release * Model and agent monitoring, drift detection * Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs * Hands\-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec\-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus * MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus ### **Nice to have:** * Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution * Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare * Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer\-facing delivery * A2A: you can explain agent\-to\-agent interoperability * AWS and Claude Code Certifications * CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) * Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust) * Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа ### **What We Offer:** * The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment * A forward\-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers * A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them * Remote\-friendly culture * Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance * Career growth; we actively develop our engineers * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long\-term B2B collaboration * Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work ### **How we hire:** * Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions. * Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant * HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations * HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
