jobs.title: Quality Engineer (SDET)
jobs.description: **About Prudentia Sciences** ---------------------------- Prudentia Sciences is an AI\-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by: * **Empowering biopharma** to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact * **Enabling strategic positioning** of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking * **Equipping investors** with data\-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Signal Fire, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R\&D by empowering decision\-makers with real\-time, data\-driven insights. **We’re hiring our first dedicated QA Engineer: a hands\-on engineer who writes code, builds quality into our platform from the ground up, and cares as much about performance and reliability as about correctness.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This is a rare opportunity to join a high\-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and ML teams to safeguard the trust our pharma and biopharma customers place in our platform. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top\-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry. **What You’ll Do** * **Test Automation:** Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across UI, API, and data pipelines, with most coverage at the API and data layers, so the team can ship fast and with confidence as the platform scales. * **AI\-Assisted Engineering:** Use AI coding tools (like Claude Code) daily to build and maintain tests, and know when to question their output. You understand why the code works, not just that it runs, and you keep sensitive data out of AI tools. * **Quality Gates in CI/CD:** Own the automated quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), deciding what blocks a release and what doesn’t. Be ruthless about eliminating flaky or long\-running tests. * **API \& Contract Testing:** Test at the API layer by default, and catch breaking changes between services before they reach production. * **Performance \& Reliability Testing:** Own load, performance, and reliability testing so the platform meets the availability and responsiveness expectations of deal teams working with large volumes of sensitive, time\-sensitive data. * **Bug Tracking \& Triage:** Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, work with engineers to prioritize fixes, and make clear go/no\-go release calls. * **Data \& Output Validation:** Validate the accuracy and consistency of ML\-driven outputs (risk analyses, valuations, scientific assessments) as they move from the orchestration layer into user\-facing views. * **Security \& Compliance Awareness:** Help verify secure handling of sensitive scientific and deal data, including keeping each customer’s data separate, in line with best practices for healthcare and life sciences data. * **Collaboration \& Process:** Work cross\-functionally with engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scientific and business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria. * **Continuous Improvement:** Champion a quality\-first culture: advocate for testability in design reviews, improve test coverage over time, and stay current on modern QA tooling and practices. **Who You Are** *Core Qualifications* * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * **QA Experience:** Proven experience testing modern web applications and designing and building automated test suites, ideally as the person who owned them. * **Test Automation Tools:** Hands\-on experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., pytest, REST\-assured, pactflow). * **CI/CD Integration:** Experience owning automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), including setting up quality gates and managing flaky tests. * **AI\-Assisted Development:** Hands\-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily work, with a habit of verifying what they produce. * **Performance Testing:** Experience designing load or performance tests and finding real bottlenecks. * **Technical Fluency:** Comfort reading code and working directly with engineers to understand system architecture, APIs, and data flows well enough to design meaningful tests. * **Data\-Driven Applications:** Experience testing applications with complex, data\-driven workflows. * **Bug Tracking \& Communication:** Skilled at writing clear, reproducible bug reports and explaining quality risks and release readiness to the team. * **Security \& Compliance Awareness:** Familiarity with best practices for secure data handling and testing in regulated or sensitive\-data environments (especially valuable in healthcare, life sciences, or enterprise environments). * **Collaboration \& Product Mindset:** Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with engineers, product managers, and scientific domain experts to deliver a high\-quality user experience. **Bonus** * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biopharma sectors is nice, but not required. More important is a willingness to dive into the field and a curiosity to learn about life sciences and the drug development process, and how deal making revolves around it. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact:** Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster * **Ownership:** Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader * **Growth:** Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase * **Compensation:** Competitive salary and equity * **Team:** Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma **Location** ------------ This role is hybrid, requiring being onsite 2 days per week (Tuesday/Thursday) in one of our U.S. hubs: Boston, New York City, or San Francisco. Compensation Range: $120K \- $145K

jobs.title: Principal/Senior Software Engineer - Mobile App Monetization (Ad Server)
jobs.description: **About the Role** PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next\-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high\-performance, low\-latency, scalable, and privacy\-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in\-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency. The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP\-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads. The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad\-tech domain expertise and experience building real\-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML\-integrated and data\-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic's mobile app ecosystem. **What You'll Do** * Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in\-app behavioral data using on\-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities. * Build and optimize SSP\-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy\-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP\-specific troubleshooting. * Design mobile\-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high\-value in\-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior. * Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward\-callback correctness. * Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well\-represented, privacy\-compliant, format\-compatible, attribution\-ready, and supply\-quality\-aware mobile app requests. * Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low\-quality partner supply detection. * Support privacy\-aware and attribution\-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child\-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy\-safe fallback when user\-level identifiers are unavailable. * Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal\-quality standards, request\-field expectations, placement/ad\-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply. * Build publisher\-facing and buyer\-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing\-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no\-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply\-path quality insights. * Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic's MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality. * Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities. * Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross\-team incident response. **We'd Love for You to Have** * Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high\-scale, low\-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app\-install, or programmatic AdTech domains. * Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewar rience working with incrementality measurement, retargeting systems, audience segmentation, cohort\-based optimization, or privacy\-safe targeting for mobile performance marketing. * Exposure to privacy\-preserving user ID solutions such as UID2\.0, RampID, publisher first\-party IDs, hashed identifiers where allowed, and frameworks such as SKAdNetwork for iOS post\-ATT monetization. * Experience with cross\-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session. * Familiarity with real\-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency. * Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy\-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech. **Why Join Us?** * Work on high\-scale mobile monetization infrastructure that directly impacts publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem. * Help shape the future of ML\-powered mobile monetization, real\-time ad decisioning, traffic shaping, attribution readiness, and privacy\-safe performance advertising. * Build systems that improve monetization across premium mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads. * Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product teams, machine learning experts, DSP partners, publisher teams, and marketplace quality teams. * Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company. **AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset:** We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment. **Qualifications:** * Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well\-known Institutes / Universities. **Additional Information:** **Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. **Benefits**: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more! **Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **About PubMatic** PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

jobs.title: Deployment Engineer - PTS Deployment Center
jobs.description: Publix Super Markets, Inc., the largest employee\-owned company in the U.S., is driven by a dynamic technology team of 2,300\+ professionals delivering innovative solutions to 1,400\+ stores and 260,000\+ associates across 8 states. From IT security and platform engineering to architecture, software development, and infrastructure, we offer career opportunities at every level—internships through technical leadership. Join a company consistently ranked among Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” and help us build more than great subs—build the future of technology at Publix. **Join Publix Technology as a Deployment Engineer where you can be part of a team that builds, configures, and customizes hardware platforms for our retail and corporate business areas. Specifically, this position will work in the Deployment Center where the team builds and configures all technology related equipment for new stores, retail, and corporate projects as well as retail and corporate incidents and requests. The Deployment team plays a key role in supporting our retail and corporate technicians as well as assisting our engineering and development teams.** **The most suitable candidate will be a technical candidate with strong analytical, planning and communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with management, peers, and business unit customers. Additionally, the candidate would be familiar with all aspects of staging technology, such as terminals, workstations, scales, self\-checkouts, servers, PCs, routers, switches, firewalls, and mobile devices.** **Why Join Us?*** **Operational Efficiency:** Ensure technology solutions support efficient workflows and enable automation to improve operational effectiveness. * **Empowered Culture:** We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization. **Your Impact:*** Manage and deliver all corporate and retail hardware and software builds for new production stores, staging stores, development stores, and corporate support sites * Perform software builds of store systems, workstations, POS terminals, mobile devices, scales, networking components, and all associated peripheral equipment to deliver a functional production store, staging store, development store, and corporate support site * Implement software packages and configuration changes to ensure new stores, staging stores, development stores, corporate support site systems are up to date with the latest production code level, security packages, and other software components * Manage/monitor the status of the systems to ensure proper operations and uptime * Stage and configure hardware for retail stores and corporate support sites for incident, request and project work as needed * Ensure that new store builds are completed on time to support new store openings * Foster and maintain working relationships with customers to ensure processes are optimized to support expected customer service levels

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Title: Senior Mechanical Automation Engineer Department: Tech Center – Product R\&D Location: Houston, TX Supervisor: Director, Automation \& Robotics FLSA Status: Exempt Position Status: Permanent, Full Time Work Status (Remote/Hybrid/In\-Office): Hybrid SENIOR MECHANICAL AUTOMATION ENGINEER Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (Qcells USA), headquartered in Houston, TX, specializes in providing utility\-scale modules, solar photovoltaic (PV), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) project development, along with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar and BESS projects nationwide. Qcells USA delivers comprehensive turnkey solutions encompassing the entire utility\-scale project lifecycle. By choosing Qcells USA for turnkey solutions, customers can reduce uncertainty and risk, leading to enhanced investment returns and contributing to a more sustainable future. Qcells USA’s complete turnkey solutions seamlessly integrate the expertise of our Development, Module, and EPC teams, while ensuring close coordination with other vital internal groups such as Project Finance, Systems Integration, and Legal. This collaborative approach ensures that Qcells USA projects deliver exceptional value and performance. With several multi\-billion\-dollar investments, Qcells is pioneering the establishment of the only complete module supply chain in the U.S., including the expansion of our Georgia module manufacturing facility, which stands as the largest in the Western Hemisphere. As an integral part of the global Qcells brand, Qcells USA benefits from a legacy of excellence in photovoltaic manufacturing. Qcells is renowned worldwide for its high\-performance, superior\-quality solar cells and modules. With dual headquarters in Seoul, South Korea (Global Executive HQ) and Thalheim, Germany (Technology \& Innovation HQ), Qcells operates under the umbrella of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company and one of the top 8 business conglomerates in South Korea. Summary We are currently seeking a Senior Mechanical Automation Engineer to work with our cross\-functional business units to design and implement automated and robotic assembly systems for utility scale solar power plant construction. This position reports to the Director of Automation and Robotics or another management personnel that the CEO of the Company may designate. This position is hybrid for candidates living near a corporate office Houston, TX requiring up to four days per week on site. Candidates living outside the commuting distance of an office location will operate as fully remote with occasional travel. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8 am to 5 pm or from 9 am to 6 pm local time. This position is expected to travel up to 20%. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: * Lead mechanical design of new automation and related solar products from concept through commercialization, applying statics, dynamics, and mechanics principles to solve complex assembly and installation challenges. * Collaborate with controls engineers, system integrators, and cross\-functional and third\-party partners to integrate custom and commercial\-off\-the\-shelf (COTS) components (robots, conveyors, drives, sensors) into complex automation systems. * Develop 3D CAD models and detailed product drawings in SolidWorks. * Perform structural and stress (FEA) analysis and maintain FMEA, design\-verification, and calculation reports, establishing safety factors and ensuring traceability between requirements, design, testing, and compliance evidence. * Design and execute prototype, system\-integration, and validation testing (lab and field, including FAT/SAT); document findings, perform root\-cause analysis on failures, and recommend design or process changes. * Engage field teams and customers to gather prototype feedback, validate design solutions, and prepare installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting documentation. * Lead or support mechanical workstreams on development programs, tracking milestones, managing design reviews, and communicating technical risks, trade studies, and recommendations to project leadership and cross\-functional audiences. * Ensure designs meet applicable safety and design standards; coordinate third\-party certification with test labs and regulatory bodies. * Apply value engineering and design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM) practices with manufacturing and supply partners to optimize cost, manufacturability, and field reliability. * Develop and maintain economic models (cost, logistics, field performance, operations) to support investment and pricing decisions. * Convert market requirements and competitive/market analysis into mechanical design specifications and product strategy, aligning scope and targets with cross\-functional teams. * Doc lectromechanical systems, including designing and executing validation protocols. * Familiarity with relevant engineering standards and codes (e.g., OSHA 29 CFR 1910, ANSI B11, NFPA 79, UL 1740\) and experience supporting or managing third\-party certification processes. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to cross\-functional teams and senior leadership, in both written and verbal formats. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, meet schedules, escalate risks proactively, and work effectively in remote/distributed team settings. Preferred Qualifications * Solar or utility\-scale energy industry experience; familiarity with solar tracker systems, PV module assembly, field\-deployment equipment, and single\-axis solar tracking mechanics/control principles. * Design and development of robotic assembly systems or related automation. * Experience with mobile or field\-deployable equipment: understanding of logistics, field setup, transportation, and operational support requirements for equipment deployed across multiple sites. * Experience with design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM), lean manufacturing principles, or value\-stream mapping to optimize designs for cost and manufacturability. * Demonstrated ability to own a technical domain and serve as subject\-matter authority on cross\-disciplinary projects. * Experience managing vendor relationships and integrating COTS subsystems into larger products; comfort navigating supplier quality, lead times, and technical\-support constraints. EXAMPLES OF PHYSICAL DEMANDS * Stationary Position: frequently remains stationary up to 90% of the time and sitting up to 8 hours in a day * Move/Traverse: infrequently bend, stand, stoop and/or walk * Carry Weight: infrequently carry weight and/or lift objects (light to heavy) weighing up to 10 pounds * Hearing and Speech: frequently communicates with the ability to hear and talk on a regular basis with employees, coworkers, and all personnel matters; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations * Sight: frequent use of sight to detect images on computer, office documents, and office objects near and far * Climb: occasionally ascends/descends on stairway to get to office upper and lower floors * Travel: up to 20% as needed EXAMPLES OF WORK ENVIRONMENT * Regular professional, office business setting * Noise level ranges from low to moderate (if in office setting) * Noise level ranges from moderate to high (if on construction worksite) * Under the Office Mobilization Plan (OMP) policy, the role may transition to an onsite or hybrid arrangement, as determined by business needs and the Head of Department Hanwha Qcells is proud to be an at\-will Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination against race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status and any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. It is important to note that the job descriptions provided by Qcells USA Corp are not intended to be comprehensive lists of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the positions. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice, reflecting our dynamic and evolving work environment. We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Hanwha Qcells will provide reasonable accommodations to all qualified individuals with disabilities to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations at hr\-usa@qcells.com.

jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Machine Learning Engineering **General Summary:** Qualcomm AI Research is looking for world\-class researchers in deep learning to join a high\-caliber team of engineers inventing machine\-learning technology to provide best\-in\-class solutions while running with the most efficient use of power, memory, and computation. jobs.title: Staff Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Quizlet:** ================== At Quizlet, our mission is to help every learner achieve their outcomes in the most effective and delightful way. We’re a $1B\+ learning platform used by two\-thirds of U.S. high school students and half of college students, powering over 1 billion learning interactions each week. We blend cognitive science with machine learning to personalize and enhance the learning experience for students, professionals, and lifelong learners alike. We’re energized by the potential to power more learners through multiple approaches and various tools. **Let’s Build the Future of Learning** Join us to design and deliver AI\-powered learning tools that scale across the world and unlock human potential. **Why Join Quizlet?** --------------------- **Massive reach:** 60M\+ users, 1B\+ interactions per week **Cutting\-edge tech:** Generative AI, adaptive learning, cognitive science **Strong momentum:** Top\-tier investors, sustainable business, real traction **Mission\-first:** Work that makes a difference in people’s lives **Inclusive culture:** Committed to equity, diversity, and belonging **About the Team:** ------------------- Security Engineering protects Quizlet's learners, employees, and systems. We build practical safeguards that help teams deliver products securely and confidently. We partner with engineering, infrastructure, trust \& safety, and other teams to reduce risk while supporting a reliable experience for learners. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Staff Cloud Security Engineer, you will set technical direction and deliver security improvements across our cloud infrastructure and public\-facing services. Your primary focus will be Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), workload identity, infrastructure as code, and remediation. You will also improve edge defenses and turn data\-protection requirements into technical controls, automated checks, and evidence that those controls work. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Lead cloud and Kubernetes security improvements, including workload identity, organization policies, and network protections. Partner with Infrastructure and identity colleagues on design, implementation, and tested rollouts. * Operate cloud security tooling, prioritize findings by risk, and work with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and harden container images. * Improve WAF rules, rate limits, bot defenses, and anomaly detection to catch malicious traffic while reducing disruption for legitimate users. * Build maintainable security automation and review infrastructure as code so secure configurations are easier to adopt and sustain. * Create self\-service patterns for securely exposing new services and connecting AI tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to approved data. * Partner with engineering to implement agreed data\-protection requirements through enforceable controls, CI checks, regression tests, and reliable evidence. * Guide cross\-team security decisions, mentor engineers, and support incident response and security on\-call responsibilities. **What you bring to the table:** -------------------------------- * As a rough guide, we’re looking for 8\+ years working with public\-cloud infrastructure, including 5\+ years in cloud security engineering. These are guidelines rather than hard cutoffs; equivalent experience demonstrating the depth and Staff\-level impact described here is welcome. * Experience securing GCP and GKE environments. * Deep hands\-on experience securing production cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes workloads, including identity and access, networking, Linux, and containers. * Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, and programming languages such as Python or Go to build security controls and automation. * Ability to translate security requirements into practical controls, automated tests, and evidence of effectiveness. * A record of leading complex technical work across teams, making and explaining sound risk tradeoffs, and communicating clearly and respectfully. **Bonus points if you have:** ----------------------------- * Experience designing and tuning WAF rules, rate limits, or bot defenses, with attention to detection quality and customer impact. * Experience with Cloudflare and HUMAN/PerimeterX or comparable edge and bot\-defense platforms. * Experience operating Wiz or similar cloud security platforms and improving workload and container\-image security. * Experience securing AI or MCP integrations, or automating controls that support data\-protection commitments and assurance frameworks. **Work Location** ----------------- We’re happy to share that this is a **hybrid position** in our **San Francisco** office. To support collaboration, we ask employees to be in the office at least **two days a week: Wednesday and Thursday**. **Compensation, Benefits \& Perks:** ------------------------------------ * Collaborate with your manager and team to create a healthy work\-life balance * 20 vacation days that we expect you to take! * Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance (100% employee and 75% dependent PPO, Dental, VSP Choice) * Employer\-sponsored 401k plan with company match * Access to LinkedIn Learning and other resources to support professional growth * Paid Family Leave, FSA, HSA, Commuter benefits, and Wellness benefits * 40 hours of annual paid time off to participate in volunteer programs of choice **We strive to make everyone feel comfortable and welcome!** We work to create a holistic interview process, where both Quizlet and candidates have an opportunity to view what it would be like to work together, in exploring a mutually beneficial partnership. We provide a transparent setting that gives a comprehensive view of who we are! **In Closing:** --------------- At Quizlet, we’re excited about passionate people joining our team—even if you don’t check every box on the requirements list. We value unique perspectives and believe everyone has something meaningful to contribute. Our culture is all about taking initiative, learning through challenges, and striving for high\-quality work while staying curious and open to new ideas. We believe in honest, respectful communication, thoughtful collaboration, and creating a supportive space where everyone can grow and succeed together.” Quizlet’s success as an online learning community depends on a strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer and a tech company committed to societal change, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ\+ community, individuals with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. \#LI\-Onsite **To All Recruiters and Placement Agencies** -------------------------------------------- At this time Quizlet does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and/or profiles. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website or to any Quizlet employee. Quizlet will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or firm nor will it be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. All unsolicited resumes received will be considered the property of Quizlet. Compensation Range: $200,479 \- $263,129

jobs.title: Integrations Engineer II
jobs.description: **Integrations Engineer II** ============================ **J****ob Type****Location****Salary Range** Full\-Time \| On\-Site Renton, WA $36\.50 \- $45\.70 per hour **Job Summary** --------------- The primary role of the Integrations Engineer II is to design, build, and support the APIs and event\-driven services that connect Radiant's transportation management platform with our customers, carriers, partners, and internal applications.* The Integrations Engineer II is a member of the API \& Integrations team. The team builds on a modern cloud platform (**Node.js/TypeScript on AWS**) that delivers REST APIs, event streaming, and AI\-enabled services. * This is a **hands\-on, mid\-level engineering role**. The incumbent owns assigned integrations from technical design through production support, and is a go\-to reviewer and mentor for less experienced engineers. * The Integrations Engineer II works with engineers in the U.S. and Cebu, Philippines, and with partner teams across Technology and Operations. * The incumbent works free from daily oversight, regularly exercising independent discretion and significant decision making in regard to completing duties. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ In this position, the Integrations Engineer II is responsible for:**Design \& Build*** Design and build customer\- and partner\-facing **REST APIs**, including specifications, validation, versioning, and documentation. * Develop **event\-driven services and data pipelines** that move and transform data between our transportation management system and connected systems. * Own the technical design of assigned integrations: write solution designs, weigh trade\-offs, and propose improvements to performance, reliability, and scalability. * Onboard new customers and partners onto integration flows, from data mapping and testing through go\-live. * Assist API clients with their technical needs, including onboarding and setup, troubleshooting, and escalated issues. * Contribute to AI\-enabled services that give AI tools safe, governed access to integration capabilities. * Use AI\-assisted development tools and automation to speed up delivery and remove repetitive setup and support work. **Quality \& Release*** Write automated tests and keep the team's CI pipelines healthy. * Review code and approve changes for promotion to staging, in line with team standards. * Mentor Integrations Engineer I team members through development, code review, and documentation. **Support \& Reliability*** Share ownership of the team's core production services with other engineers, so no service or approval depends on a single person. * Monitor the team's integrations and lead the triage of production incidents for the services you own: find the root cause, put fixes in place, and document what happened. * Act as a technical backup to the Engineering Manager for design decisions and release approvals when needed. * Help modernize legacy integrations by moving them onto the current platform. **Collaboration \& Documentation*** Work from business requirements documents (BRDs), and contribute technical requirements and estimates. * Partner with the teams that own connected platforms to validate new or changed interfaces, report defects, and confirm fixes. * Keep runbooks and API documentation current so the wider team and the Helpdesk can support integrations. * Handle customer and partner data securely, in line with company security practices. * Other duties as may be assigned by management. **Qualifications \& Skills** ---------------------------- **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum 4 years' experience in backend software engineering or systems integration. * Strong backend development experience in **Node.js/TypeScript**. * Experience designing **REST APIs**, including authentication, versioning, and documentation. * Experience with **event\-driven architectures** and message streaming (e.g., Kafka). * Experience operating event\-streaming pipelines in production, including throughput, lag, and recovery. * Experience integrating enterprise systems (ERP, TMS, or similar), including data mapping. * Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), containers, and CI/CD. * Track record of owning services in production, including monitoring, incident response, and root\-cause analysis. * Experience reviewing code and mentoring other engineers. * Strong written communication and the discipline for **asynchronous work across time zones** (U.S. Pacific Philippines). * Proficient in English communication (verbal and written). **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience integrating with **SAP TM** or other enterprise TMS/ERP platforms. * Experience building data pipelines or change\-data\-capture solutions. * Experience with observability tooling (logs, metrics, an r using AI\-assisted development tools. * Experience with test automation frameworks. * Exposure to EDI or file\-based data exchange. * Experience in the freight forwarding, logistics, or transportation industry is an asset. * Familiarity with Jira and Confluence. **Business Skills*** Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills in a team environment. * Accurate and detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership for production systems. * Able to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Team cooperation and respect are required. **Work Schedule** ----------------- * Full\-time schedule of a minimum of 8 hours per day, with the flexibility to complete all required job duties and responsibilities. * Regular overlap with team members in the Philippines, and occasional after\-hours availability for production incidents. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ----------------------------------------- While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods; use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift and/or move up to 15–25 pounds (e.g., files, supplies, or equipment). Specific vision abilities require close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The role operates in a professional climate\-controlled office environment with a usually moderate noise level.**Compensation** ---------------- **Base Pay Range:** $36\.50 \- $45\.70 per hour*The base pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for this specific location. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.***Benefits** ------------ **Featured Benefits*** Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental and Vision coverage for you and your dependents * Health Savings Account \+ Employer Contributions * Flexible Spending Account options for Medical and/or Dependent Care * Company provided Life Insurance, Short\-term and Long\-term Disability Insurance * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan \+ Employer Match * Paid Time Off for Vacation, Sick, and Company Observed Holidays **About Radiant** ----------------- At Radiant, we’re the **network that delivers.** For our customers, that means expertise, responsiveness and solutions they can count on. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description: ***In the time it takes you to read this job description, RapidSOS will have handled \~1,380 emergencies.*** At RapidSOS, we are committed to using technology to build a safer, stronger future and working together to save lives. We're in an exciting phase of growth, welcoming new members from across the globe to our mission\-driven, ambitious, and inclusive team. Our work is founded on our values of **trust and safety**, **pioneering**, **urgency**, and **purpose over pride**, all of which support a company culture where people can innovate, collaborate, grow, and, above all, make an impact. RapidSOS is the leading public safety AI company that unlocks mission\-critical intelligence for emergency response. It harnesses artificial and human intelligence to fuse life\-saving data from the world's largest safety network, which includes over 700M\+ connected devices and 200\+ global technology companies. This intelligence is delivered to 23,000\+ federal, state, and local agencies, serving one million first responders. RapidSOS has supported over one billion emergencies in 16 countries, powering RapidSOS HARMONY, the first purpose\-built AI for public safety, designed to save critical time by automatically detecting emergencies, unifying real\-time data and video streams, and coordinating a faster, more effective response. Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com. **What this role is about:** RapidSOS is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect who is excited to dig into a technical challenge and develop an optimized solution that will contribute to building the life\-saving technology that protects 170M\+ lives annually. You will play a major role in the technical sales process, working with B2B customers to lead technical and product sales conversations, translate their requirements into a solution, and define its scope. You will build as well as advise, creating demos, proofs of concept, and integrations, and guiding clients on how to use RapidSOS's APIs and other products. You'll excel in this role if you have a solutions mindset, are AI\-forward in how you work and build, thrive in a highly visible, customer\-facing role, and are self\-motivated with a low ego. **What you'll do:** * Own the technical engagement with customers during the pre\-sales process by building and presenting product demos to help showcase product functionalities, creating pilot and proof\-of concept implementations, and more * Design the solution by turning details from discovery into a clear technical approach, from the APIs to the integrations that connect RapidSOS to emergency response workflows and a customer's products * Build and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations to clients and prospects * Partner with Account Executives to assist in developing account strategies, planning and execution, articulating RapidSOS's value proposition and vision, and building a relationship with clients as a trusted advisor * Create documentation and specifications that support technical sales and translate customer requirements into solutions for Product and Engineering, including SOWs * Assess scope, feasibility, and technical risk, and work through overcoming challenges alongside customers and internal teams to find the best path forward * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Public Safety to connect what customers need with what we build and deliver * Lead with AI and keep learning, using it to build, prototype, and solve problems faster for customers and across the team while deepening your knowledge of RapidSOS's products and the market **What we're looking for in our ideal candidate:** * 5\+ years of experience in engineering, including 3\+ in a technical customer\-facing capacity, ideally in implementation engineering, post\-sales engineering, and/or sales engineering * Experience with complex API\-based or SaaS products, whether in presales (technical discovery, presenting demos) or in post\-sales / implementation engineering * Proficient programming ability in any language (Python, Go, Javascript / Typescript, etc.), with Python preferred * Familiarity with deploying solutions, through either cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, Azure) or containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes * Ability to work directly with clients and translate what they need into clear technical solutions * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to engineers and executives alike and to build trusted customer relationships that move deals forward * Self\-starter with strong problem\-solving instincts and an innovative streak, who takes ownership of ambiguous challenges and turns them into solutions customers trust and the team stands behind * An understanding and flexibility in working at a high\-growth environment where priorities can shift quickly * Hands\-on experience building with AI tools, with an AI\-forward mindset that shows up in how you prototype, solve problems, and look for better ways to work * Ability to travel up to 25% **Nice\-to\-have experience (but not required!):** * Experience with telecommunications **What we offer:** * The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally * Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation * A dynamic, flexible and fun start\-up work environment with a highly talented team **If you're curious to learn more about RapidSOS, you can check out** **https://rapidsos.com/blog/** *Starting pay for a successful applicant will depend on a variety of job\-related factors, which may include experience, relevant skills, training, education, location, business needs, or market demands. The base salary range for this role is $150,000 \- $180,000, with a potential OTE of $200,000 \- $240,000\. This role will also be eligible to receive equity options.* If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here: https://rapidsos.com/privacy/california/ *\#LI\-Remote* RapidSOS is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. Interested in the role but you don't meet 100% of the requirements? We'd love to hear from you! We encourage you to apply; we'd be excited to see if your unique skill set and experience could be a match.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Rapsodo Operating System (ROS)
jobs.description: Rapsodo is a global sports technology company with offices in the United States, Singapore, Türkiye, Japan, and Malaysia. We build data\-driven, portable sports analytics products that help athletes understand and improve their performance. From Major League Baseball pitchers to professional golfers, our products are used globally across all levels of sport. We operate as a globally distributed team, enabled by ownership, clarity, collaboration, and disciplined execution. We are innovative, focused, and rapidly growing, and continuously looking for team players who will stop at nothing to deliver state\-of\-the\-art solutions as part of Team Rapsodo. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a curious, resourceful, and hands\-on **Software Engineer** to join our Rapsodo Operating System (ROS) team in St. Louis, Missouri. You will help build, maintain, and continuously improve the systems and tools that power how Rapsodo operates as a business. This includes developing internal software, integrating third\-party platforms, resolving technical issues, and creating automation solutions that make our operations simpler, faster, and more effective. Working closely with colleagues across our St. Louis, Singapore, and Türkiye offices, you will collaborate on shared systems, solve technical challenges, and deliver solutions that support our global operations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys figuring things out, solving real\-world problems, and exploring how technology, including AI, can improve the way people work. What matters most is your ability to think critically, learn quickly, take initiative, and turn problems into practical solutions. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, maintain, and enhance internal applications, systems, and tools that support Rapsodo's business operations. * Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable, sustainable solutions. * Build integrations between internal applications and third\-party business systems to improve connectivity and data flow. * Design and implement automation solutions to streamline workflows, reduce manual work, and improve operational efficiency. * Collaborate with colleagues across St. Louis, Singapore, and Türkiye to understand business challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, testing, and solution development while ensuring quality and reliability. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code, applying sound software engineering practices. * Test, monitor, and continuously improve system reliability, performance, security, and usability. * Explore new technologies and challenge existing ways of working to deliver simpler, smarter, and more scalable solutions. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Sound understanding of programming concepts, software development, databases, APIs, and system integration. * Experience with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, Go, or similar, gained through professional work, academic projects, or personal initiatives. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software development tools and the ability to learn and apply new technologies effectively. * Strong problem\-solving ability, with the curiosity to investigate issues, understand root causes, and find practical solutions. * Resourceful and proactive, with the initiative to explore solutions independently rather than wait for instructions. * Strong learning agility, with the willingness to experiment, adapt, seek feedback, and continuously develop new capabilities. * Ability to think beyond code, understand business needs, and consider how technology can improve processes and outcomes. * Effective communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed teams. Turkish language proficiency is an added advantage for working with colleagues in our Türkiye office but is not required. * A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and commitment to seeing tasks through to completion. We value how you think, learn, and solve problems more than the programming languages you already know. We are looking for someone who is curious about how things work, willing to challenge existing approaches, comfortable using AI to work smarter, and motivated to build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Refold** Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it. Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white\-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real\-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves. Traction: 30\+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500\+ active users, 10M\+ API calls processed daily, seven\-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time\-to\-go\-live by 70% and recovered 8,000\+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5\-month builds to 90% faster delivery. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30\. We've raised $6\.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating. We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Own the technical win:** Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours * **Build the proof, don't slide it:** Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy * **Run crisp POCs:** Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4\-week POCs — help us prove value in days * **Speak both languages:** Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi\-tenancy, and in\-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on * **Clear security and procurement:** Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air\-gapped, in\-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it * **Hand off clean:** Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go\-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise * **Feed the platform:** You'll be one of our highest\-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap * **Build the SE motion:** Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents **Role Information:** * **Partners with:** The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery * **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand * **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months * **Technical buyers you'll face:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers * **Ideal customer:** Sales\-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors * **Competitive set:** iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in\-house build * **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post\-Sale, plus a 20\-person engineering and delivery org **Required Skills \& Abilities** * **Proven SE:** 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat * **Builder, not just a presenter:** Hands\-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend * **Enterprise systems fluency:** Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am * **Sales instinct:** You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user * **Room\-ready:** You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves * **High ownership in ambiguity:** No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once **Nice to Have** * Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic * Hands\-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts * Experience with air\-gapped, in\-tenant, or customer\-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them * Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes) * First\-SE or early\-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one * Worked day\-to\-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team **Why do you want to work here?** * **Impact**: Fast\-growing seed\-stage company ($6\.5M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500\-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes * **Speed:** A category to define and a narrative to own, with founder\-level access and no layers between you and the decision * **Ownership**: Cutting\-edge AI solving a high\-value enterprise problem nobody has cracked — backed by technical founders building a next\-generation infrastructure platform **Compensation:** * **$100,000\-$120,000 (annual)** **Equal Employment Opportunity** We're a small, fast\-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here. Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer — Conversational Agents (Senior/Staff)
jobs.description: **Senior/Staff Applied AI Engineer — Conversational Agents** ============================================================ Revin · Agents Platform · Flatiron, New York City **$225,000–$325,000 base salary \+ meaningful early equity** · Full\-time Four days per week in our Flatiron office, with one remote day and flexibility when life comes up. We’re hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Final compensation depends on level, based on your demonstrated experience, scope of ownership, and impact. **About Revin** --------------- Revin builds AI\-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email. Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line. Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior\-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del\-Air, a $300M\+ HVAC and plumbing business. See the impact of our work: we’ve helped Del\-Air book 11,000\+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments. **The role** ------------ Make our conversational AI agents more capable, responsive, and natural through rigorous experimentation. You’ll join our Agents Platform team at the intersection of software engineering and data science, using real customer conversations to understand where agents fall short and ship improvements that hold up in production. You’ll own the full improvement cycle: identify a problem, form a hypothesis, design an experiment, implement a change, and validate its impact. Your work will span instruction following, tool use, task completion, latency, and conversational experience, with a substantial focus on voice. You’ll improve agents through model selection, prompting, context, orchestration, and real\-time voice behavior. We care most about your ability to learn from evidence and turn that learning into better customer experiences. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Find the problems worth solving.** Analyze production conversations, listen to calls, inspect traces, and work with customer\-facing teams to identify failure patterns and prioritize improvements. * **Build measurement you can trust.** Define quality dimensions and representative evaluation datasets. Combine human judgment, automated graders, and production metrics, and validate that they measure what customers actually experience. * **Develop and test hypotheses.** Design reproducible experiments, compare approaches, and use offline evaluations and controlled production rollouts to understand what works, where it works, and what tradeoffs it introduces. * **Improve the voice experience.** Investigate turn\-taking, interruptions, response latency, transcription errors, speech quality, and spoken naturalness. Use audio and system telemetry together to diagnose causes and validate changes. * **Ship improvements into the agent system.** Implement changes, monitor their effects in production, and take responsibility for reliability, cost, and regressions alongside quality gains. * **Make improvement repeatable.** Turn production failures and experimental findings into reusable datasets, evaluations, debugging tools, and release checks that help the team move faster. At Staff level, you’ll also shape our evaluation and experimentation strategy across agent capabilities, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and raise the broader team’s ability to diagnose and improve agent behavior while remaining hands\-on. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * **A demonstrated track record improving substantial AI agent systems deployed to external customers.** You can explain the system’s scale and complexity, the problems you identified, your hypotheses and experiments, what you personally implemented, and how you established that it improved production outcomes. * **Strong experimental and analytical judgment.** You can define useful baselines, design informative comparisons, reason about noisy or confounded results, and learn from experiments that don’t support your hypothesis. * **Strong software engineering ability.** You can analyze conversational data with code and SQL, debug complex agent behavior, and turn an experimental improvement into maintainable production software. * **Practical understanding of agent systems.** You can reason about how models, instructions, context, tools, and orchestration interact, and weigh quality against latency, reliability, and cost. Specific frameworks matter less than your judgment and results. * **Ownership and clear communication.** You make progress through ambiguity, communicate findings and tradeoffs, and work closely with engineers and product to carry improvements through to customers. * **A desire to work in an early\-stage startup.** You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and high standards. We use AI programming tools heavily and expect you to use them effectively while owning the quality of your work. **Voice experience** -------------------- Hands\-on experience improving production voice agents is strongly preferred. We value experience diagnosing conversational timing, speech recognition and generation, audio quality, and end\-to\-end latency, across any provider or stack. We’re also open to engineers with an exceptional track record improving other customer\-facing agents who can demonstrate strong judgment on voice problems and are excited to develop deeper expertise. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building simulation, replay, or evaluation tools for multi\-turn agents. * Experience developing human review workflows or calibrating automated evaluations against human judgment. * Experience at a strong startup or on a small team with substantial ownership. **Why join Revin** ------------------ You’ll work with a large, varied set of real customer interactions and a short path from an idea to measurable impact. Improvements you ship can reach hundreds of thousands of conversations, and what you learn will help shape the direction of our agent platform. We’re still early. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people, have substantial influence over how we build, and receive meaningful equity ownership with the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * **$225,000–$325,000 base salary**, with final compensation dependent on level. * **Meaningful early equity** in the company you’re helping build. * **Excellent health coverage.** $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance. * **401(k) matching up to 4% of salary.** Contribute 5% to receive the full match. * Unlimited PTO. * Commuter benefits. * Free lunches and dinners in the office. * $100/month gym membership stipend. * Tech equipment of your choice. Compensation Range: $225K \- $325K

jobs.title: Backend Engineer — Integrations (Senior/Staff)
jobs.description: **Senior / Staff Backend Engineer — Integrations** ================================================== Revin · Integrations · Flatiron, New York City **$225,000–$325,000 base salary \+ meaningful early equity** · Full\-time Four days per week in our Flatiron office, with one remote day and flexibility when life comes up. We’re hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Final compensation depends on level, based on your demonstrated experience, scope of ownership, and impact. **About Revin** --------------- Revin builds AI\-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email. Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line. Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior\-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del\-Air, a $300M\+ HVAC and plumbing business. See the impact of our work: we’ve helped Del\-Air book 11,000\+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments. **The role** ------------ Build the backend systems that let AI agents work inside the software our customers run their businesses on. You’ll join our Integrations team to turn CRM changes into timely agent actions and give agents reliable ways to look up information, book appointments, and update customer records. This is a backend and distributed systems role with direct product impact. We build custom integrations with platforms including ServiceTitan, LeadPerfection, AccuLynx, Salesforce and i360, Builder Prime, and SalesRabbit. Each has its own data model, authentication, business rules, and failure modes. Our backend is primarily Python and PostgreSQL, with asynchronous services and event\-driven processing. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly. **What you’ll build** --------------------- * **The event pipelines that keep Revin in sync.** Ingest CRM changes through webhooks, event streams, and polling; maintain fresh, accurate state; and deliver the events that trigger the right agent workflows. * **The tools that let agents take action.** Build APIs and services for customer lookup, availability, appointment booking, and CRM updates, preserving each system’s business rules and returning clear, accurate results to agents. The hard problems live at the boundaries: a webhook arrives twice, a stream disconnects, two workers race, or a CRM accepts a booking but the request times out. You’ll design how the system detects, handles, and recovers from these cases, so customers can trust what our agents do. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Design reliable event processing.** Work through ordering, deduplication, retries, rate limits, concurrency, and backpressure. Build recovery and replay paths that preserve correctness as integrations grow. * **Make CRM actions dependable.** Design clear API contracts, validate inputs and results, and handle partial failures and uncertain write outcomes without creating duplicate or inconsistent records. * **Build and deepen integrations.** Understand partner APIs and customer workflows, add new capabilities, and develop shared components that make integrations easier to extend and maintain. * **Protect data integrity and customer boundaries.** Design sound data models, secure authentication and credential handling, and correct routing across customer accounts, brands, and locations. * **Own reliability in production.** Instrument data freshness, processing lag, and action success; make failures diagnosable; and build tests, alerts, reconciliation, and recovery tools that prevent recurring issues. * **Shape the platform with the team.** Partner with agents engineers, product, and forward\-deployed engineers to prioritize customer needs and make clear tradeoffs around correctness, latency, complexity, and cost. At Staff level, you’ll also guide architecture across the integrations platform, establish stronger patterns for event processing and external actions, and raise the broader team’s effectiveness while remaining hands\-on. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * **Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems.** You can explain the systems you owned, the design decisions you made, how they behaved under failure, and what you improved. * **Strong distributed systems judgment.** You’ve worked with asynchronous processing, queues or streams, concurrency, consistency, and retries, and understand how to preserve correctness when parts of a system fail. * **Experience working across system boundaries.** You can build reliable integrations with external APIs, reason about their constraints, and turn unfamiliar data models and business rules into maintainable software. * **Strong programming and SQL skills.** You’re comfortable with data modeling, transactions, and production debugging, and can work effectively in our Python backend. We care about depth of understanding and execution more than familiarity with a particular framework. * **Ownership and clear communication.** You investigate problems end to end, surface risks early, and explain technical tradeoffs in terms of what customers and the team need. * **A desire to work in an early\-stage startup.** You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and high standards. We use AI programming tools heavily and expect you to use them effectively while owning the quality of your work. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with CRM, scheduling, payments, or other operational systems where data correctness and reliable actions matter. * Experience with change data capture, synchronization, backfills, or reconciliation across external systems. * Experience building tools or APIs used by AI agents. * Experience at a strong startup or on a small team with substantial ownership. **Why join Revin** ------------------ Your work determines which businesses Revin can serve and what our agents can actually do for them. A new integration opens up a customer segment; a more reliable booking or data pipeline improves the experience of businesses using Revin every day. We’re still early. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people, have substantial influence over the architecture of a core part of the product, and receive meaningful equity ownership with the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * **$225,000–$325,000 base salary**, with final compensation dependent on level * **Meaningful early equity** in the company you’re helping build * **Excellent health coverage.** $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance * **401(k) matching up to 4% of salary.** Contribute 5% to receive the full match * Unlimited PTO * Commuter benefits * Free lunches and dinners in the office * $100/month gym membership stipend * Tech equipment of your choice Compensation Range: $225K \- $325K

If you enjoy deep technical work, troubleshooting, reverse engineering, and working with legacy systems, this is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Lead engineering efforts supporting legacy defense electronics programs * Capture and document legacy processes and test methods from experienced technicians * Troubleshoot complex analog, digital, RF, and mixed\-signal assemblies down to the component level * Develop test fixtures, Test procedures, and conformance methods—even when documentation is limited * Design and fabricate simple mechanical fixtures or tooling as needed * Apply mechanical aptitude to support custom manufacturing solutions * Interpret and work from government technical data packages (TDPs), schematics, and legacy drawings * Partner with quality, purchasing, and production teams on root cause analysis, corrective actions, and process improvements * Support sales by providing manufacturability input during quoting and proposal activities * Help preserve and document critical knowledge from experienced engineers and technicians You will collaborate with employees across engineering, testing, manufacturing, and sustainment to help keep our legacy platforms operating at peak performance. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** * Degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology and/or 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in electronics manufacturing and troubleshooting * Strong working knowledge of analog, digital, embedded, RF, or telecom electronics * Ability to troubleshoot circuit card assemblies down to the component level * Understanding of passive and active electrical components and their properties * Ability to read and interpret schematics, drawings, and technical data packages (TDPs) * Experience using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, cable testers (e.g., Cirris), and other bench\-level equipment * Ability to work through and reverse engineer (analyze) hardware with limited or no documentation * Strong documentation, organizational, and communication skills * Interest in learning from experienced engineers and technicians and helping document key processes and knowledge **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE)** EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING IS A STRONG ADVANTAGE: * Familiarity with IPC standards and MIL specifications (e.g., MIL\-STD\-883, MIL\-STD\-202, MIL\-PRF) similar) * Ability to generate or modify Gerber files * Experience with Cirris cable testers or similar equipment * Familiarity with general CAD and schematic capture tools * Mechanical aptitude, including designing simple fixtures * Machining experience **REX SYSTEMS INCORPORATED IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly. * Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs. *
