a successful tapeout and production silicon. * Perform subchip level and block level place and route, and close design to meeting performance, power and area. * Lead and perform all aspects of full chip SoC integration activities: die size optimization, floorplanning, hard IP integration, partitioning, block/chip level clock planning, bump placement / RDL routing, power grid generation, full chip STA timing, DFT strategy planning, and final physical verification. * Good knowledge of timing analysis, power analysis, physical verification (DRC/LVS), and formal verification * Working knowledge of UPF specification in Power Intent design, implementation, and verification of power gating, level shifter, and isolation. * Define EM\-IR signoff requirements and sign\-off methodology. * Define and support Static and Dynamic, thermal, electro\-migration, peak current, di/dt, and effective resistance analysis * Develop and support Chip\-package\-Co\-Analysis (CPA) and Chip\-Power\-Model (CPM) on\- die model for package \& die co\-design analysis * Be an EM\-IR sign\-off lead with successful tape out track records * Excellent hand\-on experience in voltage drop analysis using redhawk or redhawk\-SC * Excellent hand\-on experience and debugging skills of finding root cause of voltage drop and EM issues * Solid background in EM\-IR fundamentals, analytical aptitude and excellent attention to detail * Work closely with the Foundry Engineer and Microarchitecture team to establish logic levels, Multi\-Vt library mixes and choices of tracks, metal\-stackup, etc. * Define flows through various EDA tools and write scripts for automation for floor planning, placement, routing, crosstalk avoidance, judicious usage of cell libraries and physical verification * Work with the Microarchitecture, Signal Integrity, Power Integrity and Thermal team to ensure that the floorplan and the logic is designed in such a way such that the Substrate/Packaging and Board Layout and the Power Delivery comprehend the power domains, multiple voltages, power integrity requirements, power gating, specify power sequencing to eliminate leakage paths, always\-on power, minimize hot\-spots, etc. * Design the floorplan to ensure that the power distribution for the chip for the various voltage domains is consistent with the bump and bump\-ball map to ensure power integrity (i.e., minimize voltage droop, utilization of local LDOs) and signal integrity (e.g., aggressor nets) * Ensure that the clocking architecture is robust and meets the timing requirements – i.e., well versed in Clock Tree Synthesis, Static Timing Analysis, Timing closure methodologies, Clock gating, reference clocks, PLL placement, clock muxing, etc. * Well versed in parasitic extraction, LVS/DRC and other verification checks – Physical, Power, Post\-Layout Timing * At least 12 years of experience in the chip industry with a track record of delivering silicon into volume production across multiple technology generations * Proven track record of SoC definition of complex SoCs over multiple technology generations * BS/MS/PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering with emphasis on Computer Architecture * Experienced in CPU Architecture – preferably Instruction Decode or Execution Units * Experience in Multi SoC systems is a plus * Knowledge of Machine Learning Algorithms (e.g., Convolutional Neural Networks) is a huge plus * Exhibits the right teamwork and leadership qualities backed up with references * Extensive physical design experiences at both the block level and subchip level, as well as full\-chip level is a plus. * Deep knowledge in physical design, including physical aware synthesis, floorplanning, clock tree implementation, routing, STA timing signoff, and chip\-finishing. * Solid experience in advanced process nodes (e.g. 5nm and below) and associated DRC/DFM challenges * Experience with MSCTS or custom H\-tree clock implementation * Good knowledge of basic soc architecture. Be able to work with Front\-end design team to address timing, congestion and power issues. * In\-Depth Knowledge of design flow from RTL to GDSII. * Solid understanding of STA, SDC, MCMM and on\-chip variation * Good knowledge of EM\-IR sign\-off requirements. * Experience in using EDA tools like Synopsys (/Cadence) for PPA optimization. * Good script skills such as python/tcl. * Good communication skills: documentation skills and cross\-functional skills.

jobs.title: Product Concept Lead Engineer
jobs.description: You play a critical role in shaping the future of vehicle programs and systems at the early stages of development. Part of the Vehicle Architecture and concept team, your role is to define, evaluate and refine vehicles and systems concepts balancing Attributes, Manufacturability, Cost efficiency and identifying strategic product positioning. You are directly influencing program profitability by guiding the design decisions that ultimately define vehicle cost structure, investments and long\-term platform scalability and flexibility. You ensure that product concepts are technically feasible, financially viable and aligned with company strategy before significant investment. **Job Duties:** * Develop and evaluate vehicle architecture concepts including platform layout, packaging, structural strategy and rational system integration. * Establish product requirements (range, performance, safety, cost targets, customer experience) and translate them into feasible product concepts. * Manage early stage trade\-off studies across multiple architecture scenarios. * Define concept \-level technical specifications and requirements that will serve as the corner stones of the downstream engineering teams. **Functional integration:*** Working with the Advanced studio team, you will Lead the functions, product planning, finance, manufacturing engineering, procurement, and attributes in order to align concept viability and feasibility with business objectives. * Integrate subsystem constraints (Ergonomy, Battery, Thermal, Chassis, Electrical architecture, manufacturing processes,...) into unified vehicle or system concepts. * Organize vehicle concept workshops and decision reviews. **Cost and Investment Impact:*** You will build and maintain early\-stage cost models including the Advanced Concept BOM, Platform scalability and component carry\-over opportunities, Manufacturing processes and investment cost estimates. * Identify cost drivers embedded in the architectural decisions (structure design complexity, part count, manufacturing methods). * Quantify financial impact of design trade\-offs and support executive decision\-making with cost\-benefit analysis. * Ensure alignment on concept cost and investment targets before kick\-off. **Platform Strategy and Carry Over:*** Design concepts that enable platform commonality, modularity and multi\-model scalability. * Assess long\-term benefits of architectural standardization across vehicle line\-up. * Define Architectural carry\-over opportunities to support strategy roadmap planning and cost. **Feasibility and risk assessment:*** Conduct Concept feasibility analysis covering structural integrity, packaging,thermal performance, safety compliance and manufacturability. * Support concept validation through simulations, and engineering studies. **Decision support and executive communication:*** Prepare concept evaluation reports using confluence, combining technical and financial analysis. * Present architectural options with quantified trade\-offs in cost, performance, investment, resources and planning. * Provide recommendations that optimize the product competitiveness and company’s profit. * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in mechanical engineering, automotive engineering, systems engineering or related field. * Experience in Vehicle architecture, concept engineering, or advanced product development * Strong understanding of automotive systems integration and packaging. * Experience in cost modelling, familiar with design to cost methodologies and different manufacturing processes. * Ability to perform technical trade studies and translate engineering decisions into financial impact. * Working knowledge of regulatory and certification requirements * Proficiency in CAD system, 3D experience.

jobs.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior AI \& Full\-Stack Product Engineer \- Talent Technology** **About the Role** Furniture.com is building an internally developed, AI\-enabled recruiting platform\-and we're looking for a hands\-on engineer to help take it from an early working product to a scalable enterprise application. Initially supporting corporate recruiting for Rooms To Go and Furniture.com, this platform will combine core applicant tracking functionality with AI\-powered search, automation, workflows, and decision support. This is a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up. You'll work directly with Talent Acquisition, HR, and internal AI/technology partners to understand business needs, shape the product roadmap, and turn ideas into technology people actually want to use. **What You'll Do** * Own the continued development of our internal recruiting platform, evolving an existing prototype into a secure, reliable, production\-ready application. * Design and develop full\-stack functionality across the user interface, backend, databases, APIs, and integrations. * Build AI\-powered capabilities using Claude and other leading LLMs, including intelligent candidate search, matching, workflow automation, communication, and recruiter productivity tools. * Develop AI agents, prompts, structured workflows, and human\-in\-the\-loop solutions for real\-world recruiting use cases. * Partner directly with recruiters and HR leaders to translate business problems into practical technology solutions. * Rapidly prototype new ideas, gather user feedback, and iterate. * Integrate the platform with HR systems, job boards, background screening, email/calendar, and other third\-party applications. * Build with enterprise requirements in mind, including security, candidate\-data privacy, role\-based permissions, auditability, reliability, and scalability. * Help establish the technical architecture, development standards, testing, documentation, and long\-term roadmap for the platform. **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated full\-stack application development. * Experience taking applications from prototype or early\-stage development into production. * Hands\-on experience building applications using generative AI/LLMs such as **Claude/Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable platforms**. * Strong experience building and consuming APIs and integrating third\-party systems. * Experience with modern cloud\-based application architecture, databases, authentication, security, testing, and deployment. * Strong product mindset\-you think about the user and business problem, not just the code. * Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make progress when requirements are still evolving. * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non\-technical business partners. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Technical Skills \& Stack** We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than experience with one exact technology. Relevant experience may include: * **Languages \& Frameworks:** TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js or comparable modern frameworks * **AI/LLMs:** Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agentic workflows and LLM evaluation * **AI Search \& Data:** RAG, embeddings, semantic/vector search and retrieval techniques * **Databases:** PostgreSQL, SQL and/or modern NoSQL databases * **APIs \& Integrations:** REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth and third\-party system integrations * **Cloud \& DevOps:** AWS, Azure or GCP; Git/GitHub; CI/CD; containers and modern deployment practices * **Enterprise Applications:** Authentication, role\-based access controls, data security, logging, monitoring and audit trails. Experience with recruiting or HR technology\-including ATS, CRM or HRIS platforms such as Phenom, Avature, Greenhouse, Workday or iCIMS\-is a plus, but not required. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** You are a **builder** who enjoys taking an idea and turning it into a working product. You are comfortable experimenting with emerging AI technology, but you also understand what it takes to build reliable enterprise software. You don't need every requirement perfectly defined before getting started. You ask good questions, solve problems, move quickly, and take ownership. Most importantly, you're excited by the opportunity to help determine what a modern, AI\-enabled recruiting platform should look like\-and then build it.

jobs.title: Partner Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sage Care** ------------------- Sage Care is a fast\-growing, early\-stage healthcare startup transforming care navigation with AI. Our platform helps patients find the right care, enables providers to focus on the people who need them most, and improves access, quality, and economic outcomes at scale. Founded by leaders from Apple, Uber, and Carbon Health, Sage Care is backed by top\-tier investors including General Catalyst and Chelsea Clinton. We work with health systems across the U.S. and have expanded internationally to the MENA region, where we are partnering with healthcare organizations to deploy our AI\-powered care navigation platform. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Partner Engineer to own the technical relationship with 3–5 of our health system partners, from first integration through go\-live, expansion, and day\-to\-day operations. We call our customers partners because we work that closely with them. Every partner is scaling with us: adding clinics, workflows, and call volume. We're growing from a handful of partners, and each one needs to feel supported and never forgotten. The Partner Engineer is the person who makes that true. This is a high\-ownership role at the intersection of engineering, customer relationships, and product. You'll connect Sage Care to partners' EHRs and phone systems. You'll configure and launch our AI voice and matching products for each partner's workflows, and you'll be the first responder when something breaks. You'll work inside partners' environments alongside their IT, access, and clinical teams, and bring what you learn back to our product and engineering teams. This role is ideal for a strong engineer who likes being close to customers, is energized by messy real\-world systems like Epic, HL7, faxes, and phone trees, and wants to turn one\-off partner work into a repeatable playbook. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Own Partner Relationships** * Serve as the technical owner and trusted point of contact for 3–5 health system partners. * Keep partners and Sage Care leadership informed with clear, regular communication. * Spend time on\-site with partners during integrations and go\-lives. * Support pre\-sale conversations and scoping with prospective partners. **Connect Sage Care to Partner Systems** * Connect Sage Care to each partner's systems, workflows, and data. * Build partner\-specific tooling, automations, and integrations when needed. * Work closely with our Epic integration team and partner IT teams to deliver EHR work. **Launch and Improve Agents** * Configure, test, and launch Sage Care's AI agents for each partner. * Tune agent behavior and the patient experience using real call data. * Help partners expand to new clinics, workflows, and use cases. **Keep Partners Live and Healthy** * Be the first responder when something breaks, and close the loop with partners. * Monitor partner quality and catch issues before partners notice them. * Report on partner performance with metrics partners trust. **Work Across Teams** * Help product and engineering discover, triage, and prioritize issues from the field. * Turn partner feedback and recurring problems into product improvements. * Contribute to internal projects beyond your own partners. **Make Every Partner Easier Than the Last** * Turn one\-off partner work into repeatable processes, tooling, and documentation. * Use AI and automation to create leverage in your own work. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * 4\+ years of Partner, solutions, or forward\-deployed engineering experience, with strong coding and SQL skills. * Experience integrating with and debugging third\-party systems in production. * Strong communication skills with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * A high\-ownership generalist who enjoys juggling many partners and projects. * Willingness to travel to partner sites, up to 50%, concentrated around integrations and go\-lives. * Experience in healthcare, or a strong interest in working in it. **Even Better** * Experience with Epic or other EHR integrations. * Experience at a startup. * Experience with voice AI, telephony, or LLM\-based products. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Every partner you own has a clear technical owner, trusts you, and never feels forgotten. * New partners go from signed to live faster, with fewer custom steps each time. * Partner issues are caught and resolved quickly, often before the partner notices. * Onboarding a new clinic or partner follows a shared runbook and go\-live checklist, and partner\-specific knowledge lives in config and tooling, not in one person's head. * Engineering priorities reflect real partner needs because you brought the evidence. * Your partners expand with Sage Care, adding clinics, workflows, and use cases. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- Our product only works when it's connected to a partner's real systems and workflows: their EHR, their phone lines, their SOPs, and their people. Integration and launch are where most healthcare AI deployments stall. As we grow from a handful of partners to 20\+, the Partner Engineer is how we keep the close, hands\-on partnerships that set Sage Care apart, while making each launch faster and more reliable than the last. **How We Work** --------------- At Sage Care, our values shape how we build, collaborate, and serve. * **Do Good Through Serving People:** We serve users, teammates, and communities with integrity, compassion, kindness, and optimism. * **Innovate with Safety, Evidence, and Transparency:** We move quickly while prioritizing trust, safety, ethical decision\-making, and evidence\-based approaches. * **Lead with Curiosity and Kindness:** We ask questions before making assumptions and approach discovery, debate, and problem\-solving with humility and care. * **We, Not Me:** We believe the best work happens through collaboration, mutual respect, and constructive feedback. * **Efficiency and AI in All We Do:** We use automation and AI thoughtfully to work smarter, create leverage, and build better products. Compensation Range: $145K \- $160K

jobs.title: Principal AI Application Engineer - FDE Intelligent Operations
jobs.description: **Company Description** Work in SAP's global development ecosystem where expertise is valued. You will collaborate across regions, share insights, and contribute to shaping industry\-leading practices. **Job Description** **About the Role** *This role is part of Intelligent Operations team: "We support and guardrail AI forward deployed engineering engagements across SAP industries, ensuring quality, security and lasting impact."* **What you’ll build** You’re building Intelligent Operations from the ground up. This capability doesn’t exist at scale yet — you’ll define how it works. **Handover model:** Take care of what “production\-ready” looks like when an FDE engagement transitions from Value Delivery to Value Operation. You own the handover framework — what needs to be in place before your team takes over. **Run\-team operations:** Build the monitoring, alerting, and incident response capability for deployed AI solutions. Ensure contractual SLA commitments are met — not by heroics, but by design. **AI quality in production:** Drift detection, performance benchmarking, guardrails validation, retraining triggers. The solutions we deploy use LLMs and agents — production quality assurance looks fundamentally different here than in classical software. **Operational governance:** Establish best practices for production security, data boundaries, and compliance across customer engagements. Work with other engineers to ensure the enterprise bar holds post\-deployment and establish self\-healing capabilities. **Scalable operations:** What works for one customer engagement needs to work for fifty. You’ll design the operational model to scale — tooling, automation, partner integration — so that every new go\-live doesn’t require reinventing the wheel. You’ll work closely with the Knowledge \& IP team to capture operational learnings and feed them back into the delivery lifecycle, so the next collaboration starts stronger. **Where you belong** T\&O is the engineering backbone of CIS Forward Deployed Engineering. Our mission: ensure quality, security, and lasting impact across AI engagements for SAP’s industry customers. You’ll sit in the Intelligent Operations pillar — the part of T\&O that owns what happens after go\-live. Deployed solutions stay healthy and improve. That’s the mandate. This is a leadership role without a management title. You’ll mentor engineers, set operational standards, and build the technical capabilities of a team that’s being assembled now. You’ll work globally, across FDE squads and hubs, with external delivery partners, and directly with customers when production demands it. If you’ve spent your career at the intersection of SRE, AI systems, and enterprise operations — and you want to build something new rather than maintain something existing — this is the role. You can spot drift in agentic application behavior before it becomes a customer escalation. You’ve operated in regulated or enterprise\-grade settings where compliance, security posture, and operational governance aren’t optional. And you can translate that experience into standards, playbooks, and repeatable processes that a growing team can follow. You’re comfortable working across organizational boundaries — with delivery squads, engineering/ platform teams, and customers/ external partners — and you can hold your ground in a room full of architects who built the thing you now need to run. **Skills used in this role** AI adoption mindset, AI output quality assurance, AI\-assisted development, Context engineering, Agentic orchestration, Agentic engineering, Application security, Cloud architecture, Observability, High availability engineering, Troubleshooting, Evaluations and benchmarking engineering, CI/CD. jobs.title: Layout Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** This position focuses on developing, maintaining, and releasing overall 2D plant layouts using AutoCAD within an automotive manufacturing environment. The candidate will integrate supplier drawings, verify spatial accuracy through field checks, ensure compliance with CAD standards, and collaborate with launch teams to optimize production flow and support vehicle build and installation activities. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain overall 2D plant layouts using AutoCAD aligned with production flow and plant constraints, integrating tooling, tool rails, platforms, and assembly aids from suppliers and contractors. * Release weekly layout updates to the core product launch team. * Create AutoCAD blocks for carriers, tooling, tool presentation, and aisles, evaluating interferences and providing technical resolutions. * Perform field checks to identify fixed monuments and confirm layout accuracy. * Supply build and installation drawings directly to the build team. * Participate in pilot builds and process validation to verify layout fidelity and resolve spatial or design issues. * Follow customer CAD standards, including layer structures, file naming conventions, and Xrefs. * Upload and maintain all current layout files within Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC). **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 5 years of automotive manufacturing experience with strong proficiency in AutoCAD. * **Technical Skills:** Proven knowledge in creating, managing, and maintaining standard block libraries in AutoCAD. * **Standards Compliance:** Familiarity with managing CAD layer conventions, Xrefs, and cloud\-based file management environments (ACC). **Preferred Skills** * Knowledge of converting 2D layouts to 3D using AutoCAD Factory Design Utilities / PDMC tools. * Proficiency in 3D visualization and rendering using Autodesk Navisworks.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **Build What's Next in Aerospace** For nearly a century, Simmonds Precision has been helping shape the future of flight from our home in Vergennes, Vermont. Today, our technologies are trusted across hundreds of commercial and military aircraft platforms worldwide, helping aircraft operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. At Simmonds Precision, we design and manufacture advanced sensing, monitoring, fuel management, and precision control technologies that solve some of aerospace's most demanding challenges. Behind every solution is a team of talented people who bring together engineering expertise, advanced manufacturing, craftsmanship, and a drive to innovate. When you join Simmonds Precision, you're not just taking the next step in your career, you're contributing to technology that takes flight around the world. Whether your expertise is in engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, or business support, there's an opportunity to make your mark. Find your next opportunity where precision meets possibility—and build your career in aerospace with Simmonds Precision. **What You Will Do** As a Software Engineer, you will leverage cutting\-edge development workflows to build the precise, intelligent, and secure software powering tomorrow's Monitoring and Actuation Systems. While ensuring the reliability of our existing production software, you will actively innovate—engineering next\-generation, mission\-critical solutions trusted in the world's most demanding environments. Your focus will center on two core product lines: * Health Usage Monitoring Systems (HUMS): Empowering aircraft operators to analyze fleet conditions, predict emerging mechanical anomalies early, and optimize maintenance schedules with high accuracy and confidence. * Aircraft Actuation Systems: Transforming control inputs into deterministic, high\-precision movement across flight control surfaces. You will support varied rotary/linear architectures, AC/DC power frameworks, and fly\-by\-wire system compliance. You will join our Next Generation Engineering Team—a collaborative unit of innovators and aviation enthusiasts redefining modern HUMS and actuation technologies. We balance deep technical rigor with a dynamic, fast\-iterating startup energy. This is an environment built for hands\-on experimentation with cutting\-edge tools to shape the future. **What You Will Learn** * Develop and optimize embedded flight\-software for safety\-critical systems used in commercial aircraft and military platforms. * Write high\-performance, deterministic code and conduct debugging and validation using simulation tools. * Collaborate closely with systems engineers, hardware teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet stringent aviation safety, performance, and certification requirements. * Implement and support AI\-assisted onboard features. * Conduct debugging and validation using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, hardware debuggers, simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) environments. * Ensure compliance with aviation safety standards such as DO\-178, and adherence to secure coding and cyber\-resilience practices. * Participate in flight\-test operations, lab testing, and simulation runs to evaluate system performance under real\-world and mission\-critical conditions. **Qualifications You Must Have** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date. * Experience may be obtained through on\-the\-job experience, research, coursework, or projects. **Qualifications We Prefer** * Prior internship, co\-op, or work experience. * An emphasis on strong collaboration and communication skills, with a desire to achieve world class abilities to work within dynamic teams to solve challenging problems. * Basic understanding of aircraft operational fundamentals is highly desirable, as the role involves executing flight test scenarios to validate system functionality and performance. This hands\-on work will enable the candidate to directly contribute to the advancement of next\-generation aerospace technologies. **Why Join Simmonds Precision?** At Simmonds Precision, you won't just be filling a position, you'll be developing skills in an industry where precision matters. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, gain hands\-on manufacturing experience, and contribute to products used in demanding aerospace applications. **Compensation \& Benefits** Great work deserves great rewards—and benefits that support you both at work and beyond. Our comprehensive total rewards package is designed to help you stay healthy, build financial security, enjoy time away from work, and continue growing throughout your career. * **Health \& Wellness:** Take care of yourself and your family with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA options, and convenient access to an onsite cafeteria and fitness center. * **Invest in Your Future:** Enjoy competitive pay, an annual bonus opportunity, and a 401(k)\-retirement plan that includes up to a 4% company match plus an additional annual employer contribution starting at 3%. Company\-paid life and disability insurance provide additional financial protection and peace of mind. * **Time to Recharge:** We believe time away from work matters. Enjoy four weeks of vacation, plus five additional paid days during our annual holiday shutdown, paid sick leave, and paid maternity and paternity leave—giving you more time for the moments that matter. * **Grow Your Career:** Keep building your skills and advancing your career with up to $20,000 in annual tuition reimbursement, along with ongoing professional development and learning opportunities. * **Benefits Beyond the Basics:** Choose from additional programs designed to make life a little easier, including supplemental insurance, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), legal services, identity theft protection, discounted auto and home insurance, and pet insurance. Your career is more than a paycheck. Join a company that invests in your health, your future, your growth, and your life outside of work. Shift: First Shift Compensation: $57,200\-108,800/year

jobs.title: Mechanical/Robotics Engineering Technician I
jobs.description: SEL is looking for a people\-oriented Mechanical/Robotics Engineering Technician to join our Product Support and Development \- Mechanical team in our Manufacturing Division. Our team develops and integrates mechanical and robotic solutions for our manufacturing facilities that enable us to build our products in a safer, more reliable, or more economical way. As a technician in this role, day\-to\-day is a mix of hands\-on design work, problem\-solving, and working directly with your customers. You’ll collaborate on everything from problem statement creation to solution integration and closing out the projects. You’ll primarily be assisting in the development of automation solutions that make our production environments safer, more reliable, and more economical. You’ll use tools like collaborative/industrial robotics, end\-of\-arm tooling, computer vision tools, and self\-developed mechanical tools/fixtures. CAD work is a regular thing, whether you're building new designs or tweaking existing ones. Our solutions will be brought to life on the production floor so making sure they actually work in the real world is huge. Design quality and collaboration are a big part of our day, so expect to be involved in design reviews and giving/receiving feedback. While you contribute to projects as part of a small agile team, you'll be focused on delivering results on time and within budget while also developing your skillsets and supporting production staff to grow theirs as well. **Required Qualifications:** * 2\-year\+ technical degree or the equivalent combination of training and work experience + Competence with applied physics, geometry, algebra, and basic trigonometry + CAD experience * Approximately **2\+ years of experience** in three or more of the following areas: + Automation integration + Materials and processes + Mechanics + Manufacturing engineering + Electronic manufacturing techniques * Strong **problem\-solving skills** * Clear and effective **communication skills**—written, verbal, and documentation * Quick to **learn new skills** and open to **taking on new responsibilities** * Works well in **team environments** * Must pass a **background check** and **drug test** per SEL requirements **Preferred Qualifications:** If you’ve worked with robotics, especially Universal Robots Cobots, and vision systems, that’s a big plus. Experience supporting design, automation, or general engineering in a manufacturing setting is highly valuable. And if you’ve written or run Design of Experiments before, even better. **Location(s): (Will work from both locations, about 45 min apart)** * **Lewiston, ID** – This position is located in Lewiston, ID where you'll enjoy an unmatched quality of life. Enjoy the smaller town life: country space, freedom from traffic, easy access to recreational activities in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests, as well as great schools and universities. * **Pullman, WA** – This position is located in Pullman, WA. Nestled in Eastern Washington, offering an exceptional quality of life. Embrace the charm of small\-town living with spacious surroundings, no traffic hassles, and easy access to outdoor adventures in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests. Plus, benefit from excellent schools and universities in the area. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Pay Range Data \-** **$31\.00 \- $46\.00** **per hour** We set starting pay based on job\-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. We are looking to fill this position at a level 1, and we welcome applicants with a range of experience. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly. Technician I: $31\.00\-$46\.00 per hour Technician II: $33\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Technician III: $39\.00 \- $59\.00 per hour **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: **About us** Search Miners is a white\-hat SEO and GEO agency with clients worldwide. We help businesses show up in Google and in AI search tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. We also build our own software for clients and for internal use. **The role** We need a developer who ships fast using AI coding tools and actually understands the code those tools write. You'll take projects that are already well underway and get them finished, deployed, and working for real users. Then you'll keep building. This is a contract role. If the work is good, it becomes steady, ongoing work. **What you'll do** * Finish and deploy web apps that are mostly built * Build new features in an existing codebase * Fix bugs and clean up code that AI tools wrote badly * Connect third\-party tools like Stripe and Google APIs * Keep things secure, especially user data and API keys * Communicate clearly in writing about what's done, what's blocked, and how long things will take **Our stack** * Next.js and TypeScript * Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage) * Vercel * GitHub * Claude Code, Cursor, or whatever AI tools you're fastest with **What we're looking for** * You've built and deployed real web apps that people use * You use AI coding tools every day and can read and fix what they produce * Solid with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase or a similar Postgres setup * You understand auth, environment variables, and basic security * Comfortable with Git * Clear written English * Able to overlap 3 to 4 hours a day with US Eastern time **How we hire** We care more about your work than your resume. * Send us the application below * Shortlisted people get a small **paid** trial project * If the trial goes well, we get on a call * Then we start ongoing work **How to apply** Email **info@searchminers.com** with the subject line: **Builder: \[Your Full Name]** Include: * A link to a live app or site you built, plus your GitHub or a code sample. Tell us what you built yourself, where AI helped, and one thing that broke and how you fixed it. * Which AI coding tools you use, and how you check their output before you ship it. * Your hourly rate in USD and how many hours a week you're available. Optional but a big plus: a 2 to 3 minute screen recording (Loom or similar) walking through some code you wrote. **Applications without the subject line, or applications sent only through the job board, won't be reviewed.** Pay: $15\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

Our companies span the areas of health, energy, and ecology with many emergent projects in development. Founded by Dr. Zach Bush, we are committed to developing products and services that transform the world for better. Sourced from 60\-million\-year\-old soil, the ION\* line of products naturally supports microbiome balance for your gut and skin. ION\* Intelligence of Nature is dedicated to advancing human health through science\-backed, nature\-derived solutions. This can be observed by the Brand Director through site analytics, test records, and the reliability of campaign launch execution. **Responsibilities:** **Website Development and Maintenance (Primary Focus)** * Build, update, and maintain landing pages within the Shopify storefront in support of product launches, campaigns, and seasonal promotions. * Develop and maintain theme code (Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to ensure the site remains stable, responsive, and consistent with brand standards. * Configure and manage Shopify functionality as required, including metafields, product and collection structures, navigation, and third\-party applications. * Monitor site performance, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals; identify and resolve issues affecting load speed or checkout completion. * Review the installed application stack and recommend consolidation or removal where tools duplicate function or degrade site performance. * Coordinate with external agency and platform partners on matters outside in\-house capability, including SEO, hosting, and application support. * Test all changes in a staging environment prior to publication and verify functionality following assets required for testing. **Analytics, Reporting, and Documentation** * Maintain analytics and tag management implementation in GA4 or an equivalent platform, ensuring events, conversions, and product availability, inventory messaging, and site content aligned. * Support business continuity by responding to urgent site issues, including after\-hours escalation when a customer\-facing function is affected. * Maintain awareness of Shopify platform updates and emerging e\-commerce tools, recommending adoption where relevant. **Core Competencies:** Job Specific Knowledge, skills, and jobs.title: Data Engineer III, AI Platform
jobs.description: The Data Engineer III, AI Platform builds and operates reusable data pipelines and AI\-ready platform services for Hawaii Mobility. This senior individual contributor engineers governed feature, context, and evaluation pipelines for predictive and generative AI, and implements the data and platform components of MLOps and LLMOps patterns designed with the Data \& AI Architect under the Director, Enterprise Architecture. The role owns reliability for the assets it ships and mentors engineers through review and pairing; the function is led by its Director and reports to the VP, Data \& AI. **KEY OUTCOMES:** **Production Pipelines and Frameworks** * Build and own reusable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and serving patterns across batch and streaming workloads on Databricks. Develop connectors, recovery paths, schema evolution, and certified data sets for reporting, applications, and AI. Implement automated reconciliation, data quality, freshness, lineage, and access controls so production pipelines and AI context remain reliable and governed. * **AI Enablement Engineering** * Engineer feature, context, and retrieval pipelines \- document ingestion, metadata, embeddings, and indexes \- to solution designs agreed with the Data \& AI Architect. * Build versioned evaluation data, model and agent monitoring feeds, feedback capture, and identity\-aware feature tables, APIs, and event streams. Implement the data and platform components of MLOps and LLMOps delivery. * Maintain and develop the semantic/ontology layer that informs Servco's LLMs and extends our data understanding to LLM platforms such as OpenAI and Claude. * Tune Servco's LLMs for accuracy and review feedback via the Genie admin console. Assist with the implementation and maintenance of AI agents within our enterprise platforms to automate repetitive work and remove bottlenecks in the solution development lifecycle * **Infrastructure and Reliability** * Implement reproducible environments, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, alerting, and runbooks. Tune workload performance and cloud cost within approved architecture and security standards. Own reliability, incident response, and recovery for the assets you ship. Improve testing and release practices from production learning. * **Partnership and Mentorship** * Work with the Manager, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineers, architecture, and operators to translate customer and operating needs into dependable data products; support agreed shared capabilities. * Mentor newer engineers through code review and pairing, document reusable patterns, and retain critical know\-how in Servco\-controlled systems. Training and supporting forward deployed team members in implementing AI solutions in line with architecture, implementation and platform standards * **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education:** Relevant degree or equivalent demonstrated experience. * **Work Experience:** * 6\-10 years building production data pipelines and platforms, with strong Python, SQL, Spark, and Databricks engineering on Azure or a comparable cloud. * Experience building reusable frameworks, automated tests, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observable production services. * Hands\-on AI\-ready pipelines for features, retrieval corpora, or evaluation data, with practical MLOps or LLMOps deployment and monitoring experience. Record of operating reliable data products, resolving incidents, tuning cost and performance, and mentoring engineers. * **Skills:** * Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and an ability to anticipate how changes in business workflows affect data and platform design. MLflow or comparable model lifecycle tools, Unity Catalog, vector search, event integration, and automotive or retail operations data. (Preferred) * **About Servco:** At Servco, we’re committed to providing valuable mobility solutions to empower people through the freedom of movement and opportunity. From Australia to California, and of course, Hawaii, Team Servco is a collective of over 2,000 like\-minded individuals guided by our four Core Values of Respect, Service, Teamwork, and Innovation. For over 100 years, we have been dedicated to superior service, to both our customers and team members. jobs.title: Innovation Mechanical Engineer I
jobs.description: Description: **Join the Innovation Team at Sherman \+ Reilly** **Most engineering jobs start with a spec. This one starts with a challenge.** Sherman \+ Reilly, a Chattanooga\-based manufacturer of tools and equipment for the electric utility industry and part of the Quanta Services family of companies, is seeking an Innovation Mechanical Engineer I for its innovation team. We work upstream of traditional New Product Development to explore emerging technologies, solve field\-driven problems, and build practical new equipment for the industry. This is not a design role focused on incrementally improving an existing product line. Projects begin with an operational challenge, an early idea, or an unfamiliar technology, and you work the full cycle from concept through analysis, prototype, test, field evaluation, and technical handoff. **Build, test, break, repeat —** Rapid prototyping is how we learn. Simple models and experiments answer the important questions quickly, and we would rather fail early than polish the wrong idea. **Get close to the work —** We understand the problem before committing to a solution. You will spend real time with linemen, field personnel, and technicians, see how work is actually done, and develop several concepts rather than converging on the first. **Real influence —** We are a small team, and you will have a genuine voice in how it operates. The concepts we prove out can shape Sherman \+ Reilly’s product portfolio and the company’s performance. **Two responsibilities —** Technology Exploration: exploring, developing, and proving next\-generation technologies and equipment that may enter our product roadmap or another commercialization pathway. Field Engineering Support: occasional calls into the field for investigations that require critical thinking, observation, and analysis to determine root cause and potential corrective action. See the environment and people we design for: a tour of Quanta’s Lazy Q Ranch in La Grange, Texas, where crews train on energized lines, robotic arms, and helicopter operations. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=ApDbX64SOWg **Our purpose: Getting every lineman home, every night. No exceptions.** **You Might Be a Fit If** You have built something that mattered to you, on a Formula or Baja SAE team, in a lab, or in a garage, and you can’t leave a problem alone until you understand it. You would rather learn by building and testing, and you are comfortable saying, “I don’t know yet — here is how I would find out.” **What You’ll Do** **Define the problem —** Engage directly with field users, turn loosely defined problems into testable hypotheses, and research emerging and competitive technologies. **Design \& analyze —** Compare multiple concepts, including off\-the\-shelf options, and produce calculations, CAD models, and drawings in SolidWorks, scaling analysis, including FEA, to the technical risk. **Prototype \& test —** Build prototypes with technicians and suppliers, run bench, structural, and field tests, use sensors and data acquisition to validate assumptions, and iterate. **Communicate \& hand off —** Document results and lessons learned, present recommendations to engineers, leadership, and field personnel, support occasional field investigations, and help hand validated concepts to New Product Development, other Quanta organizations, or other commercialization pathways. Projects may involve technologies new to you, including hydraulics, electrification, sensors and automation, robotics, unmanned aerial systems, additive manufacturing, and artificial intelligence and its engineering applications. We expect capable, willing learners, not experts in all of them. Requirements: * Entry level through approximately two years of relevant experience * Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals and proficiency with 3D CAD; SolidWorks preferred * Strong mechanical aptitude and willingness to work hands\-on with prototypes, test equipment, technicians, and field personnel * Clear communication, curiosity about unfamiliar technologies, and the ability to collaborate and manage several assignments **Preferred Qualifications** Experience or interest in machine and structural design, FEA, hydraulics, automation, robotics, or unmanned aerial systems; prototype fabrication and testing; and sensors and data\-acquisition systems. Experience using AI tools in an engineering environment, for design exploration and analysis is a plus. Formula or Baja SAE, maker projects, internships, and co\-ops all count. **What We Expect of an Innovation Engineer I** * Apply engineering fundamentals to practical problems with guidance from more experienced engineers * Develop CAD models, drawings, calculations, prototypes, and test setups * Participate directly in field observation, prototype builds, and testing * Take increasing ownership of defined portions of development projects **Emphasis: technical growth, curiosity, learning velocity, and the judgment to separate assumptions from facts.** **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** The role combines office and CAD work with prototype\-shop, test\-field, and field observation activity, with some travel to field operations, suppliers, and other Quanta organizations. Candidates should be comfortable working in manufacturing and prototype environments, standing for extended periods, climbing on equipment during testing, using hand tools, occasionally lifting up to 50 pounds, and working outdoors during field testing. **What We Offer** Competitive compensation; a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off and holidays; career growth and development; a close\-knit team backed by the resources of a Quanta Services company; and life in Chattanooga, a city recognized for quality of life, outdoor access, and a lower cost of living. **Apply Today** If you’re ready to help explore, build, and prove the next generation of equipment for the electric utility industry, we encourage you to apply. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Sherman \+ Reilly, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. *Notice to Recruiting Agencies: Sherman \+ Reilly does not accept unsolicited resumes or inquiries from staffing or recruiting agencies. Any resumes submitted without a signed agreement in place will be considered the property of Sherman \+ Reilly and will not be subject to placement fees.*

We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. **Transform the everyday with us!** The **Cybersecurity** **Engineer** designs, implements, and supports secure Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) solutions for federal and mission\-critical environments. Learn more about our team, values, and the individuals who have led the agency since its inception in 1996 at silvertech.com. **Our vision is to set the standard for digital excellence by building proactive, enduring partnerships that move clients forward with clarity and confidence.** We are seeking a **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Team Lead** to lead our SRE team and evolve our managed hosting practice. You’ll be a hands\-on technical leader—setting the team’s direction, mentoring and developing team members, and partnering with internal teams and clients to deploy, support, and improve infrastructure, while taking ownership of systems end to end. initiatives. * Review the team’s technical output—system changes, configurations, pipelines, and documentation—to ensure quality, security, and consistency with established standards. * Support each **Hosting Operations \& Reliability** * Own day\-to\-day performance, security, and reliability of client hosting environments across Azure, AWS, WP Engine, and Windows Server/IIS. * Maintain proactive monitoring, identifying and resolving issues before client impact, while delivering a high\-touch, white\-glove support experience. * Own the on\-call rotation and incident response process to support 24/7 client coverage, participating in the rotation and serving as the lead point of contact for major incidents and outages. **Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineering** * Architect and implement secure, resilient hosting environments with best practices for redundancy, disaster recovery, and multi\-cloud strategies. * Define and maintain infrastructure as code to ensure consistency and scalability across environments. * Manage Azure services (App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, Application Insights) and legacy AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3\). **DevOps \& Deployment** * Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, ensuring reliable and repeatable deployments. * Manage SSL/TLS lifecycle, DNS configurations, and domain services across platforms. * Support SSO integrations and identity configurations tied to hosted applications. **Systems Administration** * Administer Windows Server and IIS environments, including performance tuning, patching, and configuration management. * Oversee WP Engine\-hosted WordPress environments, including updates and platform configurations. **Collaboration \& Client Engagement** * Serve as the senior escalation point for hosting\-related issues, providing root\-cause analysis and long\-term solutions. * Partner with development teams to align infrastructure with application architecture and support go\-live readiness. * Engage directly with clients to gather requirements, communicate technical decisions, and act as a trusted advisor. **Standards \& Continuous Improvement** * Lead the evolution of SilverTech’s hosting practice by improving reliability, security, and operational standards, and ensure they are understood and followed across the team. * Partner with the Chief Innovation Officer on hosting strategy, roadmap planning, budgeting, and vendor relationships, providing regular updates on team performance, risks, and priorities. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to enhance processes, tooling, and overall service delivery. **What You Need to Succeed:** * 7\+ years of experience in systems administration, cloud infrastructure, or hosting environments, including 2\+ years leadership/management. * Expertise in Microsoft Azure hosting services, including App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, Application Insights, and networking. * Strong experience administering Windows Server and IIS in production environments. * Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure, including EC2, RDS, and S3\. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline management in Azure DevOps. * Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation. * Solid understanding of cloud security principles, including IAM, network security, and vulnerability management. * Strong communication and client\-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * A service\-oriented mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and responsiveness. **Experience That Will Set You Apart:** * Working with people, not just pipelines. This role involves interacting with internal and external clients. * Advanced experience with Cloudflare, especially in a SAAS setting. * Experience supporting .NET\-based applications in Azure. * Familiarity with WP Engine or similar managed WordPress hosting platforms. * Experience leading or mentoring engineers—assigning work, coaching, and contributing to hiring and performance reviews—and influencing technical direction. **Location:** This role offers flexibility based on candidate location and business needs, with the option to work hybrid from our Bedford, NH office or fully remote within the U.S. **Our Benefits:** * Strong compensation package * Competitive health packages * 401k with company match * Flexible work schedules * Hybrid workweek * Unlimited PTO after 5 years * Your birthday off * Regular learning \& development opportunities * Monthly company\-provided lunches * A fun, collaborative, and innovative team that actually likes working together * Cutting\-edge technology and creative freedom * Regular crew events, outings, and more! *SilverTech, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. jobs.title: Sr Facility Analyst
jobs.description: **SitelogIQ** is a rapidly growing company focused on making buildings better. We provide planning, design, and management solutions for organizations that want efficient and sustainable building environments that are healthier and safer for their occupants. The **Senior Facility Analyst** leads large, complex Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) projects for clients nationwide. This role combines hands\-on building systems expertise with project leadership, field\-team coordination, and capital planning. You’ll evaluate facility conditions, identify deficiencies and capital improvement opportunities, develop preliminary scopes and budgets, and present recommendations to clients. You’ll also lead assessment teams and collaborate closely with Engineers, Architects, and Operations professionals. **Base Compensation:** 105K\-125K **Work Arrangement:** Remote when not at a client site **Travel:** Up to 50% nationwide travel #### **What You’ll Do** * Lead Facility Condition Assessment projects from planning and fieldwork through quality review and final deliverables. * Direct field assessment teams and ensure accurate, consistent documentation and data collection. * Evaluate HVAC, plumbing, electrical, life safety, security, building envelope, interiors, and site systems. * Assess system condition, deficiencies, remaining useful life, and capital replacement needs. * Review drawings, maintenance records, prior studies, and facility information to support assessment findings. * Develop capital improvement recommendations, preliminary scopes of work, priorities, and rough\-order\-of\-magnitude budgets. * Review assessment data, condition ratings, photos, and recommendations for quality and accuracy. * Collaborate with Engineers, Architects, and Operations teams to refine project recommendations. * Present assessment findings, facility needs, and budget assumptions to clients. #### **What We’re Looking For** * Relevant experience in **facility assessments, facilities management, engineering, architecture, construction, capital planning, or HVAC/building systems**. * Strong practical knowledge of building systems, maintenance needs, and capital replacement planning. * Experience independently leading complex projects and directing field teams. * Experience developing facility improvement recommendations, preliminary scopes, and budget estimates. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings to nontechnical clients. * Comfortable working with digital assessment platforms, spreadsheets, tablets, and field data collection tools. * Degree in engineering, architecture, facilities management, construction management, or a related technical field preferred. Equivalent education, training, and experience will be considered. * **K\-12, facilities management, capital planning, or large facility portfolio experience is a plus.** #### **Work Environment** This is a hands\-on role that may involve walking large facilities, climbing stairs or ladders, and accessing mechanical rooms, rooftops, attics, crawl spaces, and other building areas. Candidates should be comfortable working in active facility environments and occasionally lifting up to **40 lbs.** **No agencies please** **Benefits** We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Disability and life insurance * 401K * Flex time off * 12 paid holidays * Tuition reimbursement * Opportunities to drive our DE\&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization or Women Inspiring \& Strengthening Everyone * Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers **More About SitelogIQ** At SitelogIQ, we’re focused on creating a great environment for our team first so that it is more energizing and rewarding to focus on creating a great customer experience. With offices across the country, it’s rewarding to make a difference in the communities where our teammates live and work. **SitelogIQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify.** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Socure?** --------------- Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **About the role** ------------------ As an IT Support Engineer, you are the face of IT for our San Francisco office and a core member of the wider IT team. You will resolve end\-user issues across macOS and Windows, keep our collaboration stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom) working, and run the office AV and device lifecycle. You work independently on most tickets, escalate well when needed, and leave behind documentation and automation so the same issue does not come back. You will be onsite in our SF office at\-minimum three days a week and will also be available to provide remote support to the rest of the workforce globally. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Resolve requests and incidents.** Own tickets end to end for hardware, software, access, and collaboration issues, meeting SLAs and communicating clearly with the requester. * **Provide deskside and remote support.** Support employees at every level, including executives, in person in the SF office and remotely for distributed teams. * **Manage endpoints.** Provision, enroll, deploy, repair, and retire macOS and peripherals through MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune), including onboarding and offboarding hardware. Experience with VDI’s a plus. * **Support identity and access.** Handle routine Okta and Google Workspace tasks: MFA and FastPass enrollment, lockouts, group and application access, and shared drive permissions, following least\-privilege and approval requirements. * **Support collaboration tools.** Troubleshoot Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom for end users, including account, calendar, sharing, and meeting issues, and escalate platform\-level problems with clear detail. * **Run office technology.** Maintain conference room AV (Zoom Rooms and similar), first\-line Wi\-Fi and wired network troubleshooting, and coordinate with other IT engineers on escalations. * **Track assets.** Keep hardware inventory accurate across the lifecycle, from procurement and deployment to return and disposal. * **Improve the system.** Write knowledge\-base articles, spot recurring ticket patterns, and automate repetitive work with scripts or workflows. Propose root\-cause fixes, not workarounds. **What you bring** ------------------ * 2\-4 years of hands\-on IT support experience in a corporate or SaaS environment. * Working proficiency in macOS and Windows troubleshooting, including imaging or enrollment, disk encryption, and common application issues. * Experience with an MDM platform (Jamf, Intune, or similar). * Familiarity with Okta and Google Workspace administration at the support level. * Working knowledge of Slack and Zoom administration or end\-user support. * Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and Wi\-Fi troubleshooting. * Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical issues to non\-technical colleagues calmly and without jargon. * Good judgment on security: you verify identity before granting access and know when to escalate. * Ability to work onsite in San Francisco three days per week and lift up to 50 lbs for equipment handling. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience with ITIL practices, Jira Service Management, or SLA\-driven support queues. * Scripting in Bash, Python, or PowerShell, or low\-code automation (Zapier, Okta Workflows). * Certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional, Jamf 100/200, CompTIA A\+ or Network\+. * Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI tools to augment technical problem\-solving and streamline IT support workflows. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.* **Follow Us!** YouTube \| LinkedIn \| X (Twitter) \| Facebook Compensation Range: $125K \- $150K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real\-time, event\-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on. Solace is the leading real\-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real\-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees. So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work! **About the Role** Solace is building Solace Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka® (SSK), by the creators of Nisshi. SSK builds on Nisshi Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka®, an open\-source project licensed under Apache\-2\.0\. Both implement the Apache Kafka® protocol and separate compute from storage. Stateless Protocol Engines scale out by adding more, and data is stored in object storage rather than on local disks. Other systems depend on this platform, so writes must remain correct under heavy concurrent load. The work covers wire protocols, storage engines, and the coordination problems that arise in keeping order and consistency across stateless engines. The team focuses on scale, security, latency, and robustness, and tunes for tail latency, throughput, and cost per byte; object storage sets its own floor on latency. You will own pieces of the data path end to end, working in Rust. Part of that work takes place in public, in the Nisshi repository. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core data\-path components: request handling and storage, for a system that must hold strict ordering guarantees under load. * Implement and evolve Apache Kafka® wire\-protocol handling: parsing, framing, versioning, and backward compatibility with Apache Kafka® client libraries. * Build and harden storage engines: offset and sequence coordination, compaction, retention, and correctness under concurrent access. * Diagnose difficult defects: races, consistency edge cases, and security or robustness issues that surface only under real concurrent load. * Profile and tune throughput and latency against measured production numbers. * Work with the open\-source community on Nisshi: review, discuss, and contribute. **What You’ll Bring to the Role** One of the Following, at a Deep Level: * Hands\-on experience building a high\-throughput, log\-based streaming or messaging system, such as Apache Kafka® or a comparable platform: wire protocols, client/server compatibility, and the internals of a system that can’t lose data. * Deep experience with a database’s internals: storage engine, write\-ahead\-log or commit\-log design, replication and consensus, or query execution. Any flavor counts (relational, graph, document, or otherwise). If you’ve solved these problems inside a database, you understand the ones we’re solving. Both Paths Also Need: * Strong systems\-programming fundamentals (Rust, C\+\+, Go, or Java). * A track record of owning hard technical problems end to end, from design through production. * Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, across time zones. Preferred: * Production experience in Rust. * Working knowledge of the Apache Kafka® protocol, client libraries, and ecosystem. * Hands\-on experience working on the internals of a system like Apache Kafka®, Redpanda, Pulsar, WarpStream, NATS JetStream, or Solace Event Broker. * Experience running one of these systems at production scale. * Experience with security hardening, fuzzing, or performance engineering of network services. **Why You’ll Love Working at Solace** At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes. * **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry. * **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around. * **Hybrid\-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered. * **Values\-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience. * **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast. * **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world\-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it). * **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time. * **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!). **At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.** To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills. Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions. **Let’s Talk** Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you. Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you. Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted. At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us! \#LI\-NM1

jobs.description: The Solomon and Keller laboratories in Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at Stanford University are seeking a joint Software Developer Associate to develop software for the storage, management, access, and analysis of human electrophysiological data. The goal of both labs is to understand the fundamental principles governing how the human brain responds to electrical stimulation, and to develop next\-generation neurotherapeutics to treat neuropsychiatric conditions. The Software Developer Associate will assist in this mission by developing software that enables research analysts to efficiently and flexibly interact with complex human neural data and associated metadata (including neuroimaging, behavioral, medical, and audio\-visual measures). The Associate will work under the general supervision of the laboratory PI and in direct collaboration with postdoctoral researchers and graduate students. **Duties include:** * Assessment of users needs relating to the flexible access and analysis of human electrophysiology data and associated research metadata. * Assist in the development of new Python\-based software packages and APIs to enable easy, efficient, and fast analysis of these data. * Assist in the integration of new software with in\-house and Stanford\-based data storage solutions. * Contribute to refinements of existing software packages for conducting transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) research experiments, including hardware/software interfacing and GUI development. * Real\-time technical support and troubleshooting during TMS experiments. * Develop user guides and tutorials for newly\-developed software and follow best practices for code documentation and version control. * Follow team software development methodology.
