jobs.title: Sr Architect I
jobs.description: Team Summary: Staples Digital Solutions partners across the enterprise to shape and deliver scalable technology that strengthens customer, sales, and service capabilities. The team works closely with business leaders, product teams, engineers, architects, vendors, and external partners to modernize platforms, improve customer experiences, and advance strategic business priorities through secure, resilient, and innovative solutions. Role Summary: The Sr. Architect leads architecture and technical evolution within the customer service domain, guiding the contact center’s transition from a traditional, agent\-led service model to an AI\-first operating model. The architect designs solutions that combine conversational AI, intelligent business process automation, and human expertise to address customer needs across email, voice, and digital channels. This is a hands\-on architecture role responsible for translating business goals into practical designs, validating technology choices, and guiding implementation from discovery through production. The architect will ensure that modernization improves customer experience, equips employees, and delivers measurable business value. What you’ll be doing: * Lead the architecture and technical design supporting the contact center modernization journey to an AI\-first operating model. * Drive the delivery of solutions that advance our AI\-first operating model, increase agent productivity, and deliver an elevated customer experience. * Develop target\-state architectures, reference models, standards, and reusable design patterns. * Define application, integration, API, cloud, and data architecture strategies aligned with business objectives. * Evaluate technology solutions and recommend approaches based on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost. * Design and govern enterprise integrations, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and service\-oriented solutions. * Assess emerging technologies, generative AI capabilities, automation opportunities, and modernization strategies. * Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, strategic technology assessments, design workshops, and governance forums. * Mentor architects and engineers while promoting architecture best practices, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence. What you bring to the table: * Strong strategic thinking and the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes. * Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to address complex challenges. * Ability to influence and lead across matrixed organizations without direct authority. * Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build trusted partnerships across the organization. * A continuous\-learning mindset with a passion for innovation, technology trends, and improvement. What’s needed \- Basic Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including designing solution architectures and providing technical leadership throughout solution development and delivery. * Expertise in designing and building enterprise applications using Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud) and front\-end technologies such as Angular, JavaScript, and TypeScript. This includes applying reactive UI patterns and using state management and component libraries. * Extensive experience designing, securing, and governing REST, GraphQL, and event\-driven APIs using Kafka, Solace, or similar technologies. This experience includes API gateway management, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contracts, OAuth2/OIDC, and API versioning strategies. * Proven ability to define target\-state architectures for multi\-application suites using microservices, domain\-driven design, and cloud\-native design patterns. * Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS), container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines. * Working knowledge of customer data platforms, relational and NoSQL data stores, data streaming, and unified platforms for data, analytics, and AI (Databricks). * Working knowledge of observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or similar solutions. * Experience integrating large language models (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) into enterprise applications through APIs and SDKs. * Ability to design scalable AI\-enabled architectures including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and embeddings, prompt orchestration, model routing, caching and fallback patterns. * Experience designing AI agents and copilots that safely invoke enterprise APIs and tools through mechanisms such as function calling and Model Context Protocol. Designs incorporate clear guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and auditability. * Experience designing architectures that integrate customer service application suites, including contact center/CCaaS platforms with omnichannel capabilities across chat, voice/IVR, and email. Integration experience spanning CRM, case management, knowledge management, and order management systems. * Ability to apply AI knowledge to develop customer service capabilities in the following areas: * Self\-service: Virtual agents, chatbots, and conversational IVR. * Agent support: Agent assist, next\-best\-action recommendations, and case / contact summarization. * Interaction analysis: Intent detection and routing, and sentiment analysis. * Knowledge of evaluation frameworks for model accuracy, groundedness, latency, and quality. * Proficiency using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate development, code review, test generation, documentation, and legacy code modernization, while maintaining quality and security standards. What’s needed \- Preferred Qualifications: * Master’s degree in a technology\- or business\-related field. * 10\+ years of architecture, engineering, or enterprise technology experience. * Cloud / AI Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or AWS Certified Machine Learning / Solutions Architect. * Development Certifications: Oracle Certified Professional Java Developer, Spring Professional, or equivalent. * Experience with delivering AI\- or ML\-enabled features into production, ideally within customer service or retail environments. * Experience supporting customer service, customer experience, CRM, contact center, or digital engagement platforms. We Offer: * Inclusive culture with associate\-led Business Resource Groups * Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays) * Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more! https://careers.staples.com/Staples\-Life/Benefits The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. Build professional and technical skills through mentorship, structured training, and hands\-on project experience. * **Requirements/Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications:** Experience, education, or training in coding computer applications. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. * Foundational experience working with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. * Exposure to cloud\-based data platforms such as Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake. * Experience (coursework, internship, or personal projects) building dashboards or reports. * Familiarity with Agile methodologies or project\-based delivery. Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and enthusiasm for solving problems through data. * If you're **currently** employed by the State of Nebraska, please don't apply through this external career site. For more information on benefits, please visit: https://statejobs.nebraska.gov/index.html\#benefits **Equal Opportunity Statement** The State of Nebraska values our teammates as well as a supportive environment that strives to promote diversity, inclusion, and belonging. jobs.title: AI Business Analyst
jobs.description: We are seeking an Artificial Intelligence Business Analyst to analyze data, develop algorithms, and research emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods. Candidates should have expertise in machine learning, deep learning, predictive modeling, and natural language processing, along with the ability to create AI solutions that support business objectives and improve operations. AI Business Analyst (AI BA) combines traditional business analysis skills with AI expertise to align AI initiatives with organizational goals. This position will act as the bridge between business leaders and technical AI teams, ensuring that AI projects are well scoped, feasible, and impactful. **Summary of Work** * AI Opportunity Identification aligned with business needs \- Discover and prioritize AI use cases that drive business value through workshops, workflow audits, and process analysis. * Requirements Gathering \& Translation \- Collect stakeholder needs, convert them into AI solution specifications, and ensure alignment with business strategy. * Feasibility \& Return on Investment Analysis \- Assess technical viability, cost benefit, and potential return on investment for AI projects. * Data Analysis \& Preparation \- Clean, validate, and prepare datasets for AI models, collaborating with data engineers to address gaps. * Model Selection \& Performance Monitoring \- Work with data scientists to choose appropriate AI models, track Key Performance Indicators (KPI)s, and adjust when performance drifts. * Risk Assessment \- Identify ethical, legal, operational, and security risks before deployment. * Stakeholder Communication \- Translate technical findings into clear business language for executives and non\-technical teams Design, implement, test, and maintain machine\-learning models and AI systems. * Integrate AI models into company platforms and services. * Monitor AI developments and apply relevant technologies. * Collaborate with data engineers, software developers, and IT staff. **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a closely related field, plus five or more years of relevant experience; demonstrated experience as a business analyst or in a similar role; and established experience using AI tools. **Preferred Qualifications** * Troubleshoot complex implementation and performance issues. * Understand data structures, data modelling, and software architecture. * Support database and transaction\-management technologies, including deployment and usage standards. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and contribute effectively to a team. Perform other duties as assigned. * **About Team ND** *"Far and away the best prize life offers is the chance to work hard at work worth doing." \- Theodore Roosevelt* More than 7,500 talented, hard\-working people across sixty\-three agencies have come together as Team North Dakota. At Team ND, we are driven to succeed through gratitude, humility, curiosity and courage. Our purpose is to empower people, improve lives, and inspire success. Join us in being legendary. **Total Rewards:** The State of North Dakota is committed to providing team members with a strong and competitive rewards package that support you, your health and your family. Considering a new position on Team ND? How does your current position stack up? Use our Total Rewards Calculator to estimate. **Application Procedures** Applications will only be accepted online through the ND PeopleSoft System. Application materials must be received by 11:59 PM Central Standard Time (CST) on the closing date. In addition to completing the online application, applicants should upload the following: Resume Cover letter Transcripts Your resume should include information to demonstrate how you meet the minimum qualifications as posted. If the Department's Human Resource Division is unable to determine that you meet the minimum qualifications, credit will not be given. State of ND employees should access the announcement and application by signing into their ND PeopleSoft account at: ND PeopleSoft, clicking on "my Career," and selecting "Careers" in the drop\-down menu. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The ND Department of Mineral Resources does not provide sponsorships. Due to access to restricted information, the successful candidate will be required to complete a satisfactory criminal background check. Applicants who are residents of North Dakota and eligible to claim veteran's preference must include a clear copy of DD Form 214\. Claims for disabled veteran's preference must also include a current statement of disabled status from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. For assistance or questions regarding the application or interview process, please contact Sara Upgren at seupgren@nd.gov or 701\-328\-7608\. Applicants who experience technical difficulties during the application process should contact recruiter@nd.gov or (701\) 328\-3290\. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user\-friendly, cost\-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention. Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps \- the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile. **About the Role** We're growing our world\-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a **Principal Engineer, Agentic AI** to join our Core Platform Team Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100\-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a **high\-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch**. We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic\-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI\-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today. We're looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are "all in" on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results. **Why Steer?** * **True Ownership:** You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high\-velocity teams. * **Hyper\-Growth \& Vision:** We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space * **Freedom to Innovate:** You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product. * **AI\-First \& Agentic Culture:** We are refactoring our teams to be agentic\-first. We prioritize high\-level problem\-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows. **What You'll Do** * **Technical Strategy \& Ownership:** Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools. * **Architectural Vision:** Lead the design of reusable full\-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance. * **Adaptive Development:** Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve. * **Code Excellence:** Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep\-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization. * **Modern DevOps \& Agentic Infrastructure:** Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI\-integrated, agentic\-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows. **What You Have** **Must Have:** * 7\+ years of professional experience building complex, web\-based SaaS products. * **The "All\-In" Mindset:** A deep commitment to Steer's mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast\-paced environment. * **AI \& LLM Integration:** Hands\-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development. * **AI in Production:** Proven experience deploying AI\-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production\-grade infrastructure. * **AI\-Driven CI/CD:** Hands\-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI\-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration). * **Database Expertise:** Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization. * **Exceptional Communication:** The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership. **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with our current stack: **.NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.** * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early\-stage startup environment. * Experience building or integrating with **Claude marketplace plugins** (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations. **Interview Process** * **Initial Screen** — 30 min with Lead Recruiter * **Hiring Manager Interview** — 60 min with the Head of Engineering \& Product * **Technical Interview** — 60 min with a Principal Engineer * **Collaborative Interview** — 30 min with Lead Product Manager **What We Offer** * **Equity Options:** Own a piece of the company's success. * **100% Remote:** Work from anywhere in the US. * **100% Employer\-Paid Medical Insurance.** * **Flexible PTO:** With a 15\-day minimum. * **FSA, HSA, and 401k options.** * **Learning Stipend \& WFH Equipment:** Everything you need for a world\-class home office. * **Innovative Culture:** A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic\-first environment. **Why Join Steer?** At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence. Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career\-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well\-being. Join Steer to be part of a forward\-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work. We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries. Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Business Rule Developer III
jobs.description: Stellantis Financial Services (SFS) is the new captive finance company for one of the world's leading automakers and a mobility provider with iconic brands including Abarth, Alfa Romeo, Chrysler, Citroën, Dodge, DS Automobiles, Fiat, Jeep®, Lancia, Maserati, Opel, Peugeot, Ram, Vauxhall, Free2move and Leasys. Our exciting growth provides opportunities to advance your career as we successfully lead products and services from a small to midsize company in just a few years. Join our world class team and culture and contribute to our core mission which is enhancing our customer's experience. **Position Summary:** The Business Rule Developer III serves as a technical leader responsible for the design, development, governance, and delivery of enterprise\-scale decision automation solutions within Stellantis Financial Services. This role owns complex decisioning logic supporting auto finance origination, lease and retail pricing, credit policy execution, and operational workflows. The Business Rule Developer III is expected to independently lead projects end\-to\-end, mentor junior rule developers, and contribute to next\- generation innovation through AI agent–enabled decision support platforms. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Serve as a senior technical expert in FICO Decision Engine (DE) configuration, rule development, and decision strategy optimization. * Design and implement complex rule flows, decision tables, and execution frameworks supporting credit, pricing, and policy automation. * Lead full lifecycle delivery of decision automation products including requirements, technical design, build, testing, deployment, and production stabilization. * Own governance, audit documentation, and change control processes to ensure decision logic is accurate, maintainable, and compliant. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues through root\-cause analysis of rule execution, data inputs, and downstream impacts. * Train and guidance level I and II developers, establishing reusable templates and best practices for rule development. * Partner with Risk, Operations, Data, and IT teams to translate business strategy into scalable and controlled decision logic. * Support AI\-enabled decision automation initiatives, including integration of conversational and agent\-based tools with deterministic rule platforms. * Drive simplification, modernization, and continuous improvement of enterprise rule architecture across origination and remarketing ecosystems. **Required Experience:** * Minimum five (5\) years of related experience in FICO decisioning configuration and business rule development. * Expertise with FICO Decision Engine (DE) and related Decision Management platforms in production environments. * Expert knowledge of business rules management systems (BRMS) and enterprise decision automation. * Proven experience delivering large\-scale decision automation solutions within auto leasing or underwriting financial services. * Demonstrated ownership of projects from design through deployment. * Ability to lead technical delivery independently with a strong sense of accountability. * Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills in complex decisioning environments. * Strong communication skills to align technical solutions with business, risk, and executive stakeholders. * Ability to mentor and guide peers in technical rule development. * Remarketing decisioning experience including off\-lease pricing strategy, vehicle disposition workflows, residual risk and auction optimization decision logic. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related field (or equivalent experience) Overtime required – as needed. Travel 0\-10% \- as required on an as needed basis. Must have reliable transportation and live within a commutable distance to one of the following cities: Atlanta, GA; Dallas, TX; Detroit, MI; Houston, TX; Phoenix, AZ. **Qualifications Preferred:** * Experience integrating decision engines with enterprise ecosystems (APIs, MuleSoft, Power Platform, data providers) **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. **Work Schedule** * Mon – Fri / 40 hrs. per week, this is an in\-office hybrid role. Stellantis Financial Services, Inc (SFS) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing its employees with an environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, and intimidation. It is the policy of SFS to comply with all applicable employment laws and regulations and to provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and to not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression, change of sex, and/or transgender status or any protected status. Candidates must possess authorization to work in the United States. This policy applies to recruitment and placement, promotion, training, transfer, retention, rate of pay and all other terms and conditions of employment. Employment and promotion decisions will be based solely on merit, ability,achievement, experience, conduct and other legitimate business reasons An applicant must be authorized to work in the United States to be eligible for this position. Stellantis Financial Services, Inc. will not sponsor applicants for work visas of any type for this position.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview: We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and support scalable enterprise applications across frontend, backend, cloud, and data platforms. This role requires strong expertise in AWS, Databricks, Power BI, Grafana, JIRA, and Confluence, along with hands\-on experience in modern frontend/UI development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building robust user\-facing applications, integrating backend services and data pipelines, and ensuring performance, reliability, and observability across the full technology stack. This role requires strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to work across engineering, DevOps, data, and business teams. Key Responsibilities: * Design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end full stack applications, including frontend UI components, backend APIs, and cloud\-native services * Build responsive, reusable, and user\-friendly frontend interfaces using modern UI frameworks, ensuring performance, accessibility, and consistency across applications * Develop and support backend services and APIs for application integration, business logic, and data access * Architect and manage cloud\-based solutions using AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, and related services * Integrate applications with Databricks and AWS\-based data platforms to support data processing, analytics, and reporting use cases * Enable business reporting and insight generation by supporting integration with Power BI dashboards and data models * Implement monitoring, observability, and application health dashboards using Grafana and cloud monitoring tools * Collaborate in Agile teams using JIRA for sprint planning and tracking, and maintain technical documentation in Confluence * Work closely with DevOps, data engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery of features and releases * Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and improve application reliability, scalability, and maintainability * Contribute to architectural decisions, coding standards, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices * Mentor junior developers and support knowledge sharing across frontend, backend, and platform teams Requirements: **Basic Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field * A minimum of 5 years of overall experience * Experience in full stack software engineering or application development * Strong hands\-on experience in frontend/UI development using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar * Strong experience in backend development using Python, Java, Node.js, or similar technologies * Solid expertise in AWS cloud services including EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, and IAM * Experience integrating applications with Databricks or similar cloud\-based data platforms * Experience working with Power BI for reporting integration, dashboard enablement, or data model support * Hands\-on experience with Grafana for monitoring, dashboard creation, and observability * Good understanding of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and application integration patterns * Strong knowledge of SQL, data access patterns, and backend\-to\-data platform integration * Experience working in Agile teams using JIRA and Confluence * Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills **Preferred Requirements:** * Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices * Familiarity with Databricks workflows, Spark, and lakehouse concepts * Experience with event\-driven architecture and serverless design patterns * Exposure to Power BI administration or advanced dashboard integration * Knowledge of enterprise application security practices * Experience in automotive or enterprise\-scale platforms * Exposure to Generative AI / RAG / LLM\-enabled applications

perception\-driven robotic applications. * Partner closely with Controls, System Software, and System Test teams to integrate perception and autonomy decisions into core vehicle software. * Drive high engineering standards through architectural leadership, comprehensive unit and regression testing, code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring. * Expand perception capabilities across jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer — T. Rowe Price Labs
jobs.description: At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi\-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident. We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity. Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you. **Role Summary** Positions are available in our New York City office or with our AI Engineering squad in Harbor Point, Baltimore, MD. In either location, you will join a collaborative team of engineers, product owners, and business partners building high\-impact AI products with leverage across the firm. As a Senior Software Engineer on T. Rowe Price Labs' AI Engineering team, you will independently design, build, and scale production\-grade AI agents and intelligent systems that solve complex business problems. You will lead technical workstreams, incubate new AI products, experiment with emerging technologies and innovative ideas, and partner with business\-aligned technology teams to enable broader adoption at scale. This is a hands\-on role for an experienced engineer with strong software fundamentals, practical AI engineering experience, and a product mindset. You will take ownership of complex and ambiguous problems, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the patterns and practices that shape AI engineering at T. Rowe Price. **Responsibilities** * Own the end\-to\-end design and delivery of production\-grade AI agents and intelligent systems, including architecture, implementation, testing, evaluation, deployment, observability, and production support. * Design agentic workflows using orchestration, tool integration, retrieval\-based systems, structured outputs, context management, and appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to take control of complex or ambiguous problems, evaluate alternative approaches, and translate needs into scalable AI solutions. * Lead technical workstreams from rapid experimentation and validation through production adoption. * Establish evaluation and testing approaches for non\-deterministic AI systems, including quality metrics, regression testing, failure analysis, and production monitoring. * Make informed engineering trade\-offs across models, prompts, context, tools, latency, cost, reliability, security, and maintainability. * Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and shared engineering patterns that improve speed, quality, and consistency across teams. * Lead code and design reviews, mentor less\-experienced engineers, and help others solve complex technical problems. * Own technical debt and continuously improve the quality, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you build. * Rapidly evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine when and how they can be applied to deliver meaningful business value. * Support the Build\-Operate\-Transfer model by preparing successful AI solutions for long\-term ownership and scale by business\-aligned technology teams. **Business Knowledge** * Work directly with business stakeholders and product owners to understand priorities, shape solution direction, and deliver measurable outcomes. * Translate complex business needs into effective technology solutions and clearly communicate technical trade\-offs. * Balance innovation, business value, scalability, risk, fiscal responsibility, and long\-term maintainability when making technical decisions. **Qualifications** **Required:** * BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience, with 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong hands\-on development experience in object\-oriented languages such as Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, or agentic systems using modern LLMs and AI development frameworks. * Practical experience with modern AI engineering patterns such as agent orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval\-based systems, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, evaluation, observability, or guardrails. * Experience taking AI\-enabled systems beyond prototypes toward production, including testing, mon Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical workstreams. * Understanding of financial markets, asset management, or financial instruments. **FINRA Requirements** FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role. **Work Flexibility** This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home. **WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING** 1\. You will receive an email and text message to answer a few questions to verify your eligibility. If you apply for multiple jobs, you will receive separate invitations for each role and will need to respond to each. **Estimated Time Commitment: 3\-5 minutes** 2\. If you are eligible, you will be asked to record video responses to introductory questions with our vendor partner, HireVue. Take time to read all instructions carefully before responding. Some questions may require you to respond within a set time limit, or with limited retakes. You can use this opportunity to tell us more about your background and interest than we can learn from a resume alone. **Estimated Time Commitment: 20\-30 minutes** **Base Salary Ranges** Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity. $121,000\.00 \- $206,000\.00 for the location of: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers $133,000\.00 \- $227,000\.00 for the location of: Washington, D.C. $151,000\.00 \- $258,000\.00 for the location of: New York, California Placement within the range provided above is based on the individual’s relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon company and individual performance. **Commitment to Diversity, Equity,** **and** **Inclusion** At T. Rowe Price, our associates are our greatest asset. We thrive because our company culture is built on inclusion and because we sustain a work environment where associates can bring their best selves to work every day. The backgrounds, talents, and experiences of our global associates allow us to embrace new ideas and perspectives that move our business priorities forward and enable us to deliver strong client outcomes. Here, you can expect equal opportunity and fair and consistent treatment for all. **Benefits** We value your goals and needs, at work and in life. As an associate, you’ll be supported with resources, benefits, and work\-life balance so you can thrive in ways that matter to you. Featured employee benefits to enrich your life: * Competitive compensation * Annual bonus eligibility * A generous retirement plan * Hybrid work schedule * Health and wellness benefits, including online therapy * Paid time off for vacation, illness, medical appointments, and volunteering days * Family care resources, including fertility and adoption benefits Learn more about our benefits. **T. Rowe Price is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity of thought, gender, and race. We believe our continued success depends upon the equal treatment of all associates and applicants for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, gender, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, or any other classification protected by country, federal, state, or local law.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Founding Engineer, Platform** **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area — Hybrid**Compensation:** 225,000–300,000 base salary \+ 0\.5%–1\.0% equity**Employment:** Full\-time**Relocation:** No relocation support available **About the Company** A seed\-stage AI startup is building the data and workflow infrastructure behind modern go\-to\-market teams. Its platform lets users describe what they need in plain language, then uses AI agents to build and execute workflows—from enriching company and contact data to scoring leads and updating CRM records. The team is developing an agent\-first platform with a custom workflow engine, an in\-house evaluation stack, and a modern TypeScript architecture. Engineers own both technical decisions and product outcomes. **The Opportunity** We’re looking for a hands\-on, staff\-level backend engineer to own the engine behind every customer workflow. You’ll work closely with the technical co\-founder to build reliable, high\-volume infrastructure across scheduling, queues, integrations, and data processing. You’ll take projects from an ambiguous idea through architecture, implementation, launch, and customer feedback. This is an opportunity to make foundational decisions, shape product direction, and earn meaningful ownership in an early\-stage company. **What You’ll Do** * Own and evolve the workflow engine, including scheduling, background jobs, queues, retries, and failure recovery. * Build infrastructure that processes high volumes of structured and unstructured data. * Improve database performance, scalability, data consistency, and system availability. * Design reliable integrations with external data providers and CRM platforms. * Help develop a custom workflow compiler and agent\-native execution capabilities. * Build evaluation and monitoring systems that make AI\-powered workflows more dependable. * Design actionable errors and interfaces that help both developers and AI agents recover from failures. * Anticipate how architectural decisions affect the broader shared platform. * Own features from scoping through delivery, making practical trade\-offs and following through on results. **What You’ll Bring** * **5\+ years of professional backend or platform engineering experience.** * **Experience at an early\-stage startup**, ideally seed through Series B, as an early engineer, founding engineer, or founder. * **Experience building production job systems, queues, or data pipelines at scale.** * Experience with **Effect or functional TypeScript**. * Demonstrated ownership of scalability, data consistency, and availability in high\-load or shared infrastructure. * Strong database and system\-design judgment, including the ability to explain past decisions, trade\-offs, and lessons learned. * Ability to independently turn loosely defined problems into reliable products. * A bachelor’s degree. * Ability to commute for hybrid work in San Francisco or the Bay Area. **Helpful Experience** * Workflow orchestration, durable execution, scheduling, retries, and idempotency. * Postgres and Redis performance and reliability. * Data enrichment, provider integrations, rate limiting, and CRM synchronization. * AI agent tooling, evaluation systems, or compiler development. * Building software used by other developers, teams, or services. **Technology** TypeScript, Effect, Postgres, Redis, React, Vite, TanStack, and ElectricSQL. **Why Join** * Own infrastructure central to every customer workflow. * Work directly with the technical co\-founder and influence product direction. * Help build an agent\-first platform at an early stage. * Take projects from idea to customer delivery with substantial autonomy. * Receive competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Visa transfers may be considered. **Interview Process** * Recorded recruiter screen — 30 minutes * Hiring manager conversation — 20 minutes * Technical interview — 60 minutes * Onsite interviews — approximately 4–6 hours, including TypeScript and workflow implementation exercises and time with the team Pay: $225,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Your Role:** As an AI Security Engineer on Tenable's Information Security team, you will help shape and mature our approach to securing AI both within Tenable's products and across the enterprise. AI introduces a new class of risk at the intersection of application security, cloud risk, and data governance, and you will be on the front lines of defining how we assess, test, and address it. You will apply hands\-on AI engineering experience alongside product security and application security skills to design security controls for AI systems, lead assessments, and help engineering teams ship AI features securely. You will establish security standards for responsible AI use, influence decisions across the organization, and build tooling that raises our security posture. This role is ideal for a practitioner who has spent time building or tinkering with AI systems, looking under the hood of model internals, and wants to channel that experience into a security specialty. **Your Opportunity:** * Design, implement, and maintain end\-to\-end security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle. * Assist in the implementation of robust security guardrails, controls, and boundary mechanisms for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open\-source models. * Continuously monitor the AI landscape for novel vulnerabilities and attack techniques, applying deep engineering experience to proactively defend enterprise AI deployments. * Assist in developing security reference architectures for AI deployment patterns, including MCP servers and agentic AI workflows and harnesses. * Deploy controls to ensure model integrity, governance, and proper access control across models and feature stores. * Build AI\-driven tooling to strengthen cybersecurity posture across identity, incident management, vulnerability management, third\-party risk, and emerging AI threat vectors. * Perform AI safety, security assessments, threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks. * Collaborate with software engineers, and product teams to integrate security best practices into AI development, training, validation, and deployment processes. * Create security guidance, documentation, and training for internal engineering and development teams; develop metrics that drive desired security behaviors and outcomes. * Assist in researching emerging trends in AI security and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tenable's AI initiatives. **What You'll Need:** * 2 or more years of professional experience in information security or application security, with at least a demonstrated interest on securing AI/ML systems. * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field preferred. * Awareness of AI\-specific security threats, including adversarial ML, data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion, model evasion, and inference attacks. * Knowledge of data security principles, including encryption, masking, and tokenization. * Knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, and security testing practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and threat modeling. * Knowledge of application security architecture best practices and patterns, including modern web applications, Docker, and microservices. * Ability to work cross\-functionally across engineering, product, and business teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly translate complex AI security risks for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to lead projects with end\-to\-end ownership. * Self\-motivated and effective working independently and across distributed teams. **And Ideally:** * Hands\-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial prompt testing, or LLM security assessments. * Basic coding experience in Python and/or Go. * Experience with frameworks \& libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow or similar. * Strong understanding of the ML/AI lifecycle and the security risks associated with each stage. * Experience with application security assessment tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Tenable WAS, etc.) * Knowledge of cloud security platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP including AI/ML\-related services. * Security certifications: CISSP, CSSLP, SANS GIAC, CEH, or AI\-focused security certifications are a plus, but not necessary. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact* *Recruiting@Tenable.com* *for further assistance.* **Tenable Data Consent Statement** Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you: General Applicant Privacy Notice California Applicant Privacy Notice EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice

You'll build automation that finds trivial app bugs and carries them unattended from discovery to documentation, root cause, and a pull request a developer can merge—while knowing when an issue is real, and handing it to a human with the evidence to act on it. We believe that tightening the feedback loop between what we ship and what owners experience is the best way to improve quality. hardware\-in\-the\-loop and software\-in\-the\-loop setups your platform drives. **What You'll Do*** Build and own a dynamic testing platform for the Tesla App on iOS and Android, running from nightly coverage where change and risk actually are * Orchestrate and maintain our test device lab—iPhones, iPads, Android phones and foldables, simulators and emulators—keeping it provisioned, reliable unattended, and able to drive the app into any locale, text size, orientation, fold posture, or multitasking window on demand * Make accessibility and layout measurable: Dynamic Type and font scale up to the largest accessibility sizes, VoiceOver and TalkBack, right\-to\-left and long\-text locales, region independent of language, tablet and foldable layouts—catching clipped, hidden, and truncated UI before customers do * Own release validation on real hardware: prove the build under test is the build we ship, validate tickets against their test plans, and produce clear, reviewable evidence for release sign\-off * Automate marketing and store screenshots and video across devices and locales, straight from the app, and help keep our App Store and Google Play submissions compliant * Investigate field\-reported issues across in\-app logs, Splunk, Sentry, and device telemetry, and use real usage data to decide which devices, sizes, and settings deserve coverage * Partner with integration engineers in the firmware and software organizations, and with app engineering, design, and product, to define test strategy and quality gates—and leave every process faster and simpler jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer [Tooling]
jobs.description: **AI Infrastructure Engineer \[Tooling]** ========================================= **About Tessera Labs** Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world\-class founding team, we build multi\-agent AI systems that automate complex business workflows across platforms like SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, Databricks, and more. Our mission is simple but ambitious: bring real AI automation to the enterprise — with speed, precision, and measurable impact. We move fast, operate with extreme ownership, and build at the frontier of applied AI. **About the Team** ------------------ The AI Platform team builds and operates the foundational infrastructure that lets Tessera's multi\-agent systems run reliably, securely, and consistently across customer environments. That spans the portable cloud foundation (Kubernetes, networking, automation) and the AI\-specific layer on top of it: model serving, agent runtimes, evaluation and release tooling, and the internal CLIs and services our engineers use every day. The work directly enables us to onboard and operate enterprise customers under strict security and compliance constraints while preserving developer velocity. It reduces integration risk, standardizes operations across hyperscalers, and makes sure product teams can ship AI features safely without infrastructure becoming a bottleneck. **The Role** ------------ As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you'll design, build, and own the tooling and services that take Tessera's AI agents from a developer's laptop to production in customer clouds. You'll write real software in Python or Go — CLIs, controllers, and internal services — and run it on Kubernetes alongside LLM serving stacks like vLLM. This is a hands\-on IC role open at mid to senior level. Mid\-level engineers will own well\-scoped components end to end; senior engineers will also set technical direction, make architectural calls across the platform, and mentor others. We'll calibrate level based on experience and interviews. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **AI infrastructure tooling** * Build and maintain internal CLIs, SDKs, and services in Python or Go that let engineers provision, deploy, test, and debug AI agents across environments * Deploy, scale, and tune LLM inference using vLLM (and similar serving stacks), including GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batching, and cost/latency trade\-offs * Build infrastructure for multi\-agent systems: agent runtimes, tool and connector execution, sandboxing, state management, and safe rollout of new agent versions * Own MLOps workflows: model and prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, artifact registries, and promotion from staging to production * Write Kubernetes operators and custom controllers (CRDs) that encode how Tessera's AI workloads are deployed and managed **Cloud platform and reliability** * Design, build, and operate production\-grade AI agent infrastructure on Kubernetes and Terraform * Support Tessera's portable infrastructure across Azure, Oracle Cloud, GCP, and AWS, with primary ownership of at least one cloud variant * Improve observability for AI systems: tracing of agent and LLM calls, token and GPU utilization, latency, error rates, and cost * Strengthen security and reliability for workloads running in customer environments under strict compliance constraints **Automation and developer experience** * Design and own CI/CD for infrastructure, services, and model/agent releases, using GitOps and pipeline\-as\-code * Build self\-service tooling that removes manual work: environment provisioning, secret rotation, dependency updates, compliance checks, and release management * Partner closely with AI, product, and platform engineers to unblock delivery * Champion an automation\-first mindset: if something is done twice, it should be automated; if it's automated, it should be observable and maintained like production code **Must\-Have Qualifications** ----------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering (7\+ years for senior) * **AI infrastructure tooling:** strong software engineering in Python or Go, with a track record of building and shipping tools, CLIs, or services that other engineers rely on * Hands\-on experience running LLM workloads in production, including serving with vLLM or a comparable stack (TGI, Triton, SGLang, Ray Serve) * Experience building infrastructure for AI agents or LLM applications: orchestration, tool calling, evaluation, or agent runtimes * Practical MLOps experience: model/prompt versioning, evaluation and release pipelines, and observability for ML systems * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, including writing or extending operators/controllers (Kubebuilder, Operator SDK, controller\-runtime, or Kopf) * Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform and at least one of Azure, Oracle Cloud, GCP, or AWS * Proven experience designing and owning CI/CD systems, GitOps\-driven deployments, and release automation * Solid networking fundamentals * Proven experience deploying and operating real production systems **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** --------------------------------- * GPU infrastructure experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator, MIG, KServe, or Karpenter\-style autoscaling for inference * Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar) * LLM observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or Arize * Experience with FluxCD, ArgoCD, or other GitOps controllers * Cloud security and DevSecOps: security gates, SBOM generation, and compliance checks in CI/CD * Deep networking expertise (service mesh, private connectivity, multi\-cloud networking) * Open\-source contributions to AI infrastructure or Kubernetes ecosystem projects * A passion for clean, unified infrastructure and a builder mindset **Who You Are** --------------- * A builder who writes production\-quality code, not just configuration * Curious about the fast\-moving AI infrastructure landscape and eager to learn new tools * Comfortable owning and defending infrastructure decisions, with clear reasoning about trade\-offs * Experienced in startups and/or big tech environments * Highly self\-motivated with a strong ownership mindset * Someone who enjoys building foundational systems that other engineers rely on **Why Join Tessera Labs** ------------------------- * Work on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure with real enterprise impact * Own foundational systems at an early\-stage, high\-growth company * Collaborate with a sharp, execution\-focused founding team * Shape how AI agents are deployed across the largest enterprise platforms in the world Compensation Range: $200K \- $230K

jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** ThreatLocker® is a global cybersecurity leader that stops cyberattacks before they happen. The company’s Zero Trust Platform prevents breaches from both known and unknown threats by allowing only explicitly trusted software and activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud systems. Built to deploy quickly and scale across complex environments, the platform reduces operational overhead while keeping business running uninterrupted. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, with offices in Dublin, Dubai, and Brisbane, ThreatLocker protects over 70,000 organizations worldwide. **POSITION OVERVIEW** We are seeking a Windows Kernel Software Developer with hands\-on experience in filter driver development and Windows system internals to join our cybersecurity product team. In this role, you will build and maintain critical kernel\-mode components that support ThreatLocker’s Zero Trust security platform, including file, process, registry, and network monitoring and enforcement. **DEVELOPMENT –****Full\-Time** **This role will be based in Orlando, FL and is an in\-office position.** **JOB SCOPE** The Kernel Developer will be responsible for, but not limited to: * Design and develop Windows kernel\-mode filter drivers, including file system minifilters, registry filters, and network filters. * Implement security monitoring and enforcement for file, process, registry, and network activity. * Investigate Windows internals to develop low\-level security features and bypass\-resistant protections. * Perform kernel debugging, crash dump analysis, and performance tuning using WinDbg, ETW, WPP, and related tools. * Develop secure, stable, and maintainable driver code. * Maintain compatibility across supported Windows versions and platform changes. * Collaborate with user\-mode, QA, DevOps, and security engineering teams. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 5\+ years of hands\-on Windows kernel\-mode driver development experience. * Experience developing Windows filter drivers. * Strong knowledge of Windows system internals, including memory management, I/O, processes, and the object manager. * Strong C/C\+\+ development skills. * Experience with the Windows Driver Kit (WDK). * Strong experience with kernel debugging and crash analysis. * Experience with Windows kernel synchronization, concurrency, and performance\-sensitive code. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a security\-first engineering mindset. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with Windows file system minifilters and Filter Manager. * Experience with Windows Filtering Platform (WFP). * Experience with registry filtering and process monitoring. * Experience with endpoint security, EDR, anti\-malware, application control, or Zero Trust products. * Experience with WinDbg, Driver Verifier, ETW, and WPP tracing. * Experience with reverse engineering or malware analysis. * Familiarity with Windows kernel threat models and secure coding practices. * Exposure to Microsoft driver signing, WHQL, HLK, and driver submission processes. * Contributions to security research, open\-source projects, publications, or technical talks. **WORKING CONDITIONS** * This is an in\-office position based in Orlando, Florida. * Job will generally be performed in an office environment but may require occasional travel. * Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. ***A background check and drug/substance screening are required after a conditional offer. Employment will proceed only upon receiving clear results from both.*** ***ThreatLocker*** ***also conducts randomized drug and substance testing approximately every******60 days, in line with the same screening standards.***

jobs.description: San Jose Regular R\&D \- Security Job ID: A43043A to this job Responsibilities About the Team Detection Engineering is part of Content Assurance and is aligned with USDS JV Security \& Privacy. The team provides product\-independent technical assurance for recommender and generative AI systems, testing whether system behavior remains within declared safety, quality, and governance boundaries before and after release. AI Assurance Engineering builds and operates shared evaluation infrastructure, including test harnesses, benchmark pipelines, replay systems, adversarial\-testing tools, safety\-metric telemetry, and assurance CI/CD. The team is independent from the product teams whose models it evaluates. About the Role As an AI Assurance Engineer, you will design rigorous evaluation methods and production\-quality capabilities for measuring and diagnosing recommender and generative AI behavior. You will develop benchmark datasets, define reproducible test protocols, implement safety, quality, robustness, and drift metrics, and investigate behavioral regressions through adversarial testing and counterfactual replay. This role focuses on evaluation engineering and technical assurance, not product model training, policy setting, moderation, or release ownership. Responsibilities \- Evaluation Methods and Benchmarks: Define reproducible protocols, benchmark suites, sampling strategies, datasets, and statistical analyses for recommender and generative AI evaluations. \- Behavioral Testing and Diagnosis: Test safety, ranking quality, consistency, adversarial robustness, refusal behavior, leakage, factuality within scope, drift, and regressions. \- Evaluation Platforms and Signals: Implement evaluation code, metrics, replay workflows, and assurance signals on shared infrastructure while preserving traceability and repeatability. \- Design Evaluation Methodologies: Define measurable evaluation objectives, metrics, sampling plans, baselines, acceptance criteria, and reproducible protocols for pre\-release and post\-release assurance of recommender and generative AI systems. \- Engineer Benchmark Datasets: Curate, version, document, and quality\-check benchmark and adversarial datasets, including harm\-exposure samples, ranking\-quality cases, jailbreak prompts, leakage tests, and counterfactual replay inputs. \- Implement Behavioral Tests: Build evaluation code for recommender objectives and GenAI behavior, including safety\-category coverage, ranking quality, fairness and consistency, refusal correctness, factuality within scope, adversarial robustness, provenance signals, and drift detection. \- Diagnose Evaluation Results: Apply statistical and experimental rigor to distinguish model\-behavior regressions from data, sampling, or infrastructure effects; analyze post\-release drift against release\-time baselines and produce traceable technical findings. \- Contribute Production\-Quality Platforms: Integrate benchmarks, metrics, replay tests, and red\-team assets with shared evaluation runtimes and assurance CI/CD; improve reproducibility, telemetry quality, and failure diagnosis without assuming ownership of the underlying platform methodology validation. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: \- Education: Bachelor degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \- Machine Learning Evaluation: Experience evaluating machine learning systems with clearly defined metrics, datasets, baselines, and reproducible test protocols. \- Software Engineering: Experience developing production\-quality evaluation or data\-processing software in Python, Go, C\+\+, or a comparable language. \- Statistical and Experimental Rigor: Strong knowledge of sampling, hypothesis testing, uncertainty, experiment design, error analysis, and regression diagnosis. Preferred Qualifications: \- Recommender\-System Evaluation: Experience with ranking metrics, counterfactual replay, harm\-exposure sampling, cohort consistency, or ranking\-quality benchmarks. \- Generative AI Evaluation: Experience evaluating refusal behavior, jailbreak resistance, leakage, factuality within scope, provenance, or multimodal generative systems. \- Adversarial and Robustness Testing: Experience designing red\-team tests, adversarial datasets, robustness analyses, or continuous post\-release evaluations. \- Evaluation Infrastructure: Experience integrating benchmarks and metrics with test harnesses, replay pipelines, experiment systems, or CI/CD workflows. \- Cross\-Functional Assurance: Ability to communicate evidence, limitations, and technical findings clearly to product engineering, Trust \& Safety, business owners, and governance partners while maintaining ownership boundaries. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** *Embedded Systems and Firmware @ Torus* We’re building energy storage and management solutions that help: * Commercial and industrial businesses reduce their operating costs while increasing reliability. * Grid operators keep the electricity grid stable and cost efficient. Torus is hiring a **Firmware Engineer** to be an individual contributor on our firmware team, working in close partnership with our Firmware Architect. This is a hands\-on role where you'll translate architectural direction into well\-engineered, production\-grade firmware. #### **Our Tech Stack** Our firmware application layer is Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto)—not C, not C\+\+. This was a deliberate architectural choice: Python gives us speed\-to\-market, flexibility to respond to changing grid program requirements, and a clean separation between hardware and application logic. Our comms are primarily RS\-485, so Python runtime overhead is seldom the limiting factor. *If you've been writing Python to control hardware over serial protocols—in energy, robotics, industrial IoT, or test \& measurement—you'll feel immediately at home here. If you've spent your career in C/C\+\+ and are looking for that, this probably isn't the right fit.* Each Torus device generates over a million data points per day and integrates with our cloud platform via MQTT/AWS IoT. Our systems also participate in Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs, responding to real\-time dispatch signals from utilities—which means our firmware decisions have direct, measurable impact on grid operations. #### **What You’ll Do** In this role, you will report to our Head of Embedded Systems and will be responsible for: * **Developing firmware** features across our energy storage product lines: telemetry, control loops, cloud connectivity, and hardware abstraction layers. * **Owning system integration**—working closely with hardware, data, and software teams to ensure seamless interoperability across the full stack. * **Driving quality** through design reviews, automated testing, and documentation. (We believe engineers own their own QA.) * **Debugging and optimizing** real\-time embedded applications and serial communication interfaces in the field and in the lab. * **Supporting scaling operations**—deployment tooling, remote monitoring, and root\-cause analysis of field issues across a growing fleet. * **Participate in on\-call rotation** for escalated technical issues. #### **Who Thrives Here** * You're a systems thinker who's comfortable owning a problem end\-to\-end—from a register on a Modbus device to a graph in a customer dashboard. You care about code quality without letting it become a bottleneck. You're energized by the fact that the firmware you write shows up in real buildings, on real grids, doing real work. * You don't need to be an energy domain expert on day one—but you're curious about how the grid works and motivated by the idea that good engineering here has an outsized impact on creating sustainable communities. * You're also comfortable in a structure where a Firmware Architect sets system\-level direction and you're the person who makes it real—bringing deep implementation judgment, surfacing tradeoffs, and pushing back when something won't work in practice. #### **Required Experience** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\-5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing commercial embedded software or firmware applications. * Strong Python proficiency and real production experience running Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto or similar). * Solid understanding of serial communication protocols—RS\-485, Modbus, I²C, CAN, Ethernet. * Experience with real\-time embedded systems: multi\-threading, inter\-process communication, timing constraints. * Ability to read schematics and PCB layouts to troubleshoot hardware integration issues. #### **Preferred Experience** * Experience with IoT device management at scale (fleet OTA, remote diagnostics). * Familiarity with AWS IoT, MQTT, or data telemetry pipelines. * Exposure to energy storage systems, inverters, or grid\-connected hardware. * Knowledge of VPP programs, demand response, or utility interconnection standards (IEEE 1547, UL 1741\). * Experience with containerized embedded deployments (Docker/Balena on Linux targets). * CI/CD practices in embedded or hardware\-adjacent environments. #### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** Remote U.S.\-based role with occasional onsite work in Salt Lake City and surrounding area locations (air\-conditioned and non\-air\-conditioned). Must be available during MT business hours. **Compensation** $135,000 \- 180,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. * When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. * When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. #### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status.
