jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role:** The Site Reliability Engineer will serve as the technical leader responsible for designing, implementing and operating enterprise observability platforms and standards. This role will drive the strategy for logging, metrics, distributed tracing, monitoring, alertin, and self\-healing automation across application, infrastructure and AI\-enabled environments. The role will establish visibility into AI and agentic workflows, including model interactions, retrieval and tool execution, performance, quality, cost and operational risk. This role will partner closely with development teams, platform engineers, AI platform teams and enterprise architects to ensure observability and traceability are built into deployment pipelines and solution architectures by design. This role will lead the evolution of monitoring maturity, improve operational resilience and enable faster detection, diagnosis and resolution of incidents. **What you'll do:** * Lead the design and implementation of enterprise observability standards across logging, metrics, tracing and alerting * Own and evolve the observability platform strategy and roadmap, including Datadog and SolarWinds * Define and implement instrumentation standards for applications, APIs and infrastructure to ensure consistent telemetry collection * Partner with development teams to embed observability into CI/CD pipelines as a first\-class deployment requirement * Design and implement automated monitoring, alerting and self\-healing patterns to improve service reliability and availability * Develop reusable observability frameworks, libraries and deployment templates for engineering teams * Establish monitoring\-as\-code, alerting\-as\-code and dashboard\-as\-code standards * Design service\-level indicators (SLIs), service\-level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets in partnership with product and engineering teams * Ensure monitoring coverage for cloud, on\-prem, containerized and hybrid environments * Implement distributed tracing and log correlation to enable end\-to\-end transaction visibility * Define observability and tracing standards for AI\-enabled applications, copilots and autonomous or agentic workflows, including model calls, prompts and responses, retrieval steps, tool invocations, latency, token consumption, cost and failure states * Implement end\-to\-end AI tracing that correlates user requests across orchestration layers, models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, APIs, tools and downstream services * Establish monitoring and evaluation patterns for AI response quality, hallucination risk, model or prompt drift, guardrail violations, safety events and degraded user outcomes * Define telemetry governance for AI workloads, including sensitive\-data redaction, access controls, retention, sampling and secure handling of prompts, responses and trace data * Serve as the escalation point for complex monitoring, performance and reliability issues * Collaborate with enterprise and platform architects to ensure observability requirements are built into reference architectures * Drive root cause analysis and reliability improvements following major incidents * Develop platform governance standards for monitoring, alerting thresholds, and on\-call best practices * Ensure observability is tightly integrated with CMDB and Service Mapping for accurate service context and impact analysis * Partner with DevOps and platform engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and pipeline automation * Tune alerts continuously to reduce noise and improve signal quality * Support capacity planning, performance engineering and load testing efforts * Engage with Datadog, SolarWinds and ServiceNow vendors and user communities to stay ahead of platform capabilities * Develop training and enablement materials for engineering teams on observability best practices * Contribute to reliability engineering practices including chaos testing, fault injection and resiliency validation * Drive continual improvement of incident response, post\-incident reviews and operational readiness * Integrate observability platforms with ServiceNow for incident, event, change and problem automation * Defines observability policy aligned with CMDB governance, service modeling and configuration management standards **What you need:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty to satisfaction. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Education + Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience required. * Experience + 1\-3 years’ site reliability engineering, DevOps or platform engineering experience required + Hands\-on experience building and operating enterprise observability platforms + Experience implementing observability and distributed tracing for AI\-enabled applications, large language model (LLM) workflows or agentic systems preferred * Skills \& Abilities + Ability to demonstrate success implementing monitoring, logging, and tracing at scale across complex environments + Deep expertise with Datadog and SolarWinds monitoring platforms + Strong experience designing observability for cloud, hybrid and on\-prem environments (Azure, Kubernetes, VMs) + Expertise in logging platforms, APM, distributed tracing and infrastructure monitoring + Working knowledge of generative AI and LLM application architectures, including copilots, agents, orchestration frameworks, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, model gateways and tool\-based integrations + Experience with OpenTelemetry or comparable instrumentation standards and the ability to apply trace context across AI, application, API and infrastructure dependencies + Understanding of AI observability concepts including prompt and model versioning, token and cost analysis, latency decomposition, quality evaluation, drift detection, guardrails and human feedback signals + Ability to balance diagnostic trace depth with privacy, security, retention and cost requirements when collecting AI telemetry + Strong proficiency in automation and scripting (Python, PowerShell) + Experience implementing observability into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab) + Strong understanding of infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, etc.) + Experience with container and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) + Strong understanding of networking, operating systems and application architectures + Experience with event\-driven monitoring, anomaly detection and predictive alerting + Excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis and incident management skills + Strong documentation, architecture diagramming and platform governance capabilities + Ability to lead cross\-functional reliability initiatives and influence engineering standards *Employment visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position. Applicants requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., F\-1 STEM OPT, H\-1B, TN, J1 etc.) will not be considered.*

jobs.description: **Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure Infrastructure)** **Company:** TouchSuite **Department:** Information Technology **Location:** Boca Raton, FL **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** $120,000–$180,000 annually, commensurate with experience **About TouchSuite** TouchSuite is a financial technology company providing payment processing and business technology solutions to merchants across a wide range of industries. Our technology infrastructure supports business\-critical applications, financial operations, and integrations that enable us to serve our customers and partners. As we continue to enhance and modernize our technology environment, we are seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineer to take a leading role in building and maintaining a secure, reliable, and scalable cloud platform. **About the Role** TouchSuite is seeking a **Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure Infrastructure)** to lead the architecture, automation, security, and operational reliability of our cloud environment. This is a high\-impact individual contributor opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys taking ownership of technology, solving complex infrastructure challenges, and introducing improvements that make systems more reliable, secure, and efficient. You will serve as the primary technical owner of our Microsoft Azure environment, including Azure SQL, Azure Functions, App Services, identity management, and CI/CD pipelines. You will also support the integration of MuleSoft into our Azure infrastructure and oversee a limited AWS environment supporting legacy data retention. Working closely with application developers, IT leadership, and business stakeholders, you will have the autonomy to recommend architectural improvements, establish infrastructure standards, and modernize our cloud engineering practices. The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on technical skills with independent judgment, a commitment to documentation, and a practical approach to problem\-solving. **If you're an experienced Azure engineer who thrives on technical ownership, enjoys solving complex problems, and takes pride in building reliable and secure systems, we'd welcome the opportunity to speak with you.** **Key Responsibilities** **Azure Infrastructure \& Cloud Operations*** Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve TouchSuite's Microsoft Azure infrastructure. * Manage Azure SQL databases, including performance optimization, backup and recovery, high availability, geo\-redundancy, and access controls. * Deploy, configure, and support Azure Function Apps and App Service Web Apps, including scaling, networking, deployment slots, and application configurations. * Manage Microsoft Entra ID integrations, role\-based access controls, managed identities, and authentication services. * Oversee Azure Key Vault, including secrets management, certificates, encryption keys, and certificate renewals. * Implement proactive monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. * Troubleshoot production incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventive improvements. * Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource utilization analysis, right\-sizing, and cost management recommendations. **DevOps Automation \& CI/CD*** Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates. * Build, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, configuration management, and routine operational tasks. * Establish consistent deployment practices across development, testing, and production environments. * Implement appropriate change management, approval workflows, release validation, and rollback procedures. * Partner with application developers to improve deployment reliability, reduce manual processes, and accelerate delivery. **Enterprise Integrations \& MuleSoft*** Lead the infrastructure and connectivity aspects of integrating MuleSoft Anypoint Platform with Azure\-hosted applications and data sources. * Establish secure connections between Azure services, Microsoft 365, internal business applications, and third\-party platforms. * Configure and support API authentication, OAuth flows, app registrations, certificates, and secure networking. * Collaborate with development teams and integration stakeholders to improve system interoperability, reliability, and monitoring. * Evaluate and recommend integration architecture improvements as business requirements evolve. **AWS Legacy Infrastructure*** Maintain and secure a limited AWS environment primarily supporting historical data retention. * Manage access controls, storage configurations, lifecycle policies, and data protection requirements. * Evaluate opportunities to reduce costs through archival storage, consolidation, or infrastructure optimization. * Recommend a long\-term strategy for retained data, including  and risk remediation. * Develop and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, including periodic recovery testing. * Ensure production deployments, privileged access changes, and infrastructure modifications follow established authorization and change\-control procedures. **Technical Ownership \& Collaboration*** Serve as the primary technical resource and escalation point for cloud infrastructure operations. * Independently evaluate infrastructure needs, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions. * Maintain architecture diagrams, infrastructure inventories, operational runbooks, and technical documentation. * Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to IT leadership and business stakeholders. * Coordinate with internal technology teams and external partners as needed. * Provide occasional after\-hours support for critical production incidents. * Stay current with evolving cloud technologies, security practices, and infrastructure automation techniques. **Required Qualifications*** 5\+ years of professional experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical discipline. * At least 3 years of substantial hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting Microsoft Azure environments. * Strong working knowledge of Azure SQL, Azure Functions, App Service, Azure networking, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM. * Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps. * Proficiency with PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar scripting and automation tools. * Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, networking, and infrastructure protection. * Experience supporting production cloud environments, including troubleshooting, jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Who are we?** Trader Joe's is your favorite neighborhood grocery store! With almost 630 stores nationwide (and *growing*), we are the place to be. Looking for something delicious and a friendly conversation? At Trader Joe's, you can find both. We love being your first and favorite place to shop. **What do we do?** Like shopping at Trader Joe's? Then, maybe you'll love working with us. We are looking for an experienced Cloud Platform Engineer who is looking to do what they'll love! Do you have experience in Cloud Platform Engineering? Do you love food? If so, read on! We may have the role of a lifetime for you! Tr Trader Joe's is unlike any place you've ever worked. Trust us on that. The qualified candidate has 5\+ years of progressive experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or related enterprise IT disciplines and is a raving fan of the Trader Joe's concept. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Relevant Azure, Terraform, DevOps, or cloud certifications are a plus. **This role is based in our Monrovia, CA, and we have an in\-office expectation of 5 days a week.** The Information Technology Crew reflects Trader Joe’s unique corporate culture through a commitment to quality, service, high performance, responsiveness, and results. The team has worked diligently to improve system stability, resiliency, and security while building trust with stakeholders and establishing a foundation for continued store growth. We are seeking a highly skilled and results\-driven Cloud Platform Engineer to design, build, and improve standardized cloud and hybrid platform capabilities supporting Trader Joe’s technology environments. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Infrastructure and Cloud Engineering, this hands\-on engineering role will help make infrastructure and cloud services more secure, repeatable, supportable, and efficient through practical engineering standards, infrastructure as code, automation, and reusable service patterns. A key priority is advancing Platform Engineering maturity across IT by working with Cloud Engineering, Core Infrastructure and Networking, Development, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Enterprise Datacenter Operations, and external technology partners. The Engineer will connect existing team capabilities into consistent end\-to\-end delivery workflows, embedding security and operational guardrails while preserving established service ownership and accountability. The role will follow a deliberate progression of Standardize, Simplify, Automate, Self\-Service, Measure, and Kaizen. Success will be measured through improvements in service delivery consistency, automation, reliability, engineering efficiency, cost visibility, and the reduction of manual handoffs and rework. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities** **Cloud Platform Engineering and Standardization** * Design, engineer, and maintain reusable cloud and hybrid platform services, primarily within Microsoft Azure, using established architecture, security, and operational standards. * Partner with service\-owning teams to define standardized platform patterns, technical prerequisites, dependencies, approvals, documentation, and support requirements for repeatable delivery. * Apply infrastructure as code, version control, and configuration standards to improve consistency, traceability, scalability, and lifecycle management of cloud resources. * Embed identity and access controls, network connectivity, monitoring, backup, resiliency, and operational readiness into platform patterns in collaboration with accountable teams. **Automation, Integration, and Self\-Service** * Standardize and simplify existing service delivery workflows before introducing automation, reducing unnecessary complexity, manual handoffs, and inconsistent implementations. * Build and improve automation using tools such as Terraform, PowerShell, Python, Git, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines to enable repeatable infrastructure provisioning and change delivery. * Develop governed self\-service capabilities for common cloud and infrastructure requests, with appropriate approvals, security guardrails, ownership, and cost controls. * Integrate platform workflows across Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Network, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Operations, and external technology partners without displacing existing service ownership. **Measurement, FinOps, and Continuous Improvement** * Instrument end\-to\-end service delivery processes to measure processing time, wait time, handoffs, rework, fulfillment performance, and service\-level outcomes. * Analyze delivery metrics, user feedback, and operational trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and demonstrate measurable gains in efficiency and quality. * Collaborate with Cloud Engineering and financial stakeholders to improve cloud cost visibility, tagging and allocation, utilization, right\-sizing, and consumption accountability through FinOps practices. * Drive continuous improvement and Kaizen through documentation, technical guidance, reusable patterns, and knowledge sharing that increase engineering capacity and platform adoption. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of progressive experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or related enterprise IT disciplines. * Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, hybrid infrastructure integration, and cloud infrastructure services, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and access management. * Practical experience designing and maintaining infrastructure as code, automated provisioning, reusable engineering patterns, and CI/CD delivery workflows. * Proficiency with technologies such as Terraform, PowerShell, Python, Git, APIs, and enterprise automation tooling. * Experience collaborating across Cloud, Infrastructure, Network, Development, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Architecture, and Operations to deliver secure and supportable services. * Understanding of platform security guardrails, change governance, observability, resiliency, backup, and production operational readiness. * Ability to define and use workflow measures, service\-level indicators, and operational data to identify bottlenecks and drive measurable improvement. * Working knowledge of FinOps principles, including cost visibility, resource allocation, utilization, right\-sizing, and cloud consumption optimization. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical outcomes without direct management authority. * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Relevant Azure, Terraform, DevOps, or cloud certifications are a plus. **WHY A QUALIFIED PROFESSIONAL SHOULD PURSUE THIS JOB** If you enjoy building practical engineering solutions, connecting teams, and improving how technology services are delivered, this role offers an opportunity to shape Cloud Platform Engineering capabilities and make a measurable impact across Trader Joe’s IT. Our IT team is a tight\-knit, highly skilled group of professionals dedicated to aligning technology strategy with business goals. We foster a high\-performance culture focused on stability, reliability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and solutions that support our stores and the Crew Members who serve our customers. **We want to hear from you!** We get a lot of resumes; so to help us get to know you better, please submit your resume and cover letter. When creating your cover letter, please answer these questions:* What is your favorite Trader Joe's product and why? * What makes you uniquely qualified for this position? *Trader Joe's is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to hiring a diverse Crew.*

jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Developer

As an AI \& Process Automation Developer, you’ll help turn business needs into secure, reliable automation and AI solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how work gets done. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, building practical technology, and learning alongside experienced developers, architects, and business partners. **What you’ll do** ================== In this role, you’ll help design, build, test, deploy, and support enterprise automation and AI solutions. You’ll also partner with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, assess automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. **What you bring** ================== We’re looking for a hands\-on developer who combines solid programming and integration experience with a practical understanding of AI and automation. You can move an idea from requirements through testing and support while asking thoughtful questions and working well with both technical and business partners. **This role is a great fit if you have:** **Required Experience:** * 2\+ years of foundational experience with AI or automation technologies such as RPA, workflow automation, conversational AI, intelligent document processing, or an equivalent platform. * 3\+ years of experience using source control, CI/CD processes, and modern software development tools. * 1\+ years of automation development, systems integration, or related experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting technical solutions. * 2\+ years of experience with REST APIs, SQL, JSON, XML, and system integration concepts. * 3\+ years of experience with Python, Java, React JavaScript, Node.js, or similar programming languages. **Required Skills:** * Develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain automation solutions using reusable components and established development practices. * Build and support integrations using APIs, databases, services, and enterprise connectors. * Use source control and CI/CD practices to manage reliable software changes across environments. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, workflow diagrams, specifications, deployment instructions, and support documentation. * Apply unit, integration, and regression testing practices and support User Acceptance Testing. **Education/Certifications required within one year:** * UiPath Advanced Developer Professional Certification. * Kore.AI Automation AI / XO Platform, Kore.AI Agent AI, \& Kore.AI Agent Platform Builder advanced training or developer certification. You should also be comfortable working within Agile delivery, SDLC, DevSecOps, secure coding, change management, and enterprise governance standards, while collaborating closely with senior developers and cross\-functional partners. **What sets you apart** ======================= **You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role:** * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 2\+ years of experience working within Agile development teams. * 2\+ years of exposure to cloud\-based platforms, services, and development environments. * 2\+ years of experience in financial services, healthcare, government, or another regulated industry. * Curiosity about emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI. **What you’ll get** =================== We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. **In this role, you can expect:** * Meaningful work that improves operational efficiency and supports a better member experience at Truliant Federal Credit Union. * Hands\-on opportunities to build across automation, integrations, conversational AI, and emerging AI technologies rather than being limited to one type of solution. * Collaboration with experienced developers, architects, and business partners who can help you strengthen both your technical skills and business understanding. * A team environment that values secure, maintainable solutions, thoughtful problem\-solving, continuous learning, and high\-quality service. **Ready to Apply?** =================== If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! As a member of the Truliant family, you will enjoy the following full time benefits: * No\-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage * Prescription benefits (including mail order) * Paid holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with contribution matching * Paid community involvement volunteers hours * Paid group life Insurance * Teammate loan discounts * Tuition reimbursement * Short and long\-term disability * Health \& Wellness program * Teledoc (physician video conferencing) * Onsite fitness facilities or health club reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Medical flexible spending account * Dependent care flexible spending account

jobs.title: Head of Hardware Engineering
jobs.description: **About Tutor** We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human\-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in\-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. **The Role** Tutor is hiring a Head of Hardware Engineering to lead the team that designs and builds our robots. Mechanical, electrical, firmware and embedded, and manufacturing engineering all report to this role. You set the hardware roadmap with the CTO, you grow the team, and you are responsible for every robot we ship working as designed and building at the rate we need. You report to the CTO. The hardware organization will grow a lot, in people and in the range of products it covers. The person in this role builds the teams that make that happen, hires the people who lead them, and keeps the whole thing running well as it gets bigger. ### **Requirements** * You have led and grown a hardware engineering organization to 50 or more people, and shipped a complex electromechanical product in volume through it * You have led mechanical, electrical, and firmware or embedded engineers, and can hire and judge all three * You have owned manufacturing engineering, or worked closely enough with it to build that team: process, test, fixtures, and design for manufacturing * You have developed the managers who lead teams under you * You have worked closely with a technical founder or CTO ### **Nice to haves** * Robotics, actuators, or motion control * Leading engineers in more than one country * Taking a product from first prototype to production at rate * Working with contract manufacturers and overseas suppliers ### **Benefits** * **Fully employer\-covered health insurance**, so you’re protected without the premium. * **A managed 401(k)** to help you plan for the future. * **Generous time off:** unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * **Regular in\-office meals** and team social events throughout the year. **About Our Roles \& Titles** Everyone in our R\&D organization, including the people who lead it, holds the title Member of Technical Staff (MoTS). Our job postings use standard titles so you can find us. If you join Tutor, you'll be a MoTS who runs hardware engineering. Head of Hardware Engineering is how you'll be known outside the company, because building the team means being legible to the people you're recruiting. In an ideal world everyone here would simply be a MoTS; external titles exist only where the outside world needs them. **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $250,000 to $350,000, depending on experience. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. *Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

Individual accommodations are available on requests for applicants taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Information obtained during this process will only be shared on a need to know basis. ### **About Us** Since 1945, U\-Haul has been serving do\-it\-yourself movers and their households. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there. **The Role** Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time. You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone, and then you'll build what their launch needs. Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one\-off. It becomes a core product that we sell to the next ten customers. That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer. **What You'll Do** * **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site. * **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side. * **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires. * **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first\-class platform features. * **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching. * **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money\-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen. * **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into. **Who You Are** * **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer\-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production\-grade, full\-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it. * **You're AI\-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us. * **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover. * **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't. * **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward\-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured. **What Success Looks Like** * Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works. * The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten. * Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge. * You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means. * You're an early member of a function we're building the company around. **How We Work** We run on three principles: * **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you. * **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos. * **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it. Location: NYC or Denver About Us: We're a recruiting, staffing, and placement company for Startups. Please submit your resume. If you're a good fit, we will connect you directly with our client who is hiring for this role. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there. **The Role** You'll be joining a lean, high\-intensity engineering team at an inflection point, processing billions in volume today. You'll work directly with our CTO, contributing full\-stack from week one. **1\. Building Infrastructure That Moves Money** You'll work on the core systems that power global payments. State machines, transaction pipelines, reconciliation flows. Accuracy is non\-negotiable when money is on the line, but so is the ability to build systems that adapt as the financial landscape evolves. You'll own features end\-to\-end, think carefully about failure modes, and write code you're proud to put your name on. **2\. Shaping the Product** You're not just implementing tickets. You'll collaborate closely with our CTO, BD team, and directly with customers to evolve our API and platform, making complex financial flows feel intuitive for the developers and businesses building on top of us. If you see a better way to build something, you'll say so. If a tradeoff matters, you'll surface it. We want engineers who think like owners. **3\. Setting the Bar** As an early engineering hire, you'll have an outsized influence on how we build. The patterns we establish, the standards we hold, the culture we cultivate. We believe quality engineering lives at the intersection of theory and experimentation. Think rigorously, ship decisively. You'll help define what that looks like in practice. **Who You Are** You're **a strong individual contributor who works well across the full team.** You don't need someone looking over your shoulder. You take ownership of your work end\-to\-end, communicate honestly about timelines and constraints, and never let something fall through the cracks because it wasn't technically "your problem." You're **comfortable with the full stack.** You have at least 4\+ years shipping production\-grade infrastructure with Node and NestJS (or something comparable) and React with TypeScript. You're proficient building client facing APIs and asynchronous backend systems with complex state machines (event queuing, job scheduling, webhook delivery, failure recovery, and so on). You move fluidly between frontend and backend depending on what the problem requires. You care about design and have high standards for what you ship. Not just whether it works, but whether it feels right. You're **built for startups.** You know what it means to operate in an environment with high ambiguity and real stakes. You move fast, make good decisions under uncertainty, and find energy in the challenge rather than frustration in the chaos. You've worked in a high\-growth environment before, or you're deeply ready for one. You're **obsessed with correctness and resilience.** Moving money globally means the margin for error is low. You think carefully about edge cases, error handling, and what happens when things go wrong, because they will. You love a good state machine. You appreciate systems that are both robust and easy to reason about. You're **curious about what we're building.** You don't need to come from a fintech background, but you should be genuinely interested in stablecoins, global payments, and the financial infrastructure being rebuilt around them. The engineers who thrive here see the mission as part of the appeal, not just the tech stack. **What Success Looks Like** * **You're shipping meaningful features from week one**, contributing to our platform and API with minimal ramp\-up time * **The systems you build are reliable, readable, and maintainable**, with code that the team is proud of and that scales with us * **You've raised the bar** through the patterns you introduce, the reviews you give, and the standards you hold * **You've become a key voice on engineering decisions**, someone our CTO relies on when it matters Location: NYC or Denver About Us: We're a recruiting, staffing, and placement company for Startups. Please submit your resume. If you're a good fit, we will connect you directly with our client who is hiring for this role. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI & Business Platforms
jobs.description: Do you want to build the system a whole company runs on, not one more feature in someone else’s product? Do you use AI coding tools every day, and still read every line before it ships? Would you rather spend an hour watching how a warehouse actually works than a week guessing from a requirements document? United Material Handling (UMH) is looking for a Principal Software Engineer, AI \& Business Platforms to take technical ownership of UMH\-os, our internal operating system, and UMH Connect, our distributor partner portal. The foundation is already in place: Azure infrastructure, single sign\-on, CI/CD, a design system, an approved catalog of applications across ten departments, and a written blueprint. Our CEO has been building much of it himself with Claude Code. Now we need a professional engineer to own it, build it out, and run it. You will work directly with the CEO, ship to production in your first two weeks, and build AI agents that produce real proposals for real distributors. **KEEP READING IF:** **YOU ARE A BUILDER WHO SHIPS.** You measure progress in working software that people use, not in plans. You like small, frequent releases, and you can take a feature from a conversation on the warehouse floor to production in days. When you inherit code, you assess before you rewrite, fix what is fragile, and leave alone what works. **YOU ARE SERIOUS ABOUT AI IN PRODUCTION.** You have put LLM agents into production, not just demos, and you know the hard part is evaluation, logging and guardrails, especially when an agent is putting prices on a proposal. You treat AI coding tools as power tools, not authors, and you can explain every line in production no matter who or what wrote it. **YOU ARE THE ENGINEER THE BUSINESS TRUSTS.** You can sit with a buyer, a warehouse lead or the CFO, figure out what they actually do, write it down in plain English and get their sign\-off before you build. You push back with a reason and an alternative, and once a decision is made, you commit. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES MAY INCLUDE:** **In the first 30 to 60 days and ongoing:** * Learns the business: tours our Corona headquarters and Moreno Valley distribution center and sits with Sales Operations, Supply Chain, Operations and Finance to see how work gets done. * Reads the UMH\-os codebase, standards and blueprint end to end, and delivers a written assessment of what to strengthen first. * Ships a first production change within two weeks and takes ownership of the deployment pipeline. * Agrees a clear working split with our IT Administrator, who owns accounts, devices and user support. **By the third month and ongoing:** * Reviews and approves every change to UMH\-os and UMH Connect before production, including work from AI tools and outside partners. * Takes a major new application, starting with Order Management, from specification to daily use. * Tightens the engineering standards so AI\-written code comes out consistent the first time. * Becomes the technical owner of our outside development partners. **By the sixth month and ongoing:** * Runs one shared agent runtime for both platforms, with evaluation, logging and guardrails. * Launches UMH Connect with pilot distributors, including a proposal agent and a proposal check agent. * Connects Fellow, Dialpad and Microsoft 365 activity to Salesforce so customer records stay current automatically. * Recruits and leads a small nearshore engineering team if the work calls for it. **By the twelfth month and ongoing:** * Brings order management into UMH\-os, with job costing, WIP and field time capture under way. * Documents the platform well enough that a new engineer ships within two weeks of joining. * Plans the next stage of our ERP roadmap with the CEO. **EDUCATION, SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including 3\+ years leading or architecting production business applications, required * Expert TypeScript, React and Node.js, required * Microsoft Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Entra ID) and GitHub Actions CI/CD, required * Relational data modeling and SQL for operational workflows, required * LLM agents or tool\-calling features shipped to production (Claude, Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry; MCP or similar), required * Integrations with Salesforce, Microsoft Graph and an ERP, required * Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, required * Application security fundamentals, including securing an external portal, required * Experience as one of a small number of engineers owning a platform end to end, required * Microsoft Dynamics NAV or Business Central experience, preferred * Salesforce platform development, preferred * Manufacturing, distribution or logistics experience, preferred * Experience leading remote or nearshore engineers, a plus * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience **WHO WE ARE:** United Material Handling is a pallet rack manufacturer, distributor and warehouse automation integrator headquartered in Corona, California, with a distribution center in Moreno Valley. We serve customers through three channels: direct storage solutions, resellers and distributors, and automation integrators. We are growing fast, and we are building our own systems to scale with us. **THIS OPPORTUNITY WILL OFFER THE RIGHT INDIVIDUAL:** * The chance to architect the operating system of a growing company: orders, projects, supply chain, finance approvals, hiring, budgeting and a partner portal, all on one platform. * Real AI work on a modern stack, connected to a live CRM, ERP and CPQ, with leadership that uses these tools daily and invests in them. * A direct line to the CEO, decisions in days rather than quarters, and work the whole company sees. * A growth path to leading a small team and the platform as it scales. This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Corona, California, with two to three days per week on site and the rest remote. Occasional visits to our Moreno Valley distribution center are part of the job. Travel beyond that is limited, at up to 10 percent. **OUR HIRING PROCESS:** We use a structured process: a screen with Employee Experience, an interview with the hiring manager, a hands\-on work sample using our real codebase and AI tools, and a final conversation with leadership. The work sample takes about three hours and needs no preparation.

œuvre des solutions techniques clés * Rechercher et mener de l’avant des méthodes pour améliorer la performance et la fiabilité * Promouvoir des méthodologies standards auprès des développeur(euse)s jobs.title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ You will find our weaknesses before someone else does. Unity's attack surface spans the engine and editor that developers build on, the client runtime shipped in games played by billions of people, a broad portfolio of cloud products and services, a large ads and monetization business, our corporate environment, and a fast\-growing set of AI\-assisted and agentic tools. Your job is to attack all of it the way a real adversary would, and to turn what you find into fixes that stick. This is not a checklist pen\-testing role. You will plan and run realistic attack campaigns, chain small weaknesses into real impact, and explain clearly to engineers and leaders what an attacker could actually do and what matters most to fix. You will work closely with Product Security, Infrastructure Security, Security Operations, and engineering teams, and you will help build the tooling and automation that let a small offensive team cover a very large surface. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Adversary emulation and red teaming**: plan and run objective\-based red team operations against our cloud, corporate, and production environments, modeled on threats relevant to Unity. Run purple team exercises with Security Operations to test and improve detection and response. * **Application testing**: deep security testing of Unity products and services, including web applications and APIs, the engine, editor and client runtime, ads and monetization systems, and developer\-facing platforms. * **Cloud and infrastructure attack paths**: find and demonstrate attack paths across multi\-cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure), Kubernetes and containers, CI/CD pipelines, identity, and secrets. * **AI and agentic systems**: test LLM integrations, AI\-native products, and agent workflows for issues such as prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, and excessive permissions. * **Findings to fixes**: write clear, prioritized findings with realistic impact, work with owning teams on remediation, and retest to confirm fixes. * **Offensive tooling and automation**: build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation that scale adversarial engineering, testing and turn repeated findings into continuous checks. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- * A risk\-based testing plan across Unity's highest\-value targets, agreed with security leadership and the owning engineering teams. * Several end\-to\-end red team or adversary emulation operations completed, each with clear findings, executive\-ready readouts, and tracked remediation. * Measurable improvements in detection from purple team exercises with Security Operations. * Reusable tooling or automation that turns recurring classes of findings into continuous checks. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **Required** * 6\+ years in offensive security (red teaming, penetration testing, purple teaming, or vulnerability research), including leading engagements end to end. * Hands\-on experience attacking cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including identity, Kubernetes and containers, and CI/CD. * Strong web application and API security testing skills, with the ability to find logic flaws, not just scanner results. * Solid scripting or programming ability (for example Python, Go, or C/C\+\+) to build tools and exploits. * Experience running adversary emulation or red team operations against realistic objectives, and working with defenders in purple team exercises. * Clear written and verbal communication. You go after real impact, not volume of findings, and you know the difference between an issue that matters and one that only looks bad in a report. You operate safely in production, with clear rules of engagement. You automate what you do twice. You build trust with engineering teams so they want you involved early, and you hold a high bar on getting fixes done. jobs.title: Associate Director - Career & Experiential Learning (Engineering)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Associate Director of Career \& Experiential Learning for Engineering \& Technology leads the development and delivery of pathway\-based career and experiential learning support for students pursuing careers across engineering, technology, computing, data science, and related technical fields. Working in close partnership with the School of Engineering and Career Advancement \& Engagement, the Associate Director integrates career coaching, experiential learning, faculty and academic engagement, and industry knowledge into a cohesive student experience. The position helps students understand the breadth of career possibilities available to them, develop industry\-relevant skills and experiences, and progress intentionally from early exploration through internships and full\-time employment. The Associate Director serves as a primary bridge between Career Advancement \& Engagement and the School of Engineering, partnering with faculty, academic advisers, departments, alumni, employers, and student organizations to reduce fragmentation and create a more coordinated career\-development experience for engineering students. A particular emphasis of the role is integrating career development and experiential learning earlier in the student journey. The Associate Director will help students use projects, research, employer engagement, internships, and other experiences to explore career possibilities, develop professional capabilities, and make informed career decisions well before graduation. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** **Engineering \& Technology Pathway Development** * Lead the development and execution of career pathways supporting students across engineering, technology, computing, data science, and related technical fields. * Develop pathway\-specific career preparation strategies reflecting the different professional opportunities associated with Vanderbilt's engineering disciplines. * Help students understand both traditional engineering careers and emerging opportunities in technology, product development, AI, entrepreneurship, consulting, and other fields employing technical talent. * Monitor industry trends, recruiting practices, emerging occupations, and skill requirements and translate these developments into student preparation. Partner with academic departments to clarify career possibilities and strengthen connections between academic preparation and professional outcomes. * **Career Coaching \& Student Development** * Provide high\-level individual and group coaching to undergraduate and graduate engineering students. * Help students explore career possibilities, articulate interests and goals, and develop intentional plans for gaining relevant experience. * Support students in translating technical coursework, research, projects, leadership, and other experiences into compelling professional narratives. * Prepare students for technical and behavioral interviewing, networking, recruiting processes, and other industry\-specific expectations. * Develop milestone\-based programming that helps students progress from exploration through experiential learning, internship attainment, and full\-time placement. Work particularly closely with students in disciplines where career pathways may be less visible or recruiting pipelines less established. * **Experiential Learning Integration** * Integrate experiential learning into engineering career development beginning early in the student lifecycle. * Partner with faculty, academic programs, employers, alumni, and Career Advancement \& Engagement colleagues to connect students with internships, projects, research, employer challenges, hackathons, company visits, and other applied experiences. * Help students use experiential learning as a means of testing possible career directions and developing industry\-relevant capabilities. * Connect existing School of Engineering experiential opportunities to broader career development pathways. Collaborate closely with the Associate Director for Employer \& Industry Development to identify student needs that can be addressed through new employer\-sponsored experiences. * **Faculty, Academic \& School of Engineering Partnership** * Build strong working relationships with School of Engineering faculty, academic advisers, program leaders, and department leadership. * Serve as a Career Advancement \& Engagement liaison and embedded partner to the School of Engineering. * Partner with departments to identify gaps in student career preparation and develop coordinated solutions rather than duplicative programming. * Engage faculty as important members of students' career ecosystems while ensuring they are supported rather than expected to serve as career advisers. Identify opportunities to integrate career exploration, Life Design, employer exposure, and professional development into existing academic and co\-curricular experiences. * **Employer, Alumni \& Ecosystem Alignment** * Collaborate closely with the Associate Director for Employer \& Industry Development to ensure employer\-development priorities reflect student interests and academic strengths. * Engage alumni and industry professionals as mentors, speakers, advisers, and sources of career insight. * Support employer\-facing programs that connect students directly with practitioners and organizations. Help create a connected engineering career ecosystem involving students, faculty, alumni, employers, academic advisers, and Career Advancement \& Engagement. * **Outcomes \& Assessment** * Track student engagement, experiential\-learning participation, internship attainment, and full\-time placement outcomes. * Identify gaps in outcomes by engineering discipline, degree level, career pathway, or student population. * Use student, faculty, employer, and alumni feedback to continuously improve pathway programming. * Monitor emerging career fields and changing skill requirements affecting engineering and technology students. Contribute to assessment and reporting on Engineering \& Technology pathway performance and student success. * **Supervisory Relationships:** This position reports administratively and functionally to the Senior Director of Engineering \& Technology Career Pathways and works in close partnership with leadership, faculty, and staff in the School of Engineering. The position collaborates extensively with the Associate Director for Employer \& Industry Development, Career Advancement \& Engagement colleagues, academic departments, alumni, employers, and other university partners. **Education and Certifications** Bachelor’s degree is necessary. Advanced degree in business, engineering, technology, or a related field preferred. **Experience and Skills** * 5–8\+ years of experience in engineering, technology, career development, experiential learning, university\-industry engagement, student development, recruiting, or a related field is necessary. * Demonstrated understanding of engineering and technology career pathways and the professional opportunities available to technically trained students is necessary. * Experience advising, mentoring, teaching, recruiting, or developing students or early career technical talent is necessary. * Demonstrated ability to develop experiential learning or career\-development programs is necessary. * Ability to build effective relationships with students, faculty, academic leaders, alumni, employers, and university partners is necessary. * Strong communication, facilitation, coaching, and program\-development skills are necessary. jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: AI Solutions Engineers are the hands of the AI program. You embed beside a business team, understand their work deeply, and rewire it with AI — then hand the result over and measure the win. This is not a help desk and not a build queue: you're an elite generalist deployed to the highest\-value friction in the company, owning problems end\-to\-end, from discovery sessions to the working solution to the story of what it saved. Primary Job Duties 1\.Discover \& record. Embed with a team, shadow and record how the work actually gets done, and find the high\-volume, high\-friction, rules\-heavy workflows worth rewiring. 2\.Define the SOP before AI. Make the current process explicit — you can't improve what you haven't written down. 3\.Engineer the AI\-driven SOP — human\-in\-the\-loop. Redesign the workflow around AI, keeping review and approval checkpoints wherever judgment, risk, or client trust require them. AI drafts; humans own. 4\.Build the assets. Turn the redesign into reusable capability — prompts, playbooks, harness workflows, automations (n8n / ChatGPT / Claude / agentic tooling), and small bespoke apps or integrations. You'll be able to work with developers as complex scenarios arise. 5\.Capture the win. Help employees log board\-grade wins in the AI Wins Tracker, convert their hurdles into wins, and package repeatable patterns into the shared playbook / prompt library for other teams. 6\.Clear the path. Partner with IT, security, and infrastructure on access, connectors, and permissions; escalate recurring blockers into infrastructure and policy asks. 7\.Create the moments people remember. Notice the task someone dreads and build the thing that makes it disappear — the tailored touch that produces trust and success. 8\.Business \& Customer workflows — operations across TFS, Class Action, Restructuring, and customer\-facing teams: document and case work, claims, proposals, correspondence, support. 9\.Internal \& Technical workflows — automation, reporting, data plumbing, and agentic development /QA enablement for the technical teams. jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Camera Firmware Platform
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries. ### **About the Team** The Camera Firmware Platform team owns the foundation that every Verkada camera runs on. While our product firmware teams bring new camera categories to market, this team makes every camera in the fleet, both existing and future models, more reliable, faster, leaner, and more power\-efficient. * **Edge Storage:** We own the on\-camera storage stack that turns every Verkada camera into a self\-contained recording device. Our mandate is reliable, accessible, secure, and observable storage of customer video. Footage is preserved instantly across SD cards and raw NAND, even during network outages or sudden power loss, for millions of cameras and petabytes of video. This extends to the backend services that manage retention, cloud backup, and storage health across the fleet. * **Firmware Platform:** Building on that foundation, we own the cross\-cutting firmware systems underneath every camera feature: boot and shutdown, memory and power management, system state orchestration, IPC, observability, and firmware update. We build these once, for every camera model and SoC, so product teams can move fast without rebuilding the same infrastructure. ### **About the Role** As the Engineering Manager for Camera Firmware Platform, you will lead a highly technical team of storage and embedded systems engineers responsible for the reliability, performance, power, and stability of firmware running on a fleet of more than 1\.8 million perpetually online devices. You will set the storage and platform roadmap, decide which fleet\-wide investments matter most, and turn them into measurable improvements in footage retention, storage endurance, boot time, memory headroom, power draw, and crash rates. You will partner closely with the Camera Firmware product team, Hardware, Streaming, Computer Vision, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Manufacturing, and Product. You will also work with Verkada Linux, the shared OS layer across all Verkada product lines, to incubate platform capabilities on cameras and contribute them back for use across the company product lines. This role combines deep technical leadership with people management. We are committed to a thriving in\-office culture, and this role requires onsite presence at our HQ in San Mateo, CA. ### **What You'll Do** **Lead the team** * Lead and grow a team of storage, firmware, and systems engineers, and recruit and retain top\-tier embedded talent as the team expands its charter. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, career development, and execution management. * Define the technical vision and multi\-quarter roadmap for camera storage and firmware platform, balancing fleet\-wide investments against support for new camera launches. * Establish engineering best practices around testing, observability, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and long\-term maintainability. **Drive storage optimizations** * **Storage stack and architecture:** Own the on\-camera storage stack end to end, including filesystems (ext4, UBIFS), video layout and indexing, SD/eMMC drivers, and raw NAND. Lead next\-generation storage architecture such as new SD card modes, partition\-level encryption, and secure deletion of expired footage. * **Reliability, endurance, and retention:** Guarantee footage integrity through power loss, filesystem corruption, and failing media. Minimize write amplification with aligned, batched writes, and extend retention through index compression, smarter SD card capacity allocation, and better high versus low\-quality stream storage. * **Storage observability:** Build deep storage observability of SD and NAND health, erase counts, bad blocks, UBI counters, writes per hour, and retention metrics that feed release go/no\-go decisions. * **Testing:** Build hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing for storage disaster cases health, crash rates, memory pressure, boot time, and power, and make them visible in release go/no\-go decisions. * Find and fix issues before customers notice them, using diagnostic data from across the fleet. ### **What You Bring** * BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience in embedded or systems software, including 2\+ years leading or managing high\-performing systems, storage, platform, or infrastructure teams. * Experience designing storage systems for continuous, high\-throughput write workloads, such as video recording. * Strong expertise in systems programming in C/C\+\+; experience with Go or other higher\-level languages preferred. * Hands\-on experience profiling and optimizing system\-level performance, memory, and power on resource\-constrained devices. * Experience designing concurrent userspace services and IPC mechanisms (shared memory, sockets, message queues) and reasoning about their trade\-offs. * Experience debugging complex OS or storage issues in production, across large deployed fleets. * Demonstrated success driving technical strategy and aligning multiple teams around shared platform investments. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across Hardware, Firmware, Backend, and Product. * Willingness and ability to work onsite five days per week. **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with Linux kernel fundamentals and device drivers * Experience with storage fundamentals: NAND flash behavior, filesystem fault tolerance, SD/eMMC protocols, partition tables, write amplification, and power\-loss protection. * Experience with camera or video SoCs (e.g., Ambarella), ISP/DSP pipelines, or video encoding. * Experience building firmware update, fleet observability, or device management systems for millions of IoT devices. * Experience with cloud infrastructure and backend systems. * Experience with hard drives and RAID (e.g., mdadm, ZFS), SMART monitoring, or building NAS/NVR products. ### **US Employee Benefits** Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to: * Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well\-being needs \- Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans * Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage * Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee's 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary * Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options * Expanded mental health support * Paid parental leave policy \& fertility benefits * Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time * Professional development stipend * Wellness/fitness benefits * Healthy lunches provided daily * Commuter benefits ### **Additional Information** * We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa. ### **Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer** As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. *Your application will be handled in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Policy**.*

jobs.title: Process Engineer - CNC
jobs.description: ***Process Engineer – CNC \| TxV*** Enjoy solving machining challenges and seeing your ideas take shape on the shop floor? At TxV Aerospace Composites in Rhode Island, you’ll be part of a small, close\-knit team working on interesting thermoplastic composite processes. You’ll put your CNC and 5\-axis CAD/CAM skills to work developing toolpaths, proving out setups, and taking new parts into reliable production. Working alongside operators, Quality, and Engineering, you’ll tackle practical problems, improve 3\- and 5\-axis machining processes, and see the difference your work makes. ***What you’ll do*** * Develop, prove out and optimise 3\- and 5\-axis CAD\-CAM programmes, tooling, fixtures, work holding and machine set\-ups. * Support new product introduction, providing manufacturing input into component design and transferring processes into production. * Work with Production and Quality to troubleshoot machining issues, meet drawing and quality requirements, and improve process capability, cycle times and scrap levels. * Take ownership of assigned manufacturing cells, including safety, maintenance, calibration, controlled documentation and operator training. * Support equipment procurement, commissioning and validation, ensuring processes meet safety, AS9100 and change\-control requirements. ***What you’ll bring*** * Hands\-on experience of 3\- and 5\-axis CNC machining and CAD\-CAM programming is required, including programme prove\-out and process optimisation. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models and tolerances, with practical knowledge of cutting tools, machining parameters and fixture design. * Strong troubleshooting, structured problem\-solving and communication skills, with an understanding of lean manufacturing, process control and safe working practices. * Manufacturing engineering experience in a CNC environment is preferred. Recent engineering graduates may be considered where they can demonstrate relevant CNC, CAD\-CAM or internship experience. ***Useful additional experience*** Experience with thermoplastic composites, AS9100, new product introduction, equipment commissioning or automation would be advantageous, as would knowledge of SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Mastercam or comparable software. A relevant engineering degree or equivalent manufacturing experience is preferred; recognised CNC qualifications, CAD\-CAM certification and Chartered Engineer status are desirable. **About Victrex** Victrex is an innovative world leader in high\-performance PEEK (Poly Ether Ether Ketone) and PAEK (Poly Aryl Ether Ketone) polymer solutions focusing on the strategic markets of automotive, aerospace, energy and industrial, electronics and medical. Every day, millions of people use products and applications containing our materials – from smartphones, aeroplanes and cars to energy operations and medical devices. With over 40 years‘ experience, we are developing world leading solutions with PEEK and PAEK\-based polymers and selected semi\-finished and finished parts which enable environmental and societal benefit for our customers and our markets and drive value for our shareholders **Vision and culture** At Victrex, we have a clear purpose: to deliver transformational and sustainable solutions that address global material challenges. Our core values of passion, innovation, and performance are at the heart of everything we do. We are a company that thrives on human\-centred leadership, valuing curiosity, adaptability, and collaboration in a fast\-paced, digitally enabled world. We believe in empowering individuals, rather than seeing barriers to progress. We are looking for individuals who are comfortable working in an environment that values digital and AI\-driven solutions, who see technology as an enabler rather than a challenge. At Victrex, we foster a culture of continuous learning, agility, and adaptability, where employees are encouraged to embrace new ways of working, leverage data\-driven insights, and drive meaningful change. As we continue to evolve, we need people who are not just contributors but change accelerators … individuals who champion innovation, and drive transformation with a growth mindset. Whether through digitalisation, process improvement, or human\-centred leadership, our employees play a crucial role in shaping the future of our business. Our leadership approach is built on empowerment, inclusion, and collaboration. We value people who lead with empathy and authenticity, fostering a workplace where diverse perspectives and ideas can thrive. We work hard to ensure that our teams are engaged, motivated, and equipped to navigate an ever\-changing landscape. Sustainability is core to our strategy. We are committed to reducing our environmental footprint while supporting society through our sustainable products and making a positive impact on our local communities. We are proud to be recognised as a ‘Disability Confident’ employer and to be voted as one of the best places to work by ‘The Sunday Times’ in 2024! Our aim is to provide the support of accessibility and community within Victrex for everyone. So, if you need any help, advice or just want a confidential chat regarding any Diversity, Equity or Inclusion matters even before you apply to Victrex, then here is what you need to know: The enabling support that Victrex prides itself on giving, starts from when anyone applies or wants to apply to join our team. We are always here to help provide any ‘reasonable adjustments’ you may need during your application process. So please contact us to discuss your specific requirements in more depth. We even have a dedicated email that anyone can use to reach out for help, advice, and a confidential chat......whatever you need to know, and to help ensure an equitable solution, that’s right for you, right from the start! That email is: **enablerecruitment@victrex.com** **Victrex values diversity and encourages applications from all sections of the community.**
