jobs.title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay\- Visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200\+ countries. As a Software Development Engineer on the Product Reliability Engineering (PRE) team, you won’t just watch those systems run\- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them. PRE is not a traditional ops team. We are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. You’ll write Python, build agentic AI tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real\-time transactions. From day one, you are an engineer\- and from day one, your work matters. If you are endlessly curious about how large\-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you. **Build Automation That Scales** * Design and ship end\-to\-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves. * Write clean, production\-grade Python (and Go or Bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self\-managing. * Develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle. **Manage \& Evolve Data Platforms** * Support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure. * Gain exposure to real\-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale * Perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier\-1 production databases. * Optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, CPU usage, and replication latency. * Automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like Ansible and Liquibase, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines that govern schema changes through TEST and PROD environments safely. * Build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management. * Integrate LLMs into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, AI\-driven intelligence. * Contribute to prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position PRE as one of the most AI\-forward reliability organizations in financial technology. **Own Observability \& Platform Health** * Build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK that give engineers real\-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems. * Analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur. * Contribute to self\-healing and auto\-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention. **Engineer for Reliability \& Security** * Ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud\-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale. * Support zero\-downtime deployment strategies and high\-availability architectures that Visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock. * Participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first\-class engineering concern. **Collaborate, Learn \& Grow Fast** * Embed within Agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global PRE peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions. * Document runbooks, SOPs, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time. * Participate in on\-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; December 2025 graduates welcome). * Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design \-you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes. * Proficiency in Python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (Go, Java, or Bash). * Foundational understanding of relational databases (RDBMS): SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and meaningful command\-line fluency. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained. * Genuine curiosity about GenAI platforms and agentic systems (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar)\- hands\-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must. **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi \-even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship. * Experience with database CI/CD tooling, particularly Liquibase for schema change management across environments. * Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or Datadog. * Database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring. * Familiarity with Git workflows and modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). * Academic or project experience with ML frameworks: scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain / LangGraph. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, service mesh, or TCP/IP. * A GitHub profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open\-source contribution that shows us how you think and build. **Information for US Applicants** Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: **Company Description** Vuori is re\-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. We draw inspiration from an active coastal California lifestyle; an integration of fitness, creative expression and life. Our high energy fast paced retail environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm and purpose…while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity and for personal growth and success. **Job Description** As a Principal AI Engineer specializing in Agentic Systems, you will own designing, building and scaling AI\-powered applications, agentic systems and intelligent tooling that enhance how Vuori operates. Partnering closely with business and technology leaders, you will identify high\-value opportunities, develop production\-ready AI solutions, and drive the adoption of capabilities that improve efficiency, augment decision\-making and streamline complex business processes. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, systems thinking and cross\-functional collaboration. You will set Vuori's AI platform strategy, develop reusable AI services, orchestration patterns and engineering standards, while building autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop solutions that empower teams across the organization. From AI assistants and workflow orchestration to multi\-agent systems and custom AI applications, you will be at the forefront of defining how AI creates value at Vuori. You will combine deep technical expertise with business acumen to deliver solutions that create measurable impact for employees, customers and business operations. **What you'll get to do:** *Set direction and raise the bar* * Define the evolution of Vuori's AI platform and technical standards as the AI ecosystem continues to mature. * Raise the technical capability of engineers across Vuori through review, pairing, and tooling others adopt because it is good rather than because it is mandated. * Make the build\-versus\-buy calls that shape the AI platform for years, and defend them. * Bring clarity to problems before they are well defined, including saying clearly when a workflow should not be agentic at all. * Establish engineering best practices for AI development, testing, evaluation, monitoring, observability and reliability. * Implement governance, security and guardrails to ensure responsible and trustworthy AI solutions. *Build and ship* * Design, build and deploy AI\-powered applications, intelligent agents and agentic workflows that solve high\-impact business challenges. * Develop systems that leverage planning, reasoning, memory and tool usage to automate and augment complex business processes. * Integrate LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs and business systems to deliver end\-to\-end AI experiences. * Build and maintain scalable agent orchestration, RAG and knowledge retrieval architectures. * Prototype emerging AI capabilities and rapidly translate concepts into production\-ready solutions. *Partner and measure* * Partner with business and technology leaders across the organization to identify opportunities where AI can drive measurable business value. * Monitor solution performance, measure business impact, and continuously improve outcomes through data and feedback. **Qualifications** **Who you are:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent years of experience preferred. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building and operating production AI systems. * Demonstrated experience building and operating agentic systems in production environments \- planning, reasoning, memory and tool\-calling. * Demonstrated experience designing and implementing AI evaluation frameworks, testing methodologies and production monitoring to validate solution accuracy, reliability, safety and business performance in real\-world operational environments. * Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building APIs, backend services and cloud\-native applications. * Deep experience with modern LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks, and the judgment to choose between them rather than fluency in any one. * Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and business systems. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. *Preferred Qualifications* * Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings and enterprise knowledge retrieval systems. * Experience with low\-code and pro\-code enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Agent 365 or Copilot Studio. * Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with AI observability, governance, security and compliance frameworks. * Familiarity with MLOps, model lifecycle management and AI deployment pipelines. * Experience in retail, direct\-to\-consumer, ecommerce or a similar consumer operating environment. * Demonstrated passion for emerging AI technologies and applied innovation. **Additional Information** **Our investment in you:** At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees: * Health Insurance * Savings and Retirement Plan * Employee Assistance Program * Generous Vuori Discount \& Industry Perks * Paid Time Off * Wellness \& Fitness benefits The salary range for this role is $197,500 per year \- $264,390 per year. This role is bonus eligible. Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on\-the\-job training program, and tuition reimbursement\-available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week. We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees. Senior Cloud Engineer ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT: The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback. This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi\-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on\-call support rotation.**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Responsible for day\-to\-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud\-based systems. * Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on\-call rotation with other cloud engineers. * Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates. * Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers. * Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on\-premises operations. * Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance. * Other duties as assigned by the supervisor * All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance. Incumbent is expected to demonstrate each of the following VyStar Excellence behaviors in performing the duties and responsibilities of their job: * Focus \- Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member. * Connect \- Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care. * Understand \- Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule). * Counsel \- Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives. * Advance \- Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded. * Verify necessary follow\-up actions. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS** ====================== **Education** * This position requires a 4\-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education. **Experience** * 5 \- 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft\-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry). * 3\+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment * Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are required. * Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices * Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025\). * Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus. * Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes * Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. * Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus. * Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language. * Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus. * Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps * Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages. * Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN. * Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud. * A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus. * A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams. **DISCLAIMERS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** Nothing in this position description is an implied contract for employment. The position description is intended to be an accurate account of the essential functions. The functions are not all encompassing and are subject to change at any time by management. The work environment characteristics described are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. As required or requested, may exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. **VyStar Credit Union is not seeking outside assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or search firms for employment or contractor opportunities. Any resumes submitted by an outside vendor to any employee at VyStar via e\-mail, internet, or directly to hiring managers without a valid written search agreement with the Talent Acquisition / HR department will be deemed the sole property of VyStar Credit Union.** **No placement fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of the referral, or through other means.** Thank you for your inquiry regarding our current job opening. Your resume will be carefully reviewed against the position requirements. Should your experience and skills match, you will be contacted by one of our Human Resources department staff members. Thank you again for your interest in this position! *VyStar Credit Union Human Resources*

jobs.title: Software Controls Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Join us as our newest Software Engineer II and make code that even our telescopes admire!** Are you someone who genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays?” Do you ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego? Do you communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something? Do you appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome? If so, apply to be our newest Software Engineer II! **What the Software Engineer II Does:** The Software Engineer II spends their days turning ideas into clean, reliable, scalable software—preferably without summoning any new and exciting bugs. They work with friendly humans across multiple engineering disciplines to transform napkin sketches and ambitious brainstorms into real, working features. They review code (theirs and others’) in a way that is constructive, kind, and ideally free of passive\-aggressive comments. They have room to stretch into new areas, experiment with tools they’re curious about, and grow their technical and professional chops along the way. They may also use previous robotics or control systems experiences to understand what design tradeoffs that may exist when updating our software systems implemented in EPICS (Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System). Tapping into any knowledge or previous experiences with motors and electric drives, embedded systems, or DFx would also help out greatly. In this role the Software Engineer II genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays.” They ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego. On a daily basis they communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something. They appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome.### **Why Choose W. M. Keck Observatory:** * Competitive starting salary * Generous benefits package, including 4 weeks of annual paid vacation * A robust 8% 403(b) employer contribution (with a 4% employee contribution) * Tuition assistance for dependent children grades K\-12 attending private school on Hawai’i Island * Comprehensive, employer provided health insurance * We offer relocation support for candidates moving from outside the area. * Be a part of a dedicated team working on the frontiers of astronomy. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or other relevant engineering or science field * 3\-7 years of experience in developing code used for observing tools, data tools, and/or general software development * Practical experience creating software applications with Python * Software applications with hardware interfaces * Practical experience of change control, build and release management processes * Unix/Linux shell scripting * Experience with communication protocols (RS\-232/485/422, SPI, I2C) * Broad knowledge of modern software engineering practices, especially in areas of re\-use and testability * Good knowledge of database design * TCP/IP networking * Fundamental operating system administration * Competency in C/C\+\+, Python, databases * User interface development with Java, Qt, React, or other GUI toolkits * Competency using O\-O paradigm and design patterns ### **About W. M. Keck Observatory** At the W. M. Keck Observatory, we approach our work with wonder about the mysteries of the universe and with deep respect and care for Maunakea – a mountain revered in Hawaiʻi and unlike any other in the world. For more than three decades, astronomers using Keck Observatory’s twin 10\-meter telescopes have vastly expanded our understanding of the cosmos through astonishing findings about our solar system, exoplanets, supermassive black holes, the evolution of the universe, and more. We are dedicated to the values of service and stewardship, while advancing the frontiers of astronomy, sharing our discoveries, and inspiring the imagination of all.

jobs.title: Integrated Solutions Release & Configuration Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Summary:** The Integrated Solutions Release \& Configuration Engineer serves as the subject matter expert for release and configuration management across integrated Digital Intelligence solutions. This role is responsible for defining, maintaining, and improving the processes, controls, and technical baselines that govern software, specifications, interfaces, requirements, and deployment artifacts across multiple constituent systems. Working independently and leading through influence, the position partners with Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Quality, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Field Services to ensure integrated solutions are released with traceability, consistency, and operational readiness. The role provides technical leadership on release planning, configuration integrity, audit readiness, and lifecycle governance while driving continuous process improvement and best practices across the organization. **Experience \& Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * Typically 8\+ years of experience in release management, configuration management, systems engineering, DevOps, product lifecycle management, or a related technical discipline. * Demonstrated experience managing software and documentation baselines throughout an engineering lifecycle. * Experience coordinating complex, multi\-product releases across cross\-functional engineering organizations. * Working knowledge of configuration management standards and practices, including SAE EIA\-649, ISO 10007, IEEE 828, or equivalent frameworks. * Experience with requirements and lifecycle management tools such as IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management (DOORS Next), Polarion, Jama Connect, or similar platforms. * Experience with source control, build, and release tools including Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or equivalent solutions. * Experience with PLM, document control, and service management platforms such as Teamcenter, Windchill, SharePoint, or ServiceNow. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across a matrixed environment. * Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, establish best practices, and lead initiatives with limited guidance. * Experience in transportation, industrial automation, safety\-critical systems, or other regulated industries preferred. * Advanced degree and/or certifications such as PMP, INCOSE CSEP, CMII, ASQ CQE, ITIL, or SAFe preferred. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the execution and continuous improvement of release and configuration management processes for integrated solutions spanning multiple products and systems. * Establish and maintain configuration identification and baseline definitions for software, requirements, specifications, interfaces, architecture artifacts, test assets, deployment packages, and supporting documentation. * Maintain traceability across requirements, constituent\-system versions, interface revisions, change records, verification evidence, and deployed configurations. * Facilitate solution\-level change control and release readiness activities, ensuring technical impacts, dependencies, risks, and deployment considerations are appropriately evaluated. * Develop and coordinate integrated release plans that align delivery schedules, dependencies, version compatibility requirements, and deployment readiness across participating product teams. * Manage controlled release and distribution of technical specifications, requirements, interface definitions, architecture documentation, verification artifacts, and release records. * Partner with engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and testing teams to verify release candidates satisfy established technical, quality, and compliance requirements. * Publish and maintain authoritative release manifests, solution Bills of Materials (BOMs), compatibility matrices, configuration records, and deployment documentation. * Conduct configuration status accounting, audit preparation, and configuration verification activities to ensure released solutions align with approved baselines. * Support deployment readiness, release authorization activities, rollback planning, post\-release validation, and reconciliation of field changes into controlled baselines. * Analyze release, deployment, and configuration issues; lead root\-cause investigations; and drive corrective actions to improve release quality and configuration integrity. * Mentor project teams on configuration management, release management, traceability, and lifecycle best practices while promoting automation and process standardization across the organization. You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary. Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met. \#LI\-AM1 **Additional Information** Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $104800\-149300 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible. **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?** At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. **Who are we?** Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Platform
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career. Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency\-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student\-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: Grade: Technical 412 Pay Range: $180,300\.00 \- $279,500\.00**Job Description** **Make an Impact** WGU’s Student Experience team builds the digital experiences that help working adults balance education, careers, and family responsibilities. We are creating a conversational AI platform that empowers students, staff, and applications to accomplish meaningful work through secure, intelligent experiences grounded in WGU systems and data. As Principal Software Engineer, AI Platform, you will architect and build this platform from the ground up. You will shape retrieval, inference, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation, security, and API capabilities that enable teams across WGU to create trusted AI\-powered experiences. This is a hands\-on product engineering role focused on delivering scalable, secure, and observable AI solutions. You will establish the technical foundations, standards, and platform capabilities that other engineering teams will leverage as they build the next generation of AI\-driven products. **What You'll Do** * Architect and build a conversational AI platform that supports retrieval over WGU content and data, inference integration, orchestration, tool calling, conversation state management, and multiple application experiences. * Own the platform’s security and privacy model, ensuring retrieval, generation, and tool execution are authorization\-aware and maintain strict student data protections aligned with FERPA requirements. * Build guardrails and governance capabilities including input and output filtering, escalation workflows, prompt injection resistance, audit logging, and explainability controls. * Establish evaluation and observability frameworks that measure groundedness, quality, latency, reliability, and cost across AI\-powered systems. * Define MCP servers, tool contracts, APIs, templates, libraries, and reference implementations that enable engineering teams to build AI\-powered workflows securely and consistently. * Design, build, test, operate, and modernize production services, APIs, integrations, and interfaces using modern software engineering practices in a Java and Angular environment on AWS. * Provide technical leadership through architecture guidance, mentoring, documentation, operational excellence, and production support. **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production web applications and services. * Demonstrated experience owning architecture across multiple teams or systems and defining platforms, shared services, or standards used by other engineering teams. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying LLM\-powered applications in production environments, including retrieval augmented generation (RAG), tool or function calling, and evaluation of AI system performance. * Experience designing APIs and integration contracts consumed by internal and external engineering teams within complex enterprise environments. * Production experience with at least one server\-side programming language such as Java, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, C\#, or Go. * Proven ability to influence and partner across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and business stakeholders while remaining a hands\-on technical contributor. **Experience in lieu of education:** equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as one year of experience for one year of education and is at the discretion of the hiring manager. **Bonus Points** * Experience building MCP servers or clients, agent orchestration frameworks, AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, evaluation platforms, LLM observability solutions, or AI safety testing capabilities. * Experience designing authorization\-aware retrieval systems, multi\-tenant data isolation, identity and access management solutions, SSO, OIDC, SAML, or systems handling FERPA, HIPAA, or similarly regulated data. * Experience with Java, Angular, AWS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, application modernization initiatives, conversational interfaces, higher education technology, student information systems, or online learning platforms. **What to Expect** At WGU, our mission drives everything we do, including how we hire. Our interview experience is designed to give qualified candidates the opportunity to show their best work through meaningful conversations and collaboration. We thoughtfully review every application and invite forward the candidates whose experience and potential best align with the role and our mission. * Hiring Manager interview * Senior Manager, Software Engineering interview * Senior Solutions Architect interview **Work Location** This is a full\-time, in\-office position requiring five days per week in our Salt Lake City, Utah office, designed to foster the collaboration and connection that fuel our best work. **Travel Requirement** This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business\-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements. \#LI\-SB1 **Position \& Application Details** Full\-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full\-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave. It’s not all\-inclusive. jobs.title: AI & Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse’s mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace. ### **About the role:** As a Manager, AI \& Software Engineering you will lead the AI \& Software Engineering team within Data \& AI, made up of AI/software engineers and UI/UX designers. The team designs production\-grade AI applications (including standalone bertha™), agent\-based workflows, Technology Bricks and user interfaces for Westinghouse and its customers. You will deliver the team's AI and software commitments and for developing the team. You will report to the Director, AI Delivery and work a hybrid/mobile role based in Cranberry, PA. ### **Key Responsibilities:** **AI application and agent engineering:** Develop and deliver AI applications and agent\-based workflows, including business logic, orchestration, integrations and user interfaces. Ensure commitments are delivered on time, on budget and to the required quality. **Estimation and prioritization support**: Prepare estimates, scope assumptions and capability needs for potential new developments and commercial projects. Data \& AI leadership prioritizes the portfolio and support proposals and customer commitments. **Code quality, security and maintainability:** Ensure code quality, application security, application\-level monitoring and reliability. Produce the technical documentation required for maintainability and governance, and improve findings. **Human–AI experience**: Define and apply UX and interaction guidelines so that AI solutions give users safe experiences. **Collaboration with AI \& Data Infrastructure:** Work with the leadership of the AI \& Data Infrastructure teams to build applications within the approved architecture, platforms, AI models, data architecture and deployment environments owned by those teams. Contribute application requirements and feedback, and raise application\-driven architecture and technology needs to them. Architecture decisions remain with those teams. **Engineering standards**: Apply the common AI Software Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC) across the team, including code review, CI/CD, test automation, documentation and Definition of Done. Ensure work uses the approved technology stack and follow the exception process, and that the team applies secure\-by\-design practices and Westinghouse software quality requirements. **Innovation Process**: Provide the engineering inputs and deliverables required for Technology Bricks and AI projects managed under the Westinghouse Innovation Process and Stage Gate Reviews (BMS\-RT\-3\). **Team capacity and growth:** Plan team capacity against the prioritized portfolio, and propose and manage engineer assignments within Data \& AI capacity governance. Scale the team as demand grows by defining hiring needs, leading recruitment and onboarding, and engaging contractors and third\-party companies when needed, while keeping critical knowledge and intellectual property within Westinghouse. **People leadership and development:** Lead the team, overseeing goal setting, performance management, recognition and succession. Mentor team members through coaching, mentoring, career plans and upskilling or reskilling in AI engineering, so that software engineers grow into AI engineering roles. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related discipline required. Master's degree with a focus on AI/ML helpful * 8\+ years in software engineering, including at least 3 years delivering AI, ML or GenAI solutions to production. 3\+ years leading engineering teams, including hiring and growing teams. * Azure or Google Cloud certifications helpful **Generative AI**: LLM integration, RAG and GraphRAG, agentic AI frameworks, tool use and MCP\-based integrations, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation. **Machine learning:** Understanding of ML models and how to integrate and consume them within applications. **Software engineering**: Python, APIs, front\-end and back\-end development (e.g., React/MUI), UX design (e.g., Figma), Docker and containers, and CI/CD. Data: working knowledge of databases and data platforms, including MongoDB, Databricks and lakehouse architectures. We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $130,400 to $163,000 per year. \#LI\-Hybrid **Why Westinghouse?** **Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:** * Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options * Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well\-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members * 401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement * Paid Vacations and Company Holidays * Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work\-life balance * Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers * Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service * Employee Referral Program **Westinghouse Electric Company is the global nuclear energy industry's first choice for safe, clean, and efficient energy solutions. We enable our delivery of this vision by living our value system:** * Safety and Quality * Integrity and Trust * Customer Focus and Innovation * Speed and Passion to Win * Teamwork and Accountability **While our Global Headquarters are located in Cranberry Township, PA, we have over 11,000 employees working at locations in 19 different countries. You can learn more by visiting** http://www.westinghousenuclear.com. Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities

jobs.description: **Schedule:** Generally Monday\-Friday, during regular business hours **About the role:** Windstar Technologies, Inc. is seeking a Web Designer and Developer to build and maintain client websites, adapt and publish marketing content, and improve website usability and search visibility. You will support a portfolio of approximately 15 existing websites and contribute to new website projects. Most work will involve WordPress and Elementor, along with HTML\-based websites and AI\-assisted development tools. This role is open to early\-career applicants who can show practical website skills, clear writing, and careful attention to detail. Personal, school, freelance, and volunteer projects are welcome. You will work directly with clients and carry out content and website priorities set by marketing and the CEO. Marketing resources provide most blog and social content in draft form; your work will emphasize adapting, editing, formatting, and scheduling it, with occasional original writing. Code and production changes follow our review and approval process. **What you will do:** \- Design and build responsive WordPress websites, pages, and landing pages using Elementor, approved brand guidelines, and client requirements. \- Maintain existing WordPress and HTML\-based websites, updating layouts, navigation, text, images, links, forms, and other content. \- Coordinate WordPress core, theme, plugin, and PHP updates through managed hosting tools and approved maintenance procedures. Check compatibility, document results, and escalate complex errors or unfamiliar code changes. \- Test changes in staging and confirm backup and recovery options before production updates. Check important pages, forms, links, mobile layouts, and integrations after changes, including automated updates. \- Adapt, edit, format, and schedule marketing\-supplied blog articles and social media posts for Windstar and selected clients. Check business details, factual claims, links, images, tone, brand consistency, and relevant SEO fields; obtain approval before publication. Write occasional website copy or additional content as needed under the approved strategy and editorial calendar. \- Implement on\-page SEO improvements, including page titles, headings, internal links, image optimization, and approved redirects. Monitor website and search performance and recommend practical improvements. \- Apply foundational answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) concepts through useful content, clear page structure, accurate business information, and approved search optimization practices. \- Use approved AI tools to assist with coding, code review, troubleshooting, content, and documentation. Inspect and test changes after AI\-assisted review, protect client information, and submit code for CEO review before production changes. \- Improve usability, accessibility, and performance, including readable layouts, keyboard\-friendly navigation, appropriate image text alternatives, and efficient images. \- Gather client requirements, explain progress clearly, manage assigned requests, and keep accurate records of changes, testing, approvals, and outstanding issues. **Required qualifications:** \- Practical WordPress experience and website samples demonstrating page design, responsive layouts, or useful website improvements. Professional experience is welcome but is not required when relevant project work demonstrates your skills. \- Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, including the ability to edit existing code and troubleshoot common layout problems. \- Basic JavaScript knowledge and familiarity with how WordPress themes, plugins, and PHP affect website behavior. Sound judgment about when additional technical review is needed. \- Clear writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to adapt supplied material into accurate, readable content for its intended audience. \- Foundational understanding of SEO and awareness of how useful, well\-structured content supports search and AI\-assisted discovery. \- Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to explain, check, and test the work produced with them. \- Professional client communication, organization, attention to visual detail, and reliable follow\-through on assigned work. \- Ability to work in person in Culpeper, Virginia. **Preferred qualifications:** \- Experience with Elementor or another WordPress page builder and managed WordPress hosting tools. \- Familiarity with staging, backups, deployments, Git, browser developer tools, and basic PHP troubleshooting. \- Experience with search performance tools, web analytics, structured data, local SEO, or conversion tracking. \- Familiarity with accessibility, performance testing, image editing, or design mockup tools. \- Experience adapting and publishing blog or social content, maintaining an editorial calendar, or tailoring approved messaging for different audiences. A specific degree or certification is not required. We will evaluate your practical skills, portfolio, writing, and ability to learn. **How to apply** Submit your resume, one or two website examples, and a short writing or edited\-content sample. Personal and school projects are acceptable. Briefly describe your contribution to each example and how you used templates, page builders, supplied content, or AI tools. You may provide screenshots or a demonstration project when client work is confidential. Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

Operating at the highest tier of individual contribution, you define the long\-term vision, core execution standards, and multi\-quarter roadmaps for a mission\-critical infrastructure portfolio, ensuring our platforms are structurally positioned to support Workday's hyper\-growth trajectory. You resolve high\-level technical ambiguity, mitigate existential architecture risks, and lead complex multi\-team transformations to deliver data\-as\-a\-product assets at scale. We are at the center of Workday's AI\-forward operating model, defining and governing the structural use of DataOps, Data Product, and Active Data Governance frameworks across the enterprise ecosystem. We provide the overarching operational blueprints for embedding advanced AI capabilities into our continuous delivery lines, building language model solutions and automated workflows that safely power autonomous workloads. Concurrently, we lead the transition to an AI\-first workforce, designing division\-level agent networks inside Sana and Gemini environments to automate routine tasks, manage technical debt, and multiply organization\-wide delivery velocity. **Key Responsibilities** * **Technical Delivery** : Serve as the preeminent technical authority defining the long\-term vision, core execution standards, and multi\-quarter architecture blueprints for a mission\-critical enterprise cloud infrastructure portfolio. Govern global platform administration paradigms and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) architecture standards and, CICD pipelines, mentoring senior engineers and establishing foundational infrastructure modules across the organization * **Knowledge Management** : Establish and govern function\-wide knowledge synchronization standards and "Documentation as Code" paradigms across the global DevOps and Analytics Engineering job families to ensure enterprise architectural clarity * **Incident Response \& Operational Resilience** : Mitigate existential infrastructure and architecture risks across the global enterprise. Design high\-scale zero\-trust data reliability parameters and predictive platform telemetry layers to guarantee unbroken data platform uptime during hyper\-growth cycles * **Agile Operational Facilitation:** Sponsor and chair cross\-functional technical review boards to align technical direction across competing business segments. Drive complex multi\-team infrastructure transformations, navigate platform migration blocks, and manage capital resource planning * **ED\&A Methodologies** : Establish and govern the core operational blueprints for embedding DataOps and Active Data Governance principles directly into our master software continuous delivery pipelines * **AI Productivity** : Pioneer the implementation of an AI\-first workforce strategy by building division\-level agent networks and automated scripts natively inside Cursor IDE, Sana, and Gemini tracks to automate code refactoring, system validation, and portfolio tracking at an enterprise scale **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of professional technical leadership experience in DataevOps, DevOps, cloud automation, program management, or platform engineering tracks within enterprise data and analytics. * 12\+ years of experience in managing and scaling a suite of interrelated data platform products, cluster configurations, and C platform environments and manage complex asset lifecycles * Operational Communication \& Collaboration: Superior capacity to successfully navigate high\-pressure corporate environments and complex technical landscapes to secure functional consensus across competing business units, acting as an active change agent and thought leader for the DevOps and engineering communities Open to 50% hybrid reporting to Pleasanton campus * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE:** Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders. **WHO YOU ARE:** Zinnia is looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join our Enterprise API \& CIAM team. Our Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platform handles authentication and fine\-grained authorization for carriers, distributors, agents, policyholders, and service integrations across Zinnia Live, Market Connect, and our TPA services. You'll extend and scale this production platform by building new identity flows, evolving our authorization model, and helping product teams across Zinnia integrate securely. You'll work closely with the CIAM tech lead, product management, and security and compliance partners in a regulated insurance environment. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Build and evolve authentication flows, including workforce SSO federation (SAML/OIDC), passwordless login for agents and consumers, and machine\-to\-machine access for service integrations. * Design and implement fine\-grained authorization that combines role\-, attribute\-, and relationship\-based access control (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC) to scope access by carrier, product, distributor, hierarchy, and delegation. * Build automated provisioning and lifecycle handling so access stays current as users are onboarded, transferred, given delegated access, or terminated. * Design, document, and maintain the CIAM APIs that other Zinnia teams consume. * Partner with product teams to onboard new applications onto our CIAM integration pattern. * Own the quality and reliability of what you ship through automated testing, code review, observability, and on\-call participation. * Work with security and compliance teams to implement access controls, support audits, and keep every access decision logged and explainable. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED:** * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, including building and operating production services in the cloud (AWS preferred). * Hands\-on experience implementing OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML, including federation with external identity providers. * Experience with a CIAM platform such as Auth0 (preferred), Okta, or PingOne. * Experience designing authorization systems beyond basic roles, such as attribute\- or relationship\-based models. * Strong backend skills in TypeScript/Node.js, or a comparable language, with solid fundamentals in API design, testing, and software design. * Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers, and monitoring and alerting. * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with engineers, product managers, and security partners across a distributed team. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. **BONUS POINTS:** * Experience with OpenFGA, Auth0 FGA, or other Zanzibar\-style authorization systems. * Experience with event\-driven architectures (Kafka/Confluent), API gateways (Kong), MongoDB, Terraform, or Datadog. * Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, especially agent and distributor hierarchies, licensing and appointments, or delegated access. **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?** Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, 401(k), incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We're looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. *We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.* Notice for California residents: Information about how we collect and use your personal information can be found***here*** \#LI\-JW1

jobs.title: Network Engineer I or II
jobs.description: Job Description Zions Bancorporation’s Enterprise Technology and Operations (ETO) team is transforming what it means to work for a financial institution. With a commitment to technology and innovation, we have been providing our community, clients and colleagues the best experience possible for over 150 years. Help us transform our workforce of the future, today. We are seeking a Network Engineer I to join Zions Bancorporation. The Network Engineer I plays a key role in maintaining the reliability, performance, and security of our enterprise network infrastructure. Working under normal supervision and in close partnership with senior engineers, you will gain hands\-on experience troubleshooting network connectivity, supporting hardware lifecycle deployments, and monitoring critical infrastructure across our enterprise environment. This role offers an exceptional runway for a motivated technologist looking to expand their networking fundamentals into enterprise\-scale routing, switching, and operational excellence while actively growing toward advanced engineering roles. **The Network Engineer I will:** **Monitoring \& Operational Support :** Proactively monitor enterprise network health, performance metrics, and alerts to maintain high uptime, identifying and resolving basic network incidents. **Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution:** Diagnose and resolve Tier 1/2 connectivity issues across local and wide\-area networks (LAN/WAN), routing/switching equipment, and related network services. **Hardware \& Configuration Support:** Assist senior engineers with provisioning, racking, cabling, testing, and deploying network switches, routers, access points, and peripheral devices following standard operating procedures. **Change Management \& Maintenance:** Support planned maintenance activities, hardware refreshes, and software/firmware patching in accordance with enterprise change management processes. **Documentation \& Asset Management:** Maintain accurate network diagrams, procedural documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and hardware inventory within the configuration management database (CMDB). **Project Support \& Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional IT and infrastructure teams to support project implementations, testing, and site deployments. **Continuous Learning:** Actively build technical proficiency across core enterprise technologies, network automation concepts, and industry\-standard best practices. Other duties as assigned **Requirements:** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Experience:** 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in network administration, network operations, or technical infrastructure support with a strong networking focus. **Core Networking Knowledge:** Strong foundational understanding of networking protocols and concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnets, VLANs, and basic routing/switching. **Hardware \& Operating Systems:** Familiarity with configuring, troubleshooting, and supporting enterprise networking hardware (e.g., Cisco or Arista switches, routers, and firewalls). **Troubleshooting \& Analytical Skills:** Demonstrated ability to methodically isolate, diagnose, and resolve technical hardware and software connectivity issues. **Communication \& Collaboration :** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical processes clearly and work collaboratively within a team. **Growth Mindset:** High motivation to learn emerging technologies, take ownership of assigned tasks, and advance technical skills within an enterprise IT environment. **Preferred Requirements:** Active Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification or actively pursuing/on track for CCNA certification. Familiarity with enterprise network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, ThousandEyes, Wireshark) and IT service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow). Exposure to basic scripting or network automation concepts (such as Python, Bash, or Ansible). **Visa Sponsorship:** This position is currently not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B visa). This includes, for example, situations where a candidate may have temporary work authorization while enrolled in school or upon graduation (e.g., CPT, OPT) but would need H\-1B visa sponsorship within a few years of employment in order to maintain employment eligibility. **Location:** This position is fully in office (5 days a week) at the Zions Technology Center—7860 South Bingham Junction Blvd, Midvale, UT 84047 The Zions Technology Center is a 400,000\-square\-foot technology campus in Midvale, Utah. Located on the former Sharon Steel Mill superfund site, the sustainably built campus is the company’s primary technology and operations center. This modern and environmentally friendly technology center enables Zions to compete for the best technology talent in the state while providing team members with an exceptional work environment with features such as: Electric vehicle charging stations and close proximity to Historic Gardner Village UTA TRAX station. At least 75% of the building is powered by on\-site renewable solar energy. Access to outdoor recreation, parks, trails, shareable bikes and locker rooms. Large modern cafe with a healthy and diverse menu. Healthy indoor environment with ample natural light and fresh air. LEED\-certified sustainable building that features include the use of low VOC\-emitting construction materials. **Benefits:** Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance \- START DAY ONE! Life and Disability Insurance, Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance Health Savings (HSA), Flexible Spending (FSA) and dependent care accounts Paid Training, Paid Time Off (PTO) and 11 Paid Federal Holidays 401(k) plan with company match, Profit Sharing, competitive compensation in line with work experience Mental health benefits including coaching and therapy sessions Tuition Reimbursement for qualifying employees Employee Ambassador preferred banking products Apply now is you have a passion for impactful outcomes, enjoy working collaboratively with co\-workers, and want to make a difference for the clients and communities we serve.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: ### **Location: US, Remote (Eastern Hours)** ### **About BOI** BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca\-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home. ### **Your Role** ### **Own the Technical Build** * Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment. * Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client. * Set the engineering standards every build meets: evaluation of AI outputs, security and data governance, observability, and production reliability. * Build the reusable components, patterns and internal products that let each engagement start further ahead than the last. ### **Lead with Clients** * Sit with client CTOs, CIOs and business executives as BOI's senior technical voice. Explain technical choices in terms of cost, risk and value, so non\-technical leaders can decide. * Lead client security, compliance and procurement reviews, and get our systems approved to run in their environments. * Work forward deployed: get into client environments early, build alongside their teams, and keep building as the relationship grows. ### **Shape What We Sell** * Scope and estimate builds for proposals with our Directors of Applied AI, so what we sell can be built on time and to standard. * Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership. ### **Build the Team** * Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously. * Run AI\-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example. * Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe. ### **What We Look For** We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities: * You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints. * You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project\-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose. * You've founded a company or been early at a startup. You can build the team as well as the system, and you make good decisions before everything is known. * You explain technical choices to non\-technical executives in plain language, and they leave the room ready to decide. ### **What We Offer** * You'll set the technical direction of a growing AI company and shape how BOI builds in every market we work in. * You'll build compounding skills at the frontier of AI while others are still catching up. * What your team builds goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates. * We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships. * You get the freedom to prototype, experiment, and push boundaries on what's possible with AI. ### **Benefits** We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working (if based out of NYC), professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high\-impact enterprise transformations. BOI is an equal opportunity employer: we celebrate diversity and welcome all backgrounds and identities.

jobs.title: Sr. Sales Engineer – Agentic AI for CX
jobs.description: As the global leader in AI\-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI\-powered channels. Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale. As enterprises race to deploy agentic AI, the defining question is no longer whether AI can handle customer interactions, it’s whether those interactions can be trusted. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers. Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better. ### **Let's talk about the role and responsibilities:** * **Ownership:** Own the technical sales engagement from first discovery through technical win. * **Discovery:** Lead deep discovery on customers’ CX tech stack, AI agents, quality and compliance risks, and success criteria. * **Solution design:** Design closed\-loop assurance solutions that test, monitor, and observe customers’ AI agents across their CX stack. * **Demos and workshops:** Deliver tailored demos, overviews, and workshops that connect the platform to customers’ AI agent quality and compliance goals. * **Proofs of concept:** Scope and run POCs that validate the platform against customer success criteria. * **Business case:** Quantify the cost of AI failure and the efficiency gained through assurance for executive buyers. * **Collaboration:** Partner with Sales, Product, and Implementation on RFPs, objections, and delivery handoff. * **Enablement:** Create reusable demos and materials, and mentor teammates on agentic AI technology and prompt engineering. ### **Let’s talk about your skills and expertise:** * **Pre\-sales experience:** 5\+ years in pre\-sales or solutions engineering with C\-level and VP\-level stakeholders. * **CX technology:** Solid understanding of the CX tech stack, including CCaaS, IVR, CRM, and digital channels. * **Agentic AI experience:** Strong, proven experience with how AI agents and agentic workflows are built, deployed, and behave in CX environments. * **AI technology:** Deep knowledge of the agentic tech stack: LLMs, RAG, tool calling, orchestration, and MCP. * **Prompt engineering:** Advanced prompt engineering skill, from reading agent system prompts to crafting adversarial test scenarios. * **AI observability:** Strong grasp of AI agent quality and compliance monitoring: evaluation, hallucination detection, and policy adherence. * **Closed\-loop assurance:** Understanding of how testing, monitoring, and observability combine so production failures feed new tests. * **Discovery and solutioning:** Exceptional ability to turn complex CX and AI requirements into sound technical solutions. * **Communication:** Credible storytelling that links technology to business outcomes for executive and technical audiences. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience. ### **Preferred experience:** * **AI agent platforms:** Familiarity with customer AI agent platforms such as Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Observe.AI, AWS, and Google. * **CCaaS Platforms:** Familiarity with platforms such as NiCE, Genesys, Five9, Talkdesk, AWS Connect, and others. * **Testing and monitoring:** Experience with CX testing, monitoring, or observability tools. * **AI governance:** Familiarity with compliance and risk for AI in customer interactions. This range indicates OTE. Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location.**Why you should join us:** Looking for a place where your ideas matter, your growth is accelerated, and your work creates real impact? Welcome to Cyara. We're building the assurance layer that gives enterprises the confidence to deploy agentic AI at scale with a global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Whether you're launching new ideas, solving complex problems, or learning from talented colleagues across the world, you'll be surrounded by people who challenge and support you to do your best work. At Cyara, inclusivity isn't a buzzword, it's part of who we are. We foster a culture where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to contribute. Pair that with competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, flexible work options, recognition programs, and a strong focus on employee well\-being, and you've got a workplace designed for both success and fulfilment. Big opportunities. Real impact. Amazing people. That's the Cyara experience. **Cyara’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusive and Belonging Statement:** At Cyara, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace that embodies equal opportunity and champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). We strive to cultivate an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, contributing unique perspectives and talents. Our commitment includes continuously evaluating and enhancing our policies, practices, and culture to align with our DEIB principles. We ensure a discrimination\-free environment where individuals are evaluated solely on their merits and abilities, regardless of legally protected statuses such as sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or medical condition. By celebrating our differences and championing inclusivity, we enrich our organization, make more thoughtful decisions, and drive collective success. **Cyara’s Values Statement:** At Cyara, our values shape everything we do. We're passionate about **Delivering Excellence** by putting the customer first, collaborating globally, and always striving to improve. We take smart risks and **Innovate Boldly**, setting new standards and learning from every experience. **Integrity First** is our cornerstone, we value humility, authenticity, and respect for diversity, building trust in all we do. We **Embrace Curiosity** by empowering you to experiment, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment. At Cyara, our values drive us forward, shaping a culture where innovation and excellence thrive. **Agencies:** Thanks, but we’ve got this one! Please, no phone calls or emails to any employees of Cyara outside of the Talent Acquisition team. Cyara’s policy is to only accept resumes from Agencies via the Cyara Agency Portal. Agencies must have a valid fee agreement in place, and they must have been assigned the specific requisition to which they submit resumes, by the Cyara Talent Acquisition team before submitting any CVs. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Cyara and, in the event, a candidate is submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid.
